snippets.title: Hide the Admin Bar for Subscribers
snippets.description: Hides the toolbar on the front of the site for anyone who cannot edit posts, such as subscribers and shop customers. Authors, editors and administrators keep it.
snippets.notes: Change edit_posts to another capability (for example manage_options) to hide the bar for more roles.

snippets.title: Custom Admin Footer Text
snippets.description: Replaces the "Thank you for creating with WordPress" line at the bottom of every admin screen with your own message.
snippets.notes: Edit $message. %s is replaced with the site name.

snippets.title: Remove the WordPress Version From the Admin Footer
snippets.description: Removes the "Version x.y" text from the right side of the admin footer. Useful for client sites and screenshots.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'update_footer', '__return_empty_string', 11 );

snippets.title: Hide Admin Menu Items From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes selected menu entries (Tools and Comments by default) for every user who is not an administrator, to keep the admin menu focused.
snippets.notes: Hiding a menu item does not remove the permission; users can still open the screen by URL if their role allows it.

snippets.title: Duplicate Posts and Pages
snippets.description: Adds a "Duplicate" link to the row actions of posts, pages and custom post types. It creates a draft copy with the same content, taxonomies and custom fields.
snippets.notes: WooCommerce products are skipped because WooCommerce has its own Duplicate action.

snippets.title: Show the ID Column in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Adds an ID column to the posts, pages and custom post type list tables so you can find IDs without hovering over links.

snippets.title: Featured Image Column in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Shows a small thumbnail of the featured image next to the title in post lists, for every post type that supports featured images.

snippets.title: Word Count Column for Posts
snippets.description: Adds a Words column to the Posts list showing the approximate length of each post.

snippets.title: Sortable Last Modified Column
snippets.description: Adds a sortable "Last Modified" column to the Posts and Pages lists so you can see which content was edited most recently.

snippets.title: Hide Core Update Notices From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Stops the "WordPress x.y is available" banner from showing to users who cannot update WordPress, so editors and authors are not distracted by it.

snippets.title: Set One Admin Color Scheme for Everyone
snippets.description: Applies the same admin color scheme to all users and hides the color picker on the profile screen. Handy for telling staging and production apart.
snippets.notes: Change modern to any built-in scheme name.

snippets.title: Remove the Help Tab From Admin Screens
snippets.description: Removes the contextual Help tab in the top right corner of admin screens.

snippets.title: Hide Screen Options for Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Hides the Screen Options tab for everyone except administrators, so other users cannot rearrange or hide admin panels.

snippets.title: Environment Badge in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Shows a colored LOCAL, DEVELOPMENT, STAGING or PRODUCTION badge in the admin bar for administrators, based on the WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE setting.
snippets.notes: Set the environment in wp-config.php, for example: define( 'WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE', 'staging' );

snippets.title: Replace the "Howdy" Greeting
snippets.description: Changes the "Howdy, name" text in the top right of the admin bar to a greeting of your choice.
snippets.notes: Edit $greeting.

snippets.title: Remove the WordPress Logo From the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Removes the WordPress logo menu (About WordPress, documentation and support links) from the left side of the admin bar.

snippets.title: Color Post Rows by Status
snippets.description: Tints draft, pending, scheduled and private rows in admin list tables so unpublished content stands out at a glance.

snippets.title: Remove Default Dashboard Widgets
snippets.description: Cleans up the Dashboard by removing the Quick Draft, WordPress Events and News, and Activity widgets.
snippets.notes: Other core widget IDs: dashboard_right_now (At a Glance), dashboard_site_health (Site Health Status).

snippets.title: Remove the Dashboard Welcome Panel
snippets.description: Removes the large "Welcome to WordPress" panel from the top of the Dashboard for all users.

snippets.title: Custom Dashboard Welcome Widget
snippets.description: Adds a Dashboard widget with your own message, such as instructions for clients or contact details for support.
snippets.notes: Edit the widget title and the two paragraphs.

snippets.title: Scheduled Posts Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Adds a Dashboard widget that lists the next ten scheduled posts of any type with their publish dates and edit links.

snippets.title: Show Custom Post Types in "At a Glance"
snippets.description: Adds published counts for public custom post types (portfolio items, products, events and so on) to the At a Glance Dashboard widget.

snippets.title: Remove the Site Health Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Removes the Site Health Status widget from the Dashboard. The Site Health screen under Tools still works.

snippets.title: Single Column Dashboard Layout
snippets.description: Forces the Dashboard into a single column for every user, which suits sites with only one or two widgets.

snippets.title: Use Your Logo on the Login Page
snippets.description: Replaces the WordPress logo on the login screen with your theme logo, your Site Icon, or an image URL you provide.
snippets.notes: Order of preference: the URL in $logo_url, the Customizer logo, then the Site Icon.

snippets.title: Link the Login Logo to Your Site
snippets.description: Makes the logo on the login screen link to your homepage and use your site name as its label, instead of pointing to WordPress.org.

snippets.title: Generic Login Error Message
snippets.description: Shows the same error for a wrong username and a wrong password, so the login form does not reveal which usernames exist.
snippets.notes: This replaces every login error, including messages about blocked cookies.

snippets.title: Send Non-Editors to the Homepage After Login
snippets.description: Users who cannot edit posts (subscribers, customers) land on the homepage after logging in instead of their admin profile. Staff still go to the dashboard.
snippets.notes: Replace home_url( '/' ) with any URL, for example home_url( '/account/' ).

snippets.title: Redirect to the Homepage After Logout
snippets.description: Sends users to your homepage after they log out instead of showing the "You are now logged out" login screen.

snippets.title: Check "Remember Me" by Default
snippets.description: Pre-ticks the "Remember Me" box on the login form so users stay logged in longer without having to remember to tick it.

snippets.title: Keep "Remember Me" Logins for 30 Days
snippets.description: Extends the login cookie to 30 days when "Remember Me" is ticked. Sessions without it keep the normal two-day lifetime.
snippets.notes: Change 30 to the number of days you want.

snippets.title: Log In With Username Only
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from accepting an email address in the login form, so only usernames work.

snippets.title: Log In With Email Address Only
snippets.description: Accepts only an email address and password on the login form. Usernames are rejected, which makes guessing logins harder.
snippets.notes: Do not combine with "Log In With Username Only", or nobody will be able to log in.

snippets.title: Hide the Login Language Switcher
snippets.description: Removes the language dropdown below the login form on sites that have extra languages installed.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'login_display_language_dropdown', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Block Password Resets for Administrators
snippets.description: Disables the "Lost your password?" flow for administrator accounts, which closes off reset-email based takeovers of the most powerful accounts.
snippets.notes: Administrators can still change their password from their profile, and another administrator or WP-CLI can reset it.

snippets.title: Brand Colors on the Login Page
snippets.description: Restyles the login screen with your own background, button and link colors.
snippets.notes: Edit the three color variables.

snippets.title: Track Last Login and Show It in the Users List
snippets.description: Records when each user last logged in and adds a sortable "Last Login" column to the Users screen.
snippets.notes: Logins are only recorded from the moment the snippet is activated.

snippets.title: Registration Date Column in the Users List
snippets.description: Adds a sortable "Registered" column to the Users screen showing when each account was created.

snippets.title: User ID Column in the Users List
snippets.description: Adds an ID column to the Users screen, which is handy when a plugin or shortcode asks for a user ID.

snippets.title: Allow Contributors to Upload Media
snippets.description: Lets users who can write posts but not upload files (the Contributor role) add images to their drafts. The role itself is not changed in the database.

snippets.title: Hide Administrators From Other Users
snippets.description: Removes administrator accounts from the Users screen for anyone who is not an administrator, for example shop managers on a WooCommerce site.
snippets.notes: The role counts above the list are not changed.

snippets.title: Social Profile Fields for Users
snippets.description: Adds LinkedIn, X and Instagram fields to the Contact Info section of user profiles, ready to show in author boxes.
snippets.notes: Read a value in your theme with get_the_author_meta( 'linkedin' ).

snippets.title: Redirect New Users After Registration
snippets.description: Sends people to a page of your choice (for example a welcome page) after they register through wp-login.php.
snippets.notes: Change /welcome/ to the path of your page.

snippets.title: Require a Minimum Password Length
snippets.description: Rejects new passwords shorter than 12 characters on the profile screen, the Add New User screen and the password reset form.
snippets.notes: Change 12 to your preferred minimum. WooCommerce account forms use their own strength meter.

snippets.title: Disable XML-RPC
snippets.description: Turns off the XML-RPC interface (xmlrpc.php), a common target for brute-force and pingback abuse. Use it when no app or service needs XML-RPC.
snippets.notes: The WordPress mobile apps and some services (for example Jetpack) rely on XML-RPC.

snippets.title: Hide the WordPress Version Number
snippets.description: Removes the generator meta tag and the version from feeds, so the exact WordPress version is not advertised in your page source.
snippets.code:
remove_action( 'wp_head', 'wp_generator' );
add_filter( 'the_generator', '__return_empty_string' );
snippets.notes: Hiding the version is not a replacement for keeping WordPress updated.

snippets.title: Remove the Core Version From Script and Style URLs
snippets.description: Strips ?ver= from front-end CSS and JavaScript URLs when it equals the WordPress version, hiding it from the page source. Plugin and theme versions are left alone.
snippets.notes: After a WordPress update, browsers may keep cached core files a little longer.

snippets.title: Block User Enumeration
snippets.description: Stops visitors from discovering usernames through ?author=N URLs, the public REST API users endpoint, the users sitemap and oEmbed data.

snippets.title: Restrict the REST API to Logged-In Users
snippets.description: Returns an authentication error for REST API requests from visitors who are not logged in, with an allowlist for routes your site needs publicly.
snippets.notes: Test forms, search and checkout after enabling. Plugins that call the REST API for visitors need their namespace in $public.

snippets.title: Disable the Theme and Plugin File Editors
snippets.description: Turns off the built-in Theme File Editor and Plugin File Editor screens, so a hijacked admin account cannot inject code through them.
snippets.notes: This only affects the WordPress core editors under Appearance and Plugins.

snippets.title: Send Basic Security Headers
snippets.description: Adds common HTTP security headers to front-end responses: nosniff, same-origin framing, a strict referrer policy and a restrictive permissions policy.
snippets.notes: If you embed your own pages in iframes on another domain, remove the X-Frame-Options line. Headers set by your server or CDN may override these.

snippets.title: Enable HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
snippets.description: Tells browsers to always use HTTPS for your domain for one year. Only enable it once the whole site, including subdomains you use, works over HTTPS.
snippets.notes: Browsers remember this header for the whole max-age, even if you disable the snippet later.

snippets.title: Disable Application Passwords
snippets.description: Removes the Application Passwords feature, which lets external apps authenticate to the REST API. Disable it if you do not use it.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wp_is_application_passwords_available', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Limit Failed Login Attempts
snippets.description: Temporarily blocks an IP address after 5 failed logins within 15 minutes. A lightweight brute-force guard with no settings screen.
snippets.notes: Behind a proxy or CDN, REMOTE_ADDR may be the proxy address; configure your server to pass the real visitor IP. Do not combine with another login limiter.

snippets.title: Email Alert When an Administrator Logs In
snippets.description: Sends an email to the site admin address every time an administrator account logs in, with the time, IP address and browser.

snippets.title: Prevent Installing New Plugins and Themes
snippets.description: Removes the ability to install or upload new plugins and themes for every user, while still allowing updates of what is already installed.
snippets.notes: Deactivate the snippet when you need to install something.

snippets.title: Restrict Unfiltered HTML to Administrators
snippets.description: Only administrators may save raw HTML such as scripts and iframes in posts. Editors get the same safe HTML filtering as authors.

snippets.title: Disable the Emoji Script and Styles
snippets.description: Removes the emoji detection script, inline styles and DNS prefetch that WordPress adds to every page. Browsers still display emoji natively.

snippets.title: Disable oEmbed Discovery and the Embed Script
snippets.description: Stops your site from acting as an oEmbed provider: removes the discovery links, the embed REST route and the wp-embed script. Embedding YouTube and similar services keeps working.
snippets.notes: Other WordPress sites will show a plain link instead of a rich card when they embed your posts.

snippets.title: Remove jQuery Migrate on the Front End
snippets.description: Drops the jQuery Migrate compatibility script from public pages. Only use it when your theme and plugins work with current jQuery.
snippets.notes: Check the browser console for jQuery errors after enabling.

snippets.title: Slow Down the Heartbeat API
snippets.description: Reduces admin AJAX traffic by running the Heartbeat API every 60 seconds instead of every 15 to 60, and turns it off on the front end.
snippets.notes: Post locking and login expiry warnings still work, just with slower updates. Remove the wp_enqueue_scripts part if a front-end editor needs Heartbeat.

snippets.title: Limit Post Revisions
snippets.description: Keeps only the five most recent revisions of each post, which stops the database from growing with old copies.
snippets.notes: Return 0 to disable revisions or -1 to keep all. Existing extra revisions are removed the next time a post is saved.

snippets.title: Change the Autosave Interval
snippets.description: Autosaves drafts every two minutes instead of every minute, in both the block editor and the classic editor.

snippets.title: Defer Selected Scripts
snippets.description: Adds the defer attribute to the front-end scripts you list by handle, so they no longer block page rendering.
snippets.notes: Only defer scripts that no inline script depends on immediately. Find handles with a plugin such as Query Monitor.

snippets.title: Remove Dashicons for Logged-Out Visitors
snippets.description: Stops the Dashicons icon font from loading on the front end for visitors, saving a request. Logged-in users still get it for the admin bar.
snippets.notes: If your theme uses Dashicons, they are still loaded as a dependency.

snippets.title: Clean Up the Page Head
snippets.description: Removes rarely used tags from the page head: RSD, Windows Live Writer manifest, shortlink, adjacent post links and the REST API discovery link.

snippets.title: Remove Block Styles on Classic Themes
snippets.description: Stops the block library, classic theme and global styles stylesheets from loading on the front end. For classic themes and page builders that do not use blocks.
snippets.notes: Content made with blocks will lose its default styling. Block themes are skipped automatically.

snippets.title: Preconnect to Third-Party Origins
snippets.description: Adds preconnect hints so the browser opens connections to external hosts (Google Fonts by default) earlier.
snippets.notes: Only list origins that every page actually uses.

snippets.title: Do Not Lazy-Load the First Images
snippets.description: Tells WordPress to skip lazy loading for the first three images on a page, which usually improves Largest Contentful Paint.

snippets.title: Prerender Links on Hover
snippets.description: Upgrades WordPress speculative loading (6.8+) from prefetch to prerender with moderate eagerness, so pages open almost instantly after a hover.
snippets.notes: Prerendering runs page scripts early; analytics tools that are not prerender-aware may count extra page views.

snippets.title: Disable Comments Completely
snippets.description: Turns comments off everywhere: closes comments and pings, hides existing comments, and removes the Comments menu, admin bar item and comment feed links.
snippets.notes: Existing comments stay in the database and come back if you deactivate the snippet.

snippets.title: Disable All Automatic Updates
snippets.description: Turns off every background update: WordPress core, plugins, themes and translations. For sites where updates are deployed by hand or through version control.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'automatic_updater_disabled', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: This also stops automatic security releases. Make sure you have another update process.

snippets.title: Disable Plugin and Theme Auto-Updates
snippets.description: Prevents plugins and themes from updating automatically and hides the auto-update toggles. Core security releases keep installing.

snippets.title: Disable RSS Feeds
snippets.description: Redirects every feed URL to the homepage and removes feed links from the page head. Useful for brochure sites and web apps that do not publish posts.

snippets.title: Disable Site Search
snippets.description: Turns search off: search URLs return a 404 page, the search form is emptied and the classic Search widget is removed.
snippets.notes: Search blocks placed in block themes still render; remove them from your templates.

snippets.title: Disable the Admin Email Check Screen
snippets.description: Stops the periodic "Administration email verification" screen that administrators see after logging in.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'admin_email_check_interval', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Disable Native Lazy Loading
snippets.description: Removes the loading="lazy" attribute WordPress adds to images and iframes. Use it when another plugin handles lazy loading or it conflicts with a slider.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wp_lazy_loading_enabled', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Disable the Admin Bar for Everyone
snippets.description: Hides the front-end admin bar for all users, including administrators. The admin area is not affected.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'show_admin_bar', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Disable Speculative Loading
snippets.description: Turns off the speculative prefetching of links that WordPress 6.8 adds to the front end, for sites with heavy pages or strict analytics.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wp_speculation_rules_configuration', '__return_null' );

snippets.title: Disable Tags for Posts
snippets.description: Removes the Tags taxonomy from posts: the Tags menu, the tag box in the editor and the tag column disappear.
snippets.notes: Existing tags stay in the database.

snippets.title: Stop Changing "Wordpress" to "WordPress"
snippets.description: Disables the filter that silently rewrites the spelling of WordPress in titles, content and comments, which can break URLs or quoted text.

snippets.title: Disable Self-Pingbacks
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from sending pingbacks to your own site when you link to your own posts, so they do not clutter the comment queue.

snippets.title: Remove the Website Field From Comments
snippets.description: Removes the Website (URL) field from the comment form, which discourages comments posted only to get a link.

snippets.title: Minimum and Maximum Comment Length
snippets.description: Rejects comments shorter than 15 characters or longer than 5,000 characters. Moderators are not limited.

snippets.title: Disable Pingbacks and Trackbacks
snippets.description: Closes pings on all content, removes the X-Pingback header and the XML-RPC pingback methods. Regular comments are not affected.

snippets.title: Move the Comment Box Below the Name and Email Fields
snippets.description: Reorders the comment form so visitors fill in their name and email before writing the comment, the order many themes used before WordPress 4.4.

snippets.title: Privacy Notice Above the Comment Submit Button
snippets.description: Adds a short note above the submit button explaining that the name, email and comment are stored, with a link to your privacy policy page if one is set.
snippets.notes: Set your privacy policy page under Settings > Privacy.

snippets.title: Close Comments on Media Attachments
snippets.description: Prevents comments on attachment pages, a frequent target for spam bots.

snippets.title: Honeypot Field for Comment Spam
snippets.description: Adds a hidden field to the comment form that people never see but many bots fill in. Comments that fill it are rejected before reaching the database.

snippets.title: Redirect to a Thank-You Page After Commenting
snippets.description: Sends first-time commenters to a page of your choice after they submit a comment, instead of back to the post.
snippets.notes: Create a page with the slug thank-you, or change the slug in the code.

snippets.title: Highlight Comments by the Post Author
snippets.description: Gives replies written by the author of the post a colored left border so readers can spot them in long threads.

snippets.title: Strip HTML From Comments
snippets.description: Removes all HTML tags from comments submitted by users who are not allowed to post unfiltered HTML, so links and formatting cannot be injected.
snippets.notes: URLs typed as plain text are still turned into links by WordPress when displayed.

snippets.title: Reading Time Shortcode
snippets.description: Registers a [reading_time] shortcode that shows an estimated reading time such as "4 min read" for the current post.
snippets.notes: Usage: [reading_time] or [reading_time wpm="250" label="minutes"].

snippets.title: Open External Links in a New Tab
snippets.description: Adds target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" to links in post content that point to other domains. Optionally adds nofollow too. Requires WordPress 6.2 or newer.

snippets.title: Disable Automatic Paragraphs
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from wrapping text in paragraph tags and adding line breaks in classic content and excerpts. Block content is not affected.
snippets.code:
remove_filter( 'the_content', 'wpautop' );
remove_filter( 'the_excerpt', 'wpautop' );
snippets.notes: Existing classic posts written without HTML paragraphs will appear as one block of text.

snippets.title: Disable Smart Quotes and Dashes
snippets.description: Turns off wptexturize, which converts straight quotes, double hyphens and ellipses into typographic characters. Useful for sites that publish code.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'run_wptexturize', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Change the Excerpt Length
snippets.description: Sets automatically generated excerpts to 30 words instead of the default 55.
snippets.notes: Manual excerpts are never shortened.

snippets.title: Add a "Continue Reading" Link to Excerpts
snippets.description: Replaces the [...] at the end of automatic excerpts with an accessible "Continue reading" link to the full post.

snippets.title: Related Posts Below Single Posts
snippets.description: Lists three posts from the same categories at the end of each single post. No plugin, no extra database tables.
snippets.notes: Change numberposts to show more or fewer posts.

snippets.title: Show the "Last Updated" Date on Posts
snippets.description: Adds "Last updated on" with the modified date at the top of posts that were edited at least a day after publishing.

snippets.title: Dynamic Copyright Years Shortcode
snippets.description: Registers a [copyright_years] shortcode that outputs a range like "© 2016–2026 Site Name", starting from your first post or a year you choose.
snippets.notes: Usage: [copyright_years] or [copyright_years start="2015"].

snippets.title: Current Year
snippets.description: Outputs the current year. Insert it with the snippet shortcode anywhere you need a year that updates itself, such as a footer notice.
snippets.code: echo esc_html( wp_date( 'Y' ) );
snippets.notes: Copy the snippet shortcode from the editor after saving.

snippets.title: Set the Featured Image Automatically
snippets.description: When a post is saved without a featured image, uses the first image attached to it or the first image block in its content.

snippets.title: Login / Logout Link Shortcode
snippets.description: Registers a [login_logout_link] shortcode that shows "Log in" to visitors and "Log out" to logged-in users, returning them to the same page.

snippets.title: Author Box After Posts
snippets.description: Adds a box with the author avatar, name, biography and a link to their other posts at the end of single posts. Authors without a biography are skipped.

snippets.title: Ad Slot After a Paragraph
snippets.description: Inserts a block of HTML (an ad, a newsletter prompt or any call to action) after the third paragraph of single posts.
snippets.code: Your ad or call to action goes here.
snippets.notes: Change the paragraph number in the snippet settings.

snippets.title: Newsletter Call to Action After Content
snippets.description: Adds a simple sign-up box at the end of post content that links to your newsletter page or form.
snippets.code:
Enjoyed this article?

Get new posts delivered to your inbox. No spam, unsubscribe at any time.

Subscribe
snippets.notes: Change /newsletter/ to your sign-up page or paste your email provider form.

snippets.title: Enable Excerpts for Pages
snippets.description: Adds the Excerpt box to pages, which many themes and SEO plugins can use as a summary.

snippets.title: Run Shortcodes in Manual Excerpts
snippets.description: Processes shortcodes typed into the Excerpt field instead of printing them as plain text.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'the_excerpt', 'do_shortcode', 11 );

snippets.title: Remove "Category:" and "Tag:" From Archive Titles
snippets.description: Removes the prefix such as "Category:", "Tag:" or "Author:" from archive page titles, leaving only the term or name.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'get_the_archive_title_prefix', '__return_empty_string' );

snippets.title: Disable Author Archives
snippets.description: Redirects author archive pages to the homepage. Good for single-author sites where the author archive duplicates the blog page.

snippets.title: Disable Date Archives
snippets.description: Makes yearly, monthly and daily archive pages return a 404, which avoids thin duplicate pages on most sites.

snippets.title: Exclude a Category From the Blog Page
snippets.description: Hides posts in chosen categories from the main blog page. The posts remain visible in their own category archive.
snippets.notes: Replace 1 with your category IDs (1 is Uncategorized on most sites).

snippets.title: Include Custom Post Types on the Blog Page
snippets.description: Mixes entries from a custom post type into the main blog page and feed alongside regular posts.
snippets.notes: Replace portfolio with your post type name(s).

snippets.title: Posts per Page on Category and Tag Archives
snippets.description: Shows 20 posts on category, tag and custom taxonomy archives without changing the number on the blog page.

snippets.title: Sort a Category Archive Alphabetically
snippets.description: Orders posts in chosen categories by title from A to Z, which suits glossaries, directories and recipe indexes.
snippets.notes: Replace glossary with your category slugs.

snippets.title: Run Shortcodes in Category Descriptions
snippets.description: Processes shortcodes in category, tag and taxonomy descriptions shown on archive pages.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'term_description', 'do_shortcode' );

snippets.title: Allow SVG Uploads for Administrators
snippets.description: Lets administrators upload SVG files to the Media Library. Files containing scripts, event handlers or javascript: links are rejected.
snippets.notes: The check is a basic safety net, not a full SVG sanitizer. Only upload SVG files from sources you trust.

snippets.title: Disable Big Image Scaling
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from creating a scaled-down "-scaled" copy of images larger than 2560 pixels, so the original file is used as uploaded.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'big_image_size_threshold', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Very large originals use more disk space and can be slow to serve; resize before uploading.

snippets.title: Set JPEG Compression Quality
snippets.description: Changes the quality used when WordPress generates resized JPEG images. Lower values give smaller files; the default is 82.
snippets.notes: Applies to images uploaded after activation. Use a thumbnail regeneration tool for existing images.

snippets.title: Skip Unneeded Image Sizes
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from generating the medium_large, 1536px and 2048px copies of every upload, saving disk space.
snippets.notes: Responsive images will have fewer sizes to choose from on large screens.

snippets.title: Register a Custom Image Size
snippets.description: Adds a 600 by 400 cropped image size and makes it selectable in the editor image size dropdown.
snippets.notes: Rename the size and change the dimensions. Existing images need their thumbnails regenerated.

snippets.title: Fill Missing Alt Text From the File Name
snippets.description: When an image is uploaded without alt text, creates one from its title (based on the file name), replacing dashes and underscores with spaces.
snippets.notes: Generated alt text is only as good as the file name. Review it for important images.

snippets.title: Redirect Attachment Pages
snippets.description: Sends visitors of media attachment pages to the post the file is attached to, or to the homepage for unattached files.

snippets.title: Clean Up File Names on Upload
snippets.description: Converts uploaded file names to lowercase, removes accents and replaces spaces and symbols with dashes, for tidy and portable URLs.

snippets.title: File Size and Dimensions Columns in the Media Library
snippets.description: Adds File Size and Dimensions columns to the Media Library list view, making heavy images easy to spot.

snippets.title: Limit the Maximum Upload Size
snippets.description: Caps the size of files that can be uploaded through WordPress at 8 MB, even if the server allows more.
snippets.notes: This can only lower the server limit, not raise it.

snippets.title: Show Users Only Their Own Media
snippets.description: Authors and contributors only see files they uploaded in the Media Library and media picker. Editors and administrators still see everything.

snippets.title: Do Not Link Inserted Images by Default
snippets.description: Sets the default "Link to" option for images inserted in the classic editor and galleries to None instead of the media file.

snippets.title: Categories for Media Files
snippets.description: Lets you assign post categories to images and other attachments to organize the Media Library.

snippets.title: Disable the Built-in XML Sitemaps
snippets.description: Turns off the wp-sitemap.xml sitemaps added in WordPress 5.5. Use it when an SEO plugin already generates sitemaps.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wp_sitemaps_enabled', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Exclude Content Types From the XML Sitemap
snippets.description: Removes chosen post types and taxonomies (tags by default) and the users list from the built-in wp-sitemap.xml.
snippets.notes: Add post type names to the empty array to exclude them.

snippets.title: Noindex Thin Archive Pages
snippets.description: Adds noindex, follow to date archives, attachment pages and page 2+ of archives, so search engines focus on your real content.
snippets.notes: Skip this snippet if an SEO plugin already controls robots meta tags.

snippets.title: Noindex Staging and Development Sites
snippets.description: Adds noindex, nofollow to every page when WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE is not production, so staging copies never end up in search results.
snippets.notes: Set define( 'WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE', 'staging' ); in wp-config.php on staging copies.

snippets.title: Automatic Meta Description
snippets.description: Prints a meta description from the excerpt or opening words of posts, from term descriptions on archives and from the tagline on the homepage. Skipped when an SEO plugin is active.

snippets.title: Basic Open Graph and Twitter Card Tags
snippets.description: Adds Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags (title, description, image, URL) so links shared on social networks show a proper preview. Skipped when an SEO plugin is active.

snippets.title: Organization Structured Data
snippets.description: Outputs Organization schema (JSON-LD) on the homepage with your site name, URL, logo and social profiles, helping search engines understand who runs the site.
snippets.notes: Add your social profile URLs to $profiles. Change @type to LocalBusiness or another type if it fits better.

snippets.title: Article Structured Data for Posts
snippets.description: Outputs BlogPosting schema (JSON-LD) on single posts with the headline, dates, author, image and publisher.
snippets.notes: Skip this snippet if an SEO plugin already outputs article schema.

snippets.title: Add Rules to the Virtual robots.txt
snippets.description: Adds Disallow rules for internal search result URLs to the robots.txt file that WordPress generates.
snippets.notes: Only works when there is no physical robots.txt file in the site root.

snippets.title: Add Featured Images to RSS Feeds
snippets.description: Places the featured image at the top of each item in your RSS feeds, so feed readers and email newsletters show it.

snippets.title: Delay New Posts in RSS Feeds
snippets.description: Waits 15 minutes before new posts appear in your feeds, giving you time to fix typos before feed readers and newsletters pick them up.
snippets.notes: Change $minutes to adjust the delay.

snippets.title: Exclude a Category From RSS Feeds
snippets.description: Keeps posts in chosen categories out of the main RSS feed.
snippets.notes: Replace 1 with your category IDs. The category own feed still works.

snippets.title: Add Custom Post Types to the RSS Feed
snippets.description: Includes entries from custom post types in the main RSS feed along with regular posts.
snippets.notes: Replace portfolio with your post type names.

snippets.title: Add an Attribution Line to Feed Items
snippets.description: Appends "The post ... first appeared on ..." with links to every feed item, which credits you when content is scraped from your feed.

snippets.title: Remove Comment Feeds
snippets.description: Removes comment feed links from the page head and redirects comment feed URLs to the homepage, while keeping the post feeds.

snippets.title: Set the Number of Items in Feeds
snippets.description: Shows 20 items in RSS feeds regardless of the Reading settings.

snippets.title: Limit Search Results to Posts
snippets.description: Restricts front-end search results to blog posts, leaving out pages and other post types.

snippets.title: Exclude Specific Pages From Search
snippets.description: Hides chosen posts or pages (thank-you pages, landing pages, legal pages) from front-end search results.
snippets.notes: Replace 0 with the IDs to hide.

snippets.title: Go Straight to a Single Search Result
snippets.description: When a search returns exactly one result, opens that result directly instead of showing a results page.

snippets.title: Highlight Search Terms in Results
snippets.description: Wraps the searched words in mark tags in result titles and excerpts, so visitors see why each result matched.

snippets.title: Number of Search Results per Page
snippets.description: Shows 20 results per page on search results without changing the blog page.

snippets.title: Redirect Empty Searches to the Homepage
snippets.description: Sends visitors who submit the search form without typing anything back to the homepage instead of showing every post.

snippets.title: Hide Password-Protected Posts From Search
snippets.description: Leaves password-protected posts and pages out of search results so their titles are not exposed to visitors.

snippets.title: Pretty Search URLs
snippets.description: Redirects ?s=term searches to /search/term/ when pretty permalinks are enabled, which gives cleaner, shareable URLs.

snippets.title: Use the Classic Widgets Screen
snippets.description: Restores the classic Widgets screen and Customizer widget panel instead of the block-based widget editor.
snippets.code:
add_filter( 'use_widgets_block_editor', '__return_false' );
add_filter( 'gutenberg_use_widgets_block_editor', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Only applies to classic themes that have widget areas.

snippets.title: Remove Unused Default Widgets
snippets.description: Unregisters rarely used classic widgets (Meta, Calendar, RSS, Tag Cloud, Pages and Recent Comments) to declutter the widget list.

snippets.title: Widget Area Below Single Posts
snippets.description: Registers an "After Post Content" widget area and displays it at the end of single posts, without editing theme files.

snippets.title: Run Shortcodes in Widget Titles
snippets.description: Processes shortcodes typed into classic widget titles, for example to show the current year or a dynamic label.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'widget_title', 'do_shortcode' );

snippets.title: Hide the Current Post From the Recent Posts Widget
snippets.description: Stops the classic Recent Posts widget from listing the post that is currently being viewed.

snippets.title: Exclude Categories From the Categories Widget
snippets.description: Hides chosen categories from the classic Categories widget list or dropdown.
snippets.notes: Replace 1 with your category IDs.

snippets.title: Even Font Sizes in the Tag Cloud
snippets.description: Limits the tag cloud to 30 tags with font sizes between 12 and 18 pixels, so it looks tidy in narrow sidebars.

snippets.title: Disable the Block Editor
snippets.description: Uses the classic editor for all posts and pages instead of the block editor. The block-based widgets screen is not affected.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'use_block_editor_for_post', '__return_false', 100 );

snippets.title: Disable the Block Editor for Specific Post Types
snippets.description: Keeps the block editor for posts but uses the classic editor for the post types you list (pages by default).

snippets.title: Turn Off Fullscreen Mode in the Block Editor
snippets.description: Opens the block editor with the admin menu and toolbar visible instead of in fullscreen mode, for every user.

snippets.title: Disable the Block Editor Welcome Guide
snippets.description: Stops the "Welcome to the block editor" popup from appearing for new users.

snippets.title: Disable Openverse in the Media Inserter
snippets.description: Removes the Openverse tab from the block inserter, so editors cannot pull external stock images into posts.

snippets.title: Disable Block Directory Suggestions
snippets.description: Stops the block inserter from suggesting and installing blocks from the WordPress.org block directory.
snippets.code:
remove_action( 'enqueue_block_editor_assets', 'wp_enqueue_editor_block_directory_assets' );
remove_action( 'enqueue_block_editor_assets', 'gutenberg_enqueue_block_editor_assets_block_directory' );

snippets.title: Disable Remote Block Patterns
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from loading block patterns from the WordPress.org pattern directory, leaving only theme and plugin patterns.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'should_load_remote_block_patterns', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Disable Core Block Patterns
snippets.description: Removes the block patterns that ship with WordPress itself, so the pattern inserter only shows your theme and custom patterns.

snippets.title: Hide Specific Blocks From the Inserter
snippets.description: Removes the core blocks you list from the post editor, so writers only see the blocks you want them to use.
snippets.notes: Posts that already contain a removed block will show it as unsupported in the editor.

snippets.title: Add a Patterns Link to the Admin Menu
snippets.description: Adds a "Patterns" item under Appearance that lists your synced patterns (reusable blocks), if your WordPress version does not show one already.

snippets.title: Restrict the Code Editor to Administrators
snippets.description: Hides the "Code editor" mode of the block editor from everyone except administrators, so other users only edit visually.

snippets.title: Restrict Block Locking to Administrators
snippets.description: Only administrators can lock and unlock blocks, so locked layouts stay intact when other users edit content.

snippets.title: Disable the Drop Cap Option
snippets.description: Removes the drop cap toggle from the Paragraph block settings.
snippets.notes: Requires WordPress 6.1 or newer.

snippets.title: Change the Add to Cart Button Text
snippets.description: Replaces "Add to cart" with "Buy now" on single product pages and on shop listings for simple, in-stock products.
snippets.notes: Edit both "Buy now" strings.

snippets.title: Hide Prices and Purchasing From Guests
snippets.description: Shows a "Log in to see prices" link instead of prices and disables purchasing until the visitor logs in. Common for wholesale and B2B shops.

snippets.title: Remove Related Products
snippets.description: Hides the Related products section below single product pages.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_related_products', '__return_empty_array', 100 );

snippets.title: Change the Number of Related Products
snippets.description: Shows four related products in four columns on single product pages.

snippets.title: Products per Page on the Shop
snippets.description: Sets how many products are shown per page on the shop and product category pages.
snippets.notes: Applies to classic shop templates. Block themes set this in the Product Collection block.

snippets.title: Number of Columns on the Shop Page
snippets.description: Changes the number of product columns on the shop and product category pages for classic themes.
snippets.notes: Some themes control columns themselves and ignore this filter.

snippets.title: Hide Other Shipping Rates When Free Shipping Is Available
snippets.description: When the cart qualifies for free shipping, shows only the free shipping and local pickup options instead of all rates.
snippets.notes: Clear the shipping cache (WooCommerce > Status > Tools) or update the cart to see the change.

snippets.title: Minimum Order Amount
snippets.description: Blocks checkout and shows a notice until the cart subtotal reaches a minimum amount (50 in your store currency by default).
snippets.notes: Works with the classic cart and checkout shortcodes. The subtotal is before tax and discounts.

snippets.title: Go Straight to Checkout After Adding to Cart
snippets.description: Skips the cart page and sends customers directly to checkout after they add a product, for single-product or quick-purchase stores.
snippets.notes: Turn off "Enable AJAX add to cart buttons on archives" in WooCommerce > Settings > Products so shop buttons redirect too.

snippets.title: Remove Optional Checkout Fields
snippets.description: Removes the company and second address line fields from the classic checkout form to make it shorter.
snippets.notes: Applies to the classic checkout shortcode. Block checkout fields are managed in the Site Editor.

snippets.title: Make the Billing Phone Field Optional
snippets.description: Keeps the phone field on the classic checkout but no longer requires it.

snippets.title: Auto-Complete Paid Orders for Virtual Products
snippets.description: Marks paid orders as Completed instead of Processing when every item is virtual, such as services, memberships or event tickets.

snippets.title: Remove Product Page Tabs
snippets.description: Removes the "Additional information" tab from single product pages. The reviews and description tabs can be removed the same way.

snippets.title: Show the Discount Percentage on Sale Badges
snippets.description: Replaces the "Sale!" badge with the actual discount, for example "-25%". Variable products show the largest discount among their variations.

snippets.title: Empty Cart Button
snippets.description: Adds an "Empty cart" button next to "Update cart" on the classic cart page, protected by a nonce.

snippets.title: Send "Continue Shopping" to the Shop Page
snippets.description: Points the "Continue shopping" and "Return to shop" links to the main shop page instead of the last viewed product or the homepage.

snippets.title: Limit Every Product to One per Order
snippets.description: Allows only one of each product in the cart, as if "Sold individually" were ticked on every product. Useful for licenses, courses and bookings.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_is_sold_individually', '__return_true' );

snippets.title: Cap the Quantity Selector
snippets.description: Limits the quantity field on product and cart pages to a maximum of 10 per product.
snippets.notes: This limits the input field. Quantities added another way (for example by URL) are not validated.

snippets.title: Relax the Account Password Strength Requirement
snippets.description: Lowers the password strength WooCommerce requires on registration and checkout from "strong" to "medium", which reduces abandoned sign-ups.

snippets.title: Hide SKUs on the Front End
snippets.description: Stops SKUs from being shown on product pages while keeping them available in the admin.

snippets.title: Free Shipping Progress Notice
snippets.description: Shows "Add 12.00 more to get free shipping" on the cart and checkout pages, or a success message once the threshold is reached.
snippets.notes: Set $threshold to the minimum amount configured in your Free Shipping method.

snippets.title: Load WooCommerce Assets Only on Shop Pages
snippets.description: Stops WooCommerce stylesheets and scripts from loading on pages that are not part of the store, such as blog posts and the about page.
snippets.notes: Do not use this if non-shop pages show products, a mini cart or add-to-cart buttons.

snippets.title: Remove the Order Notes Field
snippets.description: Removes the "Order notes" textarea from the classic checkout page.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_enable_order_notes_field', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Hide the Coupon Form on Checkout
snippets.description: Removes the "Have a coupon?" prompt from the classic checkout page. Customers can still apply coupons on the cart page.

snippets.title: Personal Thank-You Message After Purchase
snippets.description: Replaces the standard "Thank you. Your order has been received." text with a friendlier message that includes the customer first name.

snippets.title: Remove WooCommerce Breadcrumbs
snippets.description: Hides the WooCommerce breadcrumb trail on shop, category and product pages.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_get_breadcrumb', '__return_empty_array' );

snippets.title: Disable Marketplace Suggestions
snippets.description: Removes the extension suggestions WooCommerce shows in the admin, such as on the product and order screens.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_allow_marketplace_suggestions', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Change the Place Order Button Text
snippets.description: Renames the "Place order" button on the classic checkout to something clearer, such as "Complete purchase".

snippets.title: Redirect 404 Pages to the Homepage
snippets.description: Sends visitors who hit a missing page to the homepage instead of showing the 404 template.
snippets.notes: Search engines treat mass redirects to the homepage as soft 404s. A helpful 404 page or specific redirects are usually better.

snippets.title: Keep Subscribers Out of wp-admin
snippets.description: Redirects users who cannot edit posts (subscribers, customers) to the homepage when they try to open the admin area. AJAX and admin-post requests keep working.
snippets.notes: Users can still change their password through the front-end account page if your site has one.

snippets.title: Simple Redirect List
snippets.description: Redirects old URLs to new ones with a 301 status from a list you maintain in the snippet. Good for a handful of moved pages.
snippets.notes: Paths are matched without the query string. On a subdirectory install include the subdirectory in the old path. For other domains, add them with the allowed_redirect_hosts filter.

snippets.title: Require Login to View the Site
snippets.description: Makes the whole front end private: visitors who are not logged in are sent to the login page and returned to the page they asked for afterwards.
snippets.notes: Feeds and the REST API are not covered. Combine with "Restrict the REST API to Logged-In Users" for full privacy.

snippets.title: Maintenance Mode for Visitors
snippets.description: Shows a "back soon" message with a 503 status to visitors while logged-in staff browse the site normally. The login page stays reachable.
snippets.notes: Remember to deactivate the snippet when maintenance is over.

snippets.title: Redirect the Default Registration Page
snippets.description: Sends visitors who open wp-login.php?action=register to your own registration page.
snippets.notes: Change /register/ to the path of your registration page.

snippets.title: Change the Sender Name and Address of WordPress Emails
snippets.description: Replaces the default "WordPress <wordpress@yourdomain>" sender with your site name and, optionally, an address of your choice.
snippets.notes: Use an address on your own domain so messages pass SPF and DKIM checks.

snippets.title: Stop New User Notifications to the Admin
snippets.description: Prevents the "New user registration" email that is sent to the site admin every time someone registers. The welcome email to the user still goes out.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wp_send_new_user_notification_to_admin', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Requires WordPress 6.1 or newer.

snippets.title: Stop Password Reset Notifications to the Admin
snippets.description: Stops the email the site admin gets each time a user resets their password.
snippets.code: remove_action( 'after_password_reset', 'wp_password_change_notification' );

snippets.title: Stop Auto-Update Success Emails
snippets.description: Silences the emails sent after successful automatic updates of WordPress, plugins and themes. Emails about failed core updates are kept.

snippets.title: Stop Password and Email Change Confirmations
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from emailing users when their password or email address is changed, for example during bulk imports.
snippets.code:
add_filter( 'send_password_change_email', '__return_false' );
add_filter( 'send_email_change_email', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: These emails alert users to account takeovers. Consider enabling the snippet only while importing.

snippets.title: Send Email Through SMTP
snippets.description: Routes all WordPress email through an SMTP server, using credentials stored as constants in wp-config.php rather than in the database.
snippets.notes: Add to wp-config.php: define( 'SMTP_HOST', 'smtp.example.com' ); define( 'SMTP_PORT', 587 ); define( 'SMTP_SECURE', 'tls' ); define( 'SMTP_USER', 'user' ); define( 'SMTP_PASS', 'password' ); and optionally define( 'SMTP_FROM', 'hello@example.com' ); The snippet does nothing until SMTP_HOST is defined.

snippets.title: Log Failed Emails
snippets.description: Writes a line to the PHP error log whenever wp_mail() fails, with the subject, recipients and error message, to help debug delivery problems.
snippets.notes: The log contains recipient addresses. Enable WP_DEBUG_LOG or check your server error log.

snippets.title: Add a Reply-To Header to Outgoing Emails
snippets.description: Adds the site admin address as Reply-To on emails that do not set one, so replies to no-reply senders reach a real inbox.

snippets.title: Stop Comment Notification Emails
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from emailing post authors about new comments and moderators about comments awaiting approval.
snippets.code:
add_filter( 'notify_post_author', '__return_false' );
add_filter( 'notify_moderator', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Show the Current Template in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Displays the theme template file (and block template, on block themes) used for the current page in the admin bar, for administrators only.

snippets.title: Query Count and Load Time in the Page Source
snippets.description: Adds an HTML comment at the bottom of front-end and admin pages with the number of database queries, generation time and peak memory. Visible to administrators only.

snippets.title: Add Useful Body Classes
snippets.description: Adds the post type and slug of the current page plus a logged-in or logged-out class to the body tag, for precise CSS targeting.

snippets.title: Register a Custom Post Type
snippets.description: A ready-to-edit example that registers a "Portfolio" post type with archive, featured images and block editor support.
snippets.notes: After activating, visit Settings > Permalinks once so WordPress refreshes its URL rules.

snippets.title: Register a Custom Taxonomy
snippets.description: A ready-to-edit example that registers a hierarchical "Project Type" taxonomy for the Portfolio post type.
snippets.notes: Change portfolio to the post type(s) the taxonomy belongs to, then visit Settings > Permalinks once.

snippets.title: Featured Image URL in the REST API
snippets.description: Adds a featured_image_url field to posts and pages in REST API responses, so headless front ends do not need a second request.

snippets.title: Add a Five-Minute Cron Schedule
snippets.description: Registers an "every_five_minutes" interval that your own scheduled events can use with wp_schedule_event().

snippets.title: Enable Featured Images for Any Theme
snippets.description: Turns on featured image (post thumbnail) support for themes that do not declare it.

snippets.title: Hide Update Notices for a Specific Plugin
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from offering updates for plugins you list, such as a customized plugin that must not be overwritten.
snippets.notes: You will not hear about security fixes for the listed plugins. Check them manually.

snippets.title: Load a custom.css File From the Theme
snippets.description: Enqueues custom.css from the active (child) theme folder if it exists, with a version based on its modification time to bust caches.

snippets.title: Google Analytics 4 Tag
snippets.description: Adds the Google Analytics 4 (gtag.js) tracking code to the head of every public page.
snippets.code:
<!-- Google Analytics 4. Replace G-XXXXXXXXXX with your Measurement ID (two places). -->
<script async src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-XXXXXXXXXX"></script>
<script>
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
  gtag('js', new Date());
  gtag('config', 'G-XXXXXXXXXX');
</script>
snippets.notes: Find your Measurement ID in Google Analytics under Admin > Data streams. G-XXXXXXXXXX is a placeholder. Check your privacy and consent obligations before enabling.

snippets.title: Google Analytics 4 Without Tracking Logged-In Staff
snippets.description: Outputs the GA4 tag only for visitors and customers, so your own visits as an author, editor or administrator do not skew the statistics.
snippets.notes: Replace G-XXXXXXXXXX with your Measurement ID. Nothing is printed while the placeholder is still in place.

snippets.title: Google Tag Manager (Head)
snippets.description: Adds the Google Tag Manager container script to the head of every page. Use it together with the GTM body snippet.
snippets.code:
<!-- Google Tag Manager. Replace GTM-XXXXXXX with your container ID. -->
<script>(function(w,d,s,l,i){w[l]=w[l]||[];w[l].push({'gtm.start':
new Date().getTime(),event:'gtm.js'});var f=d.getElementsByTagName(s)[0],
j=d.createElement(s),dl=l!='dataLayer'?'&l='+l:'';j.async=true;j.src=
'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id='+i+dl;f.parentNode.insertBefore(j,f);
})(window,document,'script','dataLayer','GTM-XXXXXXX');</script>
snippets.notes: GTM-XXXXXXX is a placeholder for your container ID from tagmanager.google.com.

snippets.title: Google Tag Manager (Body)
snippets.description: Adds the Google Tag Manager noscript fallback right after the opening body tag. Use it together with the GTM head snippet.
snippets.code:
<!-- Google Tag Manager (noscript). Replace GTM-XXXXXXX with your container ID. -->
<noscript><iframe src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/ns.html?id=GTM-XXXXXXX"
height="0" width="0" style="display:none;visibility:hidden"></iframe></noscript>
snippets.notes: Your theme must call wp_body_open() for this location to work.

snippets.title: Meta (Facebook) Pixel
snippets.description: Adds the Meta Pixel base code to track page views for Facebook and Instagram ads.
snippets.notes: YOUR_PIXEL_ID is a placeholder; find the ID in Meta Events Manager.

snippets.title: Microsoft Clarity
snippets.description: Adds the Microsoft Clarity script for heatmaps and session recordings.
snippets.code:
<!-- Microsoft Clarity. Replace YOUR_PROJECT_ID with your Clarity project ID. -->
<script type="text/javascript">
(function(c,l,a,r,i,t,y){
    c[a]=c[a]||function(){(c[a].q=c[a].q||[]).push(arguments)};
    t=l.createElement(r);t.async=1;t.src="https://www.clarity.ms/tag/"+i;
    y=l.getElementsByTagName(r)[0];y.parentNode.insertBefore(t,y);
})(window, document, "clarity", "script", "YOUR_PROJECT_ID");
</script>
snippets.notes: YOUR_PROJECT_ID is a placeholder from clarity.microsoft.com > Settings > Setup.

snippets.title: Plausible Analytics
snippets.description: Adds the lightweight, cookie-free Plausible Analytics script.
snippets.code:
<!-- Plausible Analytics. Replace example.com with the domain you added in Plausible. -->
<script defer data-domain="example.com" src="https://plausible.io/js/script.js"></script>
snippets.notes: If you self-host Plausible, replace plausible.io with your own host.

snippets.title: Fathom Analytics
snippets.description: Adds the privacy-focused Fathom Analytics tracking script.
snippets.code:
<!-- Fathom Analytics. Replace ABCDEFGH with your site ID. -->
<script src="https://cdn.usefathom.com/script.js" data-site="ABCDEFGH" defer></script>
snippets.notes: ABCDEFGH is a placeholder for the site ID shown in your Fathom dashboard.

snippets.title: LinkedIn Insight Tag
snippets.description: Adds the LinkedIn Insight Tag for conversion tracking and retargeting with LinkedIn ads.
snippets.notes: YOUR_PARTNER_ID is a placeholder from LinkedIn Campaign Manager > Insight Tag.

snippets.title: Google Search Console Verification Tag
snippets.description: Adds the HTML meta tag Google Search Console uses to verify that you own the site.
snippets.code: <meta name="google-site-verification" content="YOUR_VERIFICATION_CODE" />
snippets.notes: Replace YOUR_VERIFICATION_CODE with the content value Search Console gives you under the HTML tag method.

snippets.title: Smooth Scrolling for Anchor Links
snippets.description: Makes in-page anchor links scroll smoothly instead of jumping, while respecting visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Back to Top Button
snippets.description: Adds a small round button in the bottom corner that appears after scrolling down and takes visitors back to the top of the page.
snippets.code:
<button type="button" id="wpide-back-to-top" aria-label="Back to top" hidden>↑</button>
<style>
#wpide-back-to-top{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:9999;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#1e1e1e;color:#fff;font-size:20px;line-height:44px;cursor:pointer;opacity:.8;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
#wpide-back-to-top:hover,#wpide-back-to-top:focus{opacity:1;}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var button = document.getElementById('wpide-back-to-top');
    if (!button) { return; }
    var toggle = function () { button.hidden = window.pageYOffset < 400; };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', toggle, { passive: true });
    button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
    });
    toggle();
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Change the colors in the style block to match your theme.

snippets.title: Hide the reCAPTCHA Badge
snippets.description: Hides the floating Google reCAPTCHA v3 badge in the bottom corner of every page.
snippets.notes: Google requires you to show the reCAPTCHA notice text near your forms when the badge is hidden.

snippets.title: Reading Progress Bar
snippets.description: Shows a thin bar at the top of the window that fills up as the visitor scrolls through the page.
snippets.notes: Change #2271b1 to your brand color. Add conditional logic to show it only on posts.

snippets.title: Copyright Line in the Footer
snippets.description: Prints a centered "© year Site Name. All rights reserved." line at the bottom of every page, with the year updated automatically.
snippets.code: © . All rights reserved.

snippets.title: Dismissible Announcement Bar
snippets.description: Shows a slim message bar at the top of the page (for sales, shipping notes or news) that visitors can close. It stays closed on later visits.
snippets.code: Free shipping on all orders this week. Shop now
snippets.notes: Edit the message and link. Change the key (wpide-announcement-1) whenever you publish a new announcement so it shows again to everyone.

snippets.title: Print-Friendly Styles
snippets.description: Hides navigation, sidebars, comments and the admin bar when a page is printed, and prints link addresses after external links.
snippets.notes: Adjust the selectors to match the class names used by your theme.

snippets.title: Slug Column in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Adds a Slug column to the posts and pages lists so you can check permalinks without opening each item.
snippets.notes: Add custom post type names to $wpide_slug_post_types to show the column there too.

snippets.title: Page Template Column for Pages
snippets.description: Shows which page template each page uses, right in the Pages list.

snippets.title: Filter Posts by Author in the Admin List
snippets.description: Adds an author dropdown next to the date and category filters, so editors can list one writer's posts.
snippets.notes: WordPress already understands the author filter; this snippet only adds the dropdown.

snippets.title: Filter Admin Lists by Any Taxonomy
snippets.description: Adds a dropdown filter for every taxonomy attached to a post type, such as tags or custom taxonomies on a portfolio.

snippets.title: Sortable Order Column for Pages
snippets.description: Shows the page order (menu_order) value in the Pages list and lets you sort by it.

snippets.title: Find Posts by ID in the Admin Search
snippets.description: Type #123 or id:123 in the posts or pages search box to jump straight to the item with that ID.
snippets.notes: Plain numbers are still searched as text, so titles like "2025" keep working.

snippets.title: Default Number of Items in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Shows more (or fewer) posts per page in admin lists for everyone who has not chosen their own number in Screen Options.
snippets.notes: Very high values make list screens slower on large sites.

snippets.title: Sort Admin Lists by Last Modified by Default
snippets.description: Lists recently edited posts first in the admin, unless you click a column to sort differently.

snippets.title: Site-Wide Admin Notice
snippets.description: Shows your own message at the top of every admin screen, for example "This is the staging site" or a reminder for editors.
snippets.notes: Deactivate the snippet to remove the notice; it cannot be dismissed by users.

snippets.title: Reorder the Admin Menu
snippets.description: Puts the admin menu items you use most at the top, in the order you choose. Everything else keeps its place below.
snippets.notes: Find a slug by hovering a menu item: it is the part of the link after /wp-admin/.

snippets.title: Rename "Posts" to "Articles"
snippets.description: Changes every label of the built-in Posts type in the admin, such as the menu, buttons and messages, to a name that fits your site.
snippets.notes: Only labels change; URLs, the post type name and existing content stay the same.

snippets.title: Open "Visit Site" in a New Tab
snippets.description: Makes the site name and "Visit Site" links in the admin bar open the front end in a new tab, so you keep your place in the admin.

snippets.title: Quick Links Menu in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a "Quick links" dropdown to the admin bar with the outside tools your team opens every day, such as analytics or support.

snippets.title: Remove Items From the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Removes admin bar entries you never use, such as Comments, "+ New", Customize or Search.
snippets.notes: To find a node ID, inspect the admin bar item: its list element id is "wp-admin-bar-" followed by the node ID.

snippets.title: Move the Admin Bar to the Bottom on the Front End
snippets.description: Pins the admin bar to the bottom of the screen on the front end, so it no longer covers sticky headers and menus while you browse your site.

snippets.title: Auto-Hide the Admin Bar on the Front End
snippets.description: Slides the admin bar out of view on the front end and brings it back when you move the mouse to the top edge of the screen.
snippets.notes: Touch screens and narrow windows keep the normal admin bar, because there is no hover there.

snippets.title: Collapse the Admin Menu by Default
snippets.description: Starts everyone with the narrow, icon-only admin menu for more working space. Users who expand it keep their choice.

snippets.title: Add User Role Classes to the Admin Body
snippets.description: Adds classes such as role-editor to the admin body tag, so you can write CSS that hides or highlights things for specific roles.
snippets.notes: Example CSS: body.role-editor #menu-tools { display: none; }

snippets.title: Open "View" and "Preview" Row Links in a New Tab
snippets.description: Makes the View and Preview links under each post and page in admin lists open in a new browser tab.

snippets.title: Remove Quick Edit for Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Hides the Quick Edit link and the Edit bulk action for everyone except administrators, so status, dates and slugs are only changed in the full editor.

snippets.title: Require a Featured Image Before Publishing
snippets.description: Stops posts from being published or scheduled until a featured image is set, in both the block editor and the classic editor.
snippets.notes: Already published posts without an image also need one before they can be updated.

snippets.title: Hide Plugins From the Plugins Screen
snippets.description: Hides chosen plugins from the Plugins screen for everyone except the users you name, so clients do not deactivate them by accident.
snippets.notes: Hidden plugins keep running, so pair this with blocking plugin installs on client sites.

snippets.title: Separate Favicon for the Admin Area
snippets.description: Uses a different browser tab icon in wp-admin than on the public site, so admin tabs are easy to spot among the others.
snippets.notes: A different icon per environment (for example red on staging) helps prevent editing the wrong site.

snippets.title: Remove "WordPress" From Admin Page Titles
snippets.description: Shortens browser tab titles in the admin and on the login page by dropping the trailing "— WordPress".

snippets.title: Drafts Link Under Every Post Type Menu
snippets.description: Adds a "Drafts" submenu under Posts, Pages and each custom post type for one-click access to unfinished content.
snippets.notes: Post types that sit inside another plugin menu are skipped.

snippets.title: Pending Review Count in the Admin Menu
snippets.description: Shows a red count bubble on Posts, Pages and custom post types when items are waiting for review, like WordPress does for comments.

snippets.title: Hide Editor Panels From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes rarely needed panels like Discussion, Custom Fields and the slug box from the editor for everyone but administrators, in both editors.
snippets.notes: Edit the two lists to choose which panels stay hidden.

snippets.title: Enable the Links Manager
snippets.description: Brings back the classic Links menu (blogroll) that WordPress hides on new sites, for managing a list of links.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'pre_option_link_manager_enabled', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Use the Links widget or wp_list_bookmarks() in a classic theme to display them.

snippets.title: All Settings Link Under Settings
snippets.description: Adds "All Settings" to the Settings menu, which opens the hidden screen listing every stored option for administrators.
snippets.notes: Saving that screen writes every option at once; change values there with care.

snippets.title: Sticky Table Headers in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Keeps the column headings of posts, pages, users and other admin tables visible while you scroll long lists.

snippets.title: Fuller Classic Editor Toolbar
snippets.description: Always shows the second toolbar row in the classic editor and adds font size, highlight, subscript and superscript buttons.
snippets.notes: Only affects the classic editor (and classic blocks).

snippets.title: Show Authors Only Their Own Posts in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Users who cannot edit other people's posts, like authors and contributors, see only their own items in the admin lists.
snippets.notes: The counts above the list (All, Published) still include other people's posts.

snippets.title: Warn When Search Engines Are Blocked
snippets.description: Shows a red notice on every admin screen while "Discourage search engines" is ticked, so a launched site is not left hidden by mistake.
snippets.notes: Leave it off on staging sites, where blocking search engines is intended.

snippets.title: Warn When Debug Display Is On in Production
snippets.description: Alerts administrators when WP_DEBUG shows errors on screen on a production site, where visitors could see file paths and warnings.
snippets.notes: The environment type comes from WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE and defaults to production.

snippets.title: ID Column on Category and Tag Screens
snippets.description: Adds a sortable ID column to categories, tags and every other taxonomy screen, handy for shortcodes and filters that need term IDs.

snippets.title: Last Edited By Column
snippets.description: Shows who last edited each post or page, and when, in the admin lists. Useful when several people work on the same content.

snippets.title: Bulk Action to Move Posts Back to Draft
snippets.description: Adds "Move to draft" to the Bulk actions menu for posts and pages, to unpublish several items at once.

snippets.title: Protect Important Pages From Deletion
snippets.description: Stops anyone, administrators included, from trashing or deleting the homepage, blog page, privacy page and any other pages you list.
snippets.notes: To delete a protected page later, change the Reading settings first or deactivate the snippet.

snippets.title: Show the Site Time in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Displays the current time in the site's timezone in the admin bar, which helps when scheduling posts from another timezone.
snippets.notes: The time is set when the page loads; it does not tick.

snippets.title: Save With Ctrl+S or Cmd+S in the Classic Editor
snippets.description: Lets you press Ctrl+S (Cmd+S on a Mac) to save a draft or update a published post in the classic editor, instead of the browser's save dialog.
snippets.notes: Unpublished posts are only saved as drafts, never published, by the shortcut.

snippets.title: Custom "Add Title" Placeholder per Post Type
snippets.description: Replaces the "Add title" hint in the editor with your own wording for each post type, such as "Product name" or "Team member name".
snippets.notes: Works in the block editor and the classic editor.

snippets.title: Default Content for New Posts
snippets.description: Pre-fills new posts or pages with starter content, such as a block layout or a checklist, so writers start from your template.
snippets.notes: Only new items are pre-filled; existing content is never changed.

snippets.title: Remove Columns From the Posts and Pages Lists
snippets.description: Drops columns you never look at, like Comments or Tags, from the admin lists for a cleaner overview.
snippets.notes: manage_posts_columns also covers non-hierarchical custom post types.

snippets.title: Keep Checked Categories in Their Place
snippets.description: Stops the classic editor from moving ticked categories to the top of the list, so the category tree keeps its order.

snippets.title: Publish Posts That Missed Their Schedule
snippets.description: Checks every few minutes for scheduled posts stuck with a "Missed schedule" label and publishes them, a common problem on low-traffic sites.
snippets.notes: A real server cron hitting wp-cron.php is the long-term fix; this is a safety net.

snippets.title: Hide Admin List Columns by Default
snippets.description: Hides less useful columns for users who have not customized Screen Options yet. Anyone can still turn them back on.

snippets.title: Drop "Uncategorized" When Another Category Is Chosen
snippets.description: Removes the default category from a post as soon as it has another category, so posts do not end up filed under both.

snippets.title: Compact Rows in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Tightens the spacing of admin table rows so more posts, pages and users fit on screen at once.

snippets.title: Admin Menu in Your Brand Colors
snippets.description: Recolors the admin sidebar menu and admin bar with your brand colors, set as a few SCSS variables at the top.
snippets.notes: Works best with the Default admin color scheme selected in each user profile.

snippets.title: Accent Color for Admin Buttons and Links
snippets.description: Changes the blue of primary buttons, links and focus rings across wp-admin to one accent color of your choice.

snippets.title: Larger, More Readable Admin Text
snippets.description: Raises the font size and line height of admin tables, forms and menus for editors who find the default admin text too small.
snippets.notes: The block editor canvas uses your theme styles and is not affected.

snippets.title: Recent Drafts From All Authors Widget
snippets.description: Lists the latest drafts from every author on the dashboard, so editors can see what is in progress across the team.

snippets.title: Pending Review Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Shows everything waiting for review on the dashboard, with the author and a direct link to review it.
snippets.notes: Oldest submissions are listed first.

snippets.title: Server and Site Info Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget with the PHP, database and WordPress versions, memory limit, upload limit and active theme at a glance.
snippets.notes: Only administrators see the widget.

snippets.title: Shortcut Buttons Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Puts big buttons for the most common tasks, like writing a post or editing menus, at the top of the dashboard. Ideal for clients.
snippets.notes: Menus only exist in classic themes; use site-editor.php?path=/navigation for block themes.

snippets.title: Recently Updated Content Widget
snippets.description: Lists the most recently modified posts and pages of any type on the dashboard, with who changed them.

snippets.title: Shared Notes Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: A notepad on the dashboard that every editor can read and update, for handover notes, to-dos or reminders.
snippets.notes: Notes are stored in the wpide_dashboard_notes option.

snippets.title: Any RSS Feed as a Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Shows the latest headlines from an RSS feed of your choice on the dashboard, such as your agency blog or an industry news site.
snippets.notes: The feed is fetched from the remote site, then cached by WordPress.

snippets.title: Support Contact Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Shows your agency or developer contact details on the dashboard, so clients always know how to reach you.

snippets.title: Users by Role Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Shows how many users the site has in total and per role, with links to each filtered users list.
snippets.notes: count_users() can be slow on sites with hundreds of thousands of users.

snippets.title: Content Statistics Widget
snippets.description: Summarizes published, draft and scheduled items for every post type, plus media files and comments awaiting moderation.

snippets.title: My Recent Posts Widget
snippets.description: Gives each writer a dashboard widget with their own latest posts in any status, so they can pick up where they left off.

snippets.title: Upcoming Scheduled Tasks Widget
snippets.description: Lists the next WP-Cron events and flags overdue ones, a quick way to spot a broken scheduler.
snippets.notes: Many overdue tasks usually mean WP-Cron is disabled or the site gets too little traffic.

snippets.title: Today's Orders Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Shows how many WooCommerce orders came in today and their total, with the latest orders listed below.
snippets.notes: The total sums the shown statuses in the store currency and counts up to 50 orders.

snippets.title: Low Stock Products Dashboard Widget
