snippets.description: Lists WooCommerce products that are running low or out of stock, so you can reorder before customers notice.
snippets.notes: Uses the low stock threshold from WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Inventory.

snippets.title: Recent Sales Widget for Easy Digital Downloads
snippets.description: Lists the latest completed Easy Digital Downloads orders on the dashboard with customer email and amount.
snippets.notes: Needs Easy Digital Downloads 3.0 or newer.

snippets.title: Keep Only Chosen Dashboard Widgets
snippets.description: Removes every dashboard widget, including those added by plugins, except the ones on your allow list.
snippets.notes: Widgets added by WPIDE snippets (IDs starting with wpide_) are always kept.

snippets.title: Skip the Dashboard for Chosen Roles
snippets.description: Sends users with certain roles straight to a more useful screen, like the Posts list, whenever they open the dashboard.
snippets.notes: Administrators are never redirected unless you add the administrator role to the list.

snippets.title: Newest Users Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Shows the most recent registrations on the dashboard with their role and sign-up date.

snippets.title: Most Commented Posts Widget
snippets.description: Lists the posts with the most approved comments on the dashboard, a quick read on what sparks conversation.

snippets.title: Drafts, Pending and Scheduled in "At a Glance"
snippets.description: Adds draft, pending and scheduled post counts to the At a Glance dashboard box, linked to the filtered lists.

snippets.title: Tutorial Video Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Embeds a how-to video on the dashboard, such as a walkthrough recorded for your client, with an optional short message.
snippets.notes: The oEmbed result is fetched from the video site; WordPress does not cache it outside posts, so keep the widget for clients only if needed.

snippets.title: Disk and Database Usage Widget
snippets.description: Shows how much space the uploads folder and the database take, recalculated once a day, so you notice a full hosting plan early.
snippets.notes: The first calculation can take a few seconds on sites with many uploads.

snippets.title: Softer Card Style for Dashboard Widgets
snippets.description: Gives dashboard widgets rounded corners, more breathing room and a colored top border, set with SCSS variables.

snippets.title: Login Page Background Image
snippets.description: Covers the login page with a full-screen background photo and a dark overlay that keeps the form readable.
snippets.notes: Use a compressed image of about 1920px wide so the login page stays fast.

snippets.title: Message Above the Login Form
snippets.description: Shows your own notice above the login form, for example to point customers to the shop account page or announce maintenance.
snippets.notes: The message only shows on the main login screen, not on password reset or registration.

snippets.title: Extra Links Below the Login Form
snippets.description: Adds a row of links under the login box, such as Contact, Help or Terms of Use.

snippets.title: Hide Links on the Login Page
snippets.description: Removes the "Go to site", "Lost your password?" and privacy policy links from the login screen, each one switchable on its own.
snippets.notes: Hiding the lost password link does not disable password resets.

snippets.title: Disable Password Resets for Everyone
snippets.description: Turns off the "Lost your password?" feature for all users, for sites where accounts are managed only by an administrator.
snippets.notes: The "Send password reset" button on the Users screen stops working too; set new passwords from the user profile instead.

snippets.title: Turn Off the Login Form Shake
snippets.description: Stops the login box from shaking after a wrong password, for a calmer login screen.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'shake_error_codes', '__return_empty_array' );

snippets.title: Send Logged-In Users Away From the Login Page
snippets.description: When someone who is already logged in opens wp-login.php, they go straight to the dashboard (or the homepage for subscribers) instead of seeing the form again.

snippets.title: Return Users to the Page They Were On After Login
snippets.description: After logging in, visitors land back on the page they came from instead of the dashboard, which suits membership and community sites.
snippets.notes: Some browsers or privacy settings do not send the referring page; those users get the normal destination.

snippets.title: Dark Mode for the Login Page
snippets.description: Switches the login page to dark colors automatically when the visitor's device is set to dark mode.
snippets.notes: If you use a dark logo, also provide a light version for dark mode.

snippets.title: Change Login Form Labels and Button Text
snippets.description: Renames the field labels and the button on the login screen, for example "Email" instead of "Username or Email Address" and "Sign in" instead of "Log In".
snippets.notes: Matches the original English strings, so it also works when the site language is not English.

snippets.title: Change the Login Page Browser Title
snippets.description: Sets the browser tab title of the login screens to "Log In | Your Site" instead of the WordPress default.

snippets.title: Hide the "Remember Me" Checkbox
snippets.description: Removes the Remember Me option so every login ends when the browser closes, which suits shared or public computers.
snippets.notes: Do not combine with snippets that tick Remember Me by default.

snippets.title: Log Out Idle Users Automatically
snippets.description: Logs users out after a set time without any mouse, keyboard or scroll activity, counted across all their open tabs.
snippets.notes: This runs in the browser; the login cookie itself keeps its normal lifetime.

snippets.title: Shorter Login Sessions for Administrators
snippets.description: Makes administrator logins expire sooner than everyone else's, limiting the damage of a forgotten logged-in browser.
snippets.notes: Applies from the next login; current sessions keep their expiry.

snippets.title: Login Form Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_login_form] shortcode that shows a login form on any page, or a "you are logged in" message with a logout link.
snippets.notes: Optional attribute: [wpide_login_form redirect="/members/"].

snippets.title: Log Out Without the Confirmation Screen
snippets.description: Logs users out right away from plain logout links (for example in menus) instead of showing "Do you really want to log out?".
snippets.notes: Without the confirmation step, another site could log your users out with a link; that is an annoyance, not a data risk.

snippets.title: Log In / Log Out Item in the Navigation Menu
snippets.description: Adds a Log in or Log out link at the end of a theme menu, depending on whether the visitor is logged in.
snippets.notes: Works with classic themes that use wp_nav_menu(); block themes use the Navigation block instead.

snippets.title: Allow Only Administrators to Log In
snippets.description: Temporarily blocks logins for everyone except administrators, for example during a migration or a security incident.
snippets.notes: People who are already logged in stay logged in until their session ends.

snippets.title: Use a Custom Page for Logging In
snippets.description: Sends visitors who open wp-login.php to your own login page (for example one with the login form shortcode), and back there when a login fails.
snippets.notes: Create the page first and test logging in from a private window before you rely on it.

snippets.title: Log In Prompt in the Middle of Posts
snippets.description: Shows a small "Log in or create an account" box halfway through articles for visitors who are not logged in.
snippets.code: Join the conversation. Log in or create a free account to comment and get updates.
snippets.notes: The "create an account" link only appears when "Anyone can register" is enabled.

snippets.title: Log In Reminder Above the Cart
snippets.description: Reminds guests at the top of the WooCommerce cart that they can log in to use saved addresses and see their order history.
snippets.code: Already have an account? Log in to check out faster with your saved details.

snippets.title: Log In Link Above the Easy Digital Downloads Checkout
snippets.description: Invites returning customers to log in before they fill in the Easy Digital Downloads checkout form, so purchases are linked to their account.
snippets.code: Bought from us before? Log in so this purchase appears in your account and download history.

snippets.title: Help Text in the MemberPress Login Form
snippets.description: Adds a short hint above the MemberPress login button with a link to reset the password, which cuts down on "I can't log in" emails.
snippets.code: Use the email address you signed up with. Forgot your password? Reset it here.

snippets.title: Log In Link Under the MemberPress Unauthorized Message
snippets.description: Adds a "Already a member? Log in" link below the MemberPress access-denied message, returning members to the same page after login.
snippets.code: Already a member? Log in to continue reading.

snippets.title: Allow Only One Active Session per User
snippets.description: Logs a user out of every other browser and device as soon as they log in somewhere new, which stops account sharing.
snippets.notes: The newest login always wins; the older sessions are ended on their next page load.

snippets.title: Redirect Users on Their First Login
snippets.description: Sends each user to a welcome or onboarding page the first time they log in, and to the usual place after that.
snippets.notes: Existing users count as first-timers on their next login after you activate this.

snippets.title: Show Your Previous Login Time After Logging In
snippets.description: Greets users in the admin with the date, time and IP address of their previous login, so they can spot logins they do not recognize.
snippets.notes: Stores the IP address of the last two logins in user meta; mention it in your privacy policy.

snippets.title: Load a login.css File From Your Theme
snippets.description: Loads login.css from the active (child) theme folder on the login page, so you can style it with a regular stylesheet.
snippets.notes: The file version updates automatically when you edit it, so browsers do not keep an old copy.

snippets.title: Placeholders in Login Form Fields
snippets.description: Adds hint text inside the username, password and email fields on the login, lost password and registration screens.

snippets.title: Hide the Logo on the Login Page
snippets.description: Removes the logo above the login form entirely for a minimal login screen.
snippets.notes: Do not combine with a snippet that sets a custom login logo.

snippets.title: Custom Post Type Counts in the Users List
snippets.description: Adds a column per custom post type to the Users screen showing how many published items each user has, next to the built-in Posts count.

snippets.title: Use First and Last Name as the Display Name
snippets.description: Sets each user's public display name to "First Last" whenever both names are filled in, instead of showing their username.
snippets.notes: Applies when a user is created or their profile is saved; existing users change on their next profile update.

snippets.title: Remove the Admin Color Scheme Picker
snippets.description: Hides the Admin Color Scheme option on profile screens, keeping a consistent look for every user.
snippets.notes: Pair with a snippet that forces one color scheme if you want everyone on the same one.

snippets.title: Hide Unneeded Profile Fields
snippets.description: Removes clutter from the profile screen, such as the website, biography, keyboard shortcuts and toolbar options, for non-administrators.
snippets.notes: Fields are hidden, not removed; their saved values are kept.

snippets.title: Let Editors Manage Users (Except Administrators)
snippets.description: Allows editors to add, edit and remove users, while making sure they can never create administrators or touch administrator accounts.
snippets.notes: Capabilities are granted in memory only, so deactivating the snippet removes them again.

snippets.title: Let Editors Manage Menus and Widgets
snippets.description: Gives editors access to Appearance > Menus and Widgets without letting them switch themes or open the Customizer.
snippets.notes: On block themes, menus live in the Site Editor, which editors can also open with this capability.

snippets.title: Let Editors Edit the Privacy Policy Page
snippets.description: WordPress only lets administrators edit the privacy policy page. This allows editors to update it too.
snippets.notes: The Settings > Privacy screen itself stays administrator-only.

snippets.title: Terms and Privacy Checkbox on Registration
snippets.description: Adds a required "I agree to the terms and privacy policy" checkbox to the WordPress registration form and records when each user agreed.
snippets.notes: Covers the default wp-login.php registration form; shop or membership plugins have their own forms.

snippets.title: First and Last Name on the Registration Form
snippets.description: Asks for first and last name when people register through the WordPress form and saves them to the new profile.

snippets.title: Block Disposable Email Addresses on Registration
snippets.description: Rejects registrations from throwaway email services, which are a common source of fake and spam accounts.
snippets.notes: Subdomains of listed domains are blocked as well.

snippets.title: Only Allow Registration From Certain Email Domains
snippets.description: Limits sign-ups to email addresses at the domains you list, for example your company or school domain.
snippets.notes: Administrators can still create users with any email address from the Users screen.

snippets.title: Approve New Users Before They Can Log In
snippets.description: New sign-ups wait for an administrator to approve them on the Users screen before they can log in, and get an email once approved.
snippets.notes: Users who registered before activation are treated as approved.

snippets.title: Initials Avatars Instead of Gravatar
snippets.description: Replaces Gravatar images with colored circles showing each person's initials, generated locally, so no visitor data is sent to Gravatar.
snippets.notes: Avatar URLs in the REST API still point to Gravatar; only images shown on your pages change.

snippets.title: Your Own Image as the Default Avatar
snippets.description: Adds your own image to the Default Avatar choices under Settings > Discussion, used for people without a Gravatar.
snippets.notes: After activating, choose the new avatar in Settings > Discussion (Gravatar must be able to reach the image URL).

snippets.title: Profile Picture From the Media Library
snippets.description: Lets users pick a profile picture from the Media Library on their profile screen; it replaces their Gravatar everywhere.
snippets.notes: Only users who can upload files (authors and up) see the picker; administrators can set pictures for anyone.

snippets.title: Stop Users From Changing Their Email Address
snippets.description: Makes the email field read-only for everyone except administrators, for sites where the email is tied to a contract or a login policy.

snippets.title: Allow HTML in Author Bios
snippets.description: Keeps links and basic formatting in the Biographical Info field for users who are trusted with unfiltered HTML, instead of stripping it.
snippets.notes: Bios are filtered with the same rules as post content, so scripts are still removed.

snippets.title: Add a Site Manager Role (No Database Changes)
snippets.description: Adds a "Site Manager" role with everything an editor can do plus managing users and menus, defined in code so nothing is written to the database.
snippets.notes: Users given this role lose their permissions while the snippet is inactive; reassign them before removing it.

snippets.title: Hide the Administrator Role From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes Administrator from the role dropdowns for anyone who is not an administrator, so delegated user managers cannot promote themselves or others.
snippets.notes: Useful whenever you give a non-administrator the ability to manage users.

snippets.title: Active Sessions Column With "Log Out Everywhere"
snippets.description: Shows how many devices each user is logged in on, with a link to end all of that user's sessions from the Users screen.

snippets.title: Record and Show the Registration IP Address
snippets.description: Saves the IP address each new account was created from and shows it in the Users list, which helps spot bulk fake sign-ups.
snippets.notes: IP addresses are personal data, so mention them in your privacy policy (behind a proxy you may see the proxy address).

snippets.title: Export Users to CSV
snippets.description: Adds an "Export CSV" button to the Users screen that downloads users with their name, email, role and registration date.
snippets.notes: When a role filter is active on the Users screen, only that role is exported.

snippets.title: Phone and Company Fields in User Profiles
snippets.description: Adds Phone and Company fields to user profiles, editable by the user and by administrators.
snippets.notes: Read a value in templates with get_user_meta( $user_id, 'wpide_phone', true ).

snippets.title: Last Post Date Column in the Users List
snippets.description: Shows when each user last published a post, which makes inactive authors easy to find.

snippets.title: Protect Specific Users From Editing and Deletion
snippets.description: Stops anyone but the users themselves from editing, demoting or deleting the accounts you list, such as the site owner or an agency account.
snippets.notes: Protected users can still edit their own profile.

snippets.title: Block Reserved Usernames
snippets.description: Prevents anyone from registering or being created with usernames like admin, support or root that look official or invite attacks.
snippets.notes: Existing users with these names are not affected.

snippets.title: Email Users When Their Role Changes
snippets.description: Sends users a short email when an administrator changes their role, for example when a subscriber becomes an author.

snippets.title: Private Admin Notes on User Profiles
snippets.description: Adds a notes box to user profiles that only administrators can see and edit, for things like support history or account details.

snippets.title: Make Authors Submit Posts for Review
snippets.description: Takes away the authors' right to publish, so their posts go to Pending Review for an editor to approve.
snippets.notes: Authors can still edit their already published posts; add a snippet to restrict that if needed.

snippets.title: Users Online Count in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Shows administrators how many logged-in users were active in the last five minutes, with their names in a dropdown.
snippets.notes: Writes one small transient at most once a minute per logged-in user.

snippets.title: Sign-Up Prompt Near the End of Posts
snippets.description: Invites logged-out readers to create a free account three quarters of the way through each article, when they are most engaged.
snippets.code:
Enjoying this article? Create a free account to get new posts and join the discussion.

Create my account
snippets.notes: Only shows when "Anyone can register" is enabled in Settings > General.

snippets.title: Create-Account Invitation on the Order Thank-You Page
snippets.description: Suggests to guest buyers on the WooCommerce thank-you page that they create an account to track this and future orders.
snippets.code: Want to track this order and check out faster next time? Create an account with the same email address.
snippets.notes: Only appears when account creation on the My Account page is enabled in WooCommerce settings.

snippets.title: Help Note Above MemberPress Subscriptions
snippets.description: Adds a short note above the subscriptions list in the MemberPress account page explaining how to change plans or get billing help.
snippets.code: Need to upgrade, downgrade or update your card? Use the links next to your subscription below, or email billing@example.com and we will help.
snippets.notes: Replace the email address with your own.

snippets.title: Profile Reminder on the MemberPress Account Page
snippets.description: Reminds members who have not filled in their first and last name to complete their profile, at the top of the MemberPress account page.
snippets.code:
exists() && ( '' === trim( $wpide_member->first_name ) || '' === trim( $wpide_member->last_name ) ) ) : ?>

Please add your first and last name below so we can personalize your account and invoices.

snippets.title: Disable XML-RPC Multicall
snippets.description: Removes the XML-RPC system.multicall method, which attackers use to try hundreds of passwords in a single request, while XML-RPC keeps working for apps and Jetpack.
snippets.notes: Use the "Disable XML-RPC" snippet instead if nothing on your site needs XML-RPC.

snippets.title: Content Security Policy Header (Report-Only)
snippets.description: Sends a starter Content Security Policy in report-only mode, so you can see in the browser console what a strict policy would block before enforcing it.
snippets.notes: Test page by page with the browser console open; an enforced policy that is too strict breaks scripts, embeds and fonts.

snippets.title: Protect wp-login.php With a Secret Key
snippets.description: Hides the login page behind a secret link: wp-login.php returns "Not Found" unless you have opened it with your key once in this browser.
snippets.notes: Bookmark the secret link, and if you lose it turn the snippet off from WPIDE safe mode.

snippets.title: Redirect wp-admin to the Homepage for Logged-Out Visitors
snippets.description: Sends logged-out visitors who open /wp-admin/ to the homepage instead of the login page, so bots probing wp-admin do not learn where to log in.
snippets.notes: You then need to open wp-login.php directly to log in.

snippets.title: Log Failed Logins
snippets.description: Keeps a log of the last 200 failed login attempts with username, IP address and time, viewable under Tools > Failed Logins.
snippets.notes: The log is stored in the wpide_failed_logins option (not autoloaded).

snippets.title: Simple Math Question on the Login Form
snippets.description: Adds a small addition question to wp-login.php that bots fail, without third-party CAPTCHA services or cookies.
snippets.notes: Custom login forms (shop or membership plugins) do not show the question and are not checked.

snippets.title: Allow Administrator Logins Only From Trusted IPs
snippets.description: Administrators can only log in from the IP addresses or ranges you list; everyone else logs in as usual.
snippets.notes: Add your own IP before activating (behind a proxy or CDN that may be the proxy address), or you will lock yourself out.

snippets.title: Slow Down Failed Login Attempts
snippets.description: Waits a second or two before answering a failed login, which makes password-guessing bots far slower without bothering real users.
snippets.notes: Each delayed request keeps a PHP worker busy; combine with a login limiter on busy sites.

snippets.title: Block Common and Guessable Passwords
snippets.description: Rejects the most common passwords, and passwords containing the username or site name, when users set or reset their password.

snippets.title: Block Malicious Request Patterns
snippets.description: A tiny firewall that returns 403 Forbidden for URLs containing typical attack strings, such as directory traversal, SQL injection and PHP stream wrappers.
snippets.notes: Form submissions are not inspected, so editors keep working, and it complements rather than replaces a real web application firewall.

snippets.title: Block Bad Bots by User Agent
snippets.description: Returns 403 Forbidden to aggressive SEO crawlers and scrapers that waste server resources, matched by their user agent.
snippets.notes: Only honest bots are stopped (others fake their user agent), and blocked SEO tools will no longer report on your site.

snippets.title: Block IP Addresses and Ranges
snippets.description: Denies access to the whole site for the IP addresses and IPv4 ranges you list, for example a persistent spammer or attacker.
snippets.notes: Behind Cloudflare or another proxy, REMOTE_ADDR is the proxy; configure your server to pass the real visitor IP first.

snippets.title: Redirect All Traffic to HTTPS
snippets.description: Permanently redirects every plain HTTP request to the HTTPS version of the same URL, for sites whose host does not do it already.
snippets.notes: Make sure your SSL certificate works first, and set both site URLs in Settings > General to https://.

snippets.title: Allow Only Safe File Types to Be Uploaded
snippets.description: Limits uploads to common images, documents, audio and video, and rejects files with a hidden second extension such as photo.php.jpg.
snippets.notes: Remove this snippet or extend the list before uploading other file types, such as ZIP archives or fonts.

snippets.title: Email Alert When Plugins Are Activated or Deactivated
snippets.description: Emails the site administrator whenever a plugin is turned on or off, with who did it and when.
snippets.notes: Bulk changes send one email per plugin.

snippets.title: Email Alert When a New Administrator Appears
snippets.description: Emails the site owner whenever an account is created as, or promoted to, administrator, which is often the first sign of a compromise.

snippets.title: Simple Admin Activity Log
snippets.description: Records logins, plugin and theme changes, updates, role changes and deleted content, and lists the last 300 events under Tools > Activity Log.
snippets.notes: A lightweight log for small sites; use a dedicated audit plugin when you need search, export or retention rules.

snippets.title: Lock Registration and Default Role Settings
snippets.description: Forces "Anyone can register" and the default new user role to fixed values in code, so an attacker or a mistake cannot open admin-level sign-ups.
snippets.notes: The settings screen shows the locked values; change them here instead.

snippets.title: Lock the Site URL and Admin Email
snippets.description: Ignores changes to the WordPress Address, Site Address and administration email made from the dashboard, a common target after an account takeover.
snippets.notes: Deactivate the snippet before a planned domain change or admin email update.

snippets.title: Prevent Deactivating Essential Plugins
snippets.description: Removes the Deactivate option for the plugins you list, for every user, so key functionality cannot be switched off by accident.
snippets.notes: The plugin can still be deactivated through FTP or WP-CLI.

snippets.title: Shorter Nonce Lifetime
snippets.description: Makes WordPress security tokens (nonces) expire after 4 hours instead of up to 24, shrinking the window in which a leaked link can be reused.
snippets.notes: Pages left open longer than this may show "The link you followed has expired" on submit; cached pages with forms are affected too.

snippets.title: Require Strong Passwords for Editors and Administrators
snippets.description: Requires at least 12 characters with letters, numbers and a symbol or mixed case for users who can edit other people's content.
snippets.notes: Existing passwords are not checked until the user changes or resets it.

snippets.title: Limit Password Reset Requests
snippets.description: Allows only a few password reset requests per hour from the same IP address, which stops reset-email flooding.

snippets.title: Hide Whether an Account Exists on Password Reset
snippets.description: Shows the same "check your email" screen for unknown usernames and emails on the lost password form, so it cannot be used to find valid accounts.
snippets.notes: Registration forms can still reveal existing emails; disable public registration if that matters.

snippets.title: Hide the REST API Index From Visitors
snippets.description: Stops logged-out visitors from listing every REST API route and plugin namespace at /wp-json/, while the routes themselves keep working.
snippets.notes: Some apps discover routes through the index; test integrations that connect to your site anonymously.

snippets.title: Hide PHP Errors From Visitors
snippets.description: Turns off on-screen PHP warnings and errors for everyone except logged-in administrators, so file paths are never shown to the public.
snippets.notes: Errors are still written to the error log if logging is enabled.

snippets.title: Honeypot Trap for Login and Registration Forms
snippets.description: Adds an invisible field to the login and registration forms; bots that fill it in are rejected while people never see it.
snippets.notes: Password managers rarely fill hidden fields, but test your own login once after activating.

snippets.title: Daily Core File Integrity Check
snippets.description: Compares your WordPress core files with the official checksums once a day and emails the administrator if any file was changed or is missing.
snippets.notes: Contacts api.wordpress.org once a day, and the scheduled event stays registered but idle after deactivation.

snippets.title: Hide Email Addresses From Spam Bots
snippets.description: Encodes every email address and mailto link in posts, widgets and comments so people see them normally but simple harvesting bots cannot read them.
snippets.notes: Determined scrapers that decode HTML entities can still read the addresses.

snippets.title: End Admin Sessions When the IP Address Changes
snippets.description: Logs an administrator out if their session suddenly comes from a different IP address than the one they logged in from, which blocks stolen cookies.
snippets.notes: Mobile and some office networks change IP often; switch to subnet matching or remove the snippet if admins get logged out too much.

snippets.title: Application Passwords for Administrators Only
snippets.description: Keeps Application Passwords available for administrators (for integrations and apps) but removes them for every other user.

snippets.title: Serve a security.txt File
snippets.description: Publishes /.well-known/security.txt so security researchers know how to report a vulnerability on your site responsibly.
snippets.notes: If your web server answers /.well-known/ itself, place a static file there instead.

snippets.title: Remove Usernames From CSS Classes
snippets.description: Strips the author and commenter usernames WordPress adds to body and comment classes, closing a quiet way to discover login names.
snippets.notes: Check that your theme CSS does not rely on these classes.

snippets.title: Ban IPs That Try Common Attack Usernames
snippets.description: Blocks an IP address from logging in for a day as soon as it tries a username like "admin" or "test" that does not exist on your site.
snippets.notes: Never list a username that a real person on your site uses.

snippets.title: Remind Administrators to Change Old Passwords
snippets.description: Shows administrators a reminder when they have not changed their password for 180 days.
snippets.notes: The count starts the first time each administrator opens the dashboard after activation.

snippets.title: Warn When There Are Too Many Administrators
snippets.description: Shows a dashboard notice listing the administrator accounts when there are more than you expect, a prompt to downgrade old or unused ones.

snippets.title: Warn About a Public debug.log File
snippets.description: Alerts administrators when WordPress writes errors to wp-content/debug.log, a file anyone can usually download and read.
snippets.notes: Some hosts block access to .log files; the notice cannot tell, so check the URL yourself.

snippets.title: Rate-Limit the REST API for Visitors
snippets.description: Limits how many REST API requests a logged-out visitor can make per minute and answers "429 Too Many Requests" beyond that, slowing scrapers and scanners.
snippets.notes: Writes a short-lived transient per visitor per minute; use it with a persistent object cache on busy sites.

snippets.title: Block Fake Googlebot Visits
snippets.description: Checks visitors that claim to be Googlebot with a reverse DNS lookup and blocks the impostors, which are usually scrapers or vulnerability scanners.
snippets.notes: The DNS check runs once per IP per day and adds a short delay to that first request.

snippets.title: Secure Checkout Note Above the Pay Button
snippets.description: Reassures shoppers right above the WooCommerce payment button that the connection is encrypted and card details are handled by the payment provider.
snippets.code: Secure checkout: your connection is encrypted and card details go straight to our payment provider. We never store them.
snippets.notes: Only keep the last sentence if it is true for the payment methods you use.

snippets.title: Strong Password Tip on the MemberPress Sign-Up Form
snippets.description: Adds a short tip about choosing a strong, unique password just above the MemberPress checkout button.
snippets.code: Tip: use a password you do not use anywhere else, at least 12 characters long. A password manager makes this easy.

snippets.title: Load Block Styles Only for Blocks on the Page
snippets.description: Replaces the single large block stylesheet with small per-block styles that load only when a block is actually used, which helps classic themes most.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'should_load_separate_core_block_assets', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Block themes already do this; on classic themes, check pages with widgets or page builders afterwards.

snippets.title: Disable WooCommerce Cart Fragments Outside the Shop
snippets.description: Stops the cart fragments script, which fires an extra uncached AJAX request on every page, everywhere except the shop, product, cart and checkout pages.
snippets.notes: A mini-cart in the header will not update live on other pages until the visitor reaches a shop page.

snippets.title: Preload the Featured Image on Single Posts
snippets.description: Tells the browser to fetch the featured image of the current post or page right away, which improves Largest Contentful Paint when it is shown at the top.
snippets.notes: Skip this if your theme shows the featured image lower on the page; preloading an image that is not above the fold wastes bandwidth.

snippets.title: Preload Key Web Fonts
snippets.description: Preloads the font files used above the fold, so text appears in the right font sooner and the layout shifts less.
snippets.notes: Copy the exact font URLs from your browser's Network panel and preload no more than one or two.

snippets.title: Empty the Trash After 7 Days
snippets.description: Permanently removes trashed posts, pages and comments after 7 days instead of 30, keeping the database lean.
snippets.notes: Has no effect if EMPTY_TRASH_DAYS is already set in wp-config.php.

snippets.title: Load Selected Stylesheets Without Blocking Rendering
snippets.description: Loads the stylesheets you choose in the background so they no longer delay the first paint, ideal for CSS of things below the fold like sliders or forms.
snippets.notes: Do not use it for the main theme stylesheet, or visitors will briefly see unstyled content.

snippets.title: Move Selected Scripts to the Footer
snippets.description: Moves the scripts you list from the page head to the footer, so they stop blocking the page from rendering.
snippets.notes: A script stays in the head if another head script depends on it, so test interactive features afterwards.

snippets.title: Run WP-Cron From a Real Cron Job
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from checking for scheduled tasks on every page view; you trigger wp-cron.php from your server's cron instead, which is faster and more reliable.
snippets.notes: Without the server cron job, scheduled posts, backups and emails stop running.

snippets.title: Disable the Heartbeat API Except in the Post Editor
snippets.description: Keeps the Heartbeat API (autosave and post locking) in the editor but turns it off on every other admin and front-end page to save server requests.
snippets.notes: Some plugins rely on Heartbeat on their own screens; and the "session expired" login prompt only appears in the editor.

snippets.title: Remove Google Fonts Loaded by Themes and Plugins
snippets.description: Dequeues every stylesheet loaded from Google Fonts and removes the related preconnect hints, for speed and GDPR compliance.
snippets.notes: Your theme falls back to system fonts unless you host the fonts yourself, and page builders that inline fonts need their own setting.

snippets.title: Speed Up the Custom Fields Meta Box
snippets.description: Skips the slow database query that fills the Custom Fields key dropdown, which can freeze the classic editor on sites with lots of post meta.
snippets.notes: Existing custom fields on a post are still listed and editable.

snippets.title: Remove the Months Filter From Admin Lists
snippets.description: Drops the "All dates" dropdown from post and media lists, saving a slow query on sites with many thousands of posts or files.

snippets.title: Click-to-Play YouTube Embeds
snippets.description: Shows a lightweight thumbnail instead of the full YouTube player until the visitor clicks play, saving around a megabyte of scripts per video.
snippets.notes: Works for YouTube links in posts and Embed blocks, loading the thumbnail from i.ytimg.com and the player from youtube-nocookie.com.

snippets.title: Browser and CDN Caching Headers for Visitors
snippets.description: Sends Cache-Control headers on public pages for logged-out visitors, so a CDN or proxy can cache them for a few minutes.
snippets.notes: Only useful with a CDN or caching proxy in front of the site, and pages with personal content for visitors must be excluded.

snippets.title: Skip Slow Site Health Tests
snippets.description: Removes the Site Health checks that make HTTP requests back to your own site, which are slow or time out on some hosts.
snippets.notes: Skipped tests are simply not shown, so problems they would detect stay hidden.

snippets.title: Raise the Memory Limit for Admin Tasks
snippets.description: Gives memory-hungry admin tasks like image processing and imports more room, without raising the limit for every front-end visit.
snippets.notes: Your host's PHP limit still applies; this cannot go above it.

snippets.title: Cap the Largest Image Size in srcset
snippets.description: Stops browsers on large screens from downloading huge image versions by leaving very wide sizes out of the responsive srcset list.

snippets.title: Fast 404 for Missing Images, Scripts and Styles
snippets.description: Answers requests for missing images, CSS, JavaScript and font files with a tiny 404 instead of loading a full theme page, saving server time.
snippets.notes: Do not use it with plugins that create image sizes on the fly when a file is missing.

snippets.title: Load comment-reply.js Only When Needed
snippets.description: Stops the threaded comments script from loading on pages that have no open comments or where threading is turned off.

snippets.title: Skip PDF Preview Images on Upload
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from generating preview images for every uploaded PDF, which speeds up uploads and saves disk space.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'fallback_intermediate_image_sizes', '__return_empty_array' );
snippets.notes: PDFs then show a generic document icon in the Media Library.

snippets.title: Load Contact Form 7 Assets Only Where a Form Is Used
snippets.description: Keeps Contact Form 7 scripts and styles off every page except those that contain a form, removing two requests from most pages.
snippets.notes: Does nothing unless Contact Form 7 is active.

snippets.title: Disable WooCommerce Analytics and Admin Extras
snippets.description: Turns off WooCommerce Analytics, the React-based admin home, onboarding and marketing screens, which noticeably speeds up the admin on smaller stores.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_admin_disabled', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Orders, products and the classic reports keep working; Analytics pages disappear.

snippets.title: Preload the Site Logo
snippets.description: Preloads the logo set in the theme or Site Editor so it appears with the first paint of the header.
snippets.notes: Best for logos that are images (PNG, JPG, WebP); inline SVG logos need no preloading.

snippets.title: Cache oEmbed Results Longer
snippets.description: Keeps embedded content like videos and social posts cached for 30 days instead of re-fetching it from the provider every day.
snippets.notes: Changes to an embedded item (a renamed video, for example) take longer to show.

snippets.title: Cache User Counts on Large Sites
snippets.description: Caches the per-role user counts shown on the Users screen and dashboard for 12 hours, avoiding a heavy query on sites with many users.
snippets.notes: Counts refresh when users are added, deleted or change role, and at least every 12 hours.

snippets.title: Stop Elementor From Loading Google Fonts
snippets.description: Prevents Elementor from requesting fonts from Google's servers, for faster pages and fewer third-party connections.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'elementor/frontend/print_google_fonts', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Elementor designs fall back to system fonts unless you upload them as custom fonts (no effect without Elementor).

snippets.title: Spawn WP-Cron Less Often
snippets.description: Lets WordPress start its background task runner at most every five minutes instead of every minute, reducing extra requests on busy sites.
snippets.notes: Scheduled tasks can run up to five minutes late.

snippets.title: Click-to-Load Google Maps Embeds
snippets.description: Replaces embedded Google Maps in your content with a placeholder that loads the map only when clicked, for faster pages and fewer third-party cookies.
snippets.notes: Only maps pasted as embed iframes in post content are replaced.

snippets.title: Unload Plugin Assets Except on the Pages That Need Them
snippets.description: Removes the scripts and styles you list from every page except the ones you choose, for plugins that load their files site-wide.
snippets.notes: Find handles in the page source (id="HANDLE-css" or id="HANDLE-js") and test the pages that still need them.

snippets.title: Revision Limits per Post Type
snippets.description: Keeps a different number of revisions for each content type, for example many for posts and none for products.
snippets.notes: Older revisions beyond the limit are removed the next time the item is saved.

snippets.title: Disable the Customizer
snippets.description: Removes the Customizer for every user, including its admin menu and admin bar links, on sites that are configured elsewhere.
snippets.notes: Classic themes that keep their logo, colors or menus in the Customizer lose access to those settings.

snippets.title: Disable Categories for Posts
snippets.description: Removes categories from posts: the Categories menu, the editor panel and the column in the posts list.
snippets.notes: Existing assignments stay in the database; do not use it if your permalinks include %category%.

snippets.title: Disable Post Formats
snippets.description: Removes the Post Format option (aside, gallery, quote and so on) from the editor when your theme supports formats you do not use.

snippets.title: Disable Posts for a Pages-Only Site
snippets.description: Hides the built-in Posts type everywhere in the admin and on the front end, for brochure sites that only use pages.
snippets.notes: Existing posts return 404, so set a static homepage in Settings > Reading first.

snippets.title: Allow Only Minor Core Auto-Updates
snippets.description: Keeps automatic security and maintenance releases of WordPress (like 6.8.1 to 6.8.2) but stops automatic major upgrades.
snippets.code:
add_filter( 'allow_major_auto_core_updates', '__return_false' );
add_filter( 'allow_minor_auto_core_updates', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Plan major upgrades yourself after testing them on staging.

snippets.title: Disable Automatic Translation Updates
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from installing updated language files on its own, for sites with customized translations.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'auto_update_translation', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Translation updates remain available under Dashboard > Updates.

snippets.title: Disable Site Health
snippets.description: Hides the Site Health screen, its dashboard widget and its menu entry for every user.
snippets.notes: The weekly background check still runs; only the screens are removed.

snippets.title: Prevent Switching Themes
snippets.description: Stops anyone, administrators included, from activating a different theme, so a client cannot change the site design by accident.
snippets.notes: Deactivate the snippet when you do want to change themes.

snippets.title: Disable the Font Library
snippets.description: Removes the Font Library from the Site Editor, so fonts cannot be installed or uploaded from the editor.
snippets.notes: Fonts that are already installed keep working.

snippets.title: Disable the Image Lightbox Option
snippets.description: Removes the "Expand on click" lightbox setting from Image blocks and turns the lightbox off.

snippets.title: Disable the Command Palette in wp-admin
snippets.description: Turns off the Ctrl+K / Cmd+K command palette on regular admin screens.
snippets.notes: The block editor and Site Editor keep their own command menu.

snippets.title: Hide the Post via Email Settings
snippets.description: Removes the rarely used "Post via email" section from Settings > Writing.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'enable_post_by_email_configuration', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Stop Pinging Update Services
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from notifying ping services such as Ping-O-Matic every time you publish, which most sites no longer need.
snippets.notes: Pingbacks and trackbacks are separate; use the pingbacks snippet to turn those off.

snippets.title: Stop Turning Pasted URLs Into Embeds
snippets.description: Keeps links pasted on their own line as plain links instead of turning them into embedded videos, tweets or posts.
snippets.notes: Embed blocks added on purpose in the block editor still work.

snippets.title: Turn Off Avatars Everywhere
snippets.description: Stops avatars from being shown in comments, the admin bar and user lists, saving the image requests.
snippets.notes: Same as unticking "Show Avatars" in Settings > Discussion, but locked in code.

snippets.title: Stop WordPress Guessing URLs on 404 Pages
snippets.description: Turns off the automatic redirect WordPress makes when a URL does not exist but looks similar to a post slug, so wrong URLs show a real 404.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'do_redirect_guess_404_permalink', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Useful when the guessing sends visitors to unrelated pages.

snippets.title: Hide Admin Notices From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes plugin and theme notices, update nags and promotions from the admin for everyone who is not an administrator.
snippets.notes: Messages like "Post updated" are not admin notices and keep showing.

snippets.title: Ignore Sticky Posts on the Blog Page
snippets.description: Shows posts in plain date order on the blog page, even if some are marked "Stick to the top".
snippets.notes: Blocks and widgets with their own sticky setting are not affected.

snippets.title: Remove "Private:" and "Protected:" From Titles
snippets.description: Shows private and password-protected posts with their plain title, without the prefix WordPress adds.

snippets.title: Stop Converting Text Smileys to Images
snippets.description: Leaves text like :) and ;-) as typed instead of replacing it with smiley images or emoji.
snippets.notes: Emoji you type directly are not affected; use the emoji snippet to stop the emoji script.

snippets.title: Remove Unwanted Block Style Variations
snippets.description: Hides block styles you do not want editors to use, such as the outline button or rounded image, from the block editor.
snippets.notes: Blocks already using a removed style keep it until edited.

snippets.title: Hide Embed Blocks You Do Not Use
snippets.description: Keeps only the embed providers you choose, like YouTube and Vimeo, in the block inserter instead of dozens of services.
snippets.notes: Pasting a URL from a hidden provider may still create an embed.

snippets.title: Disable Responsive Image srcset
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from adding srcset and sizes attributes to images, for sites where an image CDN already serves the right size.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wp_calculate_image_srcset', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Without a CDN that resizes images, phones will download full-size images.

snippets.title: Disable "sizes=auto" on Lazy-Loaded Images
snippets.description: Turns off the automatic sizes="auto" attribute WordPress adds to lazy-loaded images, which some themes and sliders display incorrectly.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wp_img_tag_add_auto_sizes', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Turn Off the Visual Tab in the Classic Editor
snippets.description: Makes the classic editor open in Text (HTML) mode only, for sites where the visual editor keeps changing hand-written markup.
snippets.notes: Only affects the classic editor; the block editor is unchanged.

snippets.title: Disable Additional CSS
snippets.description: Removes the Additional CSS panel from the Customizer and the custom CSS option in the Site Editor, so styles are only changed in code.
snippets.notes: CSS that was already saved keeps loading on the site.

snippets.title: Stop WordPress Serving Its Logo as favicon.ico
snippets.description: When no Site Icon is set, WordPress answers /favicon.ico with its own logo. This returns a plain 404 instead, so your tab never shows the WordPress logo.
snippets.notes: If a real favicon.ico file exists in the site root, your web server serves it before WordPress is involved.

snippets.title: Stop Redirecting Old Post Slugs
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from redirecting a post's previous URLs after its slug changes, for when you want an old address to be free or truly gone.
snippets.notes: Links and search results that point to old slugs will return 404, which can hurt SEO.

snippets.title: Lock the Editor to Theme Colors and Font Sizes
snippets.description: Removes the custom color picker, default palettes and custom font sizes from the block editor, so editors can only use your theme's brand styles.
snippets.notes: If your theme defines no palette or font sizes of its own, editors are left with none to choose from.

snippets.title: Disable Comments on Specific Post Types
snippets.description: Turns comments and pings off for the post types you choose, such as pages or products, while keeping them on blog posts.
snippets.notes: Existing comments stay in the database; hide them too with a comments_array filter if needed.

snippets.title: Send Comments With Too Many Links to Spam
snippets.description: Marks a comment as spam when it contains more links than you allow, catching most link-dropping spam before it reaches the moderation queue.
snippets.notes: Logged-in users are never affected; check the Spam folder now and then for false positives.

snippets.title: Stricter Comment Flood Protection
snippets.description: Requires a longer pause between two comments from the same person, 60 seconds instead of WordPress's 15, to slow down comment bursts.

snippets.title: Reject Comments Submitted Too Fast
snippets.description: Rejects comments sent within a few seconds of the page loading, which only bots manage, using a signed timestamp in the form.
snippets.notes: Works with page caching because the check only sets a minimum age.

snippets.title: Email Commenters When Someone Replies (Opt-In)
snippets.description: Adds a "Notify me of replies" checkbox to the comment form and emails the commenter once a reply to their comment is approved.
snippets.notes: Each reply sends at most one email, and replies by the original commenter are skipped.

snippets.title: Remove Links From Comment Author Names
snippets.description: Shows commenter names as plain text instead of links to their websites, removing the main reward for comment spammers.
snippets.notes: Combine with removing the website field so new commenters are not asked for a URL.

snippets.title: Change the Comment Form Title, Note and Button Text
snippets.description: Replaces "Leave a Reply", the "Your email address will not be published" note and the "Post Comment" button with your own wording.
snippets.notes: Leave out any key you want to keep as it is.

snippets.title: Remove the Email Field From Comments
snippets.description: Lets visitors comment with just a name, for communities where asking for an email address puts people off.
snippets.notes: Without email addresses, Gravatars, reply notifications and some spam filters work less well.

snippets.title: Stop Saving Commenter Details in Cookies
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from remembering commenters' name, email and website in cookies, and removes the related consent checkbox.
snippets.notes: Returning visitors have to type their details again; pending comments are no longer shown to their author.

snippets.title: Show Comments Only After a Click
snippets.description: Collapses the comments section behind a "Show comments" button, so long discussions do not distract from the article or load avatars until wanted.
snippets.notes: Links to a specific comment or to the form open the section automatically.

snippets.title: Recent Comments Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_recent_comments] shortcode that lists the latest approved comments with the commenter's name, post title and a short excerpt.
snippets.notes: Options: [wpide_recent_comments number="8" words="20"].

snippets.title: Top Commenters Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_top_commenters] shortcode listing the people who left the most approved comments, a simple way to thank your community.
snippets.notes: Results are cached for 12 hours; options: [wpide_top_commenters number="5" days="90"].

snippets.title: Stop Turning URLs in Comments Into Links
snippets.description: Keeps web addresses typed in comments as plain text, so spam links are not clickable.
snippets.notes: Links written as HTML anchors are not affected; use the "Strip HTML from comments" snippet for those.

snippets.title: Send Comment Moderation Emails to More People
snippets.description: Sends "comment awaiting moderation" emails to extra addresses, such as your community manager, besides the site admin and post author.
snippets.notes: Emails are only sent while "A comment is held for moderation" is ticked in Settings > Discussion.

snippets.title: Hold Comments Written in All Capitals
snippets.description: Sends comments that are mostly in capital letters to the moderation queue instead of publishing them straight away.
snippets.notes: Short comments (under 20 letters) are never held.

snippets.title: Character Counter Under the Comment Box
snippets.description: Shows how many characters are left while typing a comment and stops input at the limit you set.
snippets.notes: Pair it with the minimum and maximum comment length snippet for a server-side check.

snippets.title: Auto-Approve Comments From Logged-In Users
snippets.description: Publishes comments from registered, logged-in users right away, while comments from guests still follow your moderation settings.
snippets.notes: Anyone who can register can then publish comments instantly; keep registrations under control.

snippets.title: Hide Comments in the Admin From Users Who Cannot Moderate
snippets.description: Removes the Comments menu, admin bar bubble and screen for users without moderation rights, such as authors and contributors.

snippets.title: Modern Comment List Styles
snippets.description: Restyles the comment list as soft cards with round avatars, a highlighted post author and thin lines that show reply threads.
snippets.notes: Theme styles with higher specificity may win; inspect the comment markup of your theme if something does not change.

snippets.title: Clean Comment Form Styles
snippets.description: Gives the comment form full-width fields, rounded corners, a clear focus color and a solid submit button that match your accent color.

snippets.title: Jump-to-Comments Link in the Middle of Posts
snippets.description: Adds a small "Join the discussion" link with the comment count halfway through posts, so engaged readers find the comments faster.
snippets.code: ↓
snippets.notes: Links to the comment form (#respond), which exists in classic and block themes.

snippets.title: Comment Invitation Near the End of Posts
snippets.description: Asks readers a question near the end of each post (after 80% of the content) and links straight to the comment form.
snippets.code: What do you think? Share your experience or ask a question in the comments. We read every one.

snippets.title: Review Prompt Below the Product Summary
snippets.description: Adds a "Bought this? Share your review" link with the current review count under the WooCommerce product summary, opening the Reviews tab.

snippets.notes: The woocommerce-review-link class makes WooCommerce open the Reviews tab on click.

snippets.title: Show Comments Only to Logged-In Users
snippets.description: Hides existing comments and the comment form from visitors who are not logged in, including in feeds and the REST API, and invites them to log in.
snippets.notes: Logged-in users of any role see and post comments as usual.

snippets.title: Let Visitors Report Inappropriate Comments
snippets.description: Adds a "Report" link to each comment; moderators get an email on the first report and the comment is held for review after three reports.
snippets.notes: Page caching longer than 12 hours can make the report link fail, because the security token expires.

snippets.title: Send Comments With Links in the Name Field to Spam
snippets.description: Marks comments as spam when the name field contains a web address, a classic trick of spam bots.

snippets.title: Close Comments After a Set Number
snippets.description: Closes the comment form on a post once it has reached the number of approved comments you choose, keeping threads manageable.

snippets.title: Email Commenters When Their Comment Is Approved
snippets.description: Lets people know by email when the comment they left has been approved and is live, with a link to it.

snippets.title: Latest Comment Teaser Inside Long Posts
snippets.description: Shows a short quote from the most recent approved comment two thirds of the way through a post, with a link to the discussion.

snippets.notes: Nothing is shown on posts without approved comments.

snippets.title: Questions Prompt Below Easy Digital Downloads Products
snippets.description: Invites visitors to ask questions in the comments at the end of each Easy Digital Downloads product page, when comments are open.
snippets.code: Questions before you buy? Ask them in the comments and we will answer publicly so others can benefit too.
snippets.notes: Downloads need comments enabled for the prompt to appear.

snippets.title: Automatic Table of Contents
snippets.description: Adds a linked table of contents above posts that have enough headings, and gives each heading an anchor so readers can jump straight to a section.
snippets.notes: Change the minimum heading count, the heading levels or the title in the variables at the top.

snippets.title: Copyable Anchor Links on Headings
snippets.description: Gives h2 to h4 headings in posts and pages an ID and a small # link that appears on hover, so readers can share a link to an exact section.
snippets.notes: Works alongside the table of contents snippet; headings that already have an ID keep it.

snippets.title: Estimated Reading Time Above Posts
snippets.description: Shows a short "5 min read" line at the top of every blog post, calculated from the number of words in the post.
snippets.notes: Adjust the reading speed in words per minute or the label text at the top of the snippet.

snippets.title: Word Count Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [word_count] shortcode that prints how many words the current post contains, handy for long-form guides and writing portfolios.
snippets.notes: Use [word_count id="123"] to show the count of another post.

snippets.title: Simple Post Views Counter
snippets.description: Counts how many times each blog post is viewed, shows the total in a Views column in the posts list and adds a [post_views] shortcode for the front end.
snippets.notes: Visits from logged-in editors and common bots are not counted. Full-page caching stops the counter from seeing cached visits.

snippets.title: Share Links Below Posts
snippets.description: Adds plain share links for X, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and email under each blog post. No third-party scripts or tracking pixels are loaded.
snippets.notes: Remove networks you do not want from the $wpide_share_networks list.

snippets.title: Print Button Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [print_button] shortcode that places a button visitors can click to print the current page, useful for recipes, guides and forms.
snippets.notes: Change the label with [print_button label="Print this recipe"].

snippets.title: Affiliate Disclosure on Selected Categories
snippets.description: Shows an affiliate or sponsorship disclosure at the top of posts in the categories you choose, so you never forget to add it by hand.
snippets.notes: Set the category slugs and the disclosure text at the top of the snippet.

snippets.title: Notice on Old Posts
snippets.description: Warns readers at the top of posts older than a set number of years that the information may be out of date.
snippets.notes: Change the age in years and the message; %s is replaced with the age, such as "3 years".

snippets.title: Show Content Between Two Dates
snippets.description: Adds a [scheduled] shortcode that shows the text inside it only from a start date, until an end date, or between both. Ideal for limited offers and event notices.
snippets.notes: Example: [scheduled from="2026-11-25 00:00" until="2026-11-30 23:59"]Black Friday sale![/scheduled]. Dates use the site time zone. Page caching may delay the switch.

snippets.title: Content for Logged-In or Logged-Out Visitors
snippets.description: Adds [members_only] and [guests_only] shortcodes so you can show different text, links or offers to visitors depending on whether they are logged in.
snippets.notes: [members_only message="Please log in to read this."] shows the message to guests instead of nothing.

snippets.title: Show Content to Specific Roles
snippets.description: Adds a [show_to] shortcode that reveals the text inside it only to users with the roles you list, such as editors or customers.
snippets.notes: Example: [show_to roles="editor,administrator"]Internal note[/show_to]. Content stays hidden from everyone else, including guests.

snippets.title: Button Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [button] shortcode that turns a link into a styled button using your theme's button styles, for calls to action inside classic content and widgets.
snippets.notes: Example: [button url="/contact/" text="Get in touch" new_tab="no"].

snippets.title: Notice Box Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [notice] shortcode for colored info, success, warning and error boxes that make tips and important warnings stand out in your content.
snippets.notes: Example: [notice type="warning" title="Heads up"]Back up first.[/notice]. Types are info, success, warning and error.

snippets.title: Site Name, Tagline and URL Shortcodes
snippets.description: Adds [site_name], [site_tagline] and [site_url] shortcodes so text that mentions your site stays correct if you rename or move it.
snippets.notes: [site_url link="yes"] prints a clickable link instead of plain text.

snippets.title: Child Pages List Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [child_pages] shortcode that lists the subpages of the current page, so section landing pages always link to everything below them.
snippets.notes: Use [child_pages id="12" depth="2"] to list the children of another page or to include grandchildren.

snippets.title: Recent Posts Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [recent_posts] shortcode that lists your latest posts anywhere, optionally from one category and with dates.
snippets.notes: Example: [recent_posts number="5" category="news" show_date="yes"].

snippets.title: Previous and Next Post Links Below Posts
snippets.description: Adds links to the previous and next post at the end of each blog post, for themes that do not show post navigation.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_same_category to true to only link to posts in the same category.

snippets.title: Show the Featured Image Above Post Content
snippets.description: Prints the featured image at the top of single posts, for themes that only use featured images on archive pages.
snippets.notes: Change the image size from large to full or any registered size. Do not use it if your theme already shows the image on single posts.

snippets.title: Replace Words in Content on Display
snippets.description: Swaps words or phrases in post titles, content and excerpts when pages are shown, without editing the posts. Useful after a rebrand or a product rename.
snippets.notes: Replacements are case-sensitive and skip HTML tags and attributes. The text saved in the database is not changed.

snippets.title: Automatic Internal Links for Keywords
snippets.description: Turns the first mention of chosen keywords in each post into a link to the page you pick, building internal links without editing every post.
snippets.notes: Add your keywords and target pages to the list first; it is empty by default. Links are not added inside headings, existing links, code or buttons, and a post never links to itself.

snippets.title: Larger Lead Paragraph on Posts
snippets.description: Makes the first paragraph of every blog post slightly larger, a classic magazine touch that draws readers into the article.
snippets.notes: Change the font size in the style rule at the bottom of the snippet.

snippets.title: Automatic Drop Cap on Posts
snippets.description: Styles the first letter of every blog post as a large decorative drop cap, without having to switch it on block by block.
snippets.notes: Selectors cover block themes and most classic themes; adjust them if your theme uses different content classes.

snippets.title: Minimum Word Count to Publish Posts
snippets.description: Stops posts shorter than a minimum number of words from being published, in both the block editor and the classic editor, to keep thin content off the site.
snippets.notes: Drafts can still be saved at any length. Change the minimum at the top of the snippet.

snippets.title: Starter Text for New Posts
snippets.description: Fills the editor of every new post with your own starter text or outline, so writers begin from the same structure each time.
snippets.notes: Change the post type or the starter HTML. Existing posts are not affected.

snippets.title: Footnotes Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [ref] shortcode for footnotes: each note becomes a numbered superscript link, and all notes are listed at the end of the post with links back.
snippets.notes: Example: The study found this.[ref]Smith, 2024, page 12.[/ref] Notes can contain links and basic formatting.

snippets.title: Collapsible Toggle Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [toggle] shortcode that hides text behind a clickable title, built on the native details element so it works without JavaScript.
snippets.notes: Example: [toggle title="What is included?" open="no"]Answer here.[/toggle].

snippets.title: Spam-Protected Email Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds an [email] shortcode that prints a clickable email address encoded so simple spam bots cannot harvest it.
snippets.notes: Example: [email]hello@example.com[/email] or [email address="hello@example.com" label="Email us"].

snippets.title: Show Recent Post Dates as "2 Days Ago"
snippets.description: Displays the publish date of recent posts in a friendly relative format, such as "3 hours ago", and switches back to the normal date after a set number of days.
snippets.notes: Machine-readable dates in datetime attributes are left untouched. Change the day limit at the top.

snippets.title: Change the "Read More" Tag Link
snippets.description: Changes the text of the link created by the More block and stops it from jumping halfway down the post when clicked.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_more_text to your own wording. Set $wpide_more_jump to true to keep the jump to the #more anchor.

snippets.title: Custom Message on Password-Protected Posts
snippets.description: Replaces the standard "This content is password protected" sentence with your own message, for example explaining how to get the password.
snippets.notes: Basic HTML such as links is allowed in the message.

snippets.title: Remove "Protected:" and "Private:" From Titles
snippets.description: Drops the "Protected:" and "Private:" words WordPress adds in front of the titles of password-protected and private posts.

snippets.title: Hide the Title on Selected Pages
snippets.description: Removes the page title on the pages you list, such as a landing page or the homepage, while keeping it in menus, the browser tab and search results.
snippets.notes: Add the page IDs to the list. Some themes print the title outside the main loop, in which case hide it with CSS instead.

snippets.title: Turn Plain URLs Into Links
snippets.description: Converts web addresses and email addresses typed as plain text in posts into clickable links.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'the_content', 'make_clickable', 12 );
snippets.notes: Text inside existing links, code and preformatted blocks is left alone.

snippets.title: "New" Badge on Recent Post Titles
snippets.description: Adds a small "New" label next to the titles of posts published in the last few days on your blog and archive pages.
snippets.notes: Change the number of days or the label text. Themes that use the title inside an HTML attribute will show the word as plain text there.

snippets.title: Unpublish Posts on an Expiry Date
snippets.description: Adds an "Unpublish on" date box to the post editor and moves expired posts back to draft automatically, for time-limited offers and announcements.
snippets.notes: A check runs every hour with WP-Cron, so posts expire within an hour of the chosen time. Dates use the site time zone.

snippets.title: Call to Action in the Middle of Posts
snippets.description: Places a call-to-action box halfway through each post, where readers who are engaged are most likely to notice it.
snippets.code:
Want the full checklist?

Download the free PDF version of this guide and keep it handy.

Get the checklist
snippets.notes: Replace the heading, text and link with your own offer.

snippets.title: Repeating Ad Slot Every 350 Words
snippets.description: Inserts your ad code after every 350 words of a post, at paragraph boundaries, so long articles earn more without manual placement.
snippets.code: Advertisement
snippets.notes: Change the word count in the snippet settings and paste your ad network code in place of the placeholder.

snippets.title: "Read Next" Link Two Thirds Into Posts
snippets.description: Adds a "Read next" link to another post from the same category two thirds of the way through each article, keeping readers on your site.

snippets.title: Call-to-Action Group Block After Posts

snippets.title: Make Content Tables Scroll on Small Screens
snippets.description: Wraps tables in posts and pages in a scrollable container so wide tables no longer break the layout on phones.
snippets.notes: Tables that are already inside a Table block wrapper are left as they are.

snippets.title: Remove Empty Paragraphs From Content
snippets.description: Cleans up the empty paragraphs and stray line breaks left behind by pasted text, old page builders and shortcodes, so spacing stays even.

snippets.title: Hide Leftover Shortcodes From Removed Plugins
snippets.description: Hides shortcodes such as [old_slider id="3"] that show up as raw text after the plugin that handled them was removed.
snippets.notes: To avoid removing normal bracketed text, only tags with attributes, a closing tag, or an underscore or hyphen in their name are hidden.

snippets.title: Post Title, Date and Author Shortcodes
snippets.description: Adds [post_title], [post_date], [post_modified], [post_author] and [post_url] shortcodes for templates, patterns and widgets that need details of the current post.
snippets.notes: Date shortcodes accept a format, for example [post_date format="j F Y"].

snippets.title: Custom Field Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [field] shortcode that prints the value of a custom field of the current post, so you can show details like a price or a subtitle inside the content.
snippets.notes: Example: [field name="subtitle" default="-"]. Hidden fields whose names start with an underscore are never shown.

snippets.title: Countdown Timer Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [countdown] shortcode that shows a live days, hours, minutes and seconds countdown to a date, with a message once the time is up.
snippets.notes: Example: [countdown to="2026-12-31 23:59" expired="The sale has ended."]. The date uses the site time zone.

snippets.title: Copy Button on Code Blocks
snippets.description: Adds a "Copy" button to every code block in your posts so readers can copy commands and code samples with one click.
snippets.notes: The button appears on pre elements inside the content; style it with the .wpide-copy-code class.

snippets.title: Open PDF Links in a New Tab
snippets.description: Makes links to PDF files in your content open in a new browser tab, so visitors do not lose their place on your site.
snippets.notes: Links that already set a target are left unchanged.

snippets.title: Show Excerpts Instead of Full Posts on Archives
snippets.description: Shows a short excerpt and a "Read more" link for each post on the blog page, archives and search results, for themes that print the full content of every post.
snippets.notes: The excerpt length and the link text follow your excerpt settings and other excerpt snippets.

snippets.title: Elegant Blockquote Styles (SCSS)
snippets.description: Gives quotes in your posts a refined look with a large quotation mark, an accent border and a styled citation line.
snippets.notes: Change the $accent variable to your brand color.

snippets.title: Clean Table Styles for Posts (SCSS)
snippets.description: Gives tables in posts and pages a clean, readable look with a bold header row, light striping, comfortable padding and horizontal scrolling on phones.
snippets.notes: Change $header-bg and $stripe to match your theme.

snippets.title: Comfortable Reading Typography for Posts (SCSS)
snippets.description: Tunes the line length, line height and spacing of headings, paragraphs and lists inside blog posts for long-form reading.
snippets.notes: The measure limits the width of text blocks; wide and full-width blocks are not affected.

snippets.title: Styled Code Blocks (SCSS)
snippets.description: Gives code blocks and inline code in your posts a dark, readable style with rounded corners, a monospace font stack and horizontal scrolling for long lines.
snippets.notes: Pairs well with the Copy Button on Code Blocks snippet.

snippets.title: Key Takeaways Box Before Posts (Blocks)
snippets.description: Adds a "Key takeaways" box built from blocks at the top of every post, a skimmable summary readers and search engines appreciate.
snippets.code:
Key takeaways

  • The most important point of the article.
  • A second insight readers should remember.
  • What to do next.
snippets.notes: Edit the list in the snippet editor; for per-post summaries, duplicate the snippet and limit it with conditions.

snippets.title: Newsletter Prompt After 300 Words
snippets.description: Shows a short newsletter invitation once readers are about 300 words into a post, after they have shown real interest but before most people stop scrolling.
snippets.code:
Enjoying this? Get the next article in your inbox, about twice a month.

Join the newsletter
snippets.notes: Change the word count in the snippet settings and the link to your sign-up page.

snippets.title: Sponsor Message Near the End of Posts
snippets.description: Places a sponsor or partner message 80% of the way through each post, where it reaches readers who are almost finished without interrupting the start.
snippets.code:
Sponsored

This article is supported by Example Partner, who help small teams ship faster.
snippets.notes: Replace the text, logo and link with your sponsor's details and keep the "Sponsored" label for transparency.

snippets.title: Ad Slot After the First Quarter of Posts
snippets.description: Inserts your ad code after the first quarter of each post's content, a placement that tends to perform well without pushing the article down.
snippets.code: Advertisement
snippets.notes: Paste your ad network code in place of the placeholder.

snippets.title: Posts per Page for Custom Post Type Archives
snippets.description: Sets how many entries each custom post type archive shows, separately from the blog setting, for example 12 portfolio items or every testimonial on one page.
snippets.notes: Use -1 to show all entries on one page. WooCommerce products have their own setting and should not be listed here.

snippets.title: Order Blog and Archives by Last Updated
snippets.description: Lists posts on the blog page and archives by the date they were last updated instead of the date they were published, so refreshed articles move back to the top.

snippets.title: Random Order on a Post Type Archive
snippets.description: Shows the entries of selected post types, such as testimonials or team members, in a random order on each visit.
snippets.notes: Random order works best when all entries fit on one page; with pagination, items can repeat across pages. Page caching keeps the same order until the cache clears.

snippets.title: Upcoming Events Archive Sorted by Event Date
snippets.description: Orders an events post type archive by the event date stored in a custom field, soonest first, and hides events that have already happened.
snippets.notes: Set the post type and the custom field name. The field must hold dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

snippets.title: Custom Wording for Archive Titles
snippets.description: Rewrites archive headings with your own wording, such as "Articles by Jane" on author pages or "Posts from March 2026" on monthly archives.
snippets.notes: Edit the templates at the top; %s is replaced with the name or date.

snippets.title: Hide Specific Posts From the Blog Page
snippets.description: Keeps the posts you list off the main blog page and its pagination while they stay reachable through their own URL, categories and search.
snippets.notes: Add the post IDs to the list.

snippets.title: Show Only Selected Categories on the Blog Page
snippets.description: Limits the main blog page to posts from the categories you choose, for example only News, while other categories keep their own archives.
