snippets.description: Prints an HTML comment at the bottom of each page, visible to administrators, listing every script and stylesheet handle loaded and its source, to find what to optimize.
snippets.notes: View the page source and look for "Enqueued assets" near the end.

snippets.title: Log Every Redirect With Its Source
snippets.description: Writes each redirect WordPress makes to the error log, including the target, status code and the file that triggered it, to track down redirect loops.
snippets.notes: Meant for troubleshooting; turn it off afterwards as it can write many log lines. Enable WP_DEBUG_LOG to read the entries.

snippets.title: PHP Info Screen for Administrators
snippets.description: Adds a Tools > PHP Info screen showing the full phpinfo() report (extensions, limits, configuration), handy when a host's control panel does not show it.
snippets.notes: The report reveals server details; it is limited to administrators. Remove the snippet when you no longer need it.

snippets.title: Rename "Posts" to "Articles" in the Admin
snippets.description: Changes the labels of the built-in Posts type to "Articles" across the admin menu, screens and editor, for sites where "posts" means something else.
snippets.notes: Change $singular and $plural to any wording, for example News / News.

snippets.title: Register Extra Menu Locations
snippets.description: Adds new menu locations, such as a footer menu and a legal links menu, that you can assign under Appearance > Menus and print with wp_nav_menu() in a classic theme.
snippets.notes: Print a location in a template with wp_nav_menu( array( 'theme_location' => 'wpide-footer' ) );. Block themes use the Navigation block instead.

snippets.title: Show Which Functions Run on a Hook
snippets.description: Lets administrators add ?wpide_hook=the_content (or any hook name) to a URL and see the callbacks attached to that hook with their priorities and source files, printed at the bottom of the page.
snippets.notes: Only administrators see the output. Remove the parameter to hide it again.

snippets.title: Prevent Updates for Selected Plugins
snippets.description: Stops update checks and auto-updates for the plugins you list, for example a plugin you patched by hand or must keep on a tested version.
snippets.notes: List plugin paths as folder/main-file.php (see the Plugins screen). Remember to update them manually when you are ready.

snippets.title: Staging Banner on the Front End for Logged-In Users
snippets.description: Shows a bright fixed banner at the top of every page for logged-in users on development and staging sites, so nobody edits the wrong copy of the site.
snippets.notes: Set WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE in wp-config.php; production sites show nothing.

snippets.title: Offer Custom Image Sizes in the Editor
snippets.description: Adds your registered custom image sizes to the size dropdown in the block editor and media modal, so editors can pick them when inserting images.
snippets.notes: The sizes must already be registered with add_image_size(). Edit $labels to give them readable names.

snippets.title: Slow Database Query Warning for Admins
snippets.description: When SAVEQUERIES is enabled, lists the slowest database queries of the page with their duration and caller in an HTML comment visible to administrators.
snippets.notes: Add define( 'SAVEQUERIES', true ); to wp-config.php while debugging only; it slows the site down. Change $limit to show more queries.

snippets.title: Send Plain WordPress Emails in a Branded HTML Layout
snippets.description: Wraps the plain-text emails WordPress sends (password resets, notifications, form plugins) in a simple HTML layout with your site name and clickable links.
snippets.notes: Emails that are already HTML, such as WooCommerce emails, are left untouched. Change $accent to your brand color.

snippets.title: Copy Every Outgoing Email to an Archive Address
snippets.description: Adds a hidden BCC to every email the site sends, so you keep a copy of password resets, orders and form notifications in one mailbox.
snippets.notes: Set $archive to a mailbox you control. Recipients do not see the BCC address.

snippets.title: Email Log Under Tools
snippets.description: Keeps a list of the last 100 emails the site tried to send (date, recipient, subject and whether it failed) and shows it under Tools > Email Log.
snippets.notes: Message bodies are not stored. The log lives in the wpide_email_log option and is capped at $max_entries.

snippets.title: Send All Emails to One Address on Staging Sites
snippets.description: On development and staging sites, delivers every email to a single test address instead of real customers and users, and notes the original recipient in the subject.
snippets.notes: Uses wp_get_environment_type(), so set WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE to staging or development in wp-config.php. Production sites are not affected.

snippets.title: Block All Outgoing Email on Staging Sites
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from sending any email on development, local and staging environments, so test orders and imports never reach real people.
snippets.notes: Set WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE in wp-config.php. Emails are silently dropped and wp_mail() returns false.

snippets.title: Send a Test Email From the Admin
snippets.description: Adds a Tools > Send Test Email screen where administrators can send a test message to any address and see right away whether WordPress could hand it off.
snippets.notes: A "sent" result means the mail server accepted it; check spam folders if it does not arrive.

snippets.title: Tag Email Subjects on Non-Production Sites
snippets.description: Adds [STAGING] or [DEVELOPMENT] to the start of every email subject sent from a non-production copy of the site, so nobody confuses test emails with real ones.
snippets.notes: Uses wp_get_environment_type(). Production emails are unchanged.

snippets.title: Custom Welcome Email for New Users
snippets.description: Rewrites the email new users receive with their login details, using your own subject and greeting while keeping the secure link to set a password.
snippets.notes: Keep the $set_password_url line in the message, otherwise users cannot set their password.

snippets.title: Friendlier Password Reset Email
snippets.description: Replaces the wording of the password reset email with a clearer message and subject, keeping the reset link intact.
snippets.notes: The reset link expires after 24 hours by default.

snippets.title: Stop "Site Admin Email Changed" Notifications
snippets.description: Prevents the email sent to the old address when the site's administration email address is changed in Settings > General.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'send_site_admin_email_change_email', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: The confirmation email to the new address is still sent, as WordPress requires it.

snippets.title: Email Editors When a Post Is Submitted for Review
snippets.description: Notifies editors and administrators by email when a contributor submits a post for review, with a link to edit it.
snippets.notes: Change $roles to choose who is notified.

snippets.title: Email Authors When Their Post Is Published
snippets.description: Sends the author a short email with the link when one of their posts goes live, whether published by an editor or on schedule.
snippets.notes: Authors are not emailed when they publish their own post.

snippets.title: Email Alert When a User's Role Changes
snippets.description: Emails the site administrator whenever a user's role changes, which helps spot unexpected privilege changes.
snippets.notes: Sent to the address in Settings > General. Changes made during user registration are ignored.

snippets.title: Send Admin Notifications to Several Addresses
snippets.description: Delivers emails addressed to the site admin email (new users, comments, updates) to additional team members as well.
snippets.notes: List the extra addresses in $extra. Emails to other recipients are not changed.

snippets.title: Match the Return-Path to the From Address
snippets.description: Sets the envelope sender (Return-Path) of outgoing emails to the From address, which improves SPF alignment and deliverability on many hosts.
snippets.notes: Your From address domain must be allowed to send from the server (SPF record).

snippets.title: Add a Plain-Text Version to HTML Emails
snippets.description: Generates a plain-text alternative for HTML emails that do not include one, which spam filters like and text-only email clients need.
snippets.notes: Links are kept as "text (url)" in the plain-text version.

snippets.title: Sign Outgoing Emails With DKIM
snippets.description: Adds a DKIM signature to every email using a private key file and settings stored in wp-config.php, so receiving servers can verify your messages.
snippets.notes: Define WPIDE_DKIM_DOMAIN, WPIDE_DKIM_SELECTOR and WPIDE_DKIM_PRIVATE_KEY (absolute path outside the web root) in wp-config.php and publish the public key in DNS. Does nothing until they are defined.

snippets.title: Send Comment Moderation Emails to Editors
snippets.description: Sends "please moderate" comment emails to every editor as well as the site admin, so comments are approved faster.
snippets.notes: Editors must have an email address on their profile.

snippets.title: Stop Login Details Emails to New Users
snippets.description: Prevents WordPress from emailing new users their login details when an account is created, for sites that onboard users another way.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wp_send_new_user_notification_to_user', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Users created this way need another route to set a password, such as "Lost your password?".

snippets.title: Admin Notice When an Email Fails to Send
snippets.description: Shows administrators a warning in the dashboard when WordPress could not send an email, with the error message, so delivery problems are noticed quickly.
snippets.notes: The notice appears once per failure and can be dismissed by reloading. Pair it with an SMTP snippet to fix delivery.

snippets.title: Send New Order Emails to an Extra Address
snippets.description: Adds another recipient, such as a warehouse or fulfillment partner, to the WooCommerce "New order" email.
snippets.notes: Set $extra. You can list several addresses separated by commas.

snippets.title: Add a Message to the Order Completed Email
snippets.description: Inserts your own paragraph, such as care instructions or a review request, above the order details in the WooCommerce "Order completed" email.
snippets.notes: Change $message. Plain-text emails get the message without HTML.

snippets.title: Skip the "Processing Order" Email to Customers
snippets.description: Stops WooCommerce from sending customers the "Your order is being processed" email, for stores that only want to send the completed email.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_email_enabled_customer_processing_order', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Customers still get the order completed email. You can also turn this email off in WooCommerce > Settings > Emails.

snippets.title: Product Images and SKUs in Order Emails
snippets.description: Shows a small product image and the SKU next to each item in WooCommerce order emails, so customers and staff recognize products at a glance.
snippets.notes: Set $show_sku to false to show images only. Images may be blocked by some email clients until the reader allows them.

snippets.title: Customer Name and Total in New Order Email Subjects
snippets.description: Changes the subject of the admin "New order" email to include the customer's name and order total, for example "New order #1045 from Jane Doe (49.00)".

snippets.title: Send Low and Out-of-Stock Alerts to Your Buyer
snippets.description: Sends WooCommerce low stock and out-of-stock notifications to a purchasing or inventory address instead of the store admin.
snippets.notes: Set $address. Leave it empty to keep the default recipient.

snippets.title: Attach a PDF to Order Completed Emails
snippets.description: Attaches a file, such as your terms and conditions, a user guide or a returns form, to the WooCommerce "Order completed" email.
snippets.notes: Upload the PDF to the Media Library and set $attachment_id, or set $file_path to an absolute server path.

snippets.title: Highlight the Customer's Order Note in Admin Emails
snippets.description: Shows the note the customer wrote at checkout in a highlighted box at the top of the admin "New order" email, so special requests are not missed.
snippets.notes: Only appears when the customer left a note.

snippets.title: Sticky Header That Shrinks on Scroll
snippets.description: Keeps your theme's header pinned to the top of the screen and adds a shadow and smaller padding once the visitor scrolls down.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-sticky-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:999;transition:box-shadow .2s ease,padding .2s ease;}
.admin-bar .wpide-sticky-header{top:32px;}
@media (max-width:782px){.admin-bar .wpide-sticky-header{top:46px;}}
.wpide-sticky-header.is-scrolled{box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.12);padding-top:6px !important;padding-bottom:6px !important;}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var header = document.querySelector('.site-header, header.wp-block-template-part, body > header, #masthead');
    if (!header) { return; }
    header.classList.add('wpide-sticky-header');
    var toggle = function () { header.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', window.pageYOffset > 40); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', toggle, { passive: true });
    toggle();
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Change the selector in the script if your theme's header is not a <header> element or .site-header.

snippets.title: Dark Mode Toggle Button
snippets.description: Adds a floating moon button that switches the site to a dark color scheme, remembers the visitor's choice and follows their system setting on the first visit.
snippets.code:
<button type="button" id="wpide-dark-toggle" aria-label="Toggle dark mode" aria-pressed="false">☾</button>
<style>
#wpide-dark-toggle{position:fixed;left:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:9999;width:42px;height:42px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#1e1e1e;color:#fff;font-size:20px;line-height:42px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
html.wpide-dark{filter:invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg);background:#fff;}
html.wpide-dark img,html.wpide-dark video,html.wpide-dark iframe,html.wpide-dark picture,html.wpide-dark [style*="background-image"],html.wpide-dark #wpide-dark-toggle{filter:invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg);}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var root = document.documentElement, button = document.getElementById('wpide-dark-toggle');
    var stored = null;
    try { stored = localStorage.getItem('wpide-dark'); } catch (e) {}
    var dark = stored !== null ? stored === '1' : (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
    function apply() {
        root.classList.toggle('wpide-dark', dark);
        button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', dark ? 'true' : 'false');
        button.innerHTML = dark ? '☀' : '☾';
    }
    button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        dark = !dark;
        try { localStorage.setItem('wpide-dark', dark ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) {}
        apply();
    });
    apply();
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: This uses a color inversion that works on most themes; photos and videos are re-inverted so they look normal. Tune the colors if your theme has its own dark palette.

snippets.title: Lightweight Image Lightbox
snippets.description: Opens linked images in post content in a full-screen overlay instead of a new page, with keyboard and click-to-close support and no external library.
snippets.notes: Works on images that link to their media file (set "Link to: Media File" in the image block). Press Escape or click anywhere to close.

snippets.title: Automatic Table of Contents for Long Posts
snippets.description: Builds a clickable table of contents from the H2 and H3 headings of long posts and places it above the content, adding anchor IDs to the headings.
snippets.notes: Appears on posts with at least $min_headings headings. Change $post_types to use it on pages too.

snippets.title: Icon After External Links
snippets.description: Adds a small arrow icon after links in post content that point to other websites, so readers know they will leave your site.
snippets.notes: Your own domain is detected automatically. Exclude a link by adding the class no-external-icon to it.

snippets.title: Scrollable Tables on Mobile
snippets.description: Lets wide tables in your content scroll sideways on small screens instead of breaking the layout or overflowing the page.
snippets.notes: The Table block already scrolls in most block themes; this mainly helps classic themes and tables pasted from other sources.

snippets.title: Brand Color for Text Selection
snippets.description: Changes the highlight color when visitors select text on your site to match your brand.
snippets.notes: Change the two colors. Keep enough contrast between background and text.

snippets.title: Slim Custom Scrollbar
snippets.description: Replaces the default browser scrollbar with a thinner one in your brand colors on desktop browsers.
snippets.notes: Mobile browsers keep their native overlay scrollbars.

snippets.title: Floating WhatsApp Chat Button
snippets.description: Adds a round WhatsApp button in the bottom corner of every page that opens a chat with your number and a pre-filled message.
snippets.notes: Set $phone in international format without + or spaces (for example 15550100000). Nothing is shown while it is empty.

snippets.title: Click-to-Call Bar on Mobile
snippets.description: Shows a full-width "Call us now" bar fixed to the bottom of the screen on phones, so mobile visitors can call your business with one tap.
snippets.notes: Set $phone and $label. The bar only appears on screens narrower than 768px.

snippets.title: Simple Share Buttons After Posts
snippets.description: Adds lightweight share links for X, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and email at the end of each post, with no third-party scripts or tracking.
snippets.notes: Edit $networks to remove networks you do not need. Uses plain links, so nothing loads until a visitor clicks.

snippets.title: Fade In Images as They Load
snippets.description: Makes content images fade in smoothly when they finish loading instead of popping in, for a more polished feel.
snippets.code:
<style>
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .wpide-fade{opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s ease;}
    .wpide-fade.is-loaded{opacity:1;}
}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('.entry-content img, .wp-block-post-content img, .wp-block-image img').forEach(function (img) {
        if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth) { return; }
        img.classList.add('wpide-fade');
        var done = function () { img.classList.add('is-loaded'); };
        img.addEventListener('load', done, { once: true });
        img.addEventListener('error', done, { once: true });
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Respects the reduced-motion accessibility setting. Images that are already loaded are shown immediately.

snippets.title: Discourage Copying Images and Text
snippets.description: Disables right-click and dragging on images, and optionally text selection in post content, to discourage casual copying of your work.
snippets.code:
<script>
(function () {
    var blockTextSelection = false; // true: also prevent selecting text in post content.
    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) {
        if (e.target.tagName === 'IMG') { e.preventDefault(); }
    });
    document.addEventListener('dragstart', function (e) {
        if (e.target.tagName === 'IMG') { e.preventDefault(); }
    });
    if (blockTextSelection) {
        var style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent = '.entry-content,.wp-block-post-content{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;}';
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    }
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: This only deters casual copying; anything shown in a browser can still be saved. Text selection is left on by default for accessibility.

snippets.title: Exit-Intent Popup
snippets.description: Shows a popup with your offer or newsletter link when a desktop visitor moves the mouse toward closing the tab, at most once every 30 days.
snippets.code:
Before you go...

Get 10% off your first order when you join our newsletter.

Get my discount
snippets.notes: Edit the heading, text and link. Change the 30 in the script to show it more or less often.

snippets.title: Reveal Blocks on Scroll
snippets.description: Fades and slides content blocks into view as the visitor scrolls. Add the class "reveal" to any block in the editor (Advanced > Additional CSS class) to animate it.
snippets.code:
<style>
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease;}
    .reveal.is-visible{opacity:1;transform:none;}
}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var items = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    if (!items.length) { return; }
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) { items.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('is-visible'); }); return; }
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('is-visible'); observer.unobserve(entry.target); }
        });
    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px' });
    items.forEach(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Respects the reduced-motion accessibility setting. Use "reveal" on groups, columns, images or headings.

snippets.title: Hide on Mobile / Hide on Desktop Classes
snippets.description: Adds utility classes you can put on any block (hide-on-mobile, hide-on-tablet, hide-on-desktop) to show different content on different screen sizes.
snippets.notes: Add the class under Advanced > Additional CSS class(es) in the block settings. Breakpoints are 768px and 1024px.

snippets.title: Sticky Sidebar
snippets.description: Keeps the sidebar visible while visitors scroll through long posts on desktop screens, so your widgets and calls to action stay in view.
snippets.notes: Works when the sidebar is shorter than the screen. Change the selector if your theme uses a different sidebar class.

snippets.title: Clear Keyboard Focus Outlines
snippets.description: Shows a strong, visible outline around links, buttons and form fields when visitors navigate with the keyboard, which many themes hide. Mouse clicks are not affected.
snippets.notes: Change the outline color to one with good contrast against your backgrounds.

snippets.title: "Skip to Content" Link
snippets.description: Adds a hidden "Skip to content" link that appears when keyboard users press Tab, letting them jump past the header and menu, for themes that lack one.
snippets.code: Skip to content
snippets.notes: The link targets #main, main or .site-main, whichever exists first. Your theme must call wp_body_open.

snippets.title: Use the System Font Stack
snippets.description: Switches the site's text to the fonts already installed on each visitor's device (San Francisco, Segoe UI, Roboto), which look native and load instantly.
snippets.notes: Code blocks keep a monospace font. Remove "h1-h6" from the selector to keep your theme's heading font.

snippets.title: Nicer Styling for Details (Accordion) Blocks
snippets.description: Gives the Details block and other summary/details elements a clean accordion look with a border, padding and a rotating arrow.
snippets.notes: Applies to every details element on the front end.

snippets.title: Breadcrumbs Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_breadcrumbs] shortcode that prints Home > Category > Post style breadcrumbs with schema.org markup, for themes that do not have them.
snippets.notes: Place it in a Shortcode block in your single post or page template. If an SEO plugin already outputs breadcrumb schema, use only one of them.

snippets.title: Log In / Log Out Item in the Menu
snippets.description: Appends a "Log in" link to your main menu for visitors and a "Log out" link for logged-in users, returning them to the same page.
snippets.notes: Set $location to your theme's menu location slug. Works with classic menus.

snippets.title: "Listen to This Article" Button
snippets.description: Adds a play button above posts that reads the article aloud with the visitor's browser text-to-speech, with no external service or cost.
snippets.notes: Uses the browser's built-in speech voices, which vary by device. The button is hidden in browsers without speech support.

snippets.title: Call to Action in the Middle of Articles
snippets.description: Inserts a highlighted call-to-action box halfway through post content, where engaged readers are most likely to see it.
snippets.code:
Enjoying this article?

Get our best guides in your inbox every month. Subscribe for free.
snippets.notes: Edit the text and link. Use WPIDE conditions to limit it to posts or specific categories.

snippets.title: Brand Button Styles (SCSS)
snippets.description: Restyles theme and block buttons with your brand color, hover and focus states, generated from a few SCSS variables.
snippets.notes: Change the variables at the top. WPIDE compiles the SCSS to CSS for you.

snippets.title: Spacing Utility Classes (SCSS)
snippets.description: Generates margin and padding helper classes such as mt-2, mb-4 and px-3 from a spacing scale, to fine-tune block spacing with an extra CSS class.
snippets.notes: Edit $spacers to change the scale. Add a class like mb-4 under Advanced > Additional CSS class(es).

snippets.title: Equal-Height Card Grid Style (SCSS)
snippets.description: Turns any Columns or Group block with the class "card-grid" into a responsive grid of equal-height cards with shadows and hover lift.
snippets.notes: Add the class card-grid to a Columns block. Adjust $card-min to control how narrow cards get before wrapping.

snippets.title: Fluid Heading Sizes (SCSS)
snippets.description: Makes headings scale smoothly between mobile and desktop sizes with CSS clamp(), generated from a simple size table, so titles never look too big on phones.
snippets.notes: Edit the min and max sizes (in rem) in $headings. Block themes may set heading sizes in theme.json; this overrides them.

snippets.title: Consistent Form Field Styling (SCSS)
snippets.description: Gives text inputs, selects, text areas and checkboxes across the site (comments, contact forms, checkout) one consistent, accessible look with clear focus states.
snippets.notes: Change the variables at the top. Some form plugins add their own styles with higher specificity.

snippets.title: Follow Prompt Near the End of Articles
snippets.description: Inserts a short "Follow us" box with your social links three quarters of the way through post content, reaching readers who are nearly done.
snippets.code:
Like what you are reading? Follow us for more.

LinkedIn X YouTube
snippets.notes: Replace the links with your own profiles. Use WPIDE conditions to show it only on posts.

snippets.title: Hide Out-of-Stock Products From Search Results
snippets.description: Leaves sold-out products out of the front-end search results while keeping them visible on the shop and category pages.
snippets.notes: Use the "Hide out of stock items" setting in WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Inventory if you want them hidden everywhere instead.

snippets.title: Show Out-of-Stock Products Last
snippets.description: Keeps your shop and category pages sorted as usual but moves sold-out products to the end of the list, so shoppers see what they can buy first.
snippets.notes: Works with every sorting option because it only adds a first sort key on stock status.

snippets.title: Custom Stock Availability Messages
snippets.description: Replaces the standard "Out of stock" and "Available on backorder" labels on product pages with your own wording.
snippets.notes: Leave a message empty to keep the WooCommerce default for that status.

snippets.title: "Only a Few Left" Low Stock Message
snippets.description: When a product with managed stock drops to a few units, shows a highlighted "Only 3 left, order soon" message instead of the plain stock count.
snippets.notes: Change $threshold to the quantity at which the message appears. Requires stock management on the product.

snippets.title: "Sold Out" Badge on Shop Images
snippets.description: Adds a "Sold out" label over the image of out-of-stock products in shop and category listings so shoppers can tell at a glance.
snippets.notes: Adjust the colors in the inline style or override the .wpide-sold-out class in your theme CSS.

snippets.title: "New" Badge for Recent Products
snippets.description: Shows a "New" label on products in the shop that were published in the last 30 days.
snippets.notes: Change $days to control how long a product counts as new.

snippets.title: "Bestseller" Badge for Popular Products
snippets.description: Labels products that have sold at least a set number of units with a "Bestseller" badge in shop listings and on the product page.
snippets.notes: Change $min_sales to the number of units a product must sell to earn the badge.

snippets.title: Show "You Save" Amount on Sale Products
snippets.description: Adds a line under the price of products on sale that tells shoppers how much they save, for example "You save $15.00 (25%)".
snippets.notes: Works for simple products; variable products show the saving once a variation is selected.

snippets.title: Show "From" Price Instead of a Price Range
snippets.description: Replaces price ranges like "$10 - $40" on variable products with a shorter "From $10", which reads better on shop pages.
snippets.notes: When all variations cost the same, the normal single price is shown.

snippets.title: Show "Free" Instead of a Zero Price
snippets.description: Displays the word "Free" for products priced at 0 instead of showing $0.00.
snippets.notes: Change $label to any wording you like, for example "Free download".

snippets.title: "Call for Price" on Products Without a Price
snippets.description: Shows a "Call for price" link instead of a blank space when a product has no price set, so shoppers know how to get a quote.
snippets.notes: Set $phone to your number, or change the link to a contact page URL.

snippets.title: Catalog Mode (Prices Without Purchasing)
snippets.description: Turns the shop into a catalog: products and prices stay visible, but add to cart buttons, the cart and checkout are disabled for everyone.
snippets.notes: Visitors who open the cart or checkout URL are sent back to the shop. Deactivate the snippet to start selling again.

snippets.title: Add a "Buy Now" Button Next to Add to Cart
snippets.description: Adds a second button on product pages that adds the product to the cart and takes the shopper straight to checkout, while the normal add to cart button keeps working.
snippets.notes: Works for simple and variable products on the classic product template.

snippets.title: Plus and Minus Buttons on Quantity Fields
snippets.description: Adds "-" and "+" buttons around the quantity box on product and cart pages so shoppers can change quantities with a tap.
snippets.notes: The buttons respect the minimum, maximum and step values of the quantity field.

snippets.title: Minimum Purchase Quantity per Product
snippets.description: Requires shoppers to buy at least a set number of each product, for example 2, and sets the quantity box to start at that number.
snippets.notes: Change $minimum. Add product IDs to $product_ids to apply the rule only to those products; leave it empty for all products.

snippets.title: Sell in Packs (Quantity Steps)
snippets.description: Makes products sell only in multiples, such as packs of 6, by setting the quantity step and checking the cart.
snippets.notes: Change $step. The minimum quantity becomes one pack.

snippets.title: Limit the Number of Items in the Cart
snippets.description: Stops shoppers from adding more than a set total number of items to the cart, for limited releases or stock-controlled drops.
snippets.notes: Change $max_items. The limit counts quantities, so 3 of one product counts as 3.

snippets.title: Maximum Order Amount
snippets.description: Blocks checkout when the cart subtotal goes over a set amount and shows a notice asking the shopper to contact you for large orders.
snippets.notes: Change $maximum. The check uses the cart subtotal before shipping.

snippets.title: Allow Only One Product in the Cart
snippets.description: Replaces the cart contents whenever a new product is added, so each order contains a single product. Useful for services, bookings and memberships.
snippets.notes: Shoppers can still change the quantity of the product in their cart.

snippets.title: Free Gift When the Cart Reaches an Amount
snippets.description: Automatically adds a free gift product to the cart once the subtotal reaches a set amount, and removes it again if the cart drops below.
snippets.notes: Create the gift as a product priced at 0 (it can be hidden from the catalog), then set $gift_id and $threshold.

snippets.title: Apply a Coupon From a Link
snippets.description: Lets you share links like yoursite.com/?coupon=SUMMER10 that apply the coupon automatically when the shopper adds to cart or visits the cart.
snippets.notes: The coupon must exist in WooCommerce > Marketing > Coupons. Change $param to use a different query parameter.

snippets.title: Change the "Have a Coupon?" Prompt
snippets.description: Rewrites the coupon prompt shown at the top of the classic checkout with your own wording.
snippets.notes: Keep the class="showcoupon" link so the coupon form still opens when clicked.

snippets.title: Small Order Fee
snippets.description: Adds a handling fee to orders below a set subtotal, which helps cover packing costs on very small orders.
snippets.notes: Set $threshold, $fee and $taxable. The fee name appears in the cart totals and on the order.

snippets.title: Surcharge for a Payment Method
snippets.description: Adds a fee when the shopper chooses a specific payment method, for example cash on delivery, and updates the totals as soon as they switch methods.
snippets.notes: Set $gateway to the payment method ID (cod, bacs, cheque, or the ID of your gateway) and choose a fixed or percentage fee.

snippets.title: Bulk Discount by Cart Quantity
snippets.description: Gives an automatic percentage discount when the cart contains enough items, for example 10% off 5 or more items, shown as a line in the totals.
snippets.notes: Edit the $tiers list. The highest tier the cart reaches is applied.

snippets.title: Percentage Discount for a User Role
snippets.description: Shows lower prices across the store for customers with a specific role, such as wholesale buyers, without editing each product.
snippets.notes: Set $role and $percent; the role must already exist (create it with a role editor plugin). Sale prices are discounted too.

snippets.title: Hide a Payment Method for Certain Countries
snippets.description: Removes a payment method from checkout when the customer's billing country is on your list, for example to offer cash on delivery only at home.
snippets.notes: Set $gateway to the payment method ID and list two-letter country codes in $countries.

snippets.title: Disable a Payment Method Above an Order Total
snippets.description: Hides a payment method such as cash on delivery or bank transfer when the order total goes above a limit you choose.
snippets.notes: Set $gateway and $max_total. The check uses the cart total including shipping and tax.

snippets.title: Hide a Shipping Method for a Shipping Class
snippets.description: Removes a shipping method, such as local pickup or express delivery, when the cart contains a product from a specific shipping class (for example bulky items).
snippets.notes: Set $shipping_class to the class slug from WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Classes and $method to the method ID (flat_rate, local_pickup, free_shipping).

snippets.title: Move the Email Field to the Top of Checkout
snippets.description: Puts the billing email field first on the classic checkout so you capture the address early, which also helps abandoned cart tools.
snippets.notes: Only affects the classic checkout shortcode. The block checkout already asks for the email first.

snippets.title: "How Did You Hear About Us?" Checkout Field
snippets.description: Adds a dropdown to the classic checkout asking customers how they found your store, saves the answer with the order and shows it on the order screen.
snippets.notes: Edit $options to change the choices. Answers are stored in the order meta key _wpide_referral_source.

snippets.title: Gift Message Field on the Block Checkout
snippets.description: Adds an optional "Gift message" field to the block-based checkout using the WooCommerce additional checkout fields API. The message is saved with the order and shown in the admin.
snippets.notes: Needs WooCommerce 8.9 or newer and the Checkout block. For the classic checkout use a classic checkout field snippet instead.

snippets.title: Skip Address Fields for Virtual-Only Orders
snippets.description: Removes the billing address fields from the classic checkout when everything in the cart is virtual or downloadable, keeping only name and email.
snippets.notes: Some payment gateways need the billing address for fraud checks; test a payment before going live.

snippets.title: "Confirm Email" Field on Checkout
snippets.description: Adds a second email field to the classic checkout and blocks the order if the two addresses do not match, to cut down on typos.
snippets.notes: Logged-in customers with an email on file see the field pre-filled.

snippets.title: Age Confirmation Checkbox at Checkout
snippets.description: Adds a required "I confirm I am 18 or older" checkbox to the classic checkout and records the confirmation on the order.
snippets.notes: Change $age to your legal age. This is a self-declaration, not an identity check.

snippets.title: Newsletter Opt-In Checkbox at Checkout
snippets.description: Adds an unticked "Send me news and offers" checkbox to the classic checkout and stores the customer's consent on the order and their account.
snippets.notes: Consent is saved as order meta _wpide_newsletter_optin and user meta wpide_newsletter_optin. Connect it to your email tool with an export or integration.

snippets.title: Redirect New Customers After Registration
snippets.description: Sends customers who create an account from the My Account page to a page of your choice, such as a welcome page or the shop.
snippets.notes: Set $page_slug to the slug of the page to send new customers to.

snippets.title: Rename or Remove My Account Menu Items
snippets.description: Tidies the My Account navigation by renaming items and hiding ones you do not use, such as Downloads on a store without digital products.
snippets.notes: Edit the $rename and $remove lists. Keys are the endpoint names (orders, downloads, edit-address, edit-account).

snippets.title: Custom "Support" Tab in My Account
snippets.description: Adds a new Support section to the My Account area with its own URL and content, for help links, a contact form shortcode or FAQs.
snippets.notes: After activating, visit Settings > Permalinks and click Save once so the new URL works. Change $content to your text or a shortcode.

snippets.title: Show the Results Page for Single-Match Product Searches
snippets.description: Stops WooCommerce from jumping straight to a product when a search has only one match, so shoppers always see the search results page.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_redirect_single_search_result', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Simplify the Shop Sorting Dropdown
snippets.description: Removes sorting options you do not need from the shop's "Sort by" menu and lets you rename the ones that remain.
snippets.notes: Available keys are menu_order, popularity, rating, date, price and price-desc.

snippets.title: Hide Product Counts Next to Categories
snippets.description: Removes the "(12)" product count shown beside category names on the shop page when categories are displayed.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_subcategory_count_html', '__return_empty_string' );

snippets.title: Hide the "Uncategorized" Product Category
snippets.description: Keeps the default Uncategorized product category out of category lists on the shop and in the product categories block and widget.
snippets.notes: Products in the category are still visible in the shop; only the category itself is hidden.

snippets.title: Exclude a Category From the Main Shop Page
snippets.description: Hides products from one or more categories on the main shop page while they remain available in their own category and by direct link.
snippets.notes: List category slugs in $exclude.

snippets.title: Short Description Under Product Titles in the Shop
snippets.description: Shows a trimmed version of each product's short description below its title on shop and category pages.
snippets.notes: Change $words to set how many words are shown.

snippets.title: Quantity Box on Shop Page Add to Cart Buttons
snippets.description: Adds a quantity field next to the add to cart button for simple products in shop listings, so shoppers can add several at once without opening the product.
snippets.notes: Works with AJAX add to cart. Variable products keep their "Select options" button.

snippets.title: Add a "Shipping & Returns" Product Tab
snippets.description: Adds a tab with the same shipping and returns information to every product page, next to Description and Reviews.
snippets.notes: Edit $title and $content. HTML and shortcodes are allowed in the content.

snippets.title: Rename and Reorder Product Tabs
snippets.description: Changes the titles and order of the Description, Additional information and Reviews tabs on product pages.
snippets.notes: Lower priority numbers come first. Leave a title empty to keep the default.

snippets.title: Hide SKU, Categories and Tags on Product Pages
snippets.description: Removes the meta block below the add to cart button that lists the SKU, categories and tags of the product.
snippets.notes: To hide only the SKU, use the "Hide SKUs on the Front End" snippet instead.

snippets.title: Turn Off Product Image Zoom, Lightbox or Slider
snippets.description: Disables the hover zoom, the full-screen lightbox and/or the thumbnail slider of the WooCommerce product gallery.
snippets.notes: Set each feature to true to keep it or false to turn it off.

snippets.title: Change the Number of Product Gallery Thumbnails per Row
snippets.description: Sets how many thumbnails appear in each row below the main product image on product pages.
snippets.notes: Some themes override the gallery layout with their own CSS; adjust there if the change does not show.

snippets.title: Custom Placeholder Image for Products
snippets.description: Replaces the grey WooCommerce placeholder with your own image for products that do not have a featured image yet.
snippets.notes: Upload the image to the Media Library and paste its URL into $image_url.

snippets.title: Open External/Affiliate Product Links in a New Tab
snippets.description: Makes the buy buttons of external (affiliate) products open the partner site in a new tab, on shop pages and on the product page.
snippets.notes: Adds rel="noopener sponsored" to the links, which is recommended for affiliate links.

snippets.title: Remove Cross-Sells From the Cart Page
snippets.description: Hides the "You may be interested in..." product suggestions below the cart table on the classic cart page.
snippets.notes: Only the classic cart is affected. In the Cart block, remove the cross-sells inner block in the editor.

snippets.title: Number and Columns of Upsell Products
snippets.description: Controls how many "You may also like" upsell products appear on product pages and in how many columns.
snippets.notes: Set $limit to 0 to show all upsells.

snippets.title: Product Thumbnails in the Checkout Order Summary
snippets.description: Shows a small image beside each product name in the "Your order" table on the classic checkout.
snippets.notes: Change $size to a different image size or pixel array.

snippets.title: Remove Product Links in the Cart
snippets.description: Shows product names in the cart as plain text instead of links, which keeps shoppers on the path to checkout.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_cart_item_permalink', '__return_empty_string' );

snippets.title: Update the Cart Automatically When Quantities Change
snippets.description: Refreshes the classic cart totals as soon as a quantity is changed, so shoppers do not need to press "Update cart". The button is hidden.
snippets.notes: Only for the classic cart shortcode; the Cart block already updates instantly.

snippets.title: Custom "Added to Cart" Message
snippets.description: Rewrites the notice shown after a product is added to the cart, with your own text and a link to the cart or checkout.
snippets.notes: Set $link_to to 'checkout' to point the button at checkout instead of the cart.

snippets.title: Custom Empty Cart Message
snippets.description: Replaces "Your cart is currently empty" on the classic cart page with a friendlier message of your own.
snippets.notes: The Cart block has its own empty cart template you can edit in the Site Editor.

snippets.title: Redirect an Empty Cart to the Shop
snippets.description: Sends visitors who open the cart page with nothing in it straight to the shop page instead of showing an empty cart.
snippets.notes: Change $target to redirect to another page such as a category or the homepage.

snippets.title: Disable the Persistent Cart
snippets.description: Stops WooCommerce from saving logged-in customers' carts to their account between sessions, so each visit starts with an empty cart.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_persistent_cart_enabled', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Guests are not affected because their carts are stored in a session cookie.

snippets.title: Redirect to a Custom Thank-You Page
snippets.description: Sends customers to your own thank-you page after a successful order instead of the default order received page, passing the order number along.
snippets.notes: Create the page and set $page_slug. Failed orders are left on the default page so the customer can retry payment.

snippets.title: Change the "Order Received" Page Title
snippets.description: Replaces the "Order received" heading on the thank-you page with your own text.

snippets.title: Next-Order Coupon Banner on the Thank-You Page
snippets.description: Shows a banner with a discount code for the customer's next purchase at the top of the order received page.
snippets.code:
Thanks for shopping with us!

Use code THANKYOU10 for 10% off your next order.
snippets.notes: Create the coupon in WooCommerce > Marketing > Coupons and replace THANKYOU10 with its code.

snippets.title: Promotional Banner Above the Product List
snippets.description: Displays a banner with a message and a button above the products on the shop and category pages.
snippets.code:
Spring sale: 20% off selected items until Sunday.

Shop the sale
snippets.notes: Edit the text and link. Remove the button paragraph if you only need a message.

snippets.title: Reassurance Notice Above the Cart
snippets.description: Shows a short list of reassurances (secure payment, free returns, fast dispatch) above the cart table to reduce cart abandonment.
snippets.code:
• ✓ Secure payment
  • ✓ Free returns within 30 days
  • ✓ Dispatched within 24 hours
snippets.notes: Edit the three items to match your store policies.

snippets.title: Help Box Above the Checkout Form
snippets.description: Adds a small "Questions about your order?" box with your contact details at the top of the checkout page.
snippets.code: Questions about your order? Call +1 555 010 0000 or email orders@example.com.
snippets.notes: Replace the phone number and email address with your own.

snippets.title: Contact Links Below the Cart
snippets.description: Adds a "Need help choosing?" line with contact links below the cart on the classic cart page.
snippets.code: Need help choosing? Contact our team or email hello@example.com.
snippets.notes: Replace the links with your own contact page and email address.

snippets.title: Size Guide Below the Product Summary
snippets.description: Adds a collapsible size guide table below the product summary on every product page.
snippets.code:

snippets.notes: Replace the table with your own measurements. Use a WPIDE condition to show it only on clothing categories.

snippets.title: Guarantee Note Before Single Products
snippets.description: Shows a slim guarantee message at the top of every product page, such as a money-back promise.
snippets.code: ★ 60-day money-back guarantee on every product.
snippets.notes: Edit the message to match your guarantee.

snippets.title: Text Block Below the Product List
snippets.description: Adds an introduction or SEO text block underneath the products on the shop and category pages, where it does not push products down.
snippets.code:
About our products

Every item in our store is sourced from small makers and tested before it ships. Not sure what to pick? Our team is happy to help.
snippets.notes: Replace the paragraph with your own content.

snippets.title: Show "Order Again" for Processing Orders
snippets.description: Lets customers reorder from orders that are still processing, not only completed ones, using the "Order again" button in My Account.
snippets.notes: Add more statuses to the list if needed, for example on-hold.

snippets.title: Let Customers Cancel On-Hold Orders
snippets.description: Adds a Cancel button in My Account for orders that are on hold (for example unpaid bank transfers), not just pending ones.
snippets.notes: Cancelled orders restock their items automatically.

snippets.title: Orders per Page in My Account
snippets.description: Changes how many orders appear on each page of the My Account Orders list.

snippets.title: Hide Shipping Costs on the Cart Page
snippets.description: Leaves shipping out of the cart totals so it is only calculated and shown at checkout, once the customer has entered an address.
snippets.notes: Applies to the classic cart. The order total on the cart page excludes shipping until checkout.

snippets.title: Show the Total Weight in the Cart and Checkout
snippets.description: Adds a "Total weight" row to the cart and checkout totals, useful for stores that charge shipping by weight.
snippets.notes: Uses the weight unit set in WooCommerce > Settings > Products.

snippets.title: Maximum Cart Weight
snippets.description: Prevents checkout when the products in the cart weigh more than your carrier allows and tells the customer by how much they are over.
snippets.notes: Set $max_weight in your store's weight unit. Products without a weight count as 0.

snippets.title: Add a Prefix to Order Numbers
snippets.description: Shows order numbers with a prefix such as "WEB-1045" in emails, My Account and the admin, without changing the real order IDs.
snippets.notes: Searching the orders screen still uses the plain number. Payment gateways may display the prefixed number in their dashboards.

snippets.title: Product Price Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_product_price id="123"] shortcode that prints the current price of any product, including sale formatting, inside posts and pages.
snippets.notes: Use the product ID from the Products list. On a product page the id can be omitted.

snippets.title: Cart Link With Item Count Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_cart_link] shortcode that shows a cart link with the number of items and total, which updates automatically when products are added.
snippets.notes: Place it in a header widget, Shortcode block or menu. Uses WooCommerce cart fragments to refresh.

snippets.title: Add a Cart Item to the Main Menu
snippets.description: Appends a cart link with the item count to your theme's primary menu, and keeps the count up to date as products are added.
snippets.notes: Set $location to your theme's menu location slug (look under Appearance > Menus > Manage Locations). Works with classic menus.

snippets.title: Sticky Add to Cart Bar on Product Pages
snippets.description: Shows a slim bar with the product name, price and a buy button fixed to the bottom of the screen once the shopper scrolls past the main add to cart button.
snippets.notes: The button scrolls back to the product form, so variations and add-ons are still chosen normally.

snippets.title: Show the Second Product Image on Hover
snippets.description: In shop listings, swaps the product image for the first gallery image when the shopper hovers over it, giving a quick second look.
snippets.notes: Products without gallery images keep their single image.

snippets.title: Related Products by Tag Only
snippets.description: Makes the related products section match products by shared tags instead of shared categories, for more precise suggestions.
snippets.code:
add_filter( 'woocommerce_product_related_posts_relate_by_category', '__return_false' );
add_filter( 'woocommerce_product_related_posts_relate_by_tag', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Products without tags will show no related products.

snippets.title: Search Only Products
snippets.description: Makes the site search return products only, turning the regular search box into a product search.
snippets.notes: Admin searches are not affected.

snippets.title: Today's Sales Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget showing today's number of orders, revenue and average order value, so you can check the day at a glance.
snippets.notes: Counts orders in processing, completed and on-hold status created since midnight in the site timezone.

snippets.title: Processing Orders Count in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a toolbar item showing how many orders are waiting to be processed, linking to the filtered orders list. Visible to shop managers and administrators.
snippets.notes: The count is cached for five minutes to keep the toolbar fast.

snippets.title: Hide Star Ratings in Shop Listings
snippets.description: Removes the star rating below product titles on shop and category pages. Ratings stay visible on product pages.

snippets.title: Show Stock Status in Shop Listings
snippets.description: Displays "In stock", "Only 3 left" or "Out of stock" under each product's price on the shop and category pages.
snippets.notes: Uses the same availability text as the product page.

snippets.title: Validate the Checkout Phone Number Format
snippets.description: Rejects billing phone numbers that contain letters or too few digits on the classic checkout, so you get numbers you can actually call.
snippets.notes: Change $min_digits to suit your country. Spaces, dashes, dots, brackets and a leading + are allowed.

snippets.title: Remove "(optional)" From Checkout Field Labels
snippets.description: Hides the "(optional)" text WooCommerce adds after the labels of fields that are not required.
snippets.notes: Required fields still show their asterisk.

snippets.title: Replace WooCommerce Texts Without a Translation Plugin
snippets.description: Swaps specific WooCommerce texts, such as "Billing details" or "Proceed to checkout", for your own wording using a simple list.
snippets.notes: The original text must match exactly, including capitals. Texts in blocks may come from JavaScript translations and are not affected.

snippets.title: Generate SKUs Automatically
snippets.description: Gives every product saved without a SKU an automatic one based on a prefix and the product ID, for example "SHOP-0142".
snippets.notes: Only fills empty SKUs when a product is saved; existing SKUs are never changed. Change $prefix and $pad.

snippets.title: Accept Orders Only During Opening Hours
snippets.description: Disables checkout outside your opening hours and shows a notice with the time you open again. Ideal for restaurants and local delivery.
snippets.notes: Times use the site timezone from Settings > General. Set $open and $close per weekday (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday); leave a day out to close all day.

snippets.title: Store Vacation Mode
snippets.description: Pauses all purchasing between two dates and shows a store-wide notice explaining when you will be back, while the catalog stays online.
snippets.notes: Dates use the site timezone. Purchasing resumes automatically after $end.

snippets.title: Link Past Guest Orders to New Accounts
snippets.description: When a customer registers, attaches any earlier guest orders placed with the same email address to their new account so they appear in My Account.
snippets.notes: Runs once per new customer account, using WooCommerce's own linking function.

snippets.title: Allow Each Customer to Buy a Product Only Once
snippets.description: Stops logged-in customers from buying the same product twice, for example a course, a membership or a limited item, and tells them they already own it.
snippets.notes: List product IDs in $product_ids to limit only those, or leave it empty for all products. Guests cannot be checked, so consider requiring an account.

snippets.title: Skip the Cart Page
snippets.description: Sends shoppers who open the cart page straight to checkout when their cart has items, for a shorter path to purchase.
snippets.notes: The classic checkout does not let shoppers change quantities, so they return to the product page to adjust their order.

snippets.title: Purchased Items Column in the Orders List
snippets.description: Adds an "Items" column to the admin orders screen listing what each order contains, so you can see what to pack without opening orders.
snippets.notes: Works with both the HPOS orders screen and the legacy posts-based screen.

snippets.title: Coupons Used Column in the Orders List
snippets.description: Shows which coupon codes were used on each order in a new column on the admin orders screen.
snippets.notes: Works with both the HPOS orders screen and the legacy posts-based screen.

snippets.title: Sortable Total Sales Column for Products
snippets.description: Adds a "Sales" column to the admin products list showing how many units each product has sold, and lets you sort by it.
snippets.notes: Uses the total_sales counter WooCommerce keeps for each product.

snippets.title: Private Internal Note Field for Products
snippets.description: Adds an "Internal note" box to the product edit screen for staff-only information such as supplier details. It is never shown to customers.
snippets.notes: Saved in the product meta key _wpide_internal_note.

snippets.title: Add an "Awaiting Shipment" Order Status
snippets.description: Registers a new order status you can set on orders that are packed and waiting for the carrier, and adds it to the bulk actions menu.
snippets.notes: Change the slug and label to create a different status. Orders keep this status if you later remove the snippet, so move them to another status first.

snippets.title: Returning Customer Info on the Order Screen
snippets.description: Shows how many previous orders the customer has placed and their total spend on the order edit screen, so you can recognize loyal buyers.
snippets.notes: Guest orders are matched by billing email.

snippets.title: "Order Within X Hours for Same-Day Dispatch" Notice
snippets.description: Shows a live notice on product pages telling shoppers how long they have left to order for dispatch today, or that orders ship on the next working day.
snippets.notes: Set $cutoff (24h, site timezone) and $working_days (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday).

snippets.title: Payment and Trust Icons Under the Add to Cart Button
snippets.description: Adds a short secure-checkout line with accepted payment methods under the add to cart button on product pages.
snippets.notes: Edit $methods to list the payment methods you accept.

snippets.title: Recently Viewed Products Shortcode
snippets.description: Remembers the products each visitor looks at and adds a [wpide_recently_viewed] shortcode that displays them as a product grid.
snippets.notes: Products are stored in a first-party cookie for 30 days. Use [wpide_recently_viewed limit="4"] to change how many are shown.

snippets.title: "Sold X Times" Note on Product Pages
snippets.description: Shows how many times a product has been bought below its price, as social proof once it passes a minimum number of sales.
snippets.notes: Set $min_sales so new products do not show a low number.

snippets.title: Show a Product Attribute in Shop Listings
snippets.description: Displays the values of an attribute, such as available colors or sizes, under each product title on shop and category pages.
snippets.notes: Set $attribute to the attribute slug, for example pa_color for a global "Color" attribute.

snippets.title: Change the "Choose an Option" Text
snippets.description: Replaces the placeholder in variation dropdowns with a clearer prompt that names the attribute, such as "Select a size".

snippets.title: Raise the Variation Limit for Instant Price Updates
snippets.description: Increases the number of variations WooCommerce loads with the page (30 by default), so large variable products update price and stock instantly and hide unavailable combinations.
snippets.notes: Very large values make product pages heavier. 100 to 150 suits most stores.

snippets.title: Show When a Sale Ends
snippets.description: Displays "Sale ends on 31 May" under the price of products with a scheduled sale end date.
snippets.notes: Only appears when the sale has an end date set in the product's price schedule.

snippets.title: Change a Currency Symbol
snippets.description: Replaces the symbol shown for a currency, for example "AU$" instead of "$" so international shoppers know which dollar you charge in.
snippets.notes: Set $currency to the ISO code and $symbol to what should be displayed.

snippets.title: Add a Custom Currency
snippets.description: Adds a currency that WooCommerce does not list, such as a local or loyalty currency, so you can select it in the general settings.
snippets.notes: After activating, choose the new currency in WooCommerce > Settings > General. Payment gateways may not support custom currencies.

snippets.title: Untick "Ship to a Different Address" by Default
snippets.description: Makes the "Ship to a different address?" box on the classic checkout start unticked, so most customers only fill in one address.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_ship_to_different_address_checked', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Shipping still goes to the billing address unless the customer ticks the box.

snippets.title: Set the Default Checkout Country
snippets.description: Pre-selects a billing and shipping country on checkout for new customers, which saves most of your buyers a step.
snippets.notes: Use a two-letter country code. Returning customers keep the country saved in their account.

snippets.title: Add the Brand to Product Structured Data
snippets.description: Includes the product brand in the product schema WooCommerce outputs, which Google uses for rich results and Merchant listings.
snippets.notes: Uses the WooCommerce Brands taxonomy when it exists, otherwise falls back to $default_brand.

snippets.title: Remove the "Sale!" Badge
snippets.description: Hides the sale badge on product images in the shop and on product pages, while the crossed-out price still shows the discount.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_sale_flash', '__return_empty_string' );

snippets.title: Hide the Shop Page Title
snippets.description: Removes the large "Shop" heading at the top of the main shop and category pages for a cleaner layout.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_show_page_title', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Some block themes print the title from the template; edit the Product Catalog template in that case.

snippets.title: Remove the Result Count and Sorting Dropdown
snippets.description: Hides "Showing 1-12 of 40 results" and the "Default sorting" menu above the products on shop and category pages.
snippets.notes: Set either value to false to keep that element.

snippets.title: Find Products by SKU in the Site Search
snippets.description: Lets shoppers type a SKU into the regular search box and find the matching product, including SKUs of variations.
snippets.notes: Matches exact SKUs. Variation matches return the parent product.

snippets.title: Hide WooCommerce.com Connection Notices
snippets.description: Silences the admin notices asking you to connect your store to WooCommerce.com or renew extension subscriptions.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_helper_suppress_admin_notices', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: You will no longer be reminded about expiring extension subscriptions in the admin.

snippets.title: Estimated Delivery Dates Above Checkout
snippets.description: Shows "Estimated delivery: Tue 4 - Thu 6 Nov" at the top of the checkout page, counting only working days from today.
snippets.notes: Set $min_days and $max_days to your usual delivery window in working days and adjust $working_days.

snippets.title: "You're Saving X" Summary Above the Cart
snippets.description: Adds up the discounts from sale prices and coupons in the cart and shows the total saving at the top of the cart page.
snippets.notes: Only appears when the shopper saves something. Sale savings use the regular price of each product.

snippets.title: "Keep Shopping" Category Links Below the Cart
snippets.description: Lists your most popular product categories as buttons below the cart, giving shoppers an easy way to add more before checking out.
snippets.notes: Change $count to show more or fewer categories. Categories are ordered by number of products.

snippets.title: FAQ Accordion After Product Pages
snippets.description: Adds a short list of common questions and answers (shipping, returns, warranty) at the bottom of every product page.
snippets.code:
Frequently asked questions

When will my order ship?

Orders placed before 2 pm on a working day ship the same day.

Can I return this product?

Yes, you can return unused items within 30 days for a full refund.

Is there a warranty?

All products come with a two-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
snippets.notes: Edit the questions and answers. Use WPIDE conditions to show different FAQs per category.

snippets.title: "What Happens Next" Steps on the Thank-You Page
snippets.description: Shows three simple steps at the top of the order received page explaining what happens after the order, which reduces "where is my order?" emails.
snippets.code:
1. 1. Confirmation
    You will receive an order confirmation email in a few minutes.
  2. 2. Packing
    We pack your order within one working day.
  3. 3. Shipping
    You get a tracking link by email as soon as it ships.
snippets.notes: Edit the steps to match your fulfillment process.

snippets.title: Category Image Banner Above Products
snippets.description: Displays the image you set on a product category as a wide banner at the top of that category's page, which many themes do not show.
snippets.notes: Set the image in Products > Categories > Edit category > Thumbnail. Categories without an image show nothing.

snippets.title: "Back to Category" Link Above Products
snippets.description: Adds a "Back to Shoes" style link above each product page that returns the shopper to the product's main category.
snippets.notes: Uses the product's first category, or the primary category set by Yoast SEO or Rank Math when available.

snippets.title: Guarantee and Secure Payment Note Under Checkout
snippets.description: Shows a reassuring note with your guarantee, secure payment and support details below the checkout form, where customers decide to place the order.
snippets.code: 🔒 Payments are encrypted and secure ↩ 30-day money-back guarantee ✉ Questions? hello@example.com
snippets.notes: Edit the three items to match your policies.

snippets.title: Modern Product Grid Cards (SCSS)
snippets.description: Restyles the WooCommerce shop grid into clean cards with rounded images, consistent spacing, aligned buttons and a hover effect.
snippets.notes: Change the variables at the top to match your brand. Works with the classic shop loop markup.

snippets.title: Markdown Versions of Posts for AI Crawlers, Plus llms.txt
snippets.description: Serves any post or page as clean Markdown when .md is added to its address (or ?format=markdown), and publishes an /llms.txt index of your pages and recent posts for AI tools.
snippets.notes: Try it: open a post and add .md to the end of its address (example.com/my-post.md). With plain permalinks, and for the front page, use ?format=markdown instead. Each page also gets a <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> tag. If a real llms.txt file exists in the site root, the server shows that file instead. If a caching plugin serves the .md addresses as HTML, exclude them from the cache. Uses PHP's DOM extension (standard on almost every host); without it the text is sent unformatted.

snippets.title: Skip Loading Translations on English Sites
snippets.description: Stops WordPress, plugins and themes from loading translation files on the front end (or everywhere) to save memory and time on sites whose visitors read English anyway, with a list of text domains to keep.
snippets.notes: Only makes a difference when the site or user language is not English (United States), for example English (UK), or when plugins ship translations you never show. With 'frontend', wp-admin, the login page, AJAX, REST, cron and WP-CLI keep their translations. Add 'default' to the keep list to keep WordPress's own strings (dates, comment form) translated. Translations a plugin loads before WPIDE runs snippets are not affected.

snippets.title: Turn Off Autofocus on the Login Form
snippets.description: Stops the login, lost password and registration screens from putting the cursor in the first field as soon as they load, so the page does not jump or pop up the on-screen keyboard.

snippets.title: Link Featured Images to Their Posts
snippets.description: Wraps featured images on blog, archive and search pages in a link to the post, for themes that show the image without one. Works with classic themes and the Featured Image block.
snippets.notes: Images that already have a link are left alone, including Featured Image blocks with "Link to post" switched on. If a classic theme puts its own link around the image from outside, turn this off to avoid a link inside a link. The extra link is hidden from screen readers and the Tab key because the post title already links to the same page.

snippets.title: Summaries Only in RSS Feeds With a Continue Reading Link
snippets.description: Sends only a short summary of each post to feed readers, whatever the Reading setting says, and ends it with a link back to the full post on your site.
snippets.notes: Posts with a written excerpt use it in full; others are cut to the word count at the top. Set the link text to an empty string to leave the link out. If the "Read the Full Article" Link in Feeds snippet is also active, items get two links.

snippets.title: Show All Block Settings in One List Without Tabs
snippets.description: Removes the Settings and Styles tabs from the block sidebar in the editor, so every panel for the selected block is listed together again.
snippets.notes: Uses the editor's blockInspectorTabs setting (WordPress 6.2 and later). List block names at the top, such as 'core/navigation', to keep the tabs for those blocks only.

snippets.title: Bring Back Appearance > Customize on Block Themes
snippets.description: Restores the Customize link under Appearance and in the admin bar on block themes, for quick access to Customizer settings such as Site Identity and Homepage Settings.
snippets.notes: The Customizer only shows the panels that still apply to your theme. Colors, fonts and layouts of block themes stay in the Site Editor.

snippets.title: Read-Only Custom Fields Viewer for Administrators
snippets.description: Adds a box to the post editor that lists every custom field stored for the post, hidden ones included, with serialized arrays and JSON shown in a readable layout. Nothing can be changed from it.
snippets.notes: Only users who can manage options see the box. Serialized objects are displayed without being rebuilt, so viewing them is safe. In the block editor the box is at the bottom of the screen. Type in the filter field to find a key quickly.

snippets.title: Restrict wp-admin to Staff With WooCommerce My Account Support
snippets.description: Sends subscribers, customers and other users without editing rights from wp-admin to the WooCommerce My Account page or the homepage, with options to keep the profile screen open and hide the admin bar. AJAX and front-end forms keep working.
snippets.notes: A fuller version of "Keep Subscribers Out of wp-admin"; use one or the other. Works without WooCommerce. When the profile screen is closed, "Edit Profile" links go to My Account > Account details (WooCommerce) or the redirect address.

snippets.title: Use the Person's Name as Avatar Alt Text
snippets.description: Fills the empty alt attribute of avatars with the display name of the user or commenter, so accessibility checkers stop reporting images without alt text.
snippets.notes: Avatars that already have alt text keep it. Change the pattern to something like 'Photo of %s'. Snippets that replace the whole avatar image (such as Initials Avatars Instead of Gravatar) build their own tag, so this one does not change theirs.

snippets.title: Edit Links on Posts in Blog and Archive Lists
snippets.description: Adds an Edit link under each post on blog, archive and search pages for logged-in users who are allowed to edit that post. Works with classic themes and Query Loop blocks.
snippets.notes: Visitors never see the link. In block themes it appears after the Post Title block of each item in a Query Loop. Some classic themes already print an edit link in the post footer; if yours does, you will see both.

snippets.title: List Active Plugins First on the Plugins Screen
snippets.description: Moves active plugins to the top of the Plugins screen, followed by the inactive ones, keeping alphabetical order inside each group.
snippets.notes: The rows are reordered in the browser as the screen loads. Search, filters and bulk actions work as usual.

snippets.title: Random Posts Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [random_posts] shortcode that lists a few random posts, optionally from chosen categories or another post type, without running a slow random database query on every page view.
snippets.notes: Examples: [random_posts], [random_posts count="3" category="news,reviews"], [random_posts post_type="page" count="4"]. Categories can be slugs or IDs. The list of candidate posts is cached (60 minutes by default) and a new random pick is made from it on every uncached page view. The post being viewed is never included.

snippets.title: Time-of-Day Greeting Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [greeting] shortcode that says Good morning, Good afternoon or Good evening based on your site's timezone, with the logged-in user's first name when there is one.
snippets.notes: Examples: [greeting], [greeting guest="friend"], [greeting name="no"]. Change the texts and start hours at the top. Page caching can show logged-out visitors a greeting from an earlier time of day.

snippets.title: Collapse Long Comments With a Read More Button
snippets.description: Shortens very long comments to a few lines with a soft fade and a Read more / Show less button. Works with classic themes and the Comments block, and leaves comments whole when JavaScript is off.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-comment-collapsed {
    max-height: var(--wpide-comment-height, 200px);
    overflow: hidden;
    -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 60%, transparent);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 60%, transparent);
}
.wpide-comment-toggle {
    margin: .5em 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: underline;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.wpide-comment-toggle:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid currentColor;
    outline-offset: 2px;
}
@media print {
    .wpide-comment-collapsed { max-height: none; -webkit-mask-image: none; mask-image: none; }
    .wpide-comment-toggle { display: none; }
}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var COLLAPSED_HEIGHT = 200; // Visible height of a collapsed comment, in pixels.
    var MIN_HIDDEN = 120;       // Only collapse when at least this much would be hidden.
    var MORE_TEXT = 'Read more';
    var LESS_TEXT = 'Show less';

    var bodies = document.querySelectorAll('.comment-content, .wp-block-comment-content');

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(bodies, function (body, index) {
        if (body.scrollHeight < COLLAPSED_HEIGHT + MIN_HIDDEN) {
            return;
        }

        if (!body.id) {
            body.id = 'wpide-comment-body-' + (index + 1);
        }

        body.style.setProperty('--wpide-comment-height', COLLAPSED_HEIGHT + 'px');

        var button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'wpide-comment-toggle';
        button.setAttribute('aria-controls', body.id);

        var setOpen = function (open) {
            body.classList.toggle('wpide-comment-collapsed', !open);
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
            button.textContent = open ? LESS_TEXT : MORE_TEXT;
        };

        button.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var open = body.classList.contains('wpide-comment-collapsed');
            setOpen(open);
            if (!open && body.getBoundingClientRect().top < 0) {
                body.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
            }
        });

        // Keyboard users who tab into a link in the hidden part get the whole comment.
        body.addEventListener('focusin', function () {
            if (body.classList.contains('wpide-comment-collapsed')) {
                setOpen(true);
            }
        });

        body.parentNode.insertBefore(button, body.nextSibling);
        setOpen(false);
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Change the heights and button texts at the top of the script. Screen readers still read the whole comment, the button reports whether it is expanded, and tabbing into a link in the hidden part opens the comment.

snippets.title: Fade-In Page Transitions
snippets.description: Fades each page in as it loads and gently out when visitors follow a link to another page on your site. Turned off for people who prefer reduced motion, and pages never stay hidden if JavaScript fails.
snippets.code:
<style>
/* The fade-in is pure CSS, so pages stay visible even when JavaScript is off or fails. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    @keyframes wpide-page-fade-in {
        from { opacity: 0; }
        to { opacity: 1; }
    }
    body {
        animation: wpide-page-fade-in .4s ease-out backwards;
    }
    html.wpide-page-leaving body {
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity .2s ease-in;
    }
}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var FADE_OUT_MS = 200; // Fade out before following a link. Set to 0 to only fade in.

    if (!FADE_OUT_MS || !window.matchMedia || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
