        return;
    }

    var root = document.documentElement;
    var skipFiles = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|avif|svg|pdf|zip|rar|7z|mp3|mp4|mov|webm|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|csv|txt)$/i;

    // Listening on window runs after other click handlers, so links they take over are left alone.
    window.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        if (event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) {
            return;
        }

        var link = event.target && event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('a[href]') : null;

        if (!link || (link.target && link.target !== '_self') || link.hasAttribute('download') || link.closest('.no-fade, [data-no-fade]')) {
            return;
        }

        var url = new URL(link.href, location.href);

        if (url.origin !== location.origin || !/^https?:$/.test(url.protocol)) {
            return;
        }

        if (url.hash && url.pathname === location.pathname && url.search === location.search) {
            return;
        }

        if (skipFiles.test(url.pathname) || /[?&](add-to-cart|download)=/.test(url.search)) {
            return;
        }

        event.preventDefault();
        root.classList.add('wpide-page-leaving');

        setTimeout(function () {
            location.href = url.href;
        }, FADE_OUT_MS);

        // Show the page again if the navigation does not happen.
        setTimeout(function () {
            root.classList.remove('wpide-page-leaving');
        }, 3000);
    });

    // Pages restored with the Back button come back visible.
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', function (event) {
        if (event.persisted) {
            root.classList.remove('wpide-page-leaving');
        }
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Links that open a new tab, downloads, files, same-page anchors and add-to-cart links are skipped. Add the class no-fade to a link (or a parent element) to skip it. Set FADE_OUT_MS to 0 to keep only the fade-in. The fade-in can delay Largest Contentful Paint slightly; shorten the .4s duration if that matters to you.

snippets.title: Floating Social Media Icons Bar
snippets.description: Shows a slim bar of social media icons fixed to the side of the screen, with built-in SVG icons, accessible labels and an option to hide it on small screens.
snippets.notes: Fill in your profile links at the top; empty ones are skipped. Icons: Facebook, X, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Bluesky, WhatsApp, email and RSS. They are simple outline drawings, not the official brand logos.

snippets.title: Image Magnifier Lens on Hover
snippets.description: Shows a round magnifying lens over chosen images as visitors move the mouse across them, using the largest version of the image available. Opt in per image with a CSS class.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-magnifier-lens {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 99999;
    display: none;
    border: 3px solid #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #fff;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
    pointer-events: none;
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .wpide-magnify img,
    img.wpide-magnify {
        cursor: zoom-in;
    }
}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var ZOOM = 2.5;       // Magnification.
    var LENS_SIZE = 180;  // Lens diameter, in pixels.

    var images = document.querySelectorAll('.wpide-magnify img, img.wpide-magnify');
    if (!images.length || !window.PointerEvent) {
        return;
    }

    var lens = document.createElement('div');
    lens.className = 'wpide-magnifier-lens';
    lens.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    lens.style.width = LENS_SIZE + 'px';
    lens.style.height = LENS_SIZE + 'px';
    document.body.appendChild(lens);

    function hide() {
        lens.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // Use the biggest version available: a link to the image file, data-full-url or the largest srcset entry.
    function fullSource(img) {
        var link = img.closest('a[href]');
        if (link && /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|avif)(\?.*)?$/i.test(link.href)) {
            return link.href;
        }
        if (img.getAttribute('data-full-url')) {
            return img.getAttribute('data-full-url');
        }
        var best = img.currentSrc || img.src;
        var bestWidth = 0;
        (img.getAttribute('srcset') || '').split(',').forEach(function (candidate) {
            var parts = candidate.trim().split(/\s+/);
            var width = parseInt(parts[1], 10) || 0;
            if (parts[0] && width > bestWidth) {
                bestWidth = width;
                best = parts[0];
            }
        });
        return best;
    }

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(images, function (img) {
        var source = '';

        function move(event) {
            var rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();
            var x = event.clientX - rect.left;
            var y = event.clientY - rect.top;
            var half = LENS_SIZE / 2;

            if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x > rect.width || y > rect.height) {
                hide();
                return;
            }

            lens.style.left = (event.clientX - half) + 'px';
            lens.style.top = (event.clientY - half) + 'px';
            lens.style.backgroundSize = (rect.width * ZOOM) + 'px ' + (rect.height * ZOOM) + 'px';
            lens.style.backgroundPosition = (half - x * ZOOM) + 'px ' + (half - y * ZOOM) + 'px';
            lens.style.display = 'block';
        }

        // Only a mouse shows the lens. Touch, pen and keyboard use the image as normal.
        img.addEventListener('pointerenter', function (event) {
            if (event.pointerType !== 'mouse') {
                return;
            }
            if (!source) {
                source = fullSource(img);
            }
            lens.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + source.replace(/"/g, '%22') + '")';
            move(event);
        });

        img.addEventListener('pointermove', function (event) {
            if (event.pointerType === 'mouse') {
                move(event);
            }
        });

        img.addEventListener('pointerleave', hide);
    });

    window.addEventListener('scroll', hide, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key === 'Escape') {
            hide();
        }
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Add wpide-magnify under Advanced > Additional CSS class(es) of an Image or Gallery block, or to any img tag. The lens only appears for a mouse; on touch screens and with the keyboard the image behaves as usual, and a link to the full-size file still works. Change ZOOM and LENS_SIZE at the top of the script.

snippets.title: Inline Spoiler Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [spoiler] shortcode that blurs a word or sentence until the reader clicks it or presses Enter or Space, and keeps the hidden text from screen readers until it is revealed.
snippets.notes: Example: The killer was [spoiler]the butler[/spoiler]. Change what screen readers announce with [spoiler label="Ending spoiler"]. Feeds show only the label. Without JavaScript the text shows while the spoiler has keyboard focus.

snippets.title: Different Logo on Selected Pages
snippets.description: Adds a Page Logo box to the page editor so you can pick a different logo from the Media Library for that page. It replaces the site logo wherever the theme shows it, including the Site Logo block.
snippets.notes: Add more post types at the top, for example array( 'page', 'post' ). Remove the page logo to go back to the site logo. The logo is shown at the size your theme or Site Logo block uses.

snippets.title: "Last Updated" Column in the Network Sites List
snippets.description: Adds a sortable-looking "Last updated" column to Network Admin > Sites so you can spot sites nobody has touched in months.
snippets.notes: The date comes from the site's last_updated field, which WordPress refreshes when content is published.

snippets.title: Published Posts Column in the Network Sites List
snippets.description: Shows how many published posts each site has in Network Admin > Sites, cached for twelve hours so the list stays fast.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_post_type to count pages or a custom post type instead.

snippets.title: Site ID Column in the Network Sites List
snippets.description: Adds a narrow "ID" column to Network Admin > Sites, handy when a plugin, WP-CLI command or support request asks for a blog ID.

snippets.title: Active Theme Column in the Network Sites List
snippets.description: Shows the theme each site uses in Network Admin > Sites, so you know which sites a theme update or removal affects.
snippets.notes: Reads the stylesheet option of each site directly instead of switching blogs, so it costs one cached query per row.

snippets.title: Storage Used Column in the Network Sites List
snippets.description: Shows how much upload space each site uses next to its quota in Network Admin > Sites, highlighting sites that are close to the limit.
snippets.notes: Disk usage is computed by WordPress and cached per site; sites with uploads unlimited show only the used size.

snippets.title: Admin Email Column in the Network Sites List
snippets.description: Lists each site's administration email address in Network Admin > Sites so you can contact site owners without opening every site.

snippets.title: Active Plugins Column in the Network Sites List
snippets.description: Shows how many plugins each site has activated on its own, with the plugin names in a tooltip, in Network Admin > Sites.
snippets.notes: Network-activated plugins are not counted because they run on every site.

snippets.title: Search Engine Visibility Column for Network Sites
snippets.description: Adds a column to Network Admin > Sites that flags sites set to "Discourage search engines", a common leftover after a site launches.

snippets.title: Extra Quick Links on Network Sites Rows
snippets.description: Adds Plugins, Users and Settings links to each row's hover actions in Network Admin > Sites, so you can jump straight to the screen you need on that site.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_links to add or remove screens; paths are relative to each site's wp-admin.

snippets.title: Site Count Column in the Network Users List
snippets.description: Adds a column to Network Admin > Users showing how many sites each person belongs to, with the site names in a tooltip.

snippets.title: Last Login Column Across the Network
snippets.description: Records when each user last signed in anywhere on the network and shows it in Network Admin > Users, making inactive accounts easy to find.
snippets.notes: The column fills in as people log in after you activate the snippet; earlier logins are not known.

snippets.title: List a User's Sites on Their Profile
snippets.description: Shows super admins every site a user belongs to, with their role on each, at the bottom of the user's profile screen.
snippets.notes: Only super admins see the list.

snippets.title: Primary Site and Profile Links on Network Users Rows
snippets.description: Adds two hover links under each user in Network Admin > Users, one to the dashboard of their first site (with their site count) and one straight to their profile.

snippets.title: Default Settings for New Network Sites
snippets.description: Applies your preferred timezone, date and time formats, week start, permalink structure and language to every site created on the network.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_defaults; any option name works. Existing sites are not changed.

snippets.title: Remove Sample Content From New Network Sites
snippets.description: Deletes the "Hello world!" post, its sample comment and the "Sample Page" from each newly created site so site owners start with a clean slate.
snippets.notes: Only runs once, right after a site is created; it matches the sample items by their default slugs.

snippets.title: Activate a Default Theme on New Network Sites
snippets.description: Switches every newly created site to the theme you choose instead of the latest default theme.
snippets.notes: Use the theme's folder name; the theme must be installed. Network-enable it too if site owners should be able to switch back to it.

snippets.title: Activate Default Plugins on New Network Sites
snippets.description: Activates a list of plugins on each new site as it is created, so every site starts with the same toolkit without network-activating it everywhere.
snippets.notes: List plugin paths as folder/main-file.php. Plugins that are missing or already network-active are skipped.

snippets.title: Create Starter Pages on New Network Sites
snippets.description: Creates a set of pages such as About, Contact and Privacy on every new site, and can set one of them as the static front page.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_pages; set $wpide_front_page to one of the titles or leave it empty to keep the latest-posts homepage.

snippets.title: Hide New Network Sites From Search Engines
snippets.description: Sets every newly created site to "Discourage search engines" so half-built sites are not indexed; site owners switch it off when they launch.
snippets.notes: Pair it with the "Search engines" column snippet to see which sites still need switching on.

snippets.title: Add a Team Member to Every New Site
snippets.description: Adds a chosen user, such as your support or editorial account, to each newly created site with the role you pick.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_login to an existing username and $wpide_role to any role that exists on new sites.

snippets.title: Turn Off Comments on New Network Sites
snippets.description: Creates every new site with comments, pingbacks and trackbacks switched off by default, for networks of brochure or business sites.
snippets.notes: Site owners can still turn comments on in Settings > Discussion.

snippets.title: Copy Settings From a Template Site to New Sites
snippets.description: Copies chosen options, such as Customizer settings, the site icon and reading settings, from a template site onto every new site.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_template_id to the blog ID of your template site. Options that point to posts or media (like page_on_front) are not copied because IDs differ between sites.

snippets.title: Email a Custom Address When a Site Is Created
snippets.description: Sends a short notice with the new site's name, address and creator to an address you choose, in addition to WordPress's own network admin email.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_notify_to; separate several addresses with commas.

snippets.title: Stop New Site and Signup Emails to the Network Admin
snippets.description: Stops WordPress from emailing the network admin every time a site is created or someone activates a new site or account, useful on networks that create many sites automatically.
snippets.notes: Site owners still get their own welcome emails; the "Registration notification" network setting is overridden while this is active.

snippets.title: Disable Welcome Emails for New Sites and Users
snippets.description: Stops the "Your new site" and "New user account" welcome emails WordPress multisite sends after activation, for networks that send their own onboarding.
snippets.notes: Activation emails sent before an account exists are not affected.

snippets.title: Custom Welcome Email Text for New Network Sites
snippets.description: Replaces the network's welcome email for new sites with your own wording while keeping the site address, login and dashboard links filled in.
snippets.notes: Available placeholders: SITE_NAME, BLOG_URL, USERNAME, LOGINLINK. WordPress replaces them before sending; the password is no longer included.

snippets.title: Limit How Many Sites Each User Can Create
snippets.description: Stops a user from signing up for another site once they already own the number you set; super admins are never limited.
snippets.notes: Counts sites where the user is an administrator. Applies to the front-end signup form and the "Add new site" screen for non-super-admins.

snippets.title: Reserve Site Names on the Network
snippets.description: Blocks signups for site names you want to keep, such as shop, support or your brand names, on top of WordPress's built-in reserved list.
snippets.notes: Names are compared in lower case; add as many as you need.

snippets.title: Minimum Site Name Length for Signups
snippets.description: Requires new site names to be at least a set number of characters (WordPress only asks for four), cutting down on throwaway and squatted names.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_min_length. Super admins creating sites are not restricted.

snippets.title: Allow Network Signups Only From Certain Email Domains
snippets.description: Rejects user signups on the network unless the email address belongs to one of your domains, such as a school or company network.
snippets.notes: This works alongside the "Limited Email Registrations" field in Network Settings; use either one.

snippets.title: Redirect wp-signup.php When Registration Is Closed
snippets.description: Sends visitors who land on wp-signup.php to a page you choose (or the homepage) when network registration is turned off, instead of showing a bare "Registration has been disabled" screen.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_target to a full URL or a path on the main site.

snippets.title: Network-Wide Dashboard Announcement
snippets.description: Adds an "Announcement" box to Network Admin > Settings; whatever a super admin writes there appears as a dismissible notice on every site's dashboard.
snippets.notes: Basic HTML (links, bold) is allowed. Clear the field to remove the notice.

snippets.title: One Analytics Tag for Every Site on the Network
snippets.description: Adds a Google Analytics 4 measurement ID field to Network Admin > Settings and prints the tag on every site, so new sites are tracked automatically.
snippets.notes: Logged-in users who can edit posts are not tracked. Leave the field empty to switch tracking off.

snippets.title: Network-Wide Footer Notice
snippets.description: Lets super admins set one line of text in Network Admin > Settings, such as a hosting credit or legal link, that appears in the footer of every site.
snippets.notes: Leave the field empty to hide it. Styled lightly so it fits most themes; adjust the inline CSS to match yours.

snippets.title: Network-Wide Maintenance Mode Switch
snippets.description: Adds a checkbox to Network Admin > Settings that puts every site on the network into maintenance mode at once; super admins can still browse and work normally.
snippets.notes: Visitors get a 503 response with a Retry-After header, which tells search engines the downtime is temporary.

snippets.title: Network Overview Widget in the Network Dashboard
snippets.description: Adds a widget to the Network Admin dashboard with totals for sites, users, archived, spam and deleted sites, and the five newest sites.
snippets.notes: Counts come from WordPress's own cached network counts and a single sites query.

snippets.title: Show the Current Site ID in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Shows super admins the blog ID of the site they are on in the toolbar, with links to that site's Network Admin edit screens.
snippets.notes: Only visible to super admins.

snippets.title: Sort "My Sites" Alphabetically in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Orders the sites in the toolbar's My Sites menu by name instead of by creation date, which makes long lists much easier to scan.
snippets.notes: The main site stays first; change the comparison to sort by address instead.

snippets.title: Search Box for the "My Sites" Admin Bar Menu
snippets.description: Adds a filter field to the top of the toolbar's My Sites menu so super admins on large networks can type part of a name to find a site instantly.
snippets.notes: Appears only when you belong to more than ten sites; change $wpide_min_sites to show it sooner.

snippets.title: Hide "My Sites" From Regular Users
snippets.description: Removes the My Sites menu from the toolbar for everyone except super admins, so members of several sites are not distracted by the network structure.
snippets.notes: Users can still reach their other sites by address.

snippets.title: Hide the Plugins Screen From Site Admins
snippets.description: Removes the Plugins menu from subsite dashboards for everyone except super admins and blocks direct visits, even if "Enable administration menus" is on in Network Settings.
snippets.notes: Network-activated plugins keep running; only the screen is hidden.

snippets.title: Stop Site Admins From Deleting Their Own Site
snippets.description: Removes Tools > Delete Site from subsite dashboards and blocks the screen, so only super admins can delete sites from Network Admin.

snippets.title: Lock the Admin Email on Subsites
snippets.description: Makes the Administration Email Address field on each site's General Settings read-only for site admins, so network notices keep reaching the right person.
snippets.notes: Super admins can still change it here or from Network Admin > Sites > Edit > Settings.

snippets.title: Hide Import and Export From Site Admins
snippets.description: Removes Tools > Import and Tools > Export from subsite dashboards for non-super-admins and blocks the screens, keeping content moves in the network team's hands.

snippets.title: Hide Permalink Settings From Site Admins
snippets.description: Removes Settings > Permalinks from subsite dashboards for non-super-admins so URL structures stay consistent across the network.
snippets.notes: Combine with the new-site defaults snippet to set the structure for every new site.

snippets.title: Show Network-Active Plugins on Subsite Plugin Screens
snippets.description: Lists network-activated and must-use plugins on each site's Plugins screen for site admins, so they can see what is running without asking.
snippets.notes: Site admins can see these plugins but cannot deactivate them.

snippets.title: Hide "Add Existing User" From Site Admins
snippets.description: Removes the "Add Existing User" form on subsite Users > Add New for site admins, so they cannot pull people from other sites on the network.
snippets.notes: Super admins still see the form.

snippets.title: Let Site Admins Edit Their Own Site's Users
snippets.description: Allows site administrators to edit the profiles of users who belong to their site, which multisite normally reserves for super admins.
snippets.notes: Site admins can never edit super admins or users who belong to other sites as well, because profile changes are network-wide.

snippets.title: Add New Network Users to the Main Site
snippets.description: Adds every newly registered user to the main site with a role you choose, so members of any subsite also have an account on your hub site.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_role. Users who are already members of the main site are left alone.

snippets.title: Send Users to Their Own Site After Login
snippets.description: When someone logs in on a site where they are not a member, sends them to the dashboard of their primary site instead of an error page.
snippets.notes: Users who belong to the site they log in on are redirected as usual.

snippets.title: Return to the Main Site After Logging Out
snippets.description: Sends users to the network's main homepage when they log out from any site, giving the whole network one consistent exit point.
snippets.notes: Change network_home_url( '/' ) to a specific page path if you prefer.

snippets.title: Lock the List of Super Admins
snippets.description: Blocks anyone from being granted super admin rights unless their username is on your approved list, protecting the network if a super admin account is compromised.
snippets.notes: Add every legitimate super admin to $wpide_allowed before activating, or new grants will be refused.

snippets.title: Email Alert When Super Admin Rights Change
snippets.description: Emails the network admin address whenever someone is granted or loses super admin rights, with who made the change.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_alert_to to send the alert somewhere else.

snippets.title: Plugin Usage Report for the Network
snippets.description: Adds Network Admin > Plugins > Usage, a table of every installed plugin with how many sites activate it and which ones, so you can safely remove unused plugins.
snippets.notes: Reads one option per site; on networks with thousands of sites, open it at a quiet time. Results are cached for an hour.

snippets.title: Theme Usage Report for the Network
snippets.description: Adds Network Admin > Themes > Usage, listing every installed theme with the sites that use it (directly or as a parent theme), so unused themes are easy to spot.
snippets.notes: Cached for an hour and refreshed whenever a site switches theme.

snippets.title: Email Alert When a Network Site Is Deleted
snippets.description: Sends an email with the site's name, address and the person responsible whenever a site is permanently deleted from the network.
snippets.notes: Sent just before the site's tables are removed, so the site name is still available.

snippets.title: Shared Navigation Menu From the Main Site
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_network_menu] shortcode that displays a menu from the main site on any site in the network, so one menu can be maintained in one place.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_network_menu menu="Main Menu"] with the menu's name, slug or ID on the main site. The HTML is cached for an hour and cleared when a menu on the main site is saved.

snippets.title: Latest Posts From the Main Site on Any Subsite
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_main_site_posts] shortcode that lists the newest posts from the network's main site, perfect for a "News from HQ" box on every subsite.
snippets.notes: Attributes: number (default 5) and category (a category slug on the main site). Cached for 15 minutes and refreshed when the main site publishes.

snippets.title: Recent Posts From Across the Network
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_network_posts] shortcode that shows the newest posts from every public site on the network in one list, with the site name next to each post.
snippets.notes: Looks at up to 50 of the most recently updated public sites and caches the result for 30 minutes; attributes are number and sites (comma-separated blog IDs to limit the list).

snippets.title: Directory of Network Sites
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_sites_directory] shortcode that lists the public sites on the network with their names, taglines and links, cached for an hour.
snippets.notes: Archived, spam, deleted and search-engine-hidden sites are left out. Set exclude="1,4" to hide particular blog IDs.

snippets.title: Copy Posts to Another Network Site
snippets.description: Adds a "Copy to site" bulk action on the Posts screen that copies the selected posts (title, content, excerpt and featured image URL as a note) as drafts to another site you are an editor on.
snippets.notes: Copies are created as drafts. Categories, tags and media are not copied because their IDs differ between sites; the original post's link is saved in a custom field.

snippets.title: Use the Main Site's Icon on Sites Without One
snippets.description: Makes subsites that have no Site Icon of their own show the main site's favicon and app icon, so every browser tab carries your brand.
snippets.notes: Sites that upload their own icon keep it.

snippets.title: Network-Wide Login Logo From the Main Site
snippets.description: Shows the main site's custom logo on the login screen of every site in the network, linked to the site being logged in to.
snippets.notes: Uses the main site's Customizer logo (custom_logo); set one there first.

snippets.title: Members-Only Subsites
snippets.description: Makes the subsites you list visible only to logged-in members of that site; everyone else is sent to the login page and non-members see a friendly notice.
snippets.notes: List blog IDs in $wpide_private_sites. Feeds and the REST API are covered too; super admins always have access.

snippets.title: Custom Upload Quotas for Individual Sites
snippets.description: Gives chosen sites a bigger (or smaller) upload quota than the network default, without editing each site in Network Admin.
snippets.notes: Values are in megabytes. Sites not listed keep the network's "Site upload space" setting.

snippets.title: Show Upload Space Used in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Shows site admins how much of their upload quota they have used, as a percentage in the toolbar, turning amber at 75% and red at 90%.
snippets.notes: Hidden when the network has upload space checks turned off.

snippets.title: Warn Site Admins Before They Run Out of Upload Space
snippets.description: Shows an admin notice on the Media screens and the dashboard once a site has used more than a set share of its upload quota, before uploads start failing.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_threshold (percent). The message includes the remaining space.

snippets.title: Add Modern Image Formats to Network Upload Types
snippets.description: Adds WebP and AVIF to the file types every site on the network may upload, without editing the "Upload file types" list in Network Settings.
snippets.notes: Add other extensions to $wpide_extra; the server must also allow their MIME types.

snippets.title: Set the Maximum Upload Size for the Whole Network
snippets.description: Overrides the network's "Max upload file size" setting from code, so every site gets the same per-file limit regardless of what is stored in the database.
snippets.notes: Value in kilobytes. PHP's upload_max_filesize and post_max_size still cap the real limit.

snippets.title: Fix Old Subsite URLs After Domain Mapping
snippets.description: Rewrites links and image URLs that still point at a site's old network address (like example.com/shop/) to its mapped domain when content is displayed.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_old_urls per blog ID. This fixes display only; run a search-replace later to update the database permanently.

snippets.title: Mapped Domain Column in the Network Sites List
snippets.description: Shows each site's public address next to its network address in Network Admin > Sites and flags sites whose Home and Site URLs do not match, a common domain-mapping mistake.
snippets.notes: Fix mismatches in Network Admin > Sites > Edit > Settings (home and siteurl).

snippets.title: Site ID and Path Classes on the Body Tag
snippets.description: Adds classes such as site-3 and site-shop to the body tag on every network site, so one shared stylesheet can target individual sites.

snippets.title: Noindex Subsites With a Staging Path
snippets.description: Adds a noindex robots directive to any subsite whose address contains "staging", "dev" or "test", so preview copies inside a network never show up in search results.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_markers to match how you name preview sites.

snippets.title: Jump to Any Site From the Network Admin Toolbar
snippets.description: Adds a small "Find site" search box to the toolbar in Network Admin that searches the sites list by name or address, saving clicks on networks with hundreds of sites.
snippets.notes: Uses WordPress's own sites search; press Enter to search.

snippets.title: "Created By" Column in the Network Sites List
snippets.description: Records which user created each new site and shows it in a column in Network Admin > Sites, which helps on networks where staff or customers create their own sites.
snippets.notes: Only sites created after activation are recorded; earlier ones show a dash.

snippets.title: Private Notes on Each Network Site
snippets.description: Adds a "Notes" box to Network Admin > Sites > Edit Site where super admins can record the client, contract details or quirks of a site, and shows the note in the sites list.
snippets.notes: Notes are stored in site meta and only visible in Network Admin.

snippets.title: Remind Super Admins Which Site They Are Editing
snippets.description: Shows a slim coloured bar at the top of every subsite dashboard for super admins with the site's name and address, so changes are never made on the wrong site by mistake.
snippets.notes: The main site uses a different colour so it stands out.

snippets.title: Point "Create a Site" Links to Your Own Signup Page
snippets.description: Replaces the network's default wp-signup.php address in links and redirects with a custom page, such as a pricing or onboarding page, while keeping the real signup form available.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_signup_url. Visits to wp-signup.php itself still work so your custom page can link to it.

snippets.title: Export Network Users to CSV
snippets.description: Adds an "Export CSV" button to Network Admin > Users that downloads every network user with their email, registration date, number of sites and super admin status.
snippets.notes: Protected by a nonce and the manage_network_users capability. Very large networks are exported in batches of 500 users to keep memory low.

snippets.title: Sort the Network Sites List by Recent Activity
snippets.description: Opens Network Admin > Sites sorted by "last updated" with the most recently active sites first, instead of by ID, so the sites people are working on are always at the top.
snippets.notes: Clicking a column header still sorts by that column.

snippets.title: Only Logged-In Members Can Create New Sites
snippets.description: Keeps the network's signup form open for new user accounts but only lets people who are already logged in create a site, cutting down on spam sites while staying open to new members.
snippets.notes: Applies when Network Settings > Registration is set to allow both user accounts and sites. Super admins are never restricted.

snippets.title: English Dashboard for Administrators Only
snippets.description: Keeps the dashboard in English for administrators while the site and everyone else's dashboard stay in the site language, handy for developers supporting non-English sites.
snippets.notes: A language chosen in the administrator's own profile still wins. Change $wpide_locale to use another admin language.

snippets.title: Switch the Front-End Language With ?lang=
snippets.description: Lets visitors switch the theme and plugin interface language with a ?lang=fr_FR link; the choice is remembered in a cookie and limited to languages you allow.
snippets.notes: Only switches interface strings that have installed translations, not your post content. Install the languages in Settings > General first.

snippets.title: Date and Time Formats Per Language
snippets.description: Uses a different date and time format for each language, such as 27 October 2026 in British English and 27. Oktober 2026 in German, whenever the site or user language changes.
snippets.notes: Add locales to $wpide_formats; languages not listed fall back to the formats in Settings > General. Works with any plugin that switches the locale.

snippets.title: First Day of the Week Per Language
snippets.description: Starts calendars and date pickers on Sunday or Monday depending on the current language, instead of one fixed setting for every visitor.
snippets.notes: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, 6 = Saturday. Locales not listed use Settings > General.

snippets.title: Localized Number Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_number] shortcode that prints a number with the thousands and decimal separators of the current language, for example 1,234.5 or 1.234,5.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_number value="1234.5" decimals="1"].

snippets.title: Localized Currency Amount Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_money] shortcode that formats an amount in a currency using the conventions of the current language, like $1,234.50, 1.234,50 € or ¥1,235.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_money amount="1234.5" currency="EUR"]. Needs PHP's intl extension for full formatting; without it a simple fallback is used.

snippets.title: Preview the Site in Right-to-Left Mode
snippets.description: Lets administrators add ?wpide_rtl=1 to any URL to see the site and dashboard laid out right-to-left, so themes can be checked for Arabic or Hebrew without switching the site language.
snippets.notes: Only affects the logged-in administrator making the request. Add ?wpide_rtl=0 or remove the parameter to go back.

snippets.title: Flip Directional Icons in Right-to-Left Languages
snippets.description: Mirrors arrows, chevrons and other directional icons when the page is right-to-left, so "next" and "back" point the right way in Arabic, Hebrew and Persian.
snippets.notes: Add your theme's icon classes to the selector list; logos and clocks should not be flipped.

snippets.title: Right-to-Left Fixes for Lists, Quotes and Tables
snippets.description: Corrects common right-to-left layout problems in post content, such as list indents, blockquote borders, table alignment and image floats, using logical CSS properties.
snippets.notes: Rules only apply when the page direction is rtl, so it is safe on multilingual sites.

snippets.title: Keep Mixed-Direction Names Readable
snippets.description: Wraps comment author names and post author names in a bidi-isolate element so a Hebrew or Arabic name does not scramble the punctuation around it on a left-to-right page (and vice versa).
snippets.notes: Uses the HTML <bdi> element, supported by all current browsers.

snippets.title: Set a Different Language for Individual Pages
snippets.description: Adds a "Page language" box to the editor so a single post or page written in another language gets the correct lang attribute (and text direction) for screen readers, spell checkers and search engines.
snippets.notes: Enter a language code such as fr, de-CH or ar. RTL languages also set dir="rtl".

snippets.title: Manual hreflang Links for Translated Pages
snippets.description: Adds a box to the editor where you list the URLs of a page's translations; the matching hreflang tags (plus x-default) are printed in the page head, for multilingual sites that do not use a translation plugin.
snippets.notes: One per line, as language code, a space, then the URL (e.g. "fr https://example.com/fr/page/"). Add "x-default URL" for the fallback version. List the page itself too.

snippets.title: Load Your Own Translation Files First
snippets.description: Looks for custom .mo files in wp-content/languages/custom/ before the official ones, so your edited translations of a plugin or theme survive updates.
snippets.notes: Name files like plugin-slug-fr_FR.mo (or theme-slug-de_DE.mo) and upload them to wp-content/languages/custom/. Strings missing from your file still come from the official translation.

snippets.title: Replace Interface Text Per Language
snippets.description: Changes specific interface strings (button labels, notices, form text) differently for each language, without editing translation files.
snippets.notes: Keys are the original English strings exactly as written in the code. Add a text domain check if a string is used by several plugins.

snippets.title: Redirect First-Time Visitors to Their Language Section
snippets.description: Sends visitors who land on the homepage to the matching language section (such as /fr/ or /de/) based on their browser language, once; their choice is then remembered.
snippets.notes: Map language codes to the paths of your translated homepages. Search engine bots are never redirected, so every version stays indexable.

snippets.title: Language Column in the Users List
snippets.description: Shows each user's chosen dashboard language in Users > All Users, which helps when you send emails or support in their language.
snippets.notes: Users without their own choice show "Site default".

snippets.title: Quick Dashboard Language Switch in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a language menu to the toolbar so each user can switch their own dashboard language in one click, using the languages installed on the site.
snippets.notes: Changes only the current user's profile language; the site language stays the same.

snippets.title: Silence "Translation Loading Triggered Too Early" Notices
snippets.description: Hides the "_load_textdomain_just_in_time was called incorrectly" debug notice (added in WordPress 6.7) for plugins you cannot fix yourself, keeping debug logs readable.
snippets.notes: List the text domains to silence in $wpide_domains, or leave it empty to silence the notice for all of them. Report the issue to the plugin author too.

snippets.title: Font Stacks Per Language With :lang()
snippets.description: Switches to fonts that cover the script of the page or block language, for example Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Thai and Hindi, while keeping your theme font for Latin text.
snippets.notes: These use fonts already installed on most devices; swap in web fonts you load if you prefer.

snippets.title: Automatic Hyphenation for Long-Word Languages
snippets.description: Turns on the browser's built-in hyphenation for post content in languages with long compound words, such as German, Dutch and Finnish, so narrow columns on phones stop showing large gaps.
snippets.notes: Hyphenation follows the page's lang attribute, so make sure it is set correctly. Headings are left alone.

snippets.title: Correct Quotation Marks Per Language
snippets.description: Makes <q> quotations use the right quote marks for the language of the page or passage, such as « » in French, „ “ in German and 「 」 in Japanese.
snippets.notes: Applies to inline <q> elements; typed quote characters in your text are not changed.

snippets.title: Show Post Times in the Visitor's Own Timezone
snippets.description: Converts post dates and times on the page into each visitor's local timezone and language format in the browser, so an event posted for 18:00 London reads 19:00 in Paris.
snippets.notes: Works on any <time datetime="..."> element with a full date and time; elements without a time are left as they are. Add the class wpide-no-localize to skip one.

snippets.title: Expose the Page Language to JavaScript
snippets.description: Adds a small window.wpideLang object with the current locale, language code and text direction, so your scripts can format dates, numbers or messages correctly without guessing.
snippets.notes: Picks up the language set by WPML or Polylang when either is active, otherwise the WordPress locale.

snippets.title: Current Language Class on the Body Tag
snippets.description: Adds classes like lang-fr and dir-rtl to the body tag, so you can adjust styles per language, whether the language comes from WPML, Polylang or the WordPress locale.

snippets.title: Show Content Only in Certain Languages
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_lang only="fr,de"]...[/wpide_lang] shortcode that shows the enclosed text only when the page is displayed in one of those languages, for small differences between translations.
snippets.notes: Uses the WPML or Polylang language when available, otherwise the WordPress locale (e.g. fr matches fr_FR). Add except="en" to hide content in a language instead.

snippets.title: Comment Notifications to a Per-Language Moderator
snippets.description: Sends comment moderation emails to a different moderator depending on the language of the post, using WPML, Polylang or each post's language box, so every comment reaches someone who reads it.
snippets.notes: Map language codes to email addresses; posts in other languages keep the default recipients.

snippets.title: Lightweight WPML Language Switcher Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_wpml_switcher] shortcode that prints an accessible list or dropdown of your WPML languages, with native names, codes or flags, anywhere you can place a shortcode.
snippets.notes: Attributes: style="list|dropdown", show="native|translated|code", flags="1", hide_current="1", skip_missing="1" (hide languages without a translation of the current page).

snippets.title: Add WPML Language Links to a Menu Location
snippets.description: Appends links to the other WPML languages of the current page at the end of a chosen theme menu, labelled with each language's native name.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_location to your theme's menu location (see Appearance > Menus > Manage Locations). Languages without a translation of the page are skipped.

snippets.title: Translatable Announcement Bar With WPML
snippets.description: Shows a slim announcement bar at the top of every page whose text you translate in WPML > String Translation, so each language gets its own message.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_text and $wpide_link, visit the dashboard once, then translate the strings under the "WPIDE Snippets" domain in String Translation.

snippets.title: Translate Customizer Text Settings With WPML
snippets.description: Registers chosen Customizer (theme_mod) text settings, such as a footer copyright or header phone number, in WPML String Translation and shows the translated value in each language.
snippets.notes: List the theme_mod names in $wpide_mods (find them in your theme's customizer code). Strings refresh in String Translation whenever the Customizer is saved.

snippets.title: Make Any Text Option Translatable With WPML
snippets.description: Registers the text of selected site options, for example a plugin's notice text or a cookie banner message, in WPML String Translation and returns the right translation on the front end.
snippets.notes: Only works for options stored as plain strings. For array options, use WPML's own Admin Texts screen instead.

snippets.title: Send Secondary-Language 404s to That Language's Homepage
snippets.description: When a visitor hits a missing page in a non-default WPML language, sends them to the homepage of that language instead of a 404, keeping them in their language.
snippets.notes: Uses a 302 redirect so search engines keep reporting real broken links; change to 301 if you prefer. The default language keeps its normal 404 page.

snippets.title: Use a Different Menu Per Language in WPML
snippets.description: Shows a completely different menu in a theme location for each WPML language, for sites whose language versions have different structures rather than translated copies.
snippets.notes: Map location => language => menu ID (find IDs in Appearance > Menus, in the URL). Languages not listed keep WPML's usual translated menu.

snippets.title: Choose the x-default Language for WPML hreflang Tags
snippets.description: Points WPML's x-default hreflang tag at the language you choose, for example English, instead of the site's default language.
snippets.notes: Use the hreflang code as WPML prints it (en, en-us, fr…). If that language has no translation of the page, the tag is left as WPML set it.

snippets.title: Remove WPML hreflang Tags From Paginated and Filtered Pages
snippets.description: Stops WPML from printing hreflang tags on page 2+ of archives, search results and URLs with query strings, where the alternates often point at mismatched pages.
snippets.notes: The first page of each archive and every singular page keep their hreflang tags.

snippets.title: Copy Custom Fields to All WPML Translations on Save
snippets.description: Copies the custom fields you list from an original post to all of its WPML translations whenever the original is saved, for values like prices, SKUs or coordinates that never change between languages.
snippets.notes: Only runs when saving the original (source-language) post. For fields WPML already manages, set them to "Copy" in WPML > Settings > Custom Fields Translation instead.

snippets.title: Show a Custom Field From the Right WPML Translation
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_wpml_field] shortcode that displays a custom field from the current-language version of any post or page, so one shortcode works in every language.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_wpml_field key="opening_hours" id="42"]; leave out id to use the current post. Falls back to the original post when no translation exists.

snippets.title: Link to the Current-Language Version of Any Page
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_wpml_link id="123"] shortcode that links to the translation of a page in the language being viewed, using that translation's title, so internal links never send visitors to the wrong language.
snippets.notes: Add text="..." to set your own link text (it can be translated with the page). Falls back to the original page if there is no translation.

snippets.title: Notice When WPML Shows Content in Another Language
snippets.description: Adds a short notice above posts that WPML displays in the default language because no translation exists yet ("display as translated" mode), so visitors know why the text is not in their language.
snippets.notes: Translate the notice text through String Translation under the "WPIDE Snippets" domain after visiting the dashboard once.

snippets.title: Add Language and Translations to the REST API (WPML)
snippets.description: Adds wpml_language and wpml_translations fields to posts and pages in the REST API, so headless front ends and apps know each item's language and the IDs of its translations.
snippets.notes: Add custom post types to $wpide_types. The translations field maps language codes to post IDs.

snippets.title: Dashboard Widget: Posts Missing WPML Translations
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget that lists your 20 most recent posts and pages in the default language with the languages they still need translating into.
snippets.notes: Cached for an hour and refreshed whenever a post is saved. Only editors and administrators see it.

snippets.title: Translatable Text Shortcode for WPML
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_t name="..."]Text[/wpide_t] shortcode that registers its text in WPML String Translation and shows the translation, ideal for short phrases in widgets, footers and page builder text.
snippets.notes: Give every phrase a unique name. Strings register the first time an administrator views a page that uses them.

snippets.title: Edit Translations From the Admin Bar (WPML)
snippets.description: Adds a "Translations" menu to the toolbar on single posts and pages with a link to edit each language version, so editors can hop between translations without searching.
snippets.notes: Only languages that already have a translation are listed, and only for users who can edit the post.

snippets.title: Polylang Language Switcher Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_pll_switcher] shortcode that prints an accessible Polylang language list or dropdown anywhere, with flags, names or both.
snippets.notes: Attributes: dropdown="1", flags="1", names="1", hide_current="1", hide_untranslated="1" (skip languages without a translation of this page).

snippets.title: Translatable Phrases With Polylang Strings
snippets.description: Registers a list of your own phrases in Languages > Translations and adds a [wpide_pll_string name="..."] shortcode to show each one in the current language.
snippets.notes: Add phrases to $wpide_strings, then translate them in Languages > Translations under the "WPIDE" group. In PHP templates you can also call pll__( 'the phrase' ).

snippets.title: Polylang Translations for Customizer Settings
snippets.description: Registers chosen Customizer text settings, such as footer copyright or a header phone number, in Polylang's string translations and shows the right translation in each language.
snippets.notes: List the theme_mod names in $wpide_mods, save the Customizer, then translate them in Languages > Translations under "Theme mods".

snippets.title: Polylang: Translate Plugin and Site Text Options
snippets.description: Registers the text stored in selected options, such as a plugin's banner text or a footer notice, in Polylang's string translations and returns the translation on the front end.
snippets.notes: Works for options that hold a plain string. Find option names in Tools > Site Health > Info or in the plugin's settings form field names.

snippets.title: Send Polylang 404s to the Visitor's Language Homepage
snippets.description: Redirects visitors who hit a missing page in a secondary Polylang language to that language's homepage, so they are not dropped onto a 404 page.
snippets.notes: Uses a 302 so your 404 reports still show broken links. The default language keeps the normal 404 page.

snippets.title: Polylang hreflang: Set Which Language Is x-default
snippets.description: Adds or replaces the x-default hreflang link Polylang prints, pointing it at the language you choose so search engines know which version to show everyone else.
snippets.notes: Use the hreflang code Polylang prints for that language (often en or en-US; view your page source to check).

snippets.title: Choose Which Custom Fields Polylang Copies to Translations
snippets.description: Tells Polylang to copy (and keep in sync) extra custom fields when you create or update a translation, and to stop copying fields that should differ per language.
snippets.notes: $wpide_copy are always copied; $wpide_skip are never copied. Syncing happens when "Custom fields" is ticked in Languages > Settings > Synchronization.

snippets.title: Copy Term Meta to Polylang Category Translations
snippets.description: Copies chosen term meta, such as a category color, icon or display order, to the translations of categories and tags when they are created or updated.
snippets.notes: Add your term meta keys to $wpide_keys.

snippets.title: Make Custom Post Types Translatable in Polylang
snippets.description: Turns on Polylang translation for custom post types registered by your theme or a plugin, even when they do not appear in Languages > Settings.
snippets.notes: Use the post type keys (e.g. book, portfolio). They disappear from Polylang's settings list because this snippet now manages them.

snippets.title: Make Custom Taxonomies Translatable in Polylang
snippets.description: Turns on Polylang translation for custom taxonomies, such as product types or event categories, that are not offered in Languages > Settings.
snippets.notes: Use the taxonomy keys; they are hidden from Polylang's settings list because this snippet manages them. Translate existing terms afterwards in each taxonomy's screen.

snippets.title: Stop Polylang Redirecting the Homepage by Browser Language
snippets.description: Keeps visitors on the homepage they asked for instead of Polylang redirecting them to another language based on their browser, which also avoids caching and SEO surprises.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'pll_redirect_home', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Visitors can still switch language with your language switcher.

snippets.title: Use Each User's Profile Language as Their Polylang Language
snippets.description: Makes Polylang pick the language set in a logged-in user's profile when it decides which language to show them on the homepage, instead of relying on browser settings.
snippets.notes: Only applies when the profile language is one of your Polylang languages; otherwise Polylang's normal detection runs.

snippets.title: "Also Available In" Links Above Polylang Posts
snippets.description: Shows a short line above each post or page listing the other languages it has been translated into, with links, so visitors who arrive in the wrong language can switch straight away.
snippets.notes: Hidden when the post has no translations. Change $wpide_label, or register it as a Polylang string to translate it.

snippets.title: Search Across All Languages With Polylang
snippets.description: Makes the site search return results from every Polylang language instead of only the current one, so visitors find content that has not been translated yet.
snippets.notes: Each result still links to the post in its own language.

snippets.title: Polylang Language Fields in the REST API
snippets.description: Adds pll_language and pll_translations fields to posts and pages in the REST API, which Polylang's free version does not provide, so headless sites and apps can link translations.
snippets.notes: Add custom post types to $wpide_types. The translations field maps language slugs to post IDs.

snippets.title: Dashboard Widget: Polylang Translation Progress
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget showing how many published posts and pages exist in each Polylang language, with a progress bar compared with the default language.
snippets.notes: Counts are cached for an hour and refreshed whenever content is published.

snippets.title: Start New Polylang Translations With the Original Content
snippets.description: Pre-fills the title, content and excerpt of a new translation with the source post's text when you click the "+" icon in Polylang, so translators can work over the original instead of an empty editor.
snippets.notes: Polylang's free version already copies taxonomies and custom fields; this adds the text. Only works for posts the user can edit.

snippets.title: Polylang Translations Menu in the Toolbar
snippets.description: Adds a "Translations" toolbar menu on posts and pages with links to edit each existing language version, plus links to create the missing ones.
snippets.notes: Visible only to users who can edit the post.

snippets.title: Assign a Language to Posts Created by Importers and Code
snippets.description: Gives posts created outside the editor, for example by importers, cron jobs, forms or the REST API, the default Polylang language when they have none, so they do not vanish from language-filtered lists.
snippets.notes: Posts that already have a language are not touched. Change $wpide_lang to assign another language instead of the default.

snippets.title: Different Logo for Each Language
snippets.description: Swaps the site logo set in the Customizer for a language-specific image, using the language from WPML, Polylang or the WordPress locale.
snippets.notes: Upload each logo to the Media Library and map language codes (or locales such as fr_FR) to attachment IDs in $wpide_logos.

snippets.title: Change How Long Polylang Remembers the Language
snippets.description: Sets how long Polylang's language cookie lasts (one year by default), for example a single session on kiosks and shared computers, or 30 days for privacy-conscious sites.
snippets.notes: 0 makes it a session cookie that disappears when the browser closes.

snippets.title: Site Title and Tagline Per Language
snippets.description: Shows a different site title and tagline for each language the site is displayed in, without a translation plugin, by mapping locales to text.
snippets.notes: Works with any locale switcher, including the ?lang= snippet. The dashboard keeps the original values so they can still be edited.

snippets.title: Latin Slugs for Cyrillic, Greek and Other Scripts
snippets.description: Turns post and term titles written in Cyrillic, Greek, Georgian or other non-Latin scripts into readable Latin URL slugs (for example "Привет мир" becomes privet-mir) instead of long percent-encoded addresses.
snippets.notes: Uses PHP's intl Transliterator when available and a built-in Cyrillic/Greek table otherwise. Existing slugs are not changed.

snippets.title: Fall Back to a Related Language's Translations
snippets.description: Uses translations from a closely related language when the visitor's exact locale has none, for example German (Germany) files on a Swiss German site or Spanish (Spain) on a Mexican Spanish site, instead of falling back to English.
snippets.notes: Map each locale to its fallback in $wpide_fallbacks. The fallback language pack must be installed (Settings > General, then switch back).

snippets.title: Suggest the Visitor's Language Version
snippets.description: Shows a small, dismissible banner when the visitor's browser language differs from the page language and a translated version exists (read from the page's hreflang links), with a link to switch.
snippets.code:
<script>
(function () {
    try { if (sessionStorage.getItem('wpideLangBanner')) { return; } } catch (e) {}
    var pageLang = (document.documentElement.lang || '').toLowerCase().split('-')[0];
    var wanted = (navigator.languages || [navigator.language || '']).map(function (l) { return l.toLowerCase(); });
    var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="alternate"][hreflang]'));
    if (!pageLang || !links.length || wanted[0].split('-')[0] === pageLang) { return; }
    var match = null;
    wanted.some(function (w) {
        match = links.filter(function (l) { var h = l.hreflang.toLowerCase(); return h === w || h.split('-')[0] === w.split('-')[0]; })[0];
        return !!match;
    });
    if (!match || match.hreflang.toLowerCase().split('-')[0] === pageLang) { return; }
    var name = match.hreflang;
    try { name = new Intl.DisplayNames([match.hreflang], { type: 'language' }).of(match.hreflang) || name; } catch (e) {}
    var bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.setAttribute('role', 'region');
    bar.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Language');
    bar.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;max-width:480px;margin:0 auto;padding:12px 44px 12px 16px;background:#1d2327;color:#fff;border-radius:8px;z-index:99999;font:14px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.25)';
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = match.href;
    a.lang = match.hreflang;
    a.textContent = name + ' →';
    a.style.color = 'inherit';
    a.style.fontWeight = '600';
    var close = document.createElement('button');
    close.type = 'button';
    close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close');
    close.textContent = '×';
    close.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;background:none;border:0;color:inherit;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer';
    close.addEventListener('click', function () {
        bar.remove();
        try { sessionStorage.setItem('wpideLangBanner', '1'); } catch (e) {}
    });
    bar.appendChild(a);
    bar.appendChild(close);
    document.body.appendChild(bar);
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Works with WPML, Polylang or manual hreflang tags. Dismissal is remembered for the browser session; nothing redirects automatically.

snippets.title: Upcoming Events List Shortcode (The Events Calendar)
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_upcoming_events] shortcode that lists the next events from The Events Calendar with date, time and venue, for sidebars, landing pages and footers.
snippets.notes: Attributes: number (default 5), category (an event category slug) and featured="1". Results are cached for 15 minutes and cleared when an event is saved.

snippets.title: Countdown to the Next Event (The Events Calendar)
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_next_event_countdown] shortcode that shows the next upcoming event with a live days-hours-minutes countdown to its start.
snippets.notes: Add category="slug" to count down to the next event in one category. The countdown updates once a minute and needs no external library.

snippets.title: Hide Past Events From Site Search
snippets.description: Removes events that have already ended from your site's search results, while keeping posts, pages and upcoming events, when The Events Calendar is active.
snippets.notes: Past events stay reachable through the calendar's own past-events view.

snippets.title: Rename "Events" in The Events Calendar
snippets.description: Changes the word "Event/Events" used across The Events Calendar's views and admin into your own term, such as Show/Shows, Class/Classes or Session/Sessions.
snippets.notes: Only the labels change; the URL slug is set in Events > Settings > General.

snippets.title: Let Search Engines Index Empty Event Calendar Views
snippets.description: Stops The Events Calendar from adding a noindex tag to calendar pages that currently have no events, useful for seasonal calendars that should stay in search results.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'tribe_events_add_no_index_meta', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Single events and populated views are not affected.

snippets.title: Redirect Long-Past Events to the Calendar
snippets.description: Sends visitors (and search engines) from single events that ended more than a set number of days ago to the main events page with a 301 redirect, keeping your calendar fresh.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_days. Logged-in editors can still view old events.

snippets.title: Add Online and Status Details to Event Schema
snippets.description: Enriches The Events Calendar's JSON-LD with eventStatus and eventAttendanceMode, marking events that have an event website but no venue as online events, as Google recommends.
snippets.notes: Add a custom field named event_status with the value cancelled, postponed or rescheduled to mark changed events.

snippets.title: Venue Column in the Events Admin List
snippets.description: Adds a Venue column to Events in the dashboard, so you can see where each event takes place without opening it.
snippets.notes: Venue names are loaded in one query for the whole page.

snippets.title: Dashboard Widget: Events in the Next Two Weeks
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget listing the events coming up in the next 14 days with dates and quick edit links, so the team always knows what is on.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_days to look further ahead.

snippets.title: Email Alert for Events Awaiting Review
snippets.description: Emails your events editor whenever an event is submitted for review (for example through Community Events or by a contributor), with a direct link to approve it.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_editor_email; it defaults to the site admin email.

snippets.title: Show Event Dates in Search Results
snippets.description: Adds the event's date (and venue when there is one) in front of its excerpt in search results, so visitors can tell upcoming events from old ones before clicking.
snippets.notes: Only affects events; other results keep their usual excerpt.

snippets.title: Keep Past Events Out of the XML Sitemap
snippets.description: Leaves events that have already ended out of WordPress's built-in sitemap (wp-sitemap.xml), so search engines spend their time on upcoming events.
snippets.notes: Only affects the core WordPress sitemap; SEO plugins with their own sitemaps have separate settings.

snippets.title: Fundraising Totals Shortcode (GiveWP)
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_give_totals] shortcode that shows the total raised and number of donations across all your GiveWP forms (or selected ones), for headers, impact pages and annual reports.
snippets.notes: Attributes: show="amount|count", forms="12,34" to limit to certain forms. Totals are cached for an hour and refresh after every completed donation.

snippets.title: Email Alert for Large Donations (GiveWP)
snippets.description: Emails your fundraising team as soon as a donation at or above a set amount is completed, so major donors can be thanked personally the same day.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_threshold in your site currency and $wpide_notify_to.

snippets.title: Reassurance Message Above GiveWP Forms
snippets.description: Shows a short trust message with a padlock icon above every GiveWP donation form, for example about secure payments and where the money goes.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_message. Works with the legacy and multi-step form templates that run GiveWP's form hooks.

snippets.title: Block Disposable Emails on GiveWP Donations
snippets.description: Rejects donations made with throwaway email addresses (such as mailinator or 10minutemail), cutting down on card-testing fraud through your donation forms.
snippets.notes: Add more domains to $wpide_blocked as you spot them.

snippets.title: "In Honor Of" Field for GiveWP Donations
snippets.description: Adds an optional "Donate in honor or memory of" field to GiveWP forms, saves it with the donation, shows it on the donation details screen and offers an {honoree} email tag.
snippets.notes: Use {honoree} in GiveWP email templates. Works with the legacy and multi-step form templates; forms made with GiveWP 3's visual builder have their own custom field blocks.

snippets.title: "What Happens Next" Box on GiveWP Receipts
snippets.description: Adds a friendly box after the GiveWP donation receipt with next steps, such as following you on social media or sharing the campaign, to keep donors engaged.
snippets.notes: Edit the HTML in $wpide_html; basic tags and links are allowed.

snippets.title: Affiliate Earnings Summary Shortcode (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_affiliate_stats] shortcode that shows the logged-in affiliate their unpaid and paid earnings, referral count, visits and personal referral link on any page.
snippets.notes: Visitors who are not active affiliates see nothing; place it on a members page or next to the Affiliate Area.

snippets.title: Top Affiliates Leaderboard (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_affiliate_leaderboard] shortcode that ranks your active affiliates by earnings, showing first names only for privacy, to spark some friendly competition.
snippets.notes: Use number="10" to set how many affiliates to show. Cached for six hours. Earnings amounts are hidden unless you add amounts="1".

snippets.title: Higher Commission Rate for a User Role (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Gives affiliates with a specific user role, such as "partner" or "wholesale", a different commission rate from the global AffiliateWP rate, unless they have a custom rate set on their profile.
snippets.notes: The rate uses the affiliate's rate type (percentage or flat). Affiliates with their own rate in AffiliateWP keep it.

snippets.title: Cap the Commission Per Referral (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Limits how much commission any single referral can earn, so a very large order does not produce an outsized payout.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_max_commission in your store currency. Referrals already recorded are not changed.

snippets.title: "Referred By" Welcome Banner (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Greets visitors who arrive through an affiliate link with a small banner naming the person who referred them, which builds trust and lifts conversions.
snippets.notes: Shows the affiliate's first name only. Change $wpide_text; %s is replaced with the name.

snippets.title: Dashboard Widget: Pending Referrals (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget for administrators with the number and value of referrals waiting for review, plus pending affiliate applications, linking to each AffiliateWP screen.
snippets.notes: Counts are cached for ten minutes.

snippets.title: Affiliate Area Link in the Admin Bar (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Adds an "Affiliate Area" link to the toolbar for logged-in affiliates, showing their unpaid earnings, so they can reach their dashboard from anywhere on the site.
snippets.notes: Uses the Affiliate Area page set in AffiliateWP > Settings.

snippets.title: Customize Jetpack Related Posts
snippets.description: Changes the heading, number of posts and thumbnail visibility of Jetpack's Related Posts, and limits suggestions to posts from the last two years.
snippets.notes: Edit the values at the top. Jetpack can show at most 6 related posts.

snippets.title: Exclude Posts From Jetpack Related Posts
snippets.description: Keeps chosen posts, and posts in chosen categories, out of Jetpack's Related Posts suggestions, such as announcements, legal pages or outdated content.
snippets.notes: List post IDs in $wpide_exclude_ids and category slugs in $wpide_exclude_cats. Category exclusion runs in Jetpack's search filter.

snippets.title: Move Jetpack Sharing Buttons Above the Content
snippets.description: Shows Jetpack's sharing buttons at the top of posts instead of the bottom, and keeps the Like button at the bottom where readers expect it.
snippets.notes: Also removes the buttons from excerpts so they do not repeat on archive pages.

snippets.title: Hide Jetpack Sharing Buttons on Selected Content
snippets.description: Turns off Jetpack's sharing buttons on chosen post types, categories or individual posts, such as landing pages, legal pages or members-only content.
snippets.notes: Fill in any of the three lists; leave a list empty to skip that rule.

snippets.title: Hide Jetpack Upsells and Promotions
snippets.description: Removes Jetpack's in-dashboard upgrade prompts, "just in time" messages and Blaze promotion links, giving clients a cleaner admin.
snippets.notes: Jetpack features you use keep working; only the promotional prompts go away.

snippets.title: Default Social Image for Jetpack Open Graph Tags
snippets.description: Sets the image Jetpack uses in Open Graph tags when a post has no featured image or images in its content, so shared links always show your brand instead of a blank square.
snippets.notes: Use a full image URL; 1200×630 pixels works best on most networks.

snippets.title: Respect Do Not Track in Jetpack Stats
snippets.description: Tells Jetpack Stats not to count visitors whose browser sends the Do Not Track signal, a simple privacy step for sites that want lighter tracking.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'jetpack_honor_dnt_header_for_stats', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Visitor numbers in Jetpack Stats may drop slightly afterwards.

snippets.title: Hide the Jetpack Menu From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes the Jetpack menu (and its dashboard widget) for authors, editors and other roles that cannot manage options, so they only see what they need.
snippets.notes: Administrators still see everything.

snippets.title: Keep Some Images Off Jetpack's Image CDN
snippets.description: Serves images from your own server instead of Jetpack's Site Accelerator CDN when their URL contains a pattern you choose, for example SVGs, signed URLs or a specific folder.
snippets.notes: Patterns are matched against the image URL as plain text.

snippets.title: Jetpack Offline Mode on Staging Sites
snippets.description: Switches Jetpack to offline (development) mode automatically on staging, dev and local hosts, so test copies never connect to WordPress.com or clash with the live site.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_markers to match your staging hostnames; .local and .test hosts are always included.

snippets.title: Clear Related Pages From WP Rocket's Cache on Update
snippets.description: When a post is updated, also clears the WP Rocket cache for the homepage, the blog page, its category and tag archives and the author page, so lists never show stale titles or excerpts.
snippets.notes: Does nothing unless WP Rocket is active. Add extra URLs to $wpide_extra_urls, such as a landing page that lists posts.

snippets.title: Never Cache Certain URLs in WP Rocket
snippets.description: Adds URL patterns that WP Rocket must never cache, such as account, quote or booking pages with personal content, without touching the plugin's settings screen.
snippets.notes: Patterns are regular expressions matched against the path, e.g. /my-account/(.*). Save WP Rocket's settings once after activating so its config file is regenerated.

snippets.title: Cache Pages With Certain Query Strings in WP Rocket
snippets.description: Tells WP Rocket to keep separate cached copies for URLs with the query parameters you list, such as a currency or filter parameter, instead of skipping the cache for them.
snippets.notes: Only add parameters that change page content. Re-save WP Rocket's settings after activating.

snippets.title: Keep Critical Scripts Out of WP Rocket's Delay JavaScript
snippets.description: Excludes scripts you list, such as a consent banner, chat widget or analytics loader, from WP Rocket's "Delay JavaScript execution" so they run right away.
snippets.notes: Use part of the script's file name or a keyword from an inline script. Clear WP Rocket's cache after activating.

snippets.title: Turn Off WP Rocket Lazy Load on Chosen Pages
snippets.description: Disables WP Rocket's image and iframe lazy loading on the pages you list, such as a gallery, slider page or landing page where above-the-fold images must load instantly.
snippets.notes: List page IDs or slugs in $wpide_pages. Clear WP Rocket's cache for those pages afterwards.

snippets.title: Let Editors Clear the WP Rocket Cache
snippets.description: Adds a "Clear page cache" item to the toolbar for editors, who normally cannot purge WP Rocket, protected with a nonce and limited to clearing the page they are viewing.
snippets.notes: Administrators already have WP Rocket's own menu. Change edit_others_posts to another capability if needed.

snippets.title: Clear WP Rocket When Site Settings Change
snippets.description: Clears WP Rocket's whole-site cache when you save the Customizer, change menus or edit widgets, so header, footer and sidebar changes show up immediately.
snippets.notes: WP Rocket already clears for theme switches; this covers the everyday design edits.

snippets.title: Purge Related Pages From LiteSpeed Cache on Update
snippets.description: When a post changes, also purges the homepage and the post's category and tag archives from LiteSpeed Cache, so lists and teasers are never out of date.
snippets.notes: Uses LiteSpeed Cache's documented purge actions and does nothing if the plugin is inactive.

snippets.title: Exclude Pages From LiteSpeed Cache by Rule
snippets.description: Marks chosen pages as not cacheable in LiteSpeed Cache from code, for example pages with a personalised widget, a query parameter or for visitors with a specific cookie.
snippets.notes: Edit the three lists; any match marks the page as non-cacheable for that request.

snippets.title: Purge LiteSpeed Cache After Design Changes
snippets.description: Purges the whole LiteSpeed Cache when the Customizer, menus or widgets are saved, so header, footer and sidebar changes appear on every page right away.

snippets.title: Use LiteSpeed Private Cache on Personalised Pages
snippets.description: Serves pages you choose (such as a dashboard or account page) from LiteSpeed's private per-visitor cache instead of the public one, so personal content is cached safely.
snippets.notes: List the page slugs or IDs in $wpide_pages.

snippets.title: Flush Related Pages From W3 Total Cache on Update
snippets.description: When a post changes, also flushes the homepage and the post's category and tag archives from W3 Total Cache's page cache, so lists update with the post.
snippets.notes: Uses W3 Total Cache's public flush functions and does nothing if it is not active.

snippets.title: Skip W3 Total Cache on Chosen Pages
snippets.description: Tells W3 Total Cache not to page-cache, minify or serve from CDN the pages you choose, using its documented DONOTCACHEPAGE-style constants.
snippets.notes: List page slugs or IDs; set $wpide_skip_minify to false to keep minification on those pages.

snippets.title: Flush W3 Total Cache After Design Changes
snippets.description: Flushes all W3 Total Cache caches when the Customizer, menus or widgets are saved, so site-wide changes are visible straight away.

snippets.title: One "Clear Cache" Button for Any Caching Plugin
snippets.description: Adds a single "Clear all caches" toolbar button for administrators that clears whichever cache plugin is active (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, WP Fastest Cache or SG Optimizer) plus the object cache.
snippets.notes: Handy on agency sites where different clients use different cache plugins. Only administrators see it.

snippets.title: Let Editors Manage Redirects in Redirection
snippets.description: Gives editors access to the Redirection plugin's screens so they can add and fix redirects themselves, without making them administrators.
snippets.notes: Change edit_others_posts to the capability of the role you want to allow. Does nothing if Redirection is not active.

snippets.title: Anonymize IP Addresses in Redirection Logs
