snippets.description: Masks the last part of visitor IP addresses before the Redirection plugin stores them in its redirect and 404 logs, keeping the logs useful while respecting privacy laws.
snippets.notes: IPv4 keeps the first three parts (1.2.3.0); IPv6 keeps the first three groups.

snippets.title: Ignore Tracking Parameters When Matching Redirects
snippets.description: Strips utm_*, fbclid, gclid and similar tracking parameters from the URL the Redirection plugin matches against, so a redirect still fires when a link arrives from a campaign.
snippets.notes: Add parameters to $wpide_params. The visitor's analytics are unaffected because the original URL is only changed for matching.

snippets.title: Keep Bots Out of Redirection's 404 Log
snippets.description: Stops the Redirection plugin from logging 404s caused by crawlers and vulnerability scanners (wp-login probes, .env and .php file hunts), so the log shows only real broken links.
snippets.notes: Add your own patterns to $wpide_noise.

snippets.title: Send Wordfence Alerts to a Separate Address
snippets.description: Redirects Wordfence's security alert emails to a dedicated address (such as your agency's monitoring inbox) and adds a site tag to the subject, without changing the site admin email.
snippets.notes: Matches emails whose subject contains "Wordfence". Keep the address in Wordfence's own settings too if you want both to receive them.

snippets.title: Hide the Wordfence Dashboard Widget From Non-Admins
snippets.description: Removes Wordfence's activity report widget from the dashboard for editors and other roles, keeping their dashboard focused on content.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_everyone to true to hide it for administrators as well.

snippets.title: Exclude Logos and Featured Images From Lazy Loading
snippets.description: Adds the "no-lazyload" class (and matching skip attributes) to the site logo and the featured image of single posts, so Smush and other lazy-load plugins load them immediately and improve Largest Contentful Paint.
snippets.notes: Smush, WP Rocket and LiteSpeed all honour these markers; it also turns off native lazy loading for those images.

snippets.title: Hide the MonsterInsights Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Removes the MonsterInsights reports widget from the WordPress dashboard for everyone except administrators, or for all users.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_everyone to true to remove it for administrators too.

snippets.title: Tag Every Mailchimp Subscriber From Your Site
snippets.description: Adds tags such as "website" and the visitor's language to every subscriber Mailchimp for WordPress sends to Mailchimp, from forms and integrations alike, so you can segment by source.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_tags. The language tag uses the site or WPML/Polylang language.

snippets.title: Save the Signup Page in a Mailchimp Merge Field
snippets.description: Stores the URL of the page where someone subscribed in a Mailchimp merge field, so you can see which articles and landing pages grow your list.
snippets.notes: Create a text merge field in your Mailchimp audience first and put its tag (e.g. SIGNUPURL) in $wpide_field.

snippets.title: Block Disposable Emails in Mailchimp for WP Forms
snippets.description: Refuses newsletter signups from throwaway email domains in Mailchimp for WordPress forms, keeping your audience clean and your Mailchimp bill lower.
snippets.notes: Add domains to $wpide_blocked. The error text can be changed in $wpide_message.

snippets.title: Email the Team About New Newsletter Signups
snippets.description: Sends a short email to your team each time someone subscribes through a Mailchimp for WordPress form, including the form name and page, for low-volume lists where every lead counts.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_notify_to. Not recommended for lists with dozens of signups per day.

snippets.title: Keep Akismet Spam Longer Before Deleting
snippets.description: Changes how long Akismet keeps caught spam before deleting it (15 days by default), giving you more time to rescue legitimate comments marked as spam.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_days; use a lower number to clean up sooner on very busy sites.

snippets.title: Show a Custom Akismet Privacy Notice Under Comments
snippets.description: Turns on the Akismet privacy notice below the comment form and replaces it with your own wording and link to your privacy policy, which many privacy laws expect.
snippets.notes: Uses your Privacy Policy page from Settings > Privacy when one is set.

snippets.title: Skip Akismet Checks for Trusted Logged-In Users
snippets.description: Stops sending comments from logged-in users who can edit posts (authors, editors, administrators) to Akismet, saving API calls and keeping staff replies out of the spam queue.
snippets.notes: Change edit_posts to moderate_comments to trust only moderators and administrators.

snippets.title: "Spam Blocked by Akismet" Counter Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_akismet_count] shortcode that shows how many spam comments Akismet has blocked on your site, a small trust signal for footers and contact pages.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_akismet_count text="%s spam comments blocked"]; %s becomes the number.

snippets.title: Check Your Own Form Submissions With Akismet
snippets.description: Adds a wpide_akismet_is_spam() helper that sends a name, email and message from any custom form to Akismet and tells you whether it looks like spam, so your hand-built forms get the same protection as comments.
snippets.notes: Call wpide_akismet_is_spam( array( 'name' => ..., 'email' => ..., 'message' => ... ) ) in your form handler; it returns false when Akismet is missing or unreachable, so submissions are never lost.

snippets.title: Hide Akismet's Approved-Comments Count in the Comments List
snippets.description: Removes the "X approved" badge Akismet shows next to each commenter in Comments, which some moderators find distracting or which reveals too much about returning visitors.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'akismet_show_user_comments_approved', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Colour-Code Event Categories in Calendar Views
snippets.description: Adds a coloured left border to events in The Events Calendar's list, day and month views based on their event category, so visitors can scan the calendar by type.
snippets.notes: Map category slugs to colours in $wpide_colors. Uses the category classes TEC adds to each event.

snippets.title: Today's Donations in the Admin Bar (GiveWP)
snippets.description: Shows administrators the number and total of donations received today in the toolbar, linking to GiveWP's donations list, for a quick pulse during campaigns.
snippets.notes: Cached for five minutes; counts completed donations only.

snippets.title: Donor Comment Length Limit for GiveWP
snippets.description: Limits the optional donor comment on GiveWP forms to a sensible length and strips links from it, so donor walls do not fill up with spam.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_max_chars. Only affects forms with the donor comment field enabled.

snippets.title: Hide GiveWP Menus From Non-Fundraising Staff
snippets.description: Removes the Donations menu from the dashboard for users who cannot view GiveWP reports, keeping editors' menus short on charity sites.
snippets.notes: Give your fundraising team the view_give_reports capability (GiveWP's Worker and Manager roles have it).

snippets.title: Copyable Referral Link for Any Page (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_affiliate_link] shortcode that shows logged-in affiliates their referral link for the current page (or a page you choose) with a copy button.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_affiliate_link url="https://example.com/product/"] to build a link to another page. Non-affiliates see nothing.

snippets.title: Notify Affiliates When a Referral Is Paid (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Emails an affiliate a short thank-you when one of their referrals is marked as paid, with the amount, which keeps partners motivated between payouts.
snippets.notes: Sent once per referral when its status changes to paid.

snippets.title: Show "Become an Affiliate" or "Affiliate Area" Menu Link (AffiliateWP)
snippets.description: Adds a menu item to a theme menu location that reads "Affiliate Area" for affiliates and "Become an affiliate" for everyone else, both pointing to your AffiliateWP page.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_location to your theme's menu location.

snippets.title: Move Jetpack Related Posts Into a Shortcode
snippets.description: Removes Jetpack's Related Posts from the bottom of posts and lets you place them anywhere with a [wpide_related] shortcode or in your theme.
snippets.notes: Jetpack also offers its own Related Posts block; this is for classic themes and page builders.

snippets.title: Tune Jetpack Infinite Scroll
snippets.description: Sets how many posts Jetpack's Infinite Scroll loads at a time and switches it to a "Load more" button, which is friendlier to footers and keyboard users than endless scrolling.
snippets.notes: Your theme must support Infinite Scroll. Set $wpide_type to scroll to keep automatic loading.

snippets.title: Send the Visitor's Language to Mailchimp (MC4WP)
snippets.description: Sets Mailchimp's built-in subscriber language for every signup from your site, using the current WordPress, WPML or Polylang language, so Mailchimp can send the right translation of your campaigns.
snippets.notes: Mailchimp expects codes like en, fr, de or pt_PT; regional variants are mapped to the two-letter code.

snippets.title: Permanently Switch Off Chosen Jetpack Modules
snippets.description: Removes Jetpack modules you never want used, such as Likes, Comments or Stats, from the list of available modules, so nobody can turn them on by accident.
snippets.notes: Use Jetpack module slugs (likes, comments, stats, sharedaddy, related-posts, infinite-scroll, photon...). Already active modules stop loading.

snippets.title: Replace the Jetpack Infinite Scroll Footer Credit
snippets.description: Replaces the "Proudly powered by WordPress" credit that Jetpack's Infinite Scroll shows in its sticky footer with your own text, or removes it.
snippets.notes: Leave $wpide_credit empty to show nothing. Basic links are allowed.

snippets.title: Keep Selectors in WP Rocket's "Remove Unused CSS"
snippets.description: Adds CSS selectors and stylesheet URLs that WP Rocket's Remove Unused CSS must always keep, such as classes added by JavaScript for menus, sliders and pop-ups, so those elements do not lose their styling.
snippets.notes: Use selectors (.menu-open, #popup) or partial stylesheet paths (/plugins/slider/). Clear the Used CSS in WP Rocket afterwards.

snippets.title: Stop WP Rocket Preloading Certain URLs
snippets.description: Keeps WP Rocket's cache preload from crawling URLs you list, such as filtered archive pages, calendars or tag pages, saving server resources on large sites.
snippets.notes: Patterns are regular expressions matched against the URL, e.g. /tag/(.*) or (.*)?filter_(.*).

snippets.title: Skip Page Caching for Visitors With a Cookie
snippets.description: Makes page-cache plugins (WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, LiteSpeed Cache and others that respect DONOTCACHEPAGE) skip caching for visitors who carry a cookie you choose, such as a personalisation, A/B test or affiliate cookie.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_cookie. WP Rocket also gets the cookie added to its "never cache" list, so cached copies are not served to those visitors; re-save its settings once.

snippets.title: Stop Elementor Icon Fonts Loading for Visitors
snippets.description: Removes the Font Awesome and Elementor icon font stylesheets from the front end for visitors, which saves several requests on sites that use SVG icons or no icons at all.
snippets.notes: Only use this if your pages show no icon-font icons; turn on Elementor's "Inline Font Icons" feature first so icons render as SVG.

snippets.title: Remove the Elementor Overview Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Removes the "Elementor Overview" box with news and recent edits from the WordPress dashboard, so the dashboard stays focused on your own widgets.

snippets.title: "Edit with Elementor" in the Admin Bar for Administrators Only
snippets.description: Hides the "Edit with Elementor" menu in the admin bar from everyone except administrators, so editors and shop managers are not tempted to change designed layouts.
snippets.notes: Change manage_options to another capability to keep the link for more roles.

snippets.title: Hide "Edit with Elementor" Links From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes the "Edit with Elementor" links under post titles in admin lists and the "Edit with Elementor" button in the editor for users who are not administrators. They can still edit text in the regular editor.
snippets.notes: Pair it with "Block Roles From the Elementor Editor" to stop access completely, not just hide the link.

snippets.title: Block Roles From the Elementor Editor
snippets.description: Stops the roles you list from opening the Elementor editor, using Elementor's own role exclusion list, while they keep normal access to the WordPress editor.
snippets.notes: Role slugs, not names: author, contributor, editor, shop_manager. Administrators can never be excluded.

snippets.title: Use Elementor Only on Pages
snippets.description: Limits Elementor to the post types you choose (pages by default), so the "Edit with Elementor" button disappears from blog posts and other content types.
snippets.notes: Posts already built with Elementor keep their design; add post to the list if you still need to edit them.

snippets.title: Opt Out of Elementor Usage Data Sharing
snippets.description: Keeps Elementor's usage data sharing turned off and marks its "Become a super contributor" notice as answered, so it no longer asks on new installs.

snippets.title: Hide Elementor Pro Upsells in wp-admin and the Editor
snippets.description: Hides the "Upgrade" and "Get Pro" menu links in wp-admin and the locked Pro widgets in the Elementor panel, for a cleaner interface on sites that use the free version.
snippets.notes: This only hides the links with CSS; nothing in Elementor is changed.

snippets.title: Custom Elementor Widget: Notice Box
snippets.description: Adds a simple "Notice Box" widget to Elementor with a title, text and four styles (info, success, warning, error), in its own "Site Widgets" panel category.
snippets.notes: Use this as a starting point for your own widgets: add controls in register_controls() and print them in render().

snippets.title: Remove Unused Widgets From the Elementor Panel
snippets.description: Takes widgets you never use, such as the old WordPress sidebar widgets, out of the Elementor panel so editors find the right ones faster.
snippets.notes: Widget names appear in the panel's HTML as data-widget_type, for example "wp-widget-calendar". Existing uses of a removed widget stop rendering.

snippets.title: Elementor Dynamic Tag: Current Year
snippets.description: Adds a "Current Year" dynamic tag to Elementor Pro so copyright lines and headings update themselves every January.
snippets.notes: Dynamic tags need Elementor Pro. Find the tag under "Site Details" in the dynamic tags list.

snippets.title: Elementor Dynamic Tag: Visitor's First Name
snippets.description: Adds a dynamic tag that shows the logged-in visitor's first name (or a fallback word like "there"), for greetings such as "Welcome back, Anna".
snippets.notes: Needs Elementor Pro. Pages using it should not be served from a full-page cache to logged-in users.

snippets.title: Elementor Dynamic Tag: URL Parameter
snippets.description: Adds a dynamic tag that prints a value from the page address, such as ?city=Paris, so landing pages can echo campaign keywords in headings.
snippets.notes: Needs Elementor Pro. The value is limited to 60 plain-text characters and escaped before it is shown.

snippets.title: Elementor Posts Query: Exclude the Current Post
snippets.description: Adds a custom query ID "wpide_exclude_current" for Elementor Pro's Posts and Loop Grid widgets that leaves out the post being viewed, ideal for "More articles" sections.
snippets.notes: In the widget's Query section, type wpide_exclude_current in the Query ID field.

snippets.title: Elementor Posts Query: Related Posts From the Same Category
snippets.description: Adds a custom query ID "wpide_related" that shows posts sharing a category with the current post, newest first, without the current post itself.
snippets.notes: Type wpide_related in the Query ID field of a Posts or Loop Grid widget in your single post template.

snippets.title: Elementor Posts Query: Upcoming Items by a Date Field
snippets.description: Adds a custom query ID "wpide_upcoming" that shows only items whose date field (for example an event date) is today or later, soonest first.
snippets.notes: The field must store dates as Ymd (20261231), the ACF date picker default. Change the meta key to your field name.

snippets.title: Elementor Posts Query: Most Discussed Posts
snippets.description: Adds a custom query ID "wpide_popular" that orders posts by number of comments, to build a "Most discussed" block with Elementor Pro.
snippets.notes: Type wpide_popular in the Query ID field. Set the number of posts in the widget as usual.

snippets.title: Elementor Posts Query: More Posts by the Same Author
snippets.description: Adds a custom query ID "wpide_same_author" that lists other posts by the author of the post being viewed, for "More from this writer" sections.
snippets.notes: Type wpide_same_author in the Query ID field of a widget in your single post template.

snippets.title: Elementor Forms: Require a Business Email Address
snippets.description: Rejects Elementor Pro form submissions that use free email providers such as Gmail or Yahoo, with a clear message under the field, for B2B lead forms.
snippets.notes: Applies to every Email field in every Elementor form. Edit the domain list to suit your audience.

snippets.title: Elementor Forms: Reject Messages Containing Links
snippets.description: Refuses Elementor Pro form submissions whose text areas contain web links, which stops most contact-form spam without a captcha.
snippets.notes: Raise $wpide_el_max_links to 1 if customers often need to paste a single link.

snippets.title: Elementor Forms: Send Submissions to the dataLayer
snippets.description: Pushes an "elementor_form_submit" event with the form name to the Google Tag Manager dataLayer each time an Elementor Pro form is sent successfully, for conversion tracking.
snippets.code:
<script>
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    if (!window.jQuery) { return; }
    window.jQuery(document).on('submit_success', function (event) {
        var form = event.target;
        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
        window.dataLayer.push({
            event: 'elementor_form_submit',
            form_name: form && form.getAttribute ? (form.getAttribute('name') || '') : '',
            form_id: form && form.querySelector ? ((form.querySelector('input[name="form_id"]') || {}).value || '') : ''
        });
    });
});
</script>
snippets.notes: In Tag Manager, create a Custom Event trigger named elementor_form_submit; the form_name variable holds the form's name.

snippets.title: Close an Elementor Popup After Its Form Is Sent
snippets.description: Closes the Elementor Pro popup a few seconds after the form inside it is submitted successfully, so visitors see the thank-you message and then return to the page.
snippets.code:
<script>
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var delay = 2500; // Time to show the success message first.
    if (!window.jQuery) { return; }
    window.jQuery(document).on('submit_success', function (event) {
        var form = event.target;
        var modal = form && form.closest ? form.closest('.elementor-popup-modal') : null;
        if (!modal) { return; }
        setTimeout(function () {
            var close = modal.querySelector('.dialog-close-button');
            if (close) { close.click(); }
        }, delay);
    });
});
</script>
snippets.notes: Change the delay (in milliseconds) at the top of the script.

snippets.title: Open an Elementor Popup From a Link or URL Hash
snippets.description: Opens an Elementor Pro popup when the address ends in #popup-123 (123 being the popup ID), so you can link to a popup from emails, menus or other pages.
snippets.code:
<script>
(function () {
    function openFromHash() {
        var match = /^#popup-(\d+)$/.exec(window.location.hash);
        var pro = window.elementorProFrontend;
        if (!match || !pro || !pro.modules || !pro.modules.popup) { return; }
        pro.modules.popup.showPopup({ id: parseInt(match[1], 10) });
    }
    window.addEventListener('load', openFromHash);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', openFromHash);
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Use the popup's ID from Templates > Popups. Set the popup's display conditions to include the pages where links point.

snippets.title: Elementor Template Shortcode for the Free Version
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_elementor_template id="123"] shortcode that shows any saved Elementor template inside posts, widgets or other builders, without Elementor Pro.
snippets.notes: Find template IDs under Templates > Saved Templates. Only published templates are shown.

snippets.title: Keep Elementor Templates Out of Search Engines
snippets.description: Sends visitors who open a saved Elementor template's own address back to the homepage and marks those pages noindex, so loose template URLs never show up in Google.
snippets.notes: Logged-in editors and Elementor previews are not redirected.

snippets.title: "Elementor" Column in the Pages List
snippets.description: Adds a column to the Pages screen that shows which pages are built with Elementor, so you know before you click whether to open Elementor or the block editor.
snippets.notes: Add post to $wpide_el_column_types to show the column on the Posts screen too.

snippets.title: Show Elementor Sections Only to Logged-In or Logged-Out Visitors
snippets.description: Hides any Elementor container, section or widget with the CSS class "wpide-logged-in" from guests, and anything with "wpide-logged-out" from members, without Elementor Pro.
snippets.notes: Add the class under Advanced > CSS Classes. Elements stay visible in the editor so you can still edit them.

snippets.title: Register Elementor Pro Theme Locations
snippets.description: Registers Elementor Pro's header, footer, single and archive locations for themes that do not do it themselves, so Theme Builder templates can replace those areas.
snippets.notes: Needs Elementor Pro. Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress and most popular themes already register these.

snippets.title: Add Your Own Font Names to Elementor's Font List
snippets.description: Adds self-hosted or theme-loaded fonts to the typography font dropdown in Elementor, so editors can pick them without typing names.
snippets.notes: This only adds the names; load the font files yourself (theme, Elementor Pro custom fonts or @font-face).

snippets.title: Remove Google Fonts From Elementor's Font Picker
snippets.description: Takes the Google Fonts and Early Access groups out of Elementor's font dropdown, so designers stick to system and self-hosted fonts.
snippets.notes: Fonts already chosen in existing designs keep loading; pair it with "Stop Elementor From Loading Google Fonts".

snippets.title: Hide Elementor Templates From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes the Templates menu Elementor adds to wp-admin for everyone except administrators and blocks direct access to the list, protecting headers, footers and popups.

snippets.title: Elementor Theme Builder Condition: Logged-In Visitors
snippets.description: Adds a "Logged-in visitors" display condition under Entire Site in Elementor Pro's Theme Builder, so you can show a different header or footer to members.
snippets.notes: Needs Elementor Pro. Re-save the template's conditions after enabling this snippet.

snippets.title: Skip Block Editor Styles on Elementor Pages
snippets.description: Stops the block library stylesheet loading on pages built entirely with Elementor, since those pages contain no blocks, which removes one render-blocking file.
snippets.notes: Leave it off if your Elementor header or footer templates contain WordPress blocks.

snippets.title: Enable the Divi Builder for Custom Post Types
snippets.description: Makes the Divi Builder available on the custom post types you list, such as portfolios, case studies or courses, even when they are not ticked in Divi's settings.
snippets.notes: Use post type slugs. The post type must support the editor.

snippets.title: Stop Divi From Loading Google Fonts
snippets.description: Turns off Divi's Google Fonts option and removes the default Open Sans stylesheet, so no font requests go to Google from your Divi site.
snippets.notes: Text falls back to your theme's other fonts; upload your own fonts in Divi if you need a specific typeface.

snippets.title: Rename Divi "Projects" to "Portfolio"
snippets.description: Renames Divi's Projects post type to Portfolio everywhere in wp-admin and changes its address from /project/ to /portfolio/.
snippets.notes: Visit Settings > Permalinks and click Save once after enabling this so the new addresses work.

snippets.title: Hide Divi's Projects Post Type
snippets.description: Hides the Projects post type that Divi adds, from the admin menu, menus, search and the front end, for sites that never use it.
snippets.notes: Existing projects are kept in the database and come back if you remove this snippet.

snippets.title: Site-Wide Message Above Divi Page Content
snippets.description: Shows a short message, such as holiday hours or a shipping notice, at the top of every page's main content area in the Divi theme.
snippets.notes: Leave the message empty to switch it off without deactivating the snippet.

snippets.title: Full-Width Blog Posts in Divi
snippets.description: Removes the sidebar from single blog posts in the Divi theme and gives the content the full width, without editing each post's layout setting.
snippets.notes: Change post to another post type slug, or add more, in $wpide_divi_full_width_types.

snippets.title: Collapsible Submenus in the Divi Mobile Menu
snippets.description: Folds submenus in Divi's mobile menu and adds a plus/minus button to open each one, so long menus no longer fill several screens on phones.
snippets.code:
<style>
.et_mobile_menu .menu-item-has-children{position:relative;}
.et_mobile_menu .menu-item-has-children > .sub-menu{display:none!important;padding-left:0;}
.et_mobile_menu .menu-item-has-children.wpide-open > .sub-menu{display:block!important;}
.et_mobile_menu .menu-item-has-children > a{padding-right:56px;}
.wpide-divi-subtoggle{position:absolute;top:4px;right:4px;width:40px;height:40px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.05);font-size:20px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;color:inherit;}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    function setup(menu) {
        if (menu.getAttribute('data-wpide-toggles')) { return; }
        menu.setAttribute('data-wpide-toggles', '1');
        menu.querySelectorAll('.menu-item-has-children').forEach(function (item) {
            var button = document.createElement('button');
            button.type = 'button';
            button.className = 'wpide-divi-subtoggle';
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Show submenu');
            button.textContent = '+';
            button.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                var open = item.classList.toggle('wpide-open');
                button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
                button.textContent = open ? '−' : '+';
            });
            item.insertBefore(button, item.querySelector('.sub-menu'));
        });
    }
    function scan() { document.querySelectorAll('.et_mobile_menu').forEach(setup); }
    window.addEventListener('load', scan);
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.mobile_menu_bar, .mobile_nav')) { setTimeout(scan, 50); }
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Works with the default Divi header and the Divi Theme Builder menu module.

snippets.title: Open a Divi Toggle or Accordion From the URL
snippets.description: Opens the Divi toggle or accordion item whose CSS ID matches the address hash (for example #shipping) and scrolls to it, so you can link straight to an answer.
snippets.code:
<script>
(function () {
    function openTarget() {
        var id = decodeURIComponent(window.location.hash.slice(1));
        if (!id) { return; }
        var target = document.getElementById(id);
        var toggle = target && (target.classList.contains('et_pb_toggle') ? target : target.querySelector('.et_pb_toggle'));
        if (!toggle) { return; }
        if (toggle.classList.contains('et_pb_toggle_close')) {
            var title = toggle.querySelector('.et_pb_toggle_title');
            if (title) { title.click(); }
        }
        setTimeout(function () { toggle.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'smooth' }); }, 300);
    }
    window.addEventListener('load', openTarget);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', openTarget);
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Give the toggle or accordion item a CSS ID in its Advanced tab, then link to page-url#that-id.

snippets.title: Divi Accordions That Start Closed
snippets.description: Makes every Divi accordion load with all items closed instead of the first one open, and lets visitors close an open item again by clicking its title.
snippets.code:
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('.et_pb_accordion:not(.wpide-keep-open) .et_pb_toggle_open').forEach(function (item) {
        item.classList.remove('et_pb_toggle_open');
        item.classList.add('et_pb_toggle_close');
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var title = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.et_pb_accordion:not(.wpide-keep-open) .et_pb_toggle_open .et_pb_toggle_title') : null;
        if (!title) { return; }
        var item = title.closest('.et_pb_toggle');
        var content = item.querySelector('.et_pb_toggle_content');
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
        item.classList.remove('et_pb_toggle_open');
        item.classList.add('et_pb_toggle_close');
        if (content) { content.style.display = ''; }
    }, true);
});
</script>
snippets.notes: Add the class wpide-keep-open to an accordion module to keep Divi's default behavior for it.

snippets.title: Smaller Logo in the Divi Fixed Header
snippets.description: Shrinks the logo smoothly when Divi's header becomes fixed while scrolling, so the sticky header takes less room on screen.
snippets.notes: Change 60% to make the scrolled logo bigger or smaller. Applies to Divi's default header, not Theme Builder headers.

snippets.title: Keep Selected Roles Out of the Divi Visual Builder
snippets.description: Sends users without the capability you choose back to the normal page when they try to open the Divi Visual Builder, and hides the "Enable Visual Builder" admin bar link from them.
snippets.notes: Divi's Role Editor gives finer control; this is a quick way to lock layouts for everyone below the chosen capability.

snippets.title: Call Button in the Divi Header
snippets.description: Adds a tap-to-call phone button next to the menu in Divi's default header, which is especially handy for local businesses on mobile.
snippets.notes: Uses Divi's et_header_top hook, so it appears in the default header, not in Theme Builder headers.

snippets.title: Skip Block Editor Styles on Divi Builder Pages
snippets.description: Stops the block library stylesheet loading on pages built with the Divi Builder, which do not use blocks, so each of those pages loads one stylesheet less.
snippets.notes: Leave it off if you mix Divi layouts with WordPress blocks on the same page.

snippets.title: Enable Beaver Builder for Custom Post Types
snippets.description: Turns Beaver Builder on for the custom post types you list, in addition to the ones ticked in its settings.
snippets.notes: Use post type slugs; the post type must be public.

snippets.title: Stop Beaver Builder From Loading Google Fonts
snippets.description: Prevents Beaver Builder modules from requesting fonts from Google, for privacy (GDPR) and faster pages.
snippets.notes: Modules set to a Google font fall back to the next font in the stack; add your own fonts with "Add System Fonts to Beaver Builder".

snippets.title: Add Your Own Fonts to Beaver Builder
snippets.description: Adds self-hosted or theme fonts to Beaver Builder's font list, with their fallback stack and available weights, so editors can select them in any module.
snippets.notes: This adds the names to the list; load the font files yourself with @font-face or your theme.

snippets.title: Brand Colors in the Beaver Builder Color Picker
snippets.description: Adds your brand colors as presets in every Beaver Builder color picker, so editors pick exact colors instead of guessing hex codes.
snippets.notes: Colors are hex values without the # sign.

snippets.title: Hide Unused Beaver Builder Modules
snippets.description: Removes the modules you list from the Beaver Builder panel, so editors only see the building blocks your design system uses.
snippets.notes: Module slugs are the folder names in the plugin's modules directory, such as audio, countdown or sidebar. Layouts already using a hidden module stop showing it.

snippets.title: Turn Off Inline Text Editing in Beaver Builder
snippets.description: Disables click-to-type text editing on the page in Beaver Builder, so text is only changed in the settings panel and is not edited by accident while dragging.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'fl_inline_editing_enabled', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Keep Selected Roles Out of Beaver Builder
snippets.description: Sends users without the chosen capability back to the normal page if they try to open Beaver Builder, and hides its admin bar link from them.
snippets.notes: Beaver Builder Pro's user access settings offer finer control; this is a quick lock for one capability.

snippets.title: Show Beaver Builder Rows Only to Logged-In or Logged-Out Visitors
snippets.description: Hides any Beaver Builder row, column or module with the class "wpide-logged-in" from guests, and anything with "wpide-logged-out" from members.
snippets.notes: Add the class under Advanced > HTML Element > Class. Everything stays visible while the builder is open.

snippets.title: Beaver Builder Post Modules: Leave Out the Current Post
snippets.description: Removes the post being viewed from Beaver Builder Posts, Post Slider and Post Carousel modules, so "latest posts" blocks on articles never repeat the article itself.
snippets.notes: Applies to every Beaver Builder post module on single posts and pages.

snippets.title: Add CSS to Every Beaver Builder Layout
snippets.description: Appends your own CSS to the stylesheet Beaver Builder generates for each layout, so it is cached and loaded together with the layout instead of on every page.
snippets.notes: Clear the Beaver Builder cache (Settings > Beaver Builder > Tools) after changing the CSS.

snippets.title: Bricks Query Loop: Exclude the Current Post
snippets.description: Leaves the post being viewed out of the Bricks query loops you choose, so "More articles" sections in single post templates never repeat the current article.
snippets.notes: Put the element IDs of your query loop elements (the six-letter ID shown in Bricks, without "brxe-") in the list.

snippets.title: Bricks Query Loop: Upcoming Items by a Date Field
snippets.description: Limits the chosen Bricks query loops to items whose date field is today or later and sorts them soonest first, for event and webinar lists.
snippets.notes: The date field must store Ymd values (ACF date picker default). Set the element IDs and field name at the top.

snippets.title: Allow Your Functions in Bricks {echo} Tags
snippets.description: Adds the PHP functions you trust to Bricks' allow list for {echo:function_name} dynamic data tags, which Bricks requires before it runs them.
snippets.notes: Only list functions you wrote or fully trust, that take no unsafe input and return a string.

snippets.title: Bricks Dynamic Tag: {wpide_year}
snippets.description: Adds a {wpide_year} dynamic data tag to Bricks that outputs the current year, for footer copyright lines that update themselves.
snippets.notes: Find it in the dynamic data list under "Site". You can also type {wpide_year} into any text field.

snippets.title: Bricks Dynamic Tag: {wpide_reading_time}
snippets.description: Adds a {wpide_reading_time} dynamic data tag that shows the estimated reading time of the current post ("5 min read"), for single templates and query loops.
snippets.notes: Change the words-per-minute value to match your audience.

snippets.title: Bricks Element Condition: URL Parameter
snippets.description: Adds a "URL parameter" condition to Bricks element conditions, so you can show an element only when the address contains something like ?ref=newsletter.
snippets.notes: Enter the value as name=value (for example ref=newsletter), or just the name to test that the parameter exists.

snippets.title: Bricks Element Condition: During Opening Hours
snippets.description: Adds a "During opening hours" condition to Bricks, so a "Call us now" button or live chat block only shows while your business is open.
snippets.notes: Hours use the site timezone from Settings > General. Pages using it should not be cached for long.

snippets.title: Show Bricks Elements Only to Logged-In or Logged-Out Visitors
snippets.description: Skips rendering any Bricks element with the CSS class "wpide-logged-in" for guests and "wpide-logged-out" for members, a quick alternative to setting conditions on each element.
snippets.notes: Add the class in the element's Style > CSS > CSS classes field (not a global class).

snippets.title: Turn Off Bricks SEO and Open Graph Tags
snippets.description: Stops Bricks from printing its own SEO meta and Open Graph tags, avoiding duplicate tags when Yoast, Rank Math or another SEO plugin handles them.
snippets.code:
add_filter( 'bricks/frontend/disable_seo', '__return_true' );
add_filter( 'bricks/frontend/disable_opengraph', '__return_true' );

snippets.title: Keep Selected Roles Out of the Bricks Builder
snippets.description: Sends users without the chosen capability back to the page when they try to open the Bricks builder and hides its admin bar link, as an extra lock on top of Bricks' builder access settings.
snippets.notes: Change manage_options to edit_others_pages to let editors in too.

snippets.title: Open a Bricks Popup From a Link or URL Hash
snippets.description: Opens a Bricks popup template when the address ends in #popup-123 (123 being the template ID) or a link to that hash is clicked, without setting up interactions.
snippets.code:
<script>
(function () {
    function open(hash) {
        var match = /^#popup-(\d+)$/.exec(hash || '');
        if (!match || typeof window.bricksOpenPopup !== 'function') { return false; }
        window.bricksOpenPopup(parseInt(match[1], 10));
        return true;
    }
    window.addEventListener('load', function () { open(window.location.hash); });
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var link = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href*="#popup-"]') : null;
        if (link && link.hash && link.pathname === window.location.pathname && open(link.hash)) { e.preventDefault(); }
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: The popup template's conditions must include the page, so Bricks prints it.

snippets.title: Bricks Forms: Require a Business Email Address
snippets.description: Rejects Bricks form submissions that use free email providers such as Gmail or Outlook, for B2B quote and demo request forms.
snippets.notes: Checks every email field of every Bricks form. Edit the domain list to suit your audience.

snippets.title: Allow Extra HTML Tags in Bricks
snippets.description: Adds HTML tags such as dialog, search and address to the list Bricks accepts in an element's custom tag setting, for more semantic markup.
snippets.notes: Only add real, non-executable HTML elements; never script or iframe.

snippets.title: Bricks Query Type: Child Pages of the Current Page
snippets.description: Adds a "Child pages" query type to Bricks query loops that lists the subpages of the page being viewed, in menu order, for section overview pages.
snippets.notes: Choose "Child pages" as the query type on any looping element; dynamic data like {post_title} works inside it.

snippets.title: Stop Bricks From Loading Google Fonts
snippets.description: Turns on Bricks' "Disable Google Fonts" setting from code, so neither the builder nor the front end requests fonts from Google.
snippets.notes: Upload the fonts you need under Bricks > Custom Fonts so headings keep their typeface.

snippets.title: Astra: No Sidebar on Selected Post Types
snippets.description: Removes the sidebar in the Astra theme for the post types you list, such as products, courses or landing pages, without changing each item's settings.
snippets.notes: Only runs while Astra is the active theme. Per-post sidebar settings set in the editor are overridden for these types.

snippets.title: Astra: Hide the Featured Image on Pages
snippets.description: Stops the Astra theme from showing the featured image at the top of pages, while it is still used for social sharing and page lists.
snippets.notes: Change is_page() to is_singular( 'post' ) to hide it on blog posts instead.

snippets.title: Astra: Remove Previous/Next Links Under Posts
snippets.description: Removes the previous and next post links that the Astra theme adds below single posts, for a cleaner end of article or when you show related posts instead.

snippets.title: Astra: Change the "Read More" Text
snippets.description: Changes the "Read More" link text that the Astra theme shows on blog archives to your own wording, such as "Continue reading".

snippets.title: Astra: Message Bar Above the Header
snippets.description: Prints a slim message bar above the Astra header on every page, for sales, shipping notes or event dates, using Astra's own header hook.
snippets.notes: Leave the message empty to hide the bar. Colors are set in the inline style.

snippets.title: Astra: Change the Mobile Menu Breakpoint
snippets.description: Changes the screen width at which the Astra theme switches to the mobile (hamburger) menu, useful when a long menu wraps on tablets.
snippets.notes: Width in pixels; Astra's default is 921. Clear any CSS cache after changing it.

snippets.title: GeneratePress: Custom Footer Copyright
snippets.description: Replaces the "Built with GeneratePress" footer line with your own copyright text and the current year, without the premium plugin.
snippets.notes: Use {year} and {site} as placeholders in the text.

snippets.title: GeneratePress: No Sidebar on Selected Post Types
snippets.description: Removes the sidebar in GeneratePress for the post types and archives you list, for full-width shop, course or portfolio pages.
snippets.notes: Layout values GeneratePress accepts: no-sidebar, right-sidebar, left-sidebar, both-sidebars.

snippets.title: GeneratePress: Choose the Post Meta Shown Under Titles
snippets.description: Sets which details appear under post titles in GeneratePress (date, author, categories, comments) in the order you want.
snippets.notes: Available items: date, author, categories, tags, comments-link. Remove an item to hide it.

snippets.title: GeneratePress: Remove Previous/Next Links Under Posts
snippets.description: Removes the previous and next post links from the end of single posts in GeneratePress, keeping categories and tags.

snippets.title: GeneratePress: Notice Bar Below the Header
snippets.description: Adds a dismiss-free notice bar right below the GeneratePress header, for opening hours, sales or important updates.
snippets.notes: Basic HTML is allowed in the message; leave it empty to hide the bar.

snippets.title: GeneratePress: Change the Mobile Menu Label
snippets.description: Changes the "Menu" text next to the hamburger icon in GeneratePress, or removes it so only the icon shows.
snippets.notes: Set the label to an empty string to show the icon only; screen readers still announce the button.

snippets.title: Kadence: Message Bar Above the Header
snippets.description: Adds a slim announcement bar above the Kadence theme header on every page, using Kadence's own header hook.
snippets.notes: Leave the message empty to hide it. Edit the colors in the inline style.

snippets.title: Kadence: Call-to-Action Band Above the Footer
snippets.description: Adds a full-width call-to-action band above the footer on every page of the Kadence theme, with a heading and button you set at the top.
snippets.notes: Add page IDs to $wpide_kadence_cta_skip to hide the band on those pages (for example the contact page).

snippets.title: OceanWP: Full-Width Layout for Selected Post Types
snippets.description: Makes the post types you list use OceanWP's full-width layout without a sidebar, for shops, portfolios or courses.
snippets.notes: OceanWP layout values: full-width, full-screen, left-sidebar, right-sidebar, both-sidebars.

snippets.title: OceanWP: Hide the Page Title Bar on Pages
snippets.description: Hides the page header (title and breadcrumb bar) that OceanWP shows at the top of pages, so designed pages start right under the menu.
snippets.notes: Change is_page() to another condition, for example is_singular( 'product' ), to target other content.

snippets.title: OceanWP: Hide the Top Bar on Selected Pages
snippets.description: Hides OceanWP's top bar on the pages you list, such as checkout or landing pages, while keeping it on the rest of the site.
snippets.notes: Use page IDs or slugs.

snippets.title: OceanWP: Notice Bar Below the Header
snippets.description: Shows a notice bar right after the OceanWP header on every page, for announcements that should be seen but not block the menu.
snippets.notes: Leave the message empty to hide it.

snippets.title: Load the Parent Theme Stylesheet in a Child Theme
snippets.description: Loads the parent theme's style.css before the child theme's own stylesheet, for child themes created without the enqueue code in functions.php.
snippets.notes: Does nothing when no child theme is active or the parent stylesheet is already loaded.

snippets.title: Show Menu Item Descriptions in Navigation Menus
snippets.description: Prints the description you write for each menu item under its title in classic theme menus, handy for mega menus and service menus.
snippets.notes: Turn on "Description" under Screen Options in Appearance > Menus to edit descriptions. Limit it with $wpide_menu_desc_locations.

snippets.title: Different Menu for Logged-In Visitors
snippets.description: Shows another navigation menu to logged-in users in the same theme location, for example with "My account" and "Log out" instead of "Sign up".
snippets.notes: Create the menu under Appearance > Menus and put its name or slug in $wpide_member_menu. Works with classic themes.

snippets.title: Highlight the Right Menu Item on Custom Post Type Pages
snippets.description: Marks a menu item as current when visitors view a single item of a custom post type, so the "Portfolio" or "Events" link stays highlighted instead of "Blog".
snippets.notes: Map each post type to the URL path of the menu item that should light up.

snippets.title: Preview Another Theme as an Administrator
snippets.description: Lets administrators view the site with another installed theme by adding ?wpide_theme=theme-folder to any address, while visitors keep seeing the active theme.
snippets.notes: Use the theme's folder name, for example ?wpide_theme=twentytwentyfour. The choice lasts for that page view only.

snippets.title: Make the Editor Match Your Classic Theme
snippets.description: Loads an editor-style.css file from your (child) theme into the block editor and turns on editor styles, so posts look the same while writing as on the site.
snippets.notes: Create editor-style.css in your theme folder with the typography and colors you want in the editor. Block themes do this automatically.

snippets.title: Add Logo Upload to Themes That Lack It
snippets.description: Adds the "Logo" option to the Customizer for older classic themes that do not support a custom logo, with flexible width and height.
snippets.notes: Your theme still needs to print the logo, for example with the_custom_logo() in header.php.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Three-Plan Pricing Table
snippets.description: Adds a "Pricing: three plans" pattern to the block inserter with a heading, three plan columns, feature lists and buttons that follow your theme's styles.
snippets.notes: Find it in the inserter under Patterns > Site Sections. Edit the plans and prices after inserting.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: FAQ With Expandable Answers
snippets.description: Adds an FAQ pattern built from core Details blocks, so visitors click a question to reveal its answer, with no plugin and no JavaScript.
snippets.notes: Add or remove questions by duplicating a Details block in the editor.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Three Testimonials
snippets.description: Adds a testimonials pattern with three customer quotes side by side, built from core Quote blocks so it inherits your theme's quote styling.
snippets.notes: The columns stack automatically on phones.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: "How It Works" in Three Steps
snippets.description: Adds a pattern with a heading and three numbered steps in columns, a common section for service pages and onboarding.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Call to Action With Two Buttons
snippets.description: Adds a centered call-to-action pattern with a heading, a sentence and a main button plus an outline button, for the end of landing and service pages.
snippets.notes: Set a background color on the Group block after inserting to make the section stand out.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Six-Feature Grid
snippets.description: Adds a pattern with a heading and six short feature descriptions in two rows of three columns, for product and service overviews.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Key Numbers Row
snippets.description: Adds a row of four big numbers with short labels (customers, years, rating, countries), a quick way to show social proof on any page.
snippets.notes: Pair it with the animated counter snippet if you want the numbers to count up.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Contact Details and Opening Hours
snippets.description: Adds a two-column contact section with address, phone and email on one side and opening hours on the other, ready to fill in.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Helpful 404 Page Content
snippets.description: Adds a friendly 404 pattern with a message, a search box and a button home, offered when you edit the 404 template in the Site Editor.
snippets.notes: Open Appearance > Editor > Templates > Page: 404 and pick it from the patterns offered for that template.

snippets.title: Starter Layout for New Pages: About Us
snippets.description: Offers an "About us" layout in the starter patterns window that opens when you create a new page, so editors start from a structure instead of a blank page.
snippets.notes: Starter layouts appear when creating a page; they need the starter patterns window to be enabled.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Company History Timeline
snippets.description: Adds a timeline pattern with a year column and a description column for each milestone, for About and history pages.
snippets.notes: Duplicate a row (Columns block) to add more milestones.

snippets.title: Remove Pattern Categories You Do Not Use
snippets.description: Removes the pattern categories you list (such as Gallery, Media or Portfolio) from the block inserter, so the pattern list is shorter and easier to scan.
snippets.notes: Category slugs include buttons, columns, gallery, header, footer, text, query, featured, call-to-action, team, testimonials, contact, about, portfolio, media, posts, banner.

snippets.title: Heading Block Styles: Eyebrow and Accent Underline
snippets.description: Adds two style options to the Heading block: a small uppercase "eyebrow" label for section kickers, and a heading with a short accent line underneath.
snippets.notes: Pick them in the block sidebar under Styles. The accent color follows currentColor, so it matches the text color you choose.

snippets.title: Quote Block Style: Big Quotation Mark
snippets.description: Adds a "Big quotation mark" style to Quote and Pullquote blocks that shows a large decorative quote sign and roomier text, for testimonials and highlights.

snippets.title: Table Block Styles: Lined Rows and Hover Highlight
snippets.description: Adds two table styles: "Lined" with thin row dividers and no outer borders, and "Hover rows" that highlights the row under the mouse for easier reading.

snippets.title: Separator Block Styles: Gradient and Ornament
snippets.description: Adds a fading gradient line and a centered ornament (✦) style to the Separator block, for more elegant breaks between sections.
snippets.notes: Change the ornament character in the CSS content value.

snippets.title: Image Block Styles: Polaroid, Frame and Tilt
snippets.description: Adds three photo styles to the Image block: a white polaroid card, a thin inset frame, and a playful slight tilt that straightens on hover.
snippets.notes: The tilt animation is skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Columns Block Style: Dividing Lines
snippets.description: Adds a "Dividers" style to the Columns block that draws a thin vertical line between columns on wide screens and a horizontal one when they stack on phones.

snippets.title: Paragraph Block Styles: Tip, Note and Warning Callouts
snippets.description: Adds three callout styles to the Paragraph block (tip, note and warning) with a colored side border and label, for documentation and tutorials.
snippets.notes: Edit the label text or colors in the $wpide_callouts array.

snippets.title: List Block Styles: Arrows and Numbered Steps
snippets.description: Adds an "Arrows" style for bullet lists and a "Steps" style that turns numbered lists into large numbered circles, for features and how-to instructions.
snippets.notes: Use "Steps" on a numbered list (ordered list) for the counters to make sense.

snippets.title: Navigation Block Style: Animated Underline on Hover
snippets.description: Adds an "Underline on hover" style to the Navigation block, where a line slides in under menu links on hover and stays under the current page link.
snippets.notes: The slide animation is turned off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Section Styles: Dark and Soft Accent Sections
snippets.description: Adds "Dark section" and "Soft accent section" styles to Group, Columns and Cover blocks, which recolor the background, text, links, headings and buttons inside in one click (WordPress 6.6+).
snippets.notes: Edit the colors in the style_data arrays to match your brand. Older WordPress versions are skipped.

snippets.title: Block Variations: Notice Box and Card
snippets.description: Adds "Notice box" and "Card" to the inserter as ready-made Group block variations with starter content, so editors insert consistent components in one click.
snippets.notes: Uses the class names wpide-notice and wpide-card; style them in your theme or with a CSS snippet. Needs WordPress 6.5+.

snippets.title: "Landing Page" Template Without Header and Footer
snippets.description: Registers a "Landing page" block template for pages that shows only the page content, with no site header, footer or title, for campaign and sales pages (WordPress 6.7+).
snippets.notes: Choose it in the page sidebar under Template. Works with block themes; older WordPress versions are skipped.

snippets.title: "Page Without Title" Template for Block Themes
snippets.description: Registers a page template that keeps the theme's header and footer but hides the page title, for pages that start with their own hero section (WordPress 6.7+).
snippets.notes: Pick it under Template in the page sidebar. It uses your theme's "header" and "footer" template parts.

snippets.title: Add a "Sidebar" Area for Template Parts
snippets.description: Adds a "Sidebar" area next to Header and Footer in the Site Editor, so sidebar template parts get their own section, icon and the right HTML tag.
snippets.notes: Create a template part and choose "Sidebar" as its area in the Advanced panel.

snippets.title: Add the Author Bio After Posts in Block Themes
snippets.description: Automatically inserts the Author Biography block after the post content in your block theme's single post template, without editing the template.
snippets.notes: You can move or remove the inserted block in the Site Editor like any other block. Needs WordPress 6.4+.

snippets.title: Log In/Out Link at the End of the Navigation Block
snippets.description: Adds a Log in / Log out link as the last item of your block theme's header navigation automatically, using block hooks.
snippets.notes: Applies to Navigation blocks inside the header template part. Remove it in the Site Editor if you change your mind. Needs WordPress 6.5+.

snippets.title: Query Loop Block: Exclude the Current Post
snippets.description: Removes the post being viewed from any Query Loop block that has the class "wpide-exclude-current", for "More posts" sections under articles.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-exclude-current under Advanced > Additional CSS class(es) on the Query Loop block, with "Inherit query" turned off.

snippets.title: Query Loop Block: Most Discussed Posts
snippets.description: Sorts any Query Loop block with the class "wpide-most-commented" by number of comments, for a "Most discussed" list without a plugin.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-most-commented to the Query Loop's Additional CSS class(es) and turn off "Inherit query".

snippets.title: Query Loop Block: Only Posts With a Featured Image
snippets.description: Limits any Query Loop block with the class "wpide-has-thumbnail" to posts that have a featured image, so image grids never show empty cards.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-has-thumbnail to the Query Loop's Additional CSS class(es).

snippets.title: Turn Off "Edit as HTML" on Blocks for Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes the "Edit as HTML" option from block menus for everyone except administrators, so authors cannot break block markup by hand.
snippets.notes: Administrators keep the option. The Code editor mode is a separate setting.

snippets.title: Hide the "Additional CSS Class" Field From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes the Additional CSS class(es) field from the block Advanced panel for non-administrators, keeping authors to the styles you have designed.
snippets.notes: Classes already added to blocks are kept.

snippets.title: Highlight (Marker) Button in the Block Toolbar
snippets.description: Adds a "Highlight" button to the text formatting toolbar that wraps selected words in a <mark> tag with a marker-pen look, for emphasis in posts.
snippets.notes: Find it in the toolbar's "More" (chevron) menu. Change the color in the inline CSS.

snippets.title: Keyboard Key (kbd) Button in the Block Toolbar
snippets.description: Adds a "Keyboard key" format to the text toolbar that wraps text in <kbd> and styles it like a key cap, for tutorials with shortcuts such as Ctrl + S.
snippets.notes: Find it in the toolbar's "More" (chevron) menu.

snippets.title: Better Defaults for New Blocks
snippets.description: Changes the starting settings of blocks editors add: images link to nothing and open large, galleries crop evenly, columns stay side by side on phones, and new tables have header rows.
snippets.notes: Only affects newly inserted blocks. Delete any line in the defaults object you do not want.

snippets.title: Load the First Cover Block Image With High Priority
snippets.description: Marks the background image of the first Cover block on a page with fetchpriority="high" and turns off lazy loading for it, which speeds up hero sections (better LCP).
snippets.notes: Only the first Cover block with an image element is changed; later ones keep lazy loading.

snippets.title: Limit the Blocks Authors and Contributors Can Use
snippets.description: Gives authors and contributors a short list of everyday blocks (text, headings, lists, images, quotes, embeds) while editors and administrators keep every block.
snippets.notes: Users who can edit others' posts (editors and administrators) are not limited. Edit the block list to fit your site.

snippets.title: Block Bindings Source: Reading Time
snippets.description: Registers a "Reading time" block bindings source, so a Paragraph or Heading in your templates can show "5 min read" for the current post (WordPress 6.5+).
snippets.notes: In the Code editor, add {"metadata":{"bindings":{"content":{"source":"wpide/reading-time"}}}} to a Paragraph block's attributes.

snippets.title: Custom CSS for Specific Blocks, Loaded Only Where Used
snippets.description: Lets you write extra CSS for individual block types (for example tables or quotes) that WordPress prints only on pages that actually contain those blocks.
snippets.notes: Works best with block themes, or classic themes that load block styles separately. Edit the CSS per block name.

snippets.title: Stop the Navigation Block Listing All Pages
snippets.description: Prevents the Navigation block from automatically showing a list of every page when no menu is assigned, so unfinished headers stay empty instead of exposing pages.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'block_core_navigation_render_fallback', '__return_empty_array' );
snippets.notes: Assign a menu to your Navigation block in the Site Editor; until then it renders nothing.

snippets.title: Template Part Shortcode for Classic Themes
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_template_part slug="footer"] shortcode that prints a block template part, so classic themes and page builders can reuse parts designed in the Site Editor.
snippets.notes: Only slugs in the allowed list are rendered. Template parts must exist for the active theme (Appearance > Editor or the Patterns screen).

snippets.title: Register a Self-Hosted Font in theme.json
snippets.description: Adds a font family with your own font files (stored in uploads/fonts) to the theme's typography settings, so it appears in the editor's font picker and loads without Google.
snippets.notes: Upload the .woff2 files to wp-content/uploads/fonts/ first and match the file names below. Works with block themes and classic themes that use theme.json.

snippets.title: Custom Spacing Scale for Padding, Margin and Gaps
snippets.description: Replaces the spacing presets in the editor's padding, margin and block spacing controls with your own scale, so every page uses the same rhythm.
snippets.notes: Sizes can use clamp() for fluid spacing. Keep slugs stable once used, or blocks lose their spacing.

snippets.title: Add Your Own Shadow Presets to the Editor
snippets.description: Adds soft, medium and lifted shadow options to the editor's Shadow control for buttons, images, groups and columns, next to the theme's own shadows.
snippets.notes: Shadow controls need WordPress 6.5+ and blocks that support shadows.

snippets.title: Add Brand Gradients to the Editor
snippets.description: Adds your brand gradients to the gradient picker for Group, Cover, Button and other blocks, so editors use on-brand backgrounds.
snippets.notes: Any valid CSS gradient works. Existing theme gradients are kept.

snippets.title: Add Brand Duotone Filters for Images
snippets.description: Adds duotone image filters in your brand colors to the Image and Cover block toolbars, for a consistent photo style across the site.
snippets.notes: Each filter maps shadows to the first color and highlights to the second.

snippets.title: Site-Wide Link Color and Hover Style
snippets.description: Sets the color, underline and hover color of links across a block theme through theme.json, so links look the same in the editor and on the site.
snippets.notes: Colors set later in Styles (Site Editor) still override these values.

snippets.title: Tighter, Bolder Headings Through theme.json
snippets.description: Sets the weight, line height and letter spacing of all headings in a block theme, for a crisper, more modern look in the editor and on the site.
snippets.notes: Adjust the three values at the top. Individual blocks can still override them.

snippets.title: Rounded Buttons Through theme.json
snippets.description: Sets the shape, padding and weight of all buttons (Button block, search and form buttons) in a block theme through theme.json, including a darker hover color.
snippets.notes: Set the radius to 4px for slightly rounded corners or 0 for square buttons.

snippets.title: Turn On Fluid Typography
snippets.description: Makes font sizes from the theme presets scale smoothly between phone and desktop widths, so large headings never overflow on small screens.
snippets.notes: Change the viewport range to control where scaling starts and stops.

snippets.title: Limit the CSS Units Offered in the Editor
snippets.description: Reduces the unit dropdowns in spacing and size controls to the units you want (for example px, rem and %), keeping layouts consistent.

snippets.title: Only Your Image Aspect Ratios in the Editor
snippets.description: Replaces the long list of aspect ratios offered for images and featured images with a short set you choose, so cropped images stay consistent.
snippets.notes: Needs WordPress 6.6+. Ratios are written as width/height.

snippets.title: Restrict Button Block Colors to Brand Colors
snippets.description: Gives the Button block its own small palette of brand colors and removes the custom color picker for it, so every button on the site stays on-brand.
snippets.notes: Other blocks keep the full theme palette.

snippets.title: Extra Color Palette for One Post Type
snippets.description: Adds extra colors to the editor palette only while editing a chosen post type (for example a landing page type), and prints the matching color classes on the front end.
snippets.notes: Set the post type and colors at the top. The theme palette is kept; these colors are added to it.

snippets.title: Stop Non-Administrators Changing Content Widths
snippets.description: Hides the content width and wide width fields in the layout settings of Group and similar blocks for everyone except administrators, so page widths stay consistent.
snippets.notes: Needs WordPress 6.6+; older versions ignore the setting.

snippets.title: Remove the "Sticky" Position Option From Blocks
snippets.description: Hides the Position: Sticky setting from Group blocks in the editor, so editors cannot accidentally pin sections to the top of the screen.
snippets.notes: Blocks already set to sticky keep that setting.

snippets.title: Change the Default Space Between Blocks
snippets.description: Sets the default vertical gap between blocks across a block theme, for a tighter or airier rhythm without adjusting every Group block.
snippets.notes: Any CSS length works, including clamp() values.

snippets.title: Show Text While Theme Fonts Load (font-display)
snippets.description: Changes the font-display setting of every font the theme registers in theme.json, so text shows immediately in a fallback font instead of staying invisible while web fonts load.
snippets.notes: Use swap to always switch to the web font, or optional to keep the fallback on slow connections and avoid layout shifts.

snippets.title: Keep Only the Theme Fonts You Use
snippets.description: Removes the font families you do not use from the theme's font list, so editors see a short list and the unused fonts are never loaded.
snippets.notes: Font slugs are shown in the theme's theme.json (settings.typography.fontFamilies). Text set to a removed font falls back to the default font.

snippets.title: Hide Design Controls From Authors and Contributors
snippets.description: Hides color, typography, spacing and border controls in the block editor for authors and contributors, so they focus on writing while editors keep full design control.
snippets.notes: Users who can edit others' posts (editors, administrators) keep all controls. Styles already applied to blocks remain.

snippets.title: Change the Content and Wide Widths of a Block Theme
snippets.description: Sets how wide normal and "wide" content is in your block theme, on the site and in the editor, for example a narrower reading column with wider images.
snippets.notes: Values can be px, rem or %. Changes made in the Site Editor's Styles still take priority.

snippets.title: Set the Body Text Size and Line Height
snippets.description: Sets the default font size and line height of body text in a block theme through theme.json, for more comfortable reading on every page.
snippets.notes: A clamp() size scales between phones and desktops; use a fixed value like 18px if you prefer.

snippets.title: Modal Window Shortcode (No Cookies, No Library)
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_modal button="Open"]...[/wpide_modal] shortcode that shows a button which opens its content in an accessible modal window, built on the native dialog element.
snippets.notes: Add title="..." for a heading inside the modal. Escape, the close button and a click on the backdrop all close it; focus returns to the button.

snippets.title: Accessible Tabs Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds [wpide_tabs] and [wpide_tab title="..."] shortcodes to build tabbed content that works with mouse, keyboard (arrow keys) and screen readers.
snippets.notes: Example: [wpide_tabs][wpide_tab title="Overview"]Text[/wpide_tab][wpide_tab title="Specs"]Text[/wpide_tab][/wpide_tabs]. Without JavaScript all panels simply show one after another.

snippets.title: Before/After Image Comparison Slider
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_compare before="URL" after="URL"] shortcode that overlays two images with a draggable divider, perfect for renovations, retouching and redesigns.
snippets.notes: Both images should have the same size and aspect ratio. Media Library attachment IDs also work: before="123" after="124". The slider works with touch, mouse and keyboard.

snippets.title: Animated Number Counter Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_counter to="2500" suffix="+"] shortcode that counts up from zero when the number scrolls into view, for statistics and milestones.
snippets.notes: Options: from, to, prefix, suffix, duration (ms) and decimals. Visitors who prefer reduced motion see the final number straight away.

snippets.title: Typing Text Effect Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_typing words="faster|safer|simpler"] shortcode that types and deletes each word in turn, for lively hero headlines like "Make your site faster".
snippets.notes: Separate words with a vertical bar. Screen readers read the full list once, and visitors who prefer reduced motion see the first word without animation.

snippets.title: Tooltip Shortcode for Terms and Abbreviations
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_tooltip tip="Explanation"]term[/wpide_tooltip] shortcode that shows a small explanation bubble on hover, tap or keyboard focus.
snippets.notes: The explanation is also exposed to screen readers. Keep tips short; long text belongs in the content.

snippets.title: Progress Bar Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_progress value="75" label="Funding goal"] shortcode that draws a labeled progress bar, for fundraising goals, skills or project status.
snippets.notes: Add color="#16a34a" to change the bar color. The bar fills with a short animation unless the visitor prefers reduced motion.

snippets.title: Click-to-Copy Shortcode for Coupon Codes
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_copy text="SAVE20"] shortcode that shows the code in a dashed box with a Copy button, and confirms with "Copied!" when clicked.
snippets.notes: Use it for discount codes, commands, account numbers or any short text visitors need to paste elsewhere.

snippets.title: Monthly/Yearly Pricing Toggle
snippets.description: Adds a switch that flips prices on your pricing page between monthly and yearly amounts, using simple data attributes on any element that shows a price.
snippets.notes:
Add a Custom HTML block with
where the switch should appear, and give price elements data-monthly="$19" data-yearly="$190" (Custom HTML or the block's HTML editing).

snippets.title: App-Style Bottom Navigation Bar on Phones
snippets.description: Adds a "Mobile bottom bar" menu location and shows that menu as a fixed bar of up to five links at the bottom of the screen on phones, like a mobile app.
snippets.notes: Create a short menu (3 to 5 items) in Appearance > Menus and assign it to "Mobile bottom bar". Works with classic themes; block themes can assign menus there too.

snippets.title: "Load More" Button for Blog Archives
snippets.description: Replaces the numbered pagination on blog and category pages with a "Load more posts" button that adds the next page of posts without leaving the page.
snippets.code:
<script>
(function () {
    var containerSel = '.wp-block-post-template, #main, .site-main';
    var itemSel = '.wp-block-post-template > li, article.post, article.type-post';
    var nextSel = '.wp-block-query-pagination-next, .nav-links a.next, a.next.page-numbers';
    var pagerSel = '.wp-block-query-pagination, .navigation.pagination, .nav-links';
    var next = document.querySelector(nextSel);
    var container = document.querySelector(containerSel);
    if (!next || !container || !window.fetch || !window.DOMParser) { return; }
    var pager = next.closest(pagerSel) || next.parentNode;
    var button = document.createElement('button');
    button.type = 'button';
    button.className = 'wp-element-button wpide-load-more';
    button.textContent = 'Load more posts';
    button.style.cssText = 'display:block;margin:2em auto;';
    var status = document.createElement('p');
    status.className = 'screen-reader-text';
    status.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    pager.parentNode.insertBefore(button, pager);
    pager.parentNode.insertBefore(status, pager);
    pager.style.display = 'none';
    var url = next.href;
    button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = 'Loading…';
        fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin' }).then(function (r) { return r.text(); }).then(function (html) {
            var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
            var items = doc.querySelectorAll(itemSel);
            var current = container.querySelectorAll(itemSel);
            var anchor = current[current.length - 1];
            items.forEach(function (item) {
                var node = document.importNode(item, true);
                if (anchor) { anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(node, anchor.nextSibling); anchor = node; } else { container.appendChild(node); }
            });
            status.textContent = items.length + ' more posts loaded';
            var more = doc.querySelector(nextSel);
            if (more && more.href) {
                url = more.href;
                button.disabled = false;
                button.textContent = 'Load more posts';
            } else {
                button.remove();
            }
        }).catch(function () {
            window.location.href = url;
        });
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Set the container and post selectors at the top of the script to match your theme (defaults cover most classic and block themes). Without JavaScript the normal pagination stays.

snippets.title: Full-Screen Search Overlay
snippets.description: Opens a full-screen search box when visitors click any link to #search (for example a menu item) and closes with Escape, giving small headers a roomy, focused search.
snippets.notes: Add a Custom Link menu item with the URL #search and the label "Search". The overlay uses your theme's normal search form.

snippets.title: Scrolling Logo Strip (Marquee)
snippets.description: Turns any block with the class "wpide-marquee" (a Gallery, Row or Group of logos) into a smooth, endlessly scrolling strip that pauses on hover.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-marquee{overflow:hidden;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 8%,#000 92%,transparent);}
.wpide-marquee__track{display:flex;width:max-content;gap:var(--wpide-marquee-gap,48px);animation:wpide-marquee var(--wpide-marquee-speed,30s) linear infinite;}
.wpide-marquee__track>*{flex:0 0 auto;margin:0!important;}
.wpide-marquee:hover .wpide-marquee__track,.wpide-marquee:focus-within .wpide-marquee__track{animation-play-state:paused;}
@keyframes wpide-marquee{to{transform:translateX(-50%);}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wpide-marquee{-webkit-mask-image:none;mask-image:none;}.wpide-marquee__track{animation:none;flex-wrap:wrap;width:auto;justify-content:center;}.wpide-marquee__track>[aria-hidden="true"]{display:none;}}
</style>
<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.wpide-marquee').forEach(function (el) {
    if (el.querySelector('.wpide-marquee__track')) { return; }
    var track = document.createElement('div');
    track.className = 'wpide-marquee__track';
    var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(el.children);
    items.forEach(function (child) { track.appendChild(child); });
    items.forEach(function (child) {
        var copy = child.cloneNode(true);
        copy.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        copy.querySelectorAll('a, button').forEach(function (a) { a.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); });
        track.appendChild(copy);
    });
    el.style.display = 'block';
    el.appendChild(track);
});
</script>
snippets.notes: Add wpide-marquee under Advanced > Additional CSS class(es). Visitors who prefer reduced motion see a static, wrapping row instead.

snippets.title: Shimmer Placeholders While Images Load
snippets.description: Shows a soft animated "skeleton" shimmer in the space of content images until each image has loaded, so pages feel faster and less jumpy on slow connections.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-skeleton{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#eceff1 30%,#f6f7f8 50%,#eceff1 70%);background-size:300% 100%;animation:wpide-shimmer 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes wpide-shimmer{from{background-position:100% 0;}to{background-position:0 0;}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wpide-skeleton{animation:none;}}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var images = document.querySelectorAll('.entry-content img, .wp-block-post-content img, .wp-block-post-featured-image img, .post-thumbnail img');
    images.forEach(function (img) {
        if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth) { return; }
        img.classList.add('wpide-skeleton');
        var done = function () { img.classList.remove('wpide-skeleton'); };
        img.addEventListener('load', done, { once: true });
        img.addEventListener('error', done, { once: true });
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Applies to images in post content and featured images. The shimmer is static for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Mega Menu Layout for Menu Items (SCSS)
