snippets.description: Turns the dropdown of any menu item with the CSS class "mega-menu" into a wide, multi-column panel, in classic theme menus and the Navigation block.
snippets.notes: Add mega-menu to the top-level item's CSS Classes (enable the field in Appearance > Menus > Screen Options) or the Navigation submenu block's Additional CSS class. Only applies on screens 1024px and wider.

snippets.title: Close the Mobile Menu After Tapping an On-Page Link
snippets.description: Closes the Navigation block's full-screen mobile menu when a visitor taps a link to a section of the same page (like #pricing), so they actually see where they jumped to.
snippets.notes: For block themes using the Navigation block. Links to other pages work as before.

snippets.title: Hide the Header on Scroll Down, Show It on Scroll Up
snippets.description: Slides the sticky site header out of view while visitors scroll down to read and brings it back as soon as they scroll up, giving content more room on small screens.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-autohide{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:999;transition:transform .25s ease;}
.admin-bar .wpide-autohide{top:var(--wp-admin--admin-bar--height,32px);}
.wpide-autohide.is-hidden{transform:translateY(-110%);}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wpide-autohide{transition:none;}}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var header = document.querySelector('header.wp-block-template-part, .site-header, #masthead, body > header');
    if (!header) { return; }
    header.classList.add('wpide-autohide');
    var lastY = window.pageYOffset, ticking = false;
    function update() {
        var y = window.pageYOffset;
        var hide = y > lastY && y > header.offsetHeight + 40 && !header.contains(document.activeElement);
        header.classList.toggle('is-hidden', hide);
        lastY = y;
        ticking = false;
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
        if (!ticking) { window.requestAnimationFrame(update); ticking = true; }
    }, { passive: true });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Change the header selector in the script if your theme uses something other than a header element or .site-header.

snippets.title: Transparent Header Over the Homepage Hero
snippets.description: Lays the header over the first section of the homepage with a transparent background and white text, then switches to a solid header once visitors scroll.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-overlay-header{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:999;background:transparent;color:#fff;transition:background-color .25s ease,color .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease;}
.admin-bar .wpide-overlay-header{top:var(--wp-admin--admin-bar--height,32px);}
.wpide-overlay-header a{color:inherit;}
.wpide-overlay-header.is-solid{background:#ffffff;color:#111827;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wpide-overlay-header{transition:none;}}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('home')) { return; }
    var header = document.querySelector('header.wp-block-template-part, .site-header, #masthead');
    if (!header) { return; }
    header.classList.add('wpide-overlay-header');
    var toggle = function () { header.classList.toggle('is-solid', window.pageYOffset > 60); };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', toggle, { passive: true });
    toggle();
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Works best when the homepage starts with a full-width Cover block. Adjust the solid colors and the header selector at the top.

snippets.title: Highlight the Menu Link of the Section in View
snippets.description: Marks the menu link that points to the section currently on screen (for one-page sites with #about, #services links), updating as visitors scroll.
snippets.code:
<style>
a.is-current{font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.3em;}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) { return; }
    var links = Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('nav a[href*="#"]'), function (a) {
        return a.hash.length > 1 && a.pathname === window.location.pathname && document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(a.hash.slice(1)));
    });
    if (!links.length) { return; }
    var byId = {};
    links.forEach(function (a) { var id = decodeURIComponent(a.hash.slice(1)); (byId[id] = byId[id] || []).push(a); });
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
            if (!entry.isIntersecting) { return; }
            links.forEach(function (a) { a.classList.remove('is-current'); a.removeAttribute('aria-current'); });
            (byId[entry.target.id] || []).forEach(function (a) { a.classList.add('is-current'); a.setAttribute('aria-current', 'location'); });
        });
    }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -50% 0px' });
    Object.keys(byId).forEach(function (id) { io.observe(document.getElementById(id)); });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Give each section an HTML anchor (Advanced > HTML anchor) matching the menu links. The active link gets the class is-current and aria-current.

snippets.title: Open Only One Details Block at a Time
snippets.description: Makes neighboring Details blocks behave like an accordion: opening one question closes the others in the same group, which keeps long FAQs tidy.
snippets.notes: Applies to Details blocks that sit next to each other in the same parent block. Add the class wpide-multi-open to the parent to allow several open at once.

snippets.title: Floating Call-to-Action Button After Scrolling
snippets.description: Shows a floating button in the bottom corner once visitors have scrolled past the first screen, for "Book a call", "Get a quote" or "Shop now" links.
snippets.code: Get a free quote
snippets.notes: Edit the link text and URL in the HTML. The button hides on the page it links to.

snippets.title: Masonry Layout for Gallery Blocks
snippets.description: Shows images in any Gallery block with the class "wpide-masonry" in a Pinterest-style masonry layout, keeping each photo's natural shape instead of cropping it.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-masonry to the Gallery block's Additional CSS class(es) and turn off "Crop images". Column count follows the available width.

snippets.title: Swipeable Carousel for Any Block
snippets.description: Turns a Group, Row, Gallery or Query Loop post list with the class "wpide-carousel" into a swipeable horizontal carousel with previous/next buttons, using native scroll snapping.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-carousel-wrap{position:relative;}
.wpide-carousel{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none;padding-bottom:4px;}
.wpide-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.wpide-carousel>*{flex:0 0 var(--wpide-slide,80%)!important;max-width:none!important;scroll-snap-align:start;margin:0!important;}
@media (min-width:782px){.wpide-carousel>*{flex-basis:var(--wpide-slide-desktop,calc(33.333% - 11px))!important;}}
.wpide-carousel-btn{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#111;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.2);font-size:22px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;z-index:2;}
.wpide-carousel-btn[disabled]{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;}
.wpide-carousel-btn--prev{left:-10px;}.wpide-carousel-btn--next{right:-10px;}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wpide-carousel{scroll-behavior:auto;}}
</style>
<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.wpide-carousel').forEach(function (track) {
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'wpide-carousel-wrap';
    track.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, track);
    wrap.appendChild(track);
    track.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
    track.setAttribute('role', 'region');
    track.setAttribute('aria-label', track.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Carousel');
    function make(dir, label, text) {
        var b = document.createElement('button');
        b.type = 'button';
        b.className = 'wpide-carousel-btn wpide-carousel-btn--' + dir;
        b.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
        b.textContent = text;
        b.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var step = track.firstElementChild ? track.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().width + 16 : track.clientWidth;
            track.scrollBy({ left: dir === 'next' ? step : -step });
        });
        wrap.appendChild(b);
        return b;
    }
    var prev = make('prev', 'Previous', '\u2039');
    var next = make('next', 'Next', '\u203A');
    function update() {
        prev.disabled = track.scrollLeft < 5;
        next.disabled = track.scrollLeft + track.clientWidth >= track.scrollWidth - 5;
    }
    track.addEventListener('scroll', update, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', update);
    update();
});
</script>
snippets.notes: Add wpide-carousel to the block's Additional CSS class(es). Set the slide width with the --wpide-slide variable (default 80% on phones, 33% on desktop).

snippets.title: "Show More" Button for Long Sections
snippets.description: Shortens any block with the class "wpide-show-more" to a preview height with a fade, and adds a "Show more" button that expands it, ideal for long descriptions and terms.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-show-more.is-clamped{max-height:var(--wpide-preview,220px);overflow:hidden;position:relative;}
.wpide-show-more.is-clamped::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:80px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,var(--wp--preset--color--base,#fff));pointer-events:none;}
.wpide-show-more-btn{display:inline-block;margin-top:.5em;padding:.4em 0;border:0;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;}
</style>
<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.wpide-show-more').forEach(function (block, i) {
    var limit = parseInt(getComputedStyle(block).getPropertyValue('--wpide-preview'), 10) || 220;
    if (block.scrollHeight <= limit + 60) { return; }
    if (!block.id) { block.id = 'wpide-show-more-' + i; }
    block.classList.add('is-clamped');
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = 'wpide-show-more-btn';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-controls', block.id);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    btn.textContent = 'Show more';
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var open = block.classList.toggle('is-clamped') === false;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
        btn.textContent = open ? 'Show less' : 'Show more';
    });
    block.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', btn);
});
</script>
snippets.notes: Change the preview height with the --wpide-preview CSS variable (default 220px). Content shorter than the preview is left alone.

snippets.title: Limit Post Titles and Excerpts to a Few Lines in Grids
snippets.description: Cuts long post titles to two lines and excerpts to three lines in blog grids and Query Loop blocks, so cards line up neatly whatever the text length.
snippets.notes: Change the line counts in -webkit-line-clamp. Full titles still show on single posts.

snippets.title: Animated Underline for Links in Posts
snippets.description: Replaces the plain underline on links inside post content with a thin line that thickens on hover, a subtle touch that keeps links easy to spot.
snippets.notes: Buttons are not affected. The transition is skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Lazy-Load Background Images
snippets.description: Loads background images only when their section is about to scroll into view, for any element marked with data-wpide-bg="image-url", saving bandwidth on long landing pages.
snippets.notes: Add data-wpide-bg="https://example.com/image.webp" to an element in a Custom HTML block or theme template. Elements already on screen load immediately.

snippets.title: Keep the Footer at the Bottom on Short Pages
snippets.description: Stops the footer from floating halfway up the screen on pages with little content, by letting the main area grow to fill the window. Works with block and classic themes.
snippets.notes: Classic themes need a wrapper like #page around the content and footer, which most themes have.

snippets.title: Fix Full-Height Sections on Mobile Browsers
snippets.description: Makes Cover blocks and sections set to 100vh fit the visible screen on phones, where the browser's address bar otherwise hides the bottom of the section and its buttons.
snippets.notes: Uses the small-viewport unit (svh), supported by all current browsers; older ones keep the original height.

snippets.title: Stop Sideways Scrolling on Phones
snippets.description: Prevents the whole page from scrolling sideways on phones when a wide image, embed or full-width block sticks out a few pixels past the screen edge.
snippets.notes: Uses overflow-x: clip, which does not break sticky headers the way overflow: hidden does. It hides the symptom; check which element is too wide if you can.

snippets.title: Stop Sticky Headers Covering Jump-Link Targets
snippets.description: Leaves space above headings and sections when visitors follow a #link, so the target is not hidden under a sticky header or the admin bar.
snippets.notes: Set --wpide-header-offset to the height of your sticky header.

snippets.title: Open Dropdown Menus With the Keyboard
snippets.description: Shows a classic theme's dropdown submenu while a keyboard user tabs through it, for themes whose dropdowns only open on mouse hover.
snippets.notes: Adjust the selector if your theme's menu is not inside .main-navigation, #site-navigation or nav.

snippets.title: Show/Hide Button on Front-End Password Fields
snippets.description: Adds an accessible "Show" button inside password fields on the front of the site (account, checkout and membership forms), so visitors can check what they typed.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-pw-wrap{position:relative;display:block;}
.wpide-pw-wrap input{padding-right:4.5em!important;width:100%;}
.wpide-pw-toggle{position:absolute;top:50%;right:6px;transform:translateY(-50%);padding:4px 8px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:inherit;font-size:.85em;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;}
.wpide-pw-toggle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;}
</style>
<script>
document.querySelectorAll('input[type="password"]').forEach(function (input) {
    if (input.closest('.password-input, .wp-pwd, .wpide-pw-wrap') || input.nextElementSibling && input.nextElementSibling.matches('button, .show-password-input')) { return; }
    var wrap = document.createElement('span');
    wrap.className = 'wpide-pw-wrap';
    input.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, input);
    wrap.appendChild(input);
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.type = 'button';
    btn.className = 'wpide-pw-toggle';
    btn.textContent = 'Show';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Show password');
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var show = input.type === 'password';
        input.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
        btn.textContent = show ? 'Hide' : 'Show';
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', show ? 'true' : 'false');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-label', show ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password');
        input.focus();
    });
    wrap.appendChild(btn);
});
</script>
snippets.notes: Fields that already have a toggle (such as WooCommerce's) are skipped. The login page has its own built-in button.

snippets.title: Share or Copy a Highlighted Quote
snippets.description: Shows a small toolbar when readers highlight text in a post, with buttons to copy the quote with a link back or share it on X, Bluesky or LinkedIn.
snippets.notes: Nothing is loaded from social networks until a reader clicks a share button. Remove a network by deleting its line in the targets list.

snippets.title: Sticky Header Row in Long Tables
snippets.description: Keeps the header row of long tables in posts visible while visitors scroll down through the rows, so they always know which column is which.
snippets.notes: Only works when the table is not inside a horizontally scrolling wrapper. Set --wpide-table-top to your sticky header height.

snippets.title: Animated Gradient Background Class
snippets.description: Adds a "wpide-animated-gradient" class that gives any Group or Cover block a slowly shifting multi-color gradient background, for eye-catching hero and CTA sections.
snippets.notes: Change the four colors in the gradient. The movement stops for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Frosted Glass Card Style (SCSS)
snippets.description: Adds a "wpide-glass" class for a frosted-glass look (blurred, semi-transparent background and fine border), great for cards placed over photos or gradients.
snippets.notes: Put a Group with the class wpide-glass inside a Cover block for the best effect. Browsers without backdrop blur get a solid fallback.

snippets.title: Play Videos on Hover
snippets.description: Plays muted Video blocks with the class "wpide-hover-play" while the mouse is over them and pauses when it leaves, like product previews in online stores.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-hover-play to the Video block's Additional CSS class(es). On touch screens a tap plays and pauses instead.

snippets.title: Pause Autoplaying Videos When Off Screen
snippets.description: Pauses background and autoplaying videos when they scroll out of view or the browser tab is hidden, and resumes them when they come back, saving battery and data.
snippets.notes: Only affects videos that autoplay muted, such as Cover block background videos.

snippets.title: "You Are Offline" Notice
snippets.description: Shows a small notice at the bottom of the screen when the visitor loses their internet connection and hides it when the connection returns, so failed clicks make sense.
snippets.code: You are offline. Some features may not work until your connection is back.
snippets.notes: Edit the message text in the HTML.

snippets.title: Smooth Open and Close Animation for Details Blocks
snippets.description: Animates Details (accordion) blocks so the answer slides open and closed smoothly instead of jumping, in browsers that support animating to auto height.
snippets.notes: Supported in recent Chrome and Edge; other browsers open instantly as before. Off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Nicer Line Breaks in Paragraphs and Headings
snippets.description: Avoids single orphan words on the last line of paragraphs and balances heading lines, using modern CSS text wrapping, for more polished typography.
snippets.notes: Browsers without support simply wrap text as usual.

snippets.title: Same-Size Thumbnails on Blog and Archive Pages
snippets.description: Crops featured images on blog, category and search pages to the same 16:9 shape, so post grids line up evenly even when images have different sizes.
snippets.notes: Change aspect-ratio to 4 / 3 or 1 for other shapes. Single posts show the full image.

snippets.title: Turn a Menu Item Into a Button
snippets.description: Styles any menu item with the CSS class "menu-button" as a solid call-to-action button, in classic theme menus and the Navigation block.
snippets.notes: Add menu-button to the item's CSS Classes (Appearance > Menus, enable it in Screen Options) or to a Navigation link block's Additional CSS class. Change the colors here.

snippets.title: Subtle Parallax Effect for Images
snippets.description: Gives images inside blocks with the class "wpide-parallax" a gentle parallax movement while scrolling, adding depth to hero and feature sections.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-parallax{overflow:hidden;}
.wpide-parallax img{will-change:transform;transform:scale(1.15);}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wpide-parallax img{transform:none;}}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) { return; }
    var items = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.wpide-parallax img'), function (img) {
        var box = img.closest('.wpide-parallax');
        return { img: img, box: box, speed: parseFloat(box.getAttribute('data-speed')) || 0.15 };
    });
    if (!items.length) { return; }
    var ticking = false;
    function update() {
        var vh = window.innerHeight;
        items.forEach(function (it) {
            var r = it.box.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (r.bottom < 0 || r.top > vh) { return; }
            var offset = (r.top + r.height / 2 - vh / 2) * -it.speed;
            it.img.style.transform = 'translate3d(0,' + offset.toFixed(1) + 'px,0) scale(1.15)';
        });
        ticking = false;
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function () { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(update); } }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', update);
    update();
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Add wpide-parallax to an Image or Group block. Set the strength with data-speed (not available in the editor), default 0.15. No movement for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Bouncing "Scroll Down" Arrow on Hero Sections
snippets.description: Adds a gently bouncing arrow to the bottom of any Cover block with the class "wpide-scroll-hint", inviting visitors to scroll past a full-screen hero.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-scroll-hint to the Cover block's Additional CSS class(es). The arrow is decorative and hidden from screen readers.

snippets.title: Collapsible Sidebar Widgets on Phones
snippets.description: Folds sidebar and footer widgets into tap-to-open sections on small screens, so visitors reach the content and footer without scrolling past long widget lists.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-widget-toggle{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:.6em 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-weight:700;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;}
.wpide-widget-toggle::after{content:"+";font-size:1.3em;line-height:1;}
.wpide-widget-toggle[aria-expanded="true"]::after{content:"\2212";}
.wpide-widget-body[hidden]{display:none;}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var breakpoint = 768;
    if (window.innerWidth >= breakpoint) { return; }
    document.querySelectorAll('.widget-area .widget, .sidebar .widget, .widget-area .wp-block-group').forEach(function (widget, i) {
        var title = widget.querySelector(':scope > .widget-title, :scope > .widgettitle, :scope > h2, :scope > .wp-block-heading');
        if (!title || widget.querySelector('.wpide-widget-toggle')) { return; }
        var body = document.createElement('div');
        body.className = 'wpide-widget-body';
        body.id = 'wpide-widget-body-' + i;
        body.hidden = true;
        while (title.nextSibling) { body.appendChild(title.nextSibling); }
        var btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.className = 'wpide-widget-toggle';
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-controls', body.id);
        btn.textContent = title.textContent;
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var open = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';
            btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
            body.hidden = !open;
        });
        title.textContent = '';
        title.appendChild(btn);
        widget.appendChild(body);
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Works with widgets that have a title (classic widget titles or a Heading block as the first item). Change the breakpoint at the top of the script.

snippets.title: Rotating Testimonials
snippets.description: Shows the items inside any block with the class "wpide-rotator" (for example Quote blocks in a Group) one at a time, rotating every few seconds with dot buttons to pick one.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-rotator>.wpide-rotator__item[hidden]{display:none;}
.wpide-rotator__dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:1em;}
.wpide-rotator__dots button{width:12px;height:12px;padding:0;border:2px solid currentColor;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;opacity:.6;}
.wpide-rotator__dots button[aria-current="true"]{background:currentColor;opacity:1;}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.wpide-rotator__item{animation:wpide-rotator-in .5s ease;}}
@keyframes wpide-rotator-in{from{opacity:0;}to{opacity:1;}}
</style>
<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.wpide-rotator').forEach(function (box) {
    var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(box.children);
    if (items.length < 2) { return; }
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    var dots = document.createElement('div');
    dots.className = 'wpide-rotator__dots';
    var current = 0, timer = null;
    function show(i) {
        current = (i + items.length) % items.length;
        items.forEach(function (item, n) { item.hidden = n !== current; });
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(dots.children, function (d, n) { d.setAttribute('aria-current', n === current ? 'true' : 'false'); });
    }
    items.forEach(function (item, n) {
        item.classList.add('wpide-rotator__item');
        var d = document.createElement('button');
        d.type = 'button';
        d.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Show item ' + (n + 1));
        d.addEventListener('click', function () { show(n); });
        dots.appendChild(d);
    });
    box.appendChild(dots);
    show(0);
    function start() { if (!reduce) { stop(); timer = setInterval(function () { show(current + 1); }, 6000); } }
    function stop() { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
    box.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
    box.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
    box.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
    box.addEventListener('focusout', start);
    start();
});
</script>
snippets.notes: Add wpide-rotator to a Group containing your quotes. Rotation pauses on hover and keyboard focus, and is off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Fix "Fixed Background" Cover Blocks on iPhone and iPad
snippets.description: Switches Cover blocks set to a fixed (parallax) background to a normal scrolling background on touch devices, where fixed backgrounds look blurry, zoomed or don't show at all.
snippets.notes: Desktop browsers keep the fixed background effect.

snippets.title: Slow Zoom (Ken Burns) Effect for Cover Images
snippets.description: Adds a slow, cinematic zoom to the background image of any Cover block with the class "wpide-ken-burns", for more lively hero sections without video.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-ken-burns to the Cover block's Additional CSS class(es). Off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Vertical Timeline Style for Groups (SCSS)
snippets.description: Turns the blocks inside a Group with the class "wpide-timeline" into a vertical timeline with a line and a dot for each step, for histories, roadmaps and processes.
snippets.notes: Put one Group (or heading + paragraph pair wrapped in a Group) per step inside the timeline Group.

snippets.title: Corner Ribbons: "New", "Sale" and "Popular" (SCSS)
snippets.description: Adds classes that put a diagonal corner ribbon on any block (wpide-ribbon-new, wpide-ribbon-sale, wpide-ribbon-popular), handy for pricing columns and product cards.
snippets.notes: Add the class to a Group or Column block. Add your own ribbons to the $ribbons map.

snippets.title: Wave Edge at the Bottom of Sections
snippets.description: Gives any Group or Cover block with the class "wpide-wave-bottom" a soft wavy bottom edge instead of a straight line, for friendlier section transitions.
snippets.notes: The wave is cut out of the block itself, so the next section's background shows through. Increase --wpide-wave-height for a taller wave.

snippets.title: Marker-Pen Animation for Highlighted Text
snippets.description: Animates highlighted text (the <mark> tag from the toolbar's Highlight option) with a marker stroke that sweeps across as the words scroll into view.
snippets.code:
<style>
.entry-content mark,.wp-block-post-content mark{--wpide-mark:#fde68a;background:linear-gradient(var(--wpide-mark),var(--wpide-mark)) no-repeat 0 85%/100% 45%;color:inherit;padding:0 .1em;}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.wpide-mark-pending{background-size:0 45%!important;}.wpide-mark-animate{transition:background-size .8s ease;}}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var marks = document.querySelectorAll('.entry-content mark, .wp-block-post-content mark');
    if (!marks.length || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) { return; }
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) { return; }
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) { io.unobserve(entry.target); entry.target.classList.remove('wpide-mark-pending'); }
        });
    }, { threshold: 1 });
    marks.forEach(function (m) {
        if (m.style.backgroundColor) { return; }
        m.classList.add('wpide-mark-pending', 'wpide-mark-animate');
        io.observe(m);
    });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Change the marker color in --wpide-mark. Visitors who prefer reduced motion see the highlight without animation.

snippets.title: Automatic Numbering for Headings (1, 1.1, 1.2...)
snippets.description: Numbers the H2 and H3 headings inside any block with the class "wpide-numbered-headings" (1., 1.1, 1.2, 2.), ideal for guides, documentation and terms pages.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-numbered-headings to the Post Content block (block themes) or to a Group that wraps your text.

snippets.title: Print the Page Address and Date on Printouts
snippets.description: Adds a line with the page's web address and the print date at the bottom of printed pages, so paper copies can always be traced back to the original.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-print-source{display:none;}
@media print{.wpide-print-source{display:block;margin-top:2em;padding-top:.6em;border-top:1px solid #999;font-size:10pt;color:#333;}}
</style>
<script>
window.addEventListener('beforeprint', function () {
    var note = document.querySelector('.wpide-print-source');
    if (!note) {
        note = document.createElement('p');
        note.className = 'wpide-print-source';
        document.body.appendChild(note);
    }
    note.textContent = 'Source: ' + window.location.href.split('#')[0] + ' \u2014 printed ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString();
});
</script>
snippets.notes: Only visible on paper or PDF exports; nothing changes on screen.

snippets.title: "Continue Where You Left Off" on Long Articles
snippets.description: Remembers how far a reader got in a long post (in their own browser only) and offers a "Continue reading" button when they come back, without cookies or accounts.
snippets.code: Continue where you left off?
snippets.notes: Uses the browser's localStorage, which is not sent to your server. Only single posts longer than about three screens are tracked.

snippets.title: Play YouTube Links in a Lightbox
snippets.description: Opens links to YouTube videos (with the class "wpide-video-lightbox" or around a thumbnail image) in a large on-page video player, and only contacts YouTube after the click.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-yt-box{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);}
.wpide-yt-box[hidden]{display:none;}
.wpide-yt-box iframe{width:min(1100px,100%);aspect-ratio:16/9;height:auto;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#000;}
.wpide-yt-close{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;width:46px;height:46px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#fff;font-size:28px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
    var box = null, last = null;
    function videoId(url) {
        var m = /(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?(?:.*&)?v=|shorts\/|embed\/)|youtu\.be\/)([\w-]{11})/.exec(url || '');
        return m ? m[1] : null;
    }
    function close() { if (box) { box.hidden = true; box.querySelector('iframe').src = 'about:blank'; if (last) { last.focus(); } } }
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var link = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href*="youtu"]') : null;
        if (!link || !(link.matches('.wpide-video-lightbox, .wpide-video-lightbox a') || link.querySelector('img'))) { return; }
        var id = videoId(link.href);
        if (!id) { return; }
        e.preventDefault();
        last = link;
        if (!box) {
            box = document.createElement('div');
            box.className = 'wpide-yt-box';
            box.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
            box.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
            box.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Video player');
            box.innerHTML = '<iframe title="YouTube video" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; fullscreen" allowfullscreen></iframe><button type="button" class="wpide-yt-close" aria-label="Close video">×</button>';
            box.addEventListener('click', function (ev) { if (ev.target === box || ev.target.closest('.wpide-yt-close')) { close(); } });
            document.body.appendChild(box);
        }
        box.querySelector('iframe').src = 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/' + id + '?autoplay=1&rel=0';
        box.hidden = false;
        box.querySelector('.wpide-yt-close').focus();
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') { close(); } });
})();
</script>
snippets.notes: Add wpide-video-lightbox to a Button block or link a thumbnail image to a YouTube URL. Videos play from youtube-nocookie.com.

snippets.title: Make Whole Cards Clickable
snippets.description: Makes an entire Group, Column or Query Loop card with the class "wpide-card-link" clickable, using the link in its heading, so visitors don't have to hit the small title link.
snippets.notes: The link in the card's heading (or Post Title block) becomes the click target; other links and buttons inside stay clickable on their own.

snippets.title: Reverse Column Order on Phones
snippets.description: Flips the stacking order of a Columns block with the class "wpide-reverse-mobile" on phones, so an image placed on the right appears above its text instead of below.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-reverse-mobile to the Columns block's Additional CSS class(es). Desktop order stays the same.

snippets.title: Elementor Posts Query: Random Order
snippets.description: Adds a custom query ID "wpide_random" that shows posts in random order in Elementor Pro's Posts and Loop Grid widgets, for testimonials, team members or featured products.
snippets.notes: Type wpide_random in the Query ID field. Page caching will freeze the order until the cache is cleared.

snippets.title: Elementor Forms: Check Phone Numbers
snippets.description: Rejects Elementor Pro form submissions whose phone (Tel) field contains letters or too few digits, so you get numbers you can actually call back.
snippets.notes: Change the minimum and maximum digit counts for your country.

snippets.title: Body Class for Pages Built With Elementor
snippets.description: Adds a "wpide-elementor-page" class to the body of pages built with Elementor, so your theme CSS can treat designed pages differently from regular posts.
snippets.notes: Use it in CSS, for example .wpide-elementor-page .site-content { padding: 0; }.

snippets.title: Stop Beaver Builder Loading Font Awesome for Visitors
snippets.description: Removes the Font Awesome icon stylesheets that Beaver Builder loads on the front end, for sites whose layouts use no Font Awesome icons.
snippets.notes: Check your pages after enabling it: any Font Awesome icons in modules will disappear. Logged-in users keep the icons so the builder works.

snippets.title: Hide Beaver Builder Templates From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes the Beaver Builder templates and saved rows menu from wp-admin for everyone but administrators, so shared layouts are not edited by mistake.

snippets.title: Full-Screen Mobile Menu in Divi
snippets.description: Turns the small dropdown mobile menu of Divi's default header into a full-screen menu with large, easy-to-tap links.
snippets.notes: Change the background and text colors to match your brand.

snippets.title: Hide the Divi Library From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes the Divi Library menu (saved layouts, sections and modules) for everyone except administrators, so global elements are not changed by accident.

snippets.title: Hide Bricks Templates From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes the Bricks Templates menu for everyone except administrators, protecting headers, footers and popups built as Bricks templates.

snippets.title: Show the Navigation Block's Mobile Menu on Tablets Too
snippets.description: Switches the Navigation block to its hamburger (mobile) menu up to 1024px wide instead of 600px, so long menus no longer squeeze or wrap on tablets.
snippets.notes: Change 1023px to another width to move the breakpoint. Only affects Navigation blocks set to show the overlay menu on mobile.

snippets.title: Query Loop Block: Random Order
snippets.description: Shows posts in random order in any Query Loop block with the class "wpide-random-order", for rotating testimonials, team members or featured posts.
snippets.notes: Add wpide-random-order to the Query Loop's Additional CSS class(es). With page caching the order only changes when the cache is refreshed.

snippets.title: Query Loop Block: Only Posts From the Last 30 Days
snippets.description: Limits any Query Loop block with the class "wpide-recent" to posts published in the last 30 days, for "This month" or "Fresh this week" sections.
snippets.notes: Change the number of days at the top. Use the class wpide-recent on the Query Loop block.

snippets.title: Query Loop Block: Upcoming Items by a Date Field
snippets.description: Shows only items whose date field (such as an event date) is today or later in any Query Loop block with the class "wpide-upcoming", sorted soonest first.
snippets.notes: The field must store Ymd dates (20261231), the ACF date picker default. Set the field name at the top.

snippets.title: Body Classes for the Blocks Used on a Page
snippets.description: Adds body classes such as "has-block-cover" or "has-block-gallery" for the main blocks a post or page contains, so CSS can adapt the header or layout to the content.
snippets.notes: Only the blocks in the list are checked, which keeps it fast. Add any block name you want to style against.

snippets.title: Remove the "Designed with WordPress" Footer Credit
snippets.description: Removes the "Designed with WordPress" or "Powered by WordPress" credit line from the footer of default block themes like Twenty Twenty-Four and Twenty Twenty-Five, without editing the template.
snippets.notes: Matches paragraphs containing one of the phrases and a link to wordpress.org. Add your theme's wording to the list if it differs.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Pros and Cons
snippets.description: Adds a two-column "Pros and cons" pattern with checkmark and cross lists, for reviews, comparisons and buying guides.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Team Members
snippets.description: Adds a team section pattern with three members, each with a name, role and short bio in columns, ready for you to add photos.
snippets.notes: Insert an Image block above each name to add photos; the "Rounded" image style looks good here.

snippets.title: Button Block Style: Arrow
snippets.description: Adds an "Arrow" style to the Button block that shows a small arrow after the text which nudges forward on hover, a classic "Learn more" look.
snippets.notes: The hover movement is turned off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Turn Headings Into an Accordion
snippets.description: Turns every H3 inside a block with the class "wpide-accordion" into a clickable question that shows or hides the content below it, for FAQs written as plain headings and paragraphs.
snippets.code:
<style>
.wpide-accordion h3 button{all:inherit;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;width:100%;cursor:pointer;}
.wpide-accordion h3 button::after{content:"+";font-weight:400;margin-left:1em;}
.wpide-accordion h3 button[aria-expanded="true"]::after{content:"\2212";}
.wpide-accordion h3 button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:3px;}
.wpide-accordion .wpide-accordion__panel[hidden]{display:none;}
</style>
<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.wpide-accordion').forEach(function (box, b) {
    box.querySelectorAll(':scope > h3').forEach(function (heading, i) {
        var panel = document.createElement('div');
        panel.className = 'wpide-accordion__panel';
        panel.id = 'wpide-acc-' + b + '-' + i;
        panel.hidden = true;
        while (heading.nextElementSibling && heading.nextElementSibling.tagName !== 'H3') {
            panel.appendChild(heading.nextElementSibling);
        }
        heading.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', panel);
        var button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        button.setAttribute('aria-controls', panel.id);
        while (heading.firstChild) { button.appendChild(heading.firstChild); }
        heading.appendChild(button);
        button.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var open = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true';
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
            panel.hidden = !open;
        });
    });
});
</script>
snippets.notes: Add wpide-accordion to a Group block containing H3 headings followed by their answers. Without JavaScript everything stays visible.

snippets.title: Gradient Text Class for Headings
snippets.description: Adds a "wpide-gradient-text" class that fills a heading's letters with a color gradient, for standout hero titles and highlighted words.
snippets.notes: Add the class to a Heading block, or wrap a few words in a span with the class using the HTML editor. Change the two colors to your brand.

snippets.title: Full-Screen Snap Scrolling Between Sections
snippets.description: Makes the page snap from one full-screen section to the next while scrolling, for presentation-style landing pages built from Cover or Group blocks with the class "wpide-snap".
snippets.notes: Add wpide-snap to each full-height section. Snapping only turns on for pages that contain such sections, and not for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

snippets.title: Elementor Posts Query: Only Sticky (Featured) Posts
snippets.description: Adds a custom query ID "wpide_sticky" that shows only the posts you marked as sticky, so a "Featured articles" section in Elementor Pro stays in sync with the post editor's Sticky option.
snippets.notes: Type wpide_sticky in the Query ID field. When no post is sticky, the widget shows nothing.

snippets.title: Block Pattern: Plan Comparison Table
snippets.description: Adds a comparison table pattern with a header row and check marks for comparing plans, products or options side by side.
snippets.notes: Edit cells directly in the table after inserting. Pair it with the "Lined" or "Hover rows" table styles.

snippets.title: Cover Block Style: Bottom Gradient for Readable Text
snippets.description: Adds a "Bottom gradient" style to the Cover block that darkens only the lower part of the image, so captions and headings at the bottom stay readable while the photo stays bright.
snippets.notes: Set the Cover's overlay opacity to 0 and place the text at the bottom for the best result.

snippets.title: Post Template Block Style: Numbered Ranking
snippets.description: Adds a "Numbered ranking" style to the Post Template block inside Query Loops, which puts a large 1, 2, 3... next to each post, for "Top 10" and "Most popular" lists.
snippets.notes: Select the Post Template block (inside the Query Loop) and choose the style. Works best with the List layout.

snippets.title: Briefly Highlight the Section You Jumped To
snippets.description: Flashes a soft highlight behind a heading or section when visitors arrive through a #link (from a table of contents or another page), so they instantly see where they landed.
snippets.notes: Change the highlight color in the keyframes. Visitors who prefer reduced motion get a static outline instead.

snippets.title: Prevent Double Form Submissions
snippets.description: Disables a form's submit button and shows "Sending…" right after it is clicked, so impatient visitors cannot send comments, enquiries or orders twice.
snippets.notes: Forms that submit with AJAX re-enable the button after 8 seconds. Add the class wpide-allow-resubmit to a form to skip it.

snippets.title: Free Shipping for a Customer Role
snippets.description: Makes your Free Shipping method available to customers with a chosen role, such as wholesale buyers or VIPs, whatever their cart total.
snippets.notes: Add a Free Shipping method to each shipping zone first; this snippet only switches it on for the listed roles.

snippets.title: Free Shipping From a Number of Items
snippets.description: Unlocks the Free Shipping method once the cart holds a set number of items, for example six bottles or three books, instead of a money threshold.
snippets.notes: Each shipping zone needs a Free Shipping method, and that method's own minimum amount or coupon rule still applies if it is stricter.

snippets.title: Free Shipping When the Cart Has a Category
snippets.description: Offers free shipping whenever the cart contains a product from a chosen category, handy for promoting a new collection or bulky-but-profitable lines.
snippets.notes: Uses category slugs; set $wpide_free_ship_mode to 'all' to require every item in the cart to be in those categories.

snippets.title: Free Shipping During a Promotion Period
snippets.description: Turns on free shipping for everyone between two dates, so a free-shipping weekend or holiday promotion starts and stops by itself.
snippets.notes: Dates use the site's timezone, and the shipping zone needs a Free Shipping method for the offer to appear.

snippets.title: Offer a Shipping Method Only to Listed Postcodes
snippets.description: Shows a method such as local delivery or same-day courier only when the shipping postcode matches your list or starts with one of your prefixes.
snippets.notes: Use the rate ID shown in WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping (for example flat_rate:3); postcodes ending in * match by prefix.

snippets.title: Remote Area Shipping Surcharge
snippets.description: Adds a surcharge to the order when the shipping postcode is in a remote area you list, such as islands or highland regions that carriers charge extra for.
snippets.notes: Postcodes match by prefix, so 'HS' covers HS1 to HS9; set 'taxable' to false if the fee should not be taxed.

snippets.title: Weight-Based Flat Rate Shipping Cost
snippets.description: Recalculates your Flat Rate shipping price from the parcel weight using tiers you set, for example 4.95 up to 2 kg and 7.95 up to 10 kg.
snippets.notes: Weights use your store's weight unit, and above the last tier the extra cost is added for every unit over it.

snippets.title: Hide a Shipping Method Above a Weight
snippets.description: Removes a light-parcel option, such as letter post or a small flat rate, when the order is heavier than that service allows.
snippets.notes: Use a method ID (flat_rate, free_shipping) to hide every instance or a full rate ID such as flat_rate:5 for one.

snippets.title: Handling Fee per Item in a Shipping Class
snippets.description: Charges an extra handling fee for each unit from a shipping class such as "fragile" or "oversized", listed as its own line in the totals.
snippets.notes: Use the shipping class slug from WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Classes.

snippets.title: Shipping Methods Reserved for Certain Roles
snippets.description: Hides chosen shipping methods, such as pallet delivery or trade collection, from everyone except customers with the roles you list.
snippets.notes: List method IDs (local_pickup) or rate IDs (flat_rate:7); guests never see these methods.

snippets.title: Sort Shipping Options From Cheapest to Most Expensive
snippets.description: Lists the available shipping methods in price order on the cart and checkout, so the cheapest option is always shown first.
snippets.notes: Free methods come first; pair it with "Select the Cheapest Shipping Method by Default" to preselect the cheapest one too.

snippets.title: Select the Cheapest Shipping Method by Default
snippets.description: Preselects the lowest-priced shipping option for new carts instead of whichever method happens to be first in the zone.
snippets.notes: Only sets the default; a method the customer picks themselves is kept.

snippets.title: Descriptions Under Shipping Methods
snippets.description: Prints a short explanation under each shipping option at checkout, such as delivery times or "signature required", so customers know what they are choosing.
snippets.notes: Keys can be rate IDs (flat_rate:1) or method IDs (local_pickup), and the notes show on the classic cart and checkout.

snippets.title: Show "Free" Next to Zero-Cost Shipping Methods
snippets.description: Adds a clear "Free" label to shipping options that cost nothing, such as local pickup, which WooCommerce otherwise shows with no price at all.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_free_text to translate or restyle the label.

snippets.title: Flat Handling Fee on Shipped Orders
snippets.description: Adds a fixed packing and handling charge to every order that needs shipping, while downloads and services stay fee-free.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_handling['taxable'] to match how your accountant treats handling charges.

snippets.title: Discount for Choosing Local Pickup
snippets.description: Rewards customers who collect their order in person with a percentage off the products, shown as a discount line when local pickup is selected.
snippets.notes: Works with both the classic Local Pickup method and the block checkout's pickup_location method.

snippets.title: Ship a Category Only to Certain Countries
snippets.description: Stops checkout when the cart contains products from a restricted category, such as batteries or plants, and the shipping country is not on your allowed list.
snippets.notes: Uses two-letter country codes, and the error message names the products that cannot be shipped.

snippets.title: Block PO Box Shipping Addresses
snippets.description: Rejects checkout when the shipping address is a PO Box or post office locker, for couriers that cannot deliver there.
snippets.notes: Checks both address lines of the address the order ships to; extend $wpide_po_patterns for other languages.

snippets.title: Accept Orders Only for Your Delivery Area
snippets.description: Stops checkout with a friendly message when the delivery postcode is outside the area you serve, ideal for local food, flower or furniture delivery.
snippets.notes: Postcodes ending in * match by prefix, and orders that do not need shipping are never checked.

snippets.title: Preferred Delivery Date Field at Checkout
snippets.description: Adds a date picker to the classic checkout so customers can choose a delivery date after your lead time, then shows the date on the order screen and in emails.
snippets.notes: Uses the browser's date picker; set 'lead_days' for the earliest date and 'skip_weekends' to refuse Saturdays and Sundays.

snippets.title: Delivery Time Slot Choice at Checkout
snippets.description: Lets customers pick a delivery time window, such as morning or evening, on the classic checkout and saves it on the order for your drivers.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_slots to match your delivery rounds; the chosen slot appears on the order screen and in order emails.

snippets.title: Delivery Day Selector on the Block Checkout
snippets.description: Adds a required "Delivery day" dropdown to the Checkout block listing the next working days, stored on the order with WooCommerce's additional fields API.
snippets.notes: Needs WooCommerce 8.9 or newer with the Checkout block, and the chosen day appears on the order screen and in emails automatically.

snippets.title: Tax-Exempt Customer Roles
snippets.description: Removes tax from the cart and checkout for customers with roles you choose, such as charities, resellers or schools with tax exemption.
snippets.notes: Orders record the exemption in WooCommerce's is_vat_exempt field, so keep proof of exemption on file for each customer.

snippets.title: Tax Exemption Checkbox With Certificate Number
snippets.description: Adds an "I am tax exempt" checkbox and certificate number to the classic checkout; when ticked, tax is removed and the number is saved on the order.
snippets.notes: The snippet only checks that a certificate number was entered, so verify numbers before you ship.

snippets.title: EU VAT Number Field With Format Check
snippets.description: Adds an optional VAT number field to the classic checkout, checks it matches the official format for the billing country, and saves it to the order and emails.
snippets.notes: Checks the number's format only (it does not contact VIES) and stores it as _billing_vat_number under the billing address.

snippets.title: Reverse Charge VAT for EU Business Buyers
snippets.description: Removes VAT for business customers in another EU country who enter a VAT number, and adds a "reverse charge" note to the order, as cross-border B2B sales require.
snippets.notes: Needs the "EU VAT Number Field With Format Check" snippet for the billing_vat_number field; confirm the rules for your business with your accountant.

snippets.title: Show Prices Without Tax to Business Customers
snippets.description: Displays shop and cart prices excluding tax for trade roles, while regular shoppers keep seeing tax-inclusive prices.
snippets.notes: Only changes how prices are shown; the tax charged at checkout is unchanged.

snippets.title: Show Prices Both With and Without Tax
snippets.description: Adds the tax-exclusive price under every tax-inclusive price (or the reverse), so both consumers and business buyers see the number they need.
snippets.notes: Needs taxes enabled in WooCommerce; edit the two labels to match your local wording, such as VAT, GST or MwSt.

snippets.title: Zero-Rate Tax Class for a Category
snippets.description: Applies a different tax class, such as Zero rate or Reduced rate, to every product in chosen categories, so you do not have to edit each product.
snippets.notes: Use the tax class slug from WooCommerce > Settings > Tax (zero-rate, reduced-rate); variations follow their parent's categories.

snippets.title: Simplify the Cart Shipping Calculator
snippets.description: Removes the city and postcode or state boxes from the cart's shipping calculator when your rates only depend on the country.
snippets.notes: Set any of the three values to true to keep that field.

snippets.title: "Free Shipping Over X" Note on Product Pages
snippets.description: Shows a small free-shipping reminder under the price on product pages, with the threshold taken from your settings, to nudge bigger orders.
snippets.notes: Hidden on virtual and downloadable products; change the wording in $wpide_ship_note.

snippets.title: Hide Express Shipping After the Daily Cut-Off
snippets.description: Removes your next-day or express shipping option after a set time and at weekends, so customers are not promised a delivery you cannot dispatch.
snippets.notes: Uses the site's timezone, and rates refresh every hour so the option disappears on time for open carts.

snippets.title: Optional Shipping Insurance at Checkout
snippets.description: Offers a "Protect my parcel" checkbox on the classic checkout that adds an insurance fee based on the order value, and updates the totals instantly.
snippets.notes: The fee is a percentage of the subtotal with a minimum, and customers can untick it any time before paying.

snippets.title: Gift Wrapping Option at Checkout
snippets.description: Adds a "Gift wrap this order" checkbox to the classic checkout for a small fee and flags the order so your packers can spot it.
snippets.notes: Set the price and label at the top; gift-wrapped orders are flagged on the order screen.

snippets.title: Wholesale Price Field per Product
snippets.description: Adds a "Wholesale price" box to simple products and variations, and charges that price to customers with your wholesale role instead of the retail price.
snippets.notes: The wholesale role must already exist, and products with an empty wholesale price charge wholesale buyers the normal price.

snippets.title: Quantity Price Breaks With a Price Table
snippets.description: Lowers the unit price when a customer buys more of the same product, for example 5% off from 10 units, and shows a price-break table on the product page.
snippets.notes: Tiers apply per cart line; list product IDs in 'products' to limit them, or leave it empty for every product.

snippets.title: Minimum Order Amount for Wholesale Customers
snippets.description: Requires trade customers to reach a higher minimum order value than retail shoppers before they can check out.
snippets.notes: The minimum is compared with the cart subtotal before shipping, and retail customers are not affected.

snippets.title: Product Category Visible Only to Certain Roles
snippets.description: Hides a category's products from the shop, search and product pages for everyone except the roles you choose, such as trade customers or members.
snippets.notes: Add 'logged_in' to the roles to show the category to any signed-in customer; direct links to hidden products show a 404 page.

snippets.title: "Available In Store Only" Products by Category
snippets.description: Lets customers browse products from chosen categories online but removes the Add to Cart button and shows an "available in store only" message instead.
snippets.notes: Products stay visible with their price; add your opening hours or address to the message.

snippets.title: "Price on Request" for a Category
snippets.description: Hides prices and the Add to Cart button for products in chosen categories and shows a "Request a price" button that links to your contact page.
snippets.notes: The product title is added to the contact link as ?product=, which form plugins can use to prefill a field.

snippets.title: Minimum Combined Quantity for a Category
snippets.description: Requires customers to buy a minimum number of items from a category in total, for example any 6 wines, mixed as they like.
snippets.notes: Only carts that contain the category are checked, so other products can still be bought on their own.

snippets.title: Sell a Category in Multiples (Cases)
snippets.description: Makes the total quantity from a category a multiple of a case size, for example 6 or 12 bottles, and explains how many more to add.
snippets.notes: Different products in the category can be mixed within a case.

snippets.title: Maximum Quantity Field per Product
snippets.description: Adds a "Maximum per order" field to the product Inventory tab and enforces it in the quantity box and the cart, for limited releases or allocated stock.
snippets.notes: Leave the field empty for no limit; variations follow the limit set on their parent product.

snippets.title: Buy 3, Get the Cheapest One Free
snippets.description: Runs a "buy X, get one free" deal automatically: for every set of items in the cart, the cheapest one is discounted to zero, shown as a line in the totals.
snippets.notes: Set the group size and optional categories at the top; a cart notice tells shoppers how many more items unlock the next free one.

snippets.title: Bundle Discount for Products Bought Together
snippets.description: Gives a discount when a set of products is in the cart together, and suggests the missing items with an add-to-cart link when only part of the bundle is there.
snippets.notes: Add more entries to $wpide_bundles for more bundles; the discount applies once per complete bundle in the cart.

snippets.title: Unit Price Display (Price per kg, litre or item)
snippets.description: Shows a comparison price such as "4.50 / kg" under the product price, calculated from a unit quantity you enter on each product.
snippets.notes: Enter the pack contents (for example 0.5 for 500 g) and the unit on each product's General tab; products without them are unchanged.

snippets.title: Hide ".00" on Whole-Number Prices
snippets.description: Shows round prices as 25 instead of 25.00 while keeping decimals on prices that need them, such as 24.99.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_price_trim_zeros', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Affects every price WooCommerce formats, including the cart and emails.

snippets.title: "Was / Now" Sale Price Format
snippets.description: Replaces the crossed-out sale price layout with clear "Now 20.00, was 25.00" wording that reads better and works with screen readers.
snippets.notes: Change the words in $wpide_was_now to match your tone.

snippets.title: Hide the Price Range Until a Variation Is Chosen
snippets.description: Removes the "10.00 to 50.00" range at the top of variable product pages, so the exact price appears only once the shopper picks options.
snippets.notes: Shop listings keep their price range, and the variation price shows even when all variations cost the same.

snippets.title: Price Label Field per Product ("per m²", "per month")
snippets.description: Adds a field to each product for a short label shown after its price, such as "per m²", "per person" or "per night".
snippets.notes: The label appears wherever the price is shown, and variations use their parent product's label.

snippets.title: "Featured" Badge on Featured Products
snippets.description: Shows a "Featured" or "Staff pick" badge on the image of products you have starred as featured, in the shop and on product pages.
snippets.notes: Star products in Products > All Products to feature them, and change the badge text and colours at the top.

snippets.title: Product Badges From Product Tags
snippets.description: Turns chosen product tags into coloured badges on product images, so tagging a product "vegan" or "limited" instantly shows a matching label.
snippets.notes: Map each tag slug to a label and colour; products with several mapped tags show several badges.

snippets.title: "Pre-Order" Badge for Backorder Products
snippets.description: Labels products that are out of stock but allow backorders with a "Pre-order" badge in the shop and on product pages, so buyers know shipping will be later.
snippets.notes: Shows on products whose stock status is "On backorder"; change the text to "Backorder" or "Ships later" if you prefer.

snippets.title: Hide Products Without a Price From the Shop
snippets.description: Keeps unfinished products that have no price yet out of the shop, category pages and product searches until you add one.
snippets.notes: Products stay reachable by direct link, and variable products are listed when any variation has a price.

snippets.title: "Sort by SKU" Option in the Shop
snippets.description: Adds a "Sort by product code" choice to the shop's sorting dropdown, useful for trade catalogues where customers order by code.
snippets.notes: Products without a SKU are listed last.

snippets.title: "Sort by Name (A to Z)" Option in the Shop
snippets.description: Adds alphabetical sorting to the shop's sorting dropdown, in both A to Z and Z to A directions.
snippets.notes: Rename the labels in the first filter to suit your shop.

snippets.title: "Most Reviewed" Sorting Option
snippets.description: Adds a "Sort by most reviewed" choice to the shop so shoppers can find the products other customers talk about most.
snippets.notes: Uses the review count WooCommerce already stores, so it adds no extra work per page.

snippets.title: Different Default Sorting per Category
snippets.description: Sets the default product order for specific categories, for example newest first for "New arrivals" and price for "Clearance", while others keep the store default.
snippets.notes: Values are the sorting keys WooCommerce uses: menu_order, popularity, rating, date, price, price-desc.

snippets.title: "Shuffle" Sorting That Changes Daily
snippets.description: Adds a random order option to the shop sorting that stays the same all day, so pagination works and every product gets its turn at the top.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_shuffle_default to true to make it the default order for the shop.

snippets.title: Custom Product Tab Edited per Product
snippets.description: Adds an editor box to each product for an extra tab, such as "Ingredients" or "Specifications", that only appears on products where you filled it in.
snippets.notes: Change the tab title in $wpide_field_tab; the content allows post HTML and runs shortcodes.

snippets.title: Product Video Tab
snippets.description: Adds a "Video" field to products and shows the video (YouTube, Vimeo or an uploaded MP4) in its own product tab.
snippets.notes: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link or a media library MP4 URL; WordPress caches the embed after the first view.

snippets.title: Shared Product Tab for One Category
snippets.description: Adds the same extra tab, such as "Care instructions" for clothing or "Allergens" for food, to every product in the categories you choose.
snippets.notes: Edit the content here once and every product in the categories updates; shortcodes are run.

snippets.title: Downloads Tab With Manuals and Data Sheets
snippets.description: Adds a "Documents" field to products for links to manuals, data sheets or certificates, listed in a Downloads tab on the product page.
snippets.notes: Enter one document per line as "Label | URL", using URLs of PDFs uploaded to the media library.

snippets.title: More Products per Page on Search Results
snippets.description: Shows a different number of products on product search results than on normal shop pages, so shoppers see more matches at once.
snippets.notes: Only affects product searches; shop and category pages keep their own setting.

snippets.title: Change the Product Search Placeholder
snippets.description: Replaces the "Search products…" hint inside WooCommerce's product search box with your own text, such as "Search 2,000 parts by name or code".
snippets.notes: Affects the classic product search widget and get_product_search_form(); the Product Search block has its own placeholder setting.

snippets.title: Match Product Searches on Titles Only
snippets.description: Makes product searches look only at product names instead of full descriptions, giving shorter and more relevant results for catalogues with long descriptions.
snippets.notes: Only product searches on the front end are affected; blog searches keep matching content.

snippets.title: Send Searches That Match a Category to It
snippets.description: Takes shoppers straight to a product category page when what they search for is exactly a category name, such as "dresses" or "garden tools".
snippets.notes: Matching ignores upper and lower case, and partial matches still show the normal search results.

snippets.title: Product Subtitle Field
snippets.description: Adds a subtitle field to products and shows it under the product name on product pages and in shop listings, for taglines like "Organic cotton, made in Portugal".
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_subtitle_in_loop to false to show it on product pages only.

snippets.title: Replace Shop "Add to Cart" With "View Product"
snippets.description: Swaps the Add to Cart buttons in shop listings for a "View product" button, so customers see the full details and options before buying.
snippets.notes: Product pages keep their normal Add to Cart button.

snippets.title: Show SKUs in the Cart, Checkout and Orders
snippets.description: Prints each product's SKU under its name in the cart, checkout and order details, which trade buyers and phone orders often need.
snippets.notes: Variations show their own SKU, or the parent's if they have none.

snippets.title: Grey Out Out-of-Stock Variations
snippets.description: Makes sold-out variations unselectable in the product options dropdowns, so customers cannot pick a size or colour you no longer have.
snippets.notes: Works best for products with up to 30 variations, where WooCommerce loads all variation data on the page.

snippets.title: "Out of Stock" Labels in Variation Dropdowns
snippets.description: Adds "(out of stock)" next to sold-out options in the variation dropdown of single-attribute products, such as sizes, so shoppers see availability before choosing.
snippets.notes: Applies to products whose variations use one attribute; products with several attributes are left unchanged.

snippets.title: Scheduled Percentage Sale on a Category
snippets.description: Puts every product in chosen categories on sale by a percentage between two dates, with sale badges and crossed-out prices, without editing products.
snippets.notes: Dates use the site's timezone, and products that already have a lower sale price keep it.

snippets.title: Automatic Discount on a Customer's First Order
snippets.description: Takes a percentage off the first order of new customers, checked against their account or billing email, to win first-time buyers without coupon codes.
snippets.notes: Guests get the discount once they enter an email address with no previous paid orders, and the check is cached per email for the session.

snippets.title: Spend More, Save More Discount Tiers
snippets.description: Gives a bigger percentage discount as the cart subtotal grows, for example 5% over 100 and 10% over 200, and tells shoppers how close they are to the next tier.
snippets.notes: Only the highest tier reached applies, and the cart notice disappears once the top tier is reached.

snippets.title: Reorder the Billing and Shipping Fields
snippets.description: Changes the order of checkout address fields, for example country first and postcode before city, to match how addresses are written in your market.
snippets.notes: Lower numbers come first; field keys have no billing_ or shipping_ prefix and apply to both address forms.

snippets.title: Make the Company Name Required
snippets.description: Turns the optional Company field into a required one for stores that sell only to businesses.
snippets.notes: Make sure the Company field is not hidden in Appearance > Customize > WooCommerce > Checkout.

snippets.title: Change Checkout Field Labels and Placeholders
snippets.description: Renames checkout fields and their placeholder hints, for example "Town / City" to "City" or "Apartment, suite, unit" to "Flat or floor", without a translation plugin.
snippets.notes: Use full field keys such as billing_city or order_comments, and leave a value empty to keep WooCommerce's default.

snippets.title: Put Postcode and City on One Row
snippets.description: Places the postcode and city fields side by side on the checkout, which saves space and matches how many countries write addresses.
snippets.notes: On phones the two fields still stack, as with WooCommerce's first and last name fields.

snippets.title: Skip Address Fields When Local Pickup Is Chosen
snippets.description: Hides and stops requiring the street address fields on the classic checkout when the customer picks Local Pickup, since you will not deliver the order.
snippets.notes: Name, email and phone stay required, and the address fields come back if the customer switches to a delivery method.

snippets.title: Purchase Order Number Field at Checkout
snippets.description: Adds an optional "PO number" field to the classic checkout for business buyers and shows it on the order screen, in emails and on the customer's order page.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_po_required to true to make the field mandatory; the value is saved as the order meta _wpide_po_number.

snippets.title: Extra Agreement Checkbox for Certain Products
snippets.description: Adds a required checkbox to the checkout only when the cart has products from a chosen category, for example "I understand personalised items cannot be returned".
snippets.notes: The agreement is recorded as an order note so you can show it was accepted.

snippets.title: Tidy Names and Postcodes Entered at Checkout
snippets.description: Cleans up what customers type before the order is saved: names get proper capitals, postcodes become upper case and stray spaces are removed.
snippets.notes: Names typed in mixed case, such as "McDonald", are left as typed; only all-lower or all-upper names are changed.

snippets.title: Block Disposable Email Addresses at Checkout
snippets.description: Refuses orders placed with throwaway email services, so order confirmations, downloads and receipts reach a real inbox.
snippets.notes: Add domains to the list as you spot them; subdomains of listed domains are blocked too.

snippets.title: Block Checkout for Listed Emails and Phone Numbers
snippets.description: Stops orders from customers on your block list, such as repeat chargeback offenders, matched by email address, email domain or phone number.
snippets.notes: Phone numbers are compared by digits only, and the message is deliberately neutral so blocked customers are not told why.

snippets.title: Limit Address Line Length for Shipping Labels
snippets.description: Stops checkout when an address line is longer than your carrier's label allows (often 35 characters) and asks the customer to use the second line.
snippets.notes: Also sets a maxlength on the fields so customers see the limit while typing.

snippets.title: Require Latin Characters in Addresses
snippets.description: Asks customers to type their name and address in Latin letters, for international carriers whose labels cannot print other alphabets.
snippets.notes: Accented letters such as é, ü and ø are allowed; edit $wpide_latin_fields to check more or fewer fields.

snippets.title: Require a House Number in the Street Address
snippets.description: Catches addresses typed without a house or building number, one of the most common reasons parcels come back undelivered.
snippets.notes: Only orders that need shipping are checked; add countries where addresses often have no numbers to $wpide_house_number_skip.

snippets.title: Make the State / County Field Optional
snippets.description: Stops requiring the state, county or province at checkout for every country, for stores whose couriers do not need it.
snippets.notes: The field stays visible; customers can still fill it in.

snippets.title: Purchase Order Number on the Block Checkout
snippets.description: Adds an optional "Purchase order number" field to the Checkout block for business buyers, saved on the order with WooCommerce's additional fields API.
snippets.notes: Needs WooCommerce 8.9 or newer, and the value appears on the order screen, in emails and on the confirmation page automatically.

snippets.title: VAT Number Field on the Block Checkout
snippets.description: Adds an optional VAT number field to the contact section of the Checkout block and rejects numbers that do not look like a VAT number.
snippets.notes: Needs WooCommerce 8.9 or newer; the check covers the format (country prefix plus 8 to 12 characters) and does not contact VIES.

snippets.title: Newsletter Opt-In on the Block Checkout
snippets.description: Adds an unticked "Send me news and offers" checkbox to the Checkout block and saves the answer on the order, so you only email customers who agreed.
snippets.notes: Needs WooCommerce 8.9 or newer; read the answer with $order->get_meta( '_wc_other/wpide/newsletter' ) when syncing to your mailing tool.

snippets.title: Cancel Unpaid Bank Transfer Orders After a Few Days
snippets.description: Automatically cancels on-hold orders paid by bank transfer or cheque that are still unpaid after a set number of days, returning the stock to your shop.
snippets.notes: Runs daily through WP-Cron, 50 orders per run, and customers get WooCommerce's cancelled order email if it is enabled.

snippets.title: Complete Processing Orders After a Set Number of Days
snippets.description: Marks processing orders as completed automatically a number of days after purchase, for stores where you do not update orders when they are delivered.
snippets.notes: Runs daily through WP-Cron, 50 orders per run, and customers get the "Order completed" email if it is enabled.

snippets.title: Put High-Value Orders On Hold for Review
snippets.description: Sends paid orders above an amount to "On hold" instead of "Processing", so you can check them for fraud before shipping.
snippets.notes: The payment is still taken and only the status changes, so move checked orders to Processing yourself.

snippets.title: Flag Orders Whose Billing and Shipping Countries Differ
snippets.description: Adds a private order note, and optionally holds the order, when the billing and shipping countries do not match, a common sign of card fraud.
snippets.notes: Works with the classic and block checkouts; set $wpide_mismatch_hold to true to also put these orders on hold.

snippets.title: Record Which Staff Member Changed an Order Status
snippets.description: Adds the name of the logged-in user to the order notes every time an order status changes, so you can see who marked an order shipped or refunded.
snippets.notes: Status changes made by payment gateways, cron or the customer are not labelled, since no staff user is logged in.

snippets.title: "Ready for Pickup" Order Status With Customer Email
snippets.description: Adds a "Ready for pickup" order status and emails the customer automatically when you set it, so click-and-collect customers know when to come in.
snippets.notes: Edit the email wording in $wpide_pickup_email; it is sent with WooCommerce's email template and colours.

snippets.title: Colour-Coded Order Statuses in the Orders List
snippets.description: Gives each order status its own clear colour in the admin orders list, so processing, on-hold and failed orders stand out at a glance.
snippets.notes: Works on the HPOS and legacy order screens; add rules for custom statuses by slug, such as .status-awaiting-shipment.

snippets.title: Payment Method Column in the Orders List
snippets.description: Adds a column to the admin orders screen showing how each order was paid, such as card, PayPal or bank transfer, without opening the order.
snippets.notes: Works with both the HPOS orders screen and the legacy posts screen.

snippets.title: Shipping Method Column in the Orders List
snippets.description: Shows the chosen shipping method of each order in the admin orders list, so you can spot express and pickup orders before packing.
snippets.notes: Orders with several shipping lines list them all, separated by commas.

snippets.title: Customer Email and Phone Column in the Orders List
snippets.description: Adds the customer's email address and phone number to the admin orders list as click-to-email and click-to-call links.
snippets.notes: Only staff who can view the orders screen see these details.

snippets.title: Filter Orders by Payment Method
snippets.description: Adds a "Payment method" dropdown above the admin orders list, so you can list only bank transfer, PayPal or cash on delivery orders.
snippets.notes: Lists the payment methods enabled in your store and works on both the HPOS and legacy orders screens.

snippets.title: Filter Orders by Billing Country
