snippets.description: Adds a country dropdown to the admin orders list so you can see only orders from one country, handy for customs paperwork or regional reports.
snippets.notes: Lists the countries you sell to and works with both HPOS and legacy order storage.

snippets.title: Flag Orders That Have a Customer Note
snippets.description: Adds a narrow column to the admin orders list with an icon on orders where the customer left a note, and shows the note when you hover over it.
snippets.notes: Helps you spot delivery instructions and gift messages before packing.

snippets.title: Ready-Made Order Note Templates
snippets.description: Adds a dropdown of saved phrases above the order notes box, such as "Dispatched with Royal Mail" or "Waiting for stock", so staff can add common notes in one click.
snippets.notes: Edit the phrases in $wpide_note_templates; picking one fills the note box and you still choose private or customer note.

snippets.title: Sequential Invoice Numbers for Orders
snippets.description: Gives each paid order its own gap-free invoice number, such as INV-2026-0001, and shows it on the order screen, in emails and in the customer's order details.
snippets.notes: Numbers are assigned when an order reaches Processing or Completed, never change, and use an atomic counter so two orders cannot share one.

snippets.title: Printable Invoice and Packing Slip From the Order Screen
snippets.description: Adds "Print invoice" and "Print packing slip" links to each order in the admin, opening a clean printable page without a PDF plugin.
snippets.notes: Uses the browser's print dialog (which can save as PDF), leaves prices off the packing slip and shows invoice numbers from the sequential invoice snippet.

snippets.title: "Print Invoice" Button in My Account Orders
snippets.description: Lets customers open a printable invoice for their paid orders from the My Account orders list, so they can file receipts without emailing you.
snippets.notes: Customers can only open their own processing and completed orders.

snippets.title: Export Selected Orders to CSV
snippets.description: Adds an "Export to CSV" bulk action to the admin orders list that downloads the selected orders with customer, address, items and totals for spreadsheets or accounting.
snippets.notes: Values starting with =, +, - or @ are prefixed with an apostrophe so spreadsheets do not run them as formulas.

snippets.title: Export Customers to CSV
snippets.description: Adds a Customers CSV export under WooCommerce > Export customers with names, emails, phone, location, order count and total spent for every customer account.
snippets.notes: Exports customer accounts, not guest orders, in batches of 500, and only store managers can run it.

snippets.title: Export a Stock Report to CSV
snippets.description: Adds a one-click stock report download under WooCommerce > Stock report, listing every product and variation with SKU, stock status, quantity and price.
snippets.notes: Reads WooCommerce's product lookup table, so even large catalogues export quickly.

snippets.title: "Save Cart for Later" for Logged-In Customers
snippets.description: Adds a "Save cart for later" button to the cart; customers can restore the saved cart from their My Account dashboard on any device.
snippets.notes: Saving replaces any earlier saved cart, and restoring skips products that are no longer available.

snippets.title: Shareable Cart Link
snippets.description: Shows a link under the cart that recreates the same cart for anyone who opens it, so customers can send a cart to a colleague or you can send ready-made carts to clients.
snippets.notes: Opening the link adds up to 30 lines to the visitor's current cart; variations that need customer choices must be completed in the cart.

snippets.title: Require a Reason Before Issuing a Refund
snippets.description: Stops staff from issuing a refund in the order screen until they have typed a reason, so every refund in your records is explained.
snippets.notes: Works with both manual and gateway (API) refunds on HPOS and legacy order screens.

snippets.title: Refunded Amount Column in the Orders List
snippets.description: Shows how much has been refunded on each order in the admin orders list, so partial refunds are visible without opening every order.
snippets.notes: Orders without refunds show a dash.

snippets.title: "Request a Refund" Button for Customers
snippets.description: Adds a "Request refund" button to recent completed orders in My Account; clicking it notes the request on the order and emails the shop owner.
snippets.notes: The button shows only within the return window you set and disappears once a request is sent; you still issue refunds from the order screen.

snippets.title: Untick "Restock Refunded Items" by Default
snippets.description: Leaves the "Restock refunded items" box unticked when you refund an order, for shops where returned goods are usually damaged or not resold.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'woocommerce_restock_refunded_items', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: You can still tick the box for an individual refund when the items do go back on the shelf.

snippets.title: Daily Low Stock Digest Email
snippets.description: Sends one email each morning listing every product at or below your low stock threshold, instead of a separate alert per product.
snippets.notes: Uses the low stock threshold from WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Inventory and sends nothing on days when no product is low.

snippets.title: Out-of-Stock Count Notice in the Admin
snippets.description: Shows store managers a notice on the dashboard and WooCommerce screens with how many products are out of stock, linking straight to the filtered product list.
snippets.notes: The count is cached for an hour and refreshed as soon as any product's stock status changes.

snippets.title: Backorder Notice in the Cart and Checkout
snippets.description: Warns customers in the cart and at checkout which of their items are on backorder and roughly when they will ship, so nobody is surprised by a delay.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_backorder_eta to your usual restock time.

snippets.title: Stock Change History on Products
snippets.description: Records every stock level change with the date and the person (or order) responsible, and shows the last 25 changes in a box on the product edit screen.
snippets.notes: Only products that manage stock are logged, and variation changes are listed on their parent product.

snippets.title: Recent Orders on the My Account Dashboard
snippets.description: Lists the customer's three latest orders with status and total on the My Account dashboard, so they see what matters without clicking through.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_recent_count to show more or fewer orders.

snippets.title: Open My Account on the Orders Page
snippets.description: Sends customers straight to their order list when they open My Account and removes the mostly empty Dashboard tab.
snippets.notes: Change 'orders' to another endpoint, such as 'downloads' or 'edit-account', to land there instead.

snippets.title: "Order Again" Button in the My Account Orders List
snippets.description: Adds an "Order again" button next to completed orders in My Account, refilling the cart with the same products in one click.
snippets.notes: Uses WooCommerce's built-in order-again feature, so stock and availability are checked as usual.

snippets.title: Tracking Number on Orders, My Account and Emails
snippets.description: Adds carrier and tracking number fields to the order screen, then shows a tracking link to the customer on their order page and in the completed order email.
snippets.notes: Add carriers and their tracking URLs to $wpide_carriers ({number} is replaced); works with HPOS and legacy orders.

snippets.title: "Buy Again" Tab With Previously Purchased Products
snippets.description: Adds a My Account tab listing every product the customer has bought before, each with an add-to-cart button, ideal for consumables and repeat orders.
snippets.notes: Visit Settings > Permalinks once after activating so the new tab's URL works.

snippets.title: Phone Number on the Account Details Form
snippets.description: Adds the billing phone number to the My Account "Account details" form, so customers can update it in the same place as their name and email.
snippets.notes: Saves to the same billing phone used at checkout, so both stay in sync.

snippets.title: Skip "Are You Sure You Want to Log Out?" for Menu Links
snippets.description: Adds the security token to My Account log out links placed in your navigation menus, so customers log out in one click instead of seeing a confirmation page.
snippets.notes: Point a custom menu link at /my-account/customer-logout/ and this snippet turns it into a direct, secure log out link.

snippets.title: First and Last Name on the WooCommerce Registration Form
snippets.description: Adds required first and last name fields to the My Account registration form and saves them to the customer's profile and billing details.
snippets.notes: Enable "Allow customers to create an account on the My account page" in WooCommerce > Settings > Accounts to see the form.

snippets.title: Order Count and Total Spent on the Account Dashboard
snippets.description: Shows customers how many orders they have placed and how much they have spent in total, a nice touch for loyalty or VIP programmes.
snippets.notes: Uses WooCommerce's cached customer totals, so it adds no heavy queries.

snippets.title: "Delete My Account" Request in My Account
snippets.description: Adds a button to the Account details page that sends a personal data erasure request through WordPress's privacy tools, which the customer confirms by email.
snippets.notes: Requests appear under Tools > Erase Personal Data for you to complete; nothing is deleted automatically.

snippets.title: Unique Thank-You Coupon in the Order Completed Email
snippets.description: Creates a personal, single-use discount code for each completed order and adds it to the customer's "Order completed" email to encourage a second purchase.
snippets.notes: The coupon only works for the customer's billing email, expires after the set number of days and is created once per order.

snippets.title: Blind Copy Customer Emails to the Shop
snippets.description: Sends you a hidden copy (BCC) of chosen customer emails, such as processing and completed order emails, so you can see exactly what customers receive.
snippets.notes: Email IDs include customer_processing_order, customer_completed_order, customer_invoice, customer_note and customer_refunded_order.

snippets.title: Show Custom Order Fields in Order Emails
snippets.description: Adds the order details you choose, such as a delivery date or gift message saved by another plugin, to WooCommerce's order emails with friendly labels.
snippets.notes: List meta keys and labels in $wpide_email_meta, and set the second value to true for details only the shop should see.

snippets.title: Personal Email Headings With the Customer's Name
snippets.description: Changes the headings of customer order emails to greet the customer by first name, for example "Thanks for your order, Anna!".
snippets.notes: Edit the headings in $wpide_email_headings; {first_name} and {order_number} are replaced.

snippets.title: Send New Order Emails to a Supplier by Category
snippets.description: Adds an extra recipient to the "New order" email when the order contains products from a category, so suppliers or warehouse teams only get the orders they fulfil.
snippets.notes: Map category slugs to email addresses; the usual recipients still receive every new order email.

snippets.title: Custom Styles for WooCommerce Emails
snippets.description: Adds your own CSS to every WooCommerce email, for example to change fonts, button colours or table borders, without overriding email templates.
snippets.notes: WooCommerce inlines this CSS into each email, so keep to simple selectors that email apps support.

snippets.title: Email the Shop When a New Customer Registers
snippets.description: Sends the shop owner a short email whenever someone creates a customer account, at checkout or on the My Account page.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_new_customer_to to send it to someone other than the site admin.

snippets.title: Attach a Product's Manual to Its Order Email
snippets.description: Adds a field to each product for a file from the media library, such as a manual or warranty card, and attaches it to the customer's completed order email.
snippets.notes: Paste the file's media library URL into the product's "Email attachment" field; only files from your own media library are attached.

snippets.title: Help and Contact Box in Customer Emails
snippets.description: Adds a short "Questions about your order?" box with your phone number and email to the bottom of customer order emails.
snippets.notes: Edit the text and contact details at the top; emails sent to the shop are left unchanged.

snippets.title: Map Link for the Shipping Address in New Order Emails
snippets.description: Adds an "Open in Maps" link under the shipping address in the shop's new order email, handy for local delivery drivers.
snippets.notes: Only added to emails sent to the shop, and nothing is requested from Google until someone clicks the link.

snippets.title: Month-to-Date Sales vs Last Month Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget comparing this month's revenue and order count so far with the same days of last month, with the change in percent.
snippets.notes: Counts processing and completed orders, caches the figures for 30 minutes and works with HPOS and legacy order storage.

snippets.title: Top Sellers of the Last 30 Days Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget listing your five best-selling products of the past 30 days by units sold, with links to edit each product.
snippets.notes: Counts processing and completed orders, caches the list for an hour and works with HPOS and legacy order storage.

snippets.title: Latest Product Reviews Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Shows the five newest product reviews with star rating, product and approval status on the dashboard, so you can answer or approve them quickly.
snippets.notes: Pending reviews are marked so you can moderate them from Products > Reviews.

snippets.title: Bulk "Put on Sale" and "Remove Sale" Actions for Products
snippets.description: Adds bulk actions to the Products list that put selected products on sale at a set percentage, or clear their sale prices, including all variations.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_bulk_sale_percent before use; sale prices are rounded to your store's decimals.

snippets.title: Product Data Health Report
snippets.description: Adds a report under Products > Data health listing published products that are missing an image, SKU, price, short description or category, with edit links.
snippets.notes: Lists up to 100 products per problem; variations are checked through their parent product.

snippets.title: Require an Image, SKU and Price Before Publishing Products
snippets.description: Keeps a product as a draft, with a notice explaining what is missing, when someone tries to publish it without a featured image, SKU or price.
snippets.notes: Remove checks you do not need from $wpide_publish_requires; variable products need at least one priced variation.

snippets.title: "On Sale" Filter in the Admin Products List
snippets.description: Adds a dropdown to the admin Products list to show only products that are currently on sale, or only those that are not.
snippets.notes: Uses WooCommerce's cached list of products on sale, so filtering is fast.

snippets.title: Cost Price Field and Margin Column for Products
snippets.description: Adds a "Cost price" field to simple products and variations and a Margin column to the Products list showing profit per sale and margin percent.
snippets.notes: Cost prices are never shown to customers, and the margin uses the current price (sale price when on sale) excluding tax.

snippets.title: Expose Custom Product Fields in the WooCommerce REST API
snippets.description: Adds the product meta fields you list to WooCommerce REST API product responses as a tidy "custom_fields" object, and lets API clients update them.
snippets.notes: Only the keys you list are exposed or writable, and API clients still need WooCommerce API keys with the right access.

snippets.title: Add Invoice, Tracking and Delivery Data to Order API Responses
snippets.description: Includes invoice numbers, tracking details, delivery dates and other order fields you list in WooCommerce REST API order responses, for accounting and shipping integrations.
snippets.notes: Read-only; the default keys match other WPIDE snippets (invoice numbers, tracking, delivery date) and you can add your own.

snippets.title: Longer Timeout for WooCommerce Webhooks
snippets.description: Gives the services that receive your WooCommerce webhooks more time to answer, which stops slow endpoints such as Zapier or ERPs from being logged as failed.
snippets.notes: WooCommerce's default is 5 seconds, and webhooks are sent in the background so customers never wait.

snippets.title: Stop WooCommerce Disabling Webhooks After 5 Failures
snippets.description: Raises the number of failed deliveries before WooCommerce switches a webhook off, so a short outage at the receiving service does not silently stop your integrations.
snippets.notes: Failed deliveries are still logged under WooCommerce > Status > Logs.

snippets.title: "Order Status Changed" Webhook Topic
snippets.description: Adds an "Order status changed" topic to WooCommerce webhooks, so your integration is told about every status change instead of every order edit.
snippets.notes: Choose "Order status changed" when creating a webhook under WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Webhooks; the payload is the full order.

snippets.title: Rate Limit the Store API Against Card Testing
snippets.description: Turns on WooCommerce's built-in rate limiting for the Store API used by the block cart and checkout, slowing down bots that test stolen cards.
snippets.notes: Allows 25 requests per 10 seconds per visitor; set 'proxy_support' to true only behind a proxy or CDN that passes the visitor IP.

snippets.title: Remove the WooCommerce Version Meta Tag
snippets.description: Stops WooCommerce adding its version number to your page source, so bots scanning for outdated stores learn a little less.
snippets.notes: Purely cosmetic for security; keep WooCommerce updated as well.

snippets.title: Remove Unused WooCommerce Widgets
snippets.description: Hides the classic WooCommerce widgets you do not use, such as price filter or recent reviews, from the widget screens to keep them tidy.
snippets.notes: Remove class names from the list for widgets you want to keep; blocks are not affected.

snippets.title: Keep Completed Background Tasks for 7 Days
snippets.description: Shortens how long WooCommerce's Action Scheduler keeps finished tasks from 31 days to 7, which keeps its database tables small on busy stores.
snippets.notes: Only completed and cancelled actions are cleared, gradually by Action Scheduler itself, and pending tasks are never touched.

snippets.title: Turn Off Order Attribution Tracking
snippets.description: Stops WooCommerce's order attribution script from setting tracking cookies and recording the visit source of each order, useful under strict cookie policies.
snippets.notes: Origin details stop appearing on new orders; the same switch also lives under WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Features.

snippets.title: Keep Guest Carts for a Week
snippets.description: Extends how long a guest's cart is remembered from two days to seven, so visitors who come back later still find their products waiting.
snippets.notes: Longer sessions mean more rows in the woocommerce_sessions table; WooCommerce cleans expired ones daily.

snippets.title: Use Plain Dropdowns Instead of Select2 at Checkout
snippets.description: Removes the Select2 search boxes WooCommerce puts on the country and state fields, using the browser's native dropdowns that are lighter and easier on phones.
snippets.notes: Country and state fields still update each other, and native dropdowns work better with screen readers and phone keyboards.

snippets.title: Orders and Total Spent Columns in the Users List
snippets.description: Adds "Orders" and "Total spent" columns to Users > All Users, so you can spot your best customers and accounts that never ordered.
snippets.notes: Uses WooCommerce's cached customer totals, which update after each order.

snippets.title: Store Shortcuts in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a "Store" menu to the admin toolbar with quick links to orders, products, coupons, customers and settings, available on the front end too.
snippets.notes: Only shown to users who can manage WooCommerce; edit the $links array to add your own shortcuts.

snippets.title: Highlight Low-Stock Products in the Products List
snippets.description: Tints rows in the admin Products list for products at or below your low stock threshold, and out-of-stock products in red, so restocking needs stand out.
snippets.notes: Uses the low stock threshold from WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Inventory, or a product's own threshold when set.

snippets.title: Start and End Scheduled Sales on the Hour
snippets.description: Checks scheduled sale dates every hour instead of once a day at midnight, so sales that should start or end during the day do so close to on time.
snippets.notes: WooCommerce sale dates are whole days, so this mainly helps sites where the midnight check runs late.

snippets.title: Use the First Gallery Image When No Featured Image Is Set
snippets.description: When a product is saved without a featured image but has gallery images, the first gallery image becomes its featured image, so it never shows a placeholder.
snippets.notes: Runs whenever a product is saved, whether in the admin, through the REST API or by an import, and leaves the gallery unchanged.

snippets.title: Keep Filtered and Sorted Shop Pages Out of Search Engines
snippets.description: Adds noindex to shop pages that have sorting, price or attribute filters in the URL, so search engines index your real category pages instead of thousands of variations.
snippets.notes: Links on those pages are still followed, and normal shop, category and paginated pages are not affected.

snippets.title: Remove WooCommerce Widgets From the Dashboard
snippets.description: Removes WooCommerce's "Status" and "Recent reviews" boxes from the WordPress dashboard, which also skips the queries they run on every dashboard visit.
snippets.notes: Reports remain available under WooCommerce > Reports or Analytics.

snippets.title: Minimum Number of Items per Order
snippets.description: Requires at least a set number of items in the cart before checkout, for shops that cannot ship single low-cost items profitably.
snippets.notes: Counts the total quantity of all products; combine it with a minimum order amount if you need both.

snippets.title: Maximum Items per Order From a Category
snippets.description: Caps how many items from a category one order can contain, useful for limited drops, rationed products or age-restricted goods.
snippets.notes: All products in the listed categories count together, and other products are not limited.

snippets.title: Apply a Coupon Automatically Above a Cart Total
snippets.description: Adds an existing coupon to the cart as soon as the subtotal reaches an amount, and removes it again if the cart drops below, so shoppers never need to type a code.
snippets.notes: Create the coupon in Marketing > Coupons first; its own usage limits and expiry still apply.

snippets.title: Restrict Coupon Codes to Certain Roles
snippets.description: Makes chosen coupon codes work only for customers with specific roles, such as staff discount codes or trade-only promotions.
snippets.notes: Codes are matched case-insensitively, and guests can never use these coupons.

snippets.title: Coupon Codes for First Orders Only
snippets.description: Limits chosen coupon codes, such as a welcome discount, to customers who have never placed a paid order, checked by account and billing email.
snippets.notes: Guests are checked by the billing email entered at checkout, so the code may be accepted in the cart and refused at checkout.

snippets.title: Phone Number Field for the Shipping Address
snippets.description: Adds a phone field to the classic checkout's shipping address, so couriers can reach the recipient when an order is sent to someone else.
snippets.notes: Uses WooCommerce's own shipping_phone order field, so it appears on the order screen and in exports automatically.

snippets.title: "Buying for a Business?" Checkbox at Checkout
snippets.description: Hides the Company field behind a "Buying for a business?" checkbox on the classic checkout, keeping the form short for consumers and requiring a company name when ticked.
snippets.notes: Also toggles the VAT number field from the "EU VAT Number Field" snippet, and the Company field must be enabled in the Customizer.

snippets.title: Ask Before Removing a Product From the Cart
snippets.description: Shows a quick "Remove this item?" confirmation when a shopper clicks the remove (×) link in the cart, preventing accidental removals on phones.
snippets.notes: Works on the classic cart page and the mini cart widget.

snippets.title: Quantity Dropdown Instead of a Number Box
snippets.description: Replaces the quantity number box with a simple dropdown (1, 2, 3...) on product and cart pages, which is faster to use on phones.
snippets.notes: Respects each product's minimum, maximum and step, offering up to $wpide_qty_options choices when there is no maximum.

snippets.title: Stock Level Progress Bar on Product Pages
snippets.description: Shows a bar with how much of a product's stock is left, such as "Hurry, only 4 left", when stock is running low, to create honest urgency.
snippets.notes: Shown only for stock-managed products at or below 'show_below' units, and the animation respects reduced-motion settings.

snippets.title: Show Variation Options as Buttons
snippets.description: Turns the variation dropdowns on product pages (size, colour and so on) into clickable buttons, keeping WooCommerce's own logic for prices, stock and images.
snippets.notes: Unavailable combinations are greyed out, and the original dropdowns stay hidden in the page so other plugins keep working.

snippets.title: Category Name Above Product Titles in the Shop
snippets.description: Prints the product's main category in small text above its title in shop and category listings, helping shoppers scan mixed results such as search pages.
snippets.notes: Uses the product's first category and is hidden on category pages, where every product shares it.

snippets.title: Two Products per Row on Phones
snippets.description: Shows shop and category pages in two columns on phones instead of one long single column, so shoppers see more products without scrolling.
snippets.notes: For classic WooCommerce templates; block themes set columns in the Product Collection block settings.

snippets.title: Move Category Descriptions Below the Products
snippets.description: Shows the product category description after the product grid instead of before it, so shoppers see products first while the text still helps SEO.
snippets.notes: For classic templates; the description shows on the first page of each category only, as WooCommerce does by default.

snippets.title: Jump Straight to a Product When Searching Its SKU
snippets.description: Sends shoppers directly to the product page when what they type in the search box is exactly a product's SKU or code.
snippets.notes: Variation SKUs open the parent product with that variation preselected.

snippets.title: Show the Currency Code Next to Prices
snippets.description: Adds the three-letter currency code after prices on the front end, such as "$25.00 USD", so international shoppers know which dollar or crown you mean.
snippets.notes: Admin screens are left unchanged; remove the symbol in WooCommerce settings if you prefer the code alone.

snippets.title: "Lowest Price in the Last 30 Days" for Sale Products
snippets.description: Records each product's price history and shows the lowest price of the 30 days before a sale under the sale price, as the EU Omnibus rules require.
snippets.notes: Price history starts when you activate the snippet and is pruned after 60 days, so the note appears for sales that start after that.

snippets.title: Shipping and Return Policy in Product Structured Data
snippets.description: Adds your shipping cost, delivery time and return policy to the product structured data WooCommerce outputs, which Google can show in shopping results.
snippets.notes: Describe your main market in $wpide_schema_policy, and keep the values true to your real offer or Google may ignore them.

snippets.title: Different Thank-You Page per Product
snippets.description: Sends customers to a specific page after checkout when their order contains a certain product, such as onboarding steps for a course or setup guide for a device.
snippets.notes: The first matching product wins, and the order key is passed along so your page can still show the order details.

snippets.title: Limit Orders per Customer per Day
snippets.description: Blocks a customer from placing more than a set number of orders in 24 hours, matched by billing email, to stop card testing and reseller bots.
snippets.notes: Failed and cancelled orders do not count, and orders shop managers create in the admin are not affected.

snippets.title: Payment Reminder for Unpaid Orders
snippets.description: Re-sends the order details with a payment link to customers whose order is still pending payment a few hours after checkout, recovering failed or abandoned payments.
snippets.notes: Uses WooCommerce's "Order details" email, sends one reminder per order and handles 20 orders per hourly WP-Cron run.

snippets.title: Hide the Downloads Tab When There Are No Downloads
snippets.description: Removes the Downloads item from the My Account menu for customers who have never bought a downloadable product.
snippets.notes: The tab reappears automatically after a customer buys something downloadable.

snippets.title: Return Customers to Their Page After Logging In
snippets.description: After logging in on the My Account page, customers go back to the page they were browsing, such as a product or the cart, instead of the account dashboard.
snippets.notes: Only pages on your own site are used, and customers who came straight to My Account still land on their dashboard.

snippets.title: Exclude Products or Categories From Related Products
snippets.description: Stops chosen products or whole categories, such as gift cards, samples or spare parts, from appearing in the related products section.
snippets.notes: WooCommerce caches related products, so changes can take a little while to show everywhere.

snippets.title: Turn Off Reviews for a Product Category
snippets.description: Disables reviews on products in chosen categories, such as made-to-order or services, while every other product keeps its Reviews tab.
snippets.notes: Existing reviews are kept in the database but hidden along with the tab.

snippets.title: Add to Cart Without a Page Reload on Product Pages
snippets.description: Adds simple products to the cart in the background from the product page, updating the mini cart and showing a confirmation instead of reloading the page.
snippets.notes: Applies to simple products only, and the mini cart refreshes when WooCommerce's cart fragments script is loaded.

snippets.title: Cart, Checkout and Confirmation Progress Steps
snippets.description: Shows a simple three-step progress bar (Cart, Checkout, Done) at the top of the cart, checkout and order-received pages, so shoppers know how close they are.
snippets.notes: Works with the classic cart and checkout; edit the step names at the top.

snippets.title: Different Low Stock Threshold per Category
snippets.description: Sets its own low stock threshold for products in chosen categories, so fast sellers warn you earlier while slow lines do not flood your inbox.
snippets.notes: A threshold set on an individual product still wins, and the change affects low stock emails and reports.

snippets.title: Payment Methods Only for Certain Roles
snippets.description: Shows chosen payment methods, such as "Pay by invoice" or cheque, only to trusted roles like trade customers, and hides them from everyone else.
snippets.notes: Use gateway IDs from WooCommerce > Settings > Payments (bacs, cheque, cod); guests never see these methods.

snippets.title: Hide a Payment Method for Certain Products
snippets.description: Removes a payment method, for example cash on delivery or buy-now-pay-later, when the cart contains products from categories it should not be used for.
snippets.notes: The payment method comes back as soon as those products leave the cart.

snippets.title: Generate a Batch of Unique Coupon Codes
snippets.description: Creates a set of single-use coupon codes in one go, for printed flyers, influencer campaigns or event giveaways, and lists them so you can copy them.
snippets.notes: Runs only when you press Run in the editor or use WP-CLI, so set the amount, type and expiry first.

snippets.title: Move Long-Expired Coupons to the Trash
snippets.description: Cleans up the coupon list by moving coupons that expired more than 90 days ago to the trash, where you can still restore them.
snippets.notes: Runs only when you press Run in the editor or use WP-CLI, handles up to 500 coupons per run and never deletes permanently.

snippets.title: "Ask a Question About This Product" Link
snippets.description: Adds a link under the Add to Cart button that opens an email to your shop with the product name and link already filled in, an easy way to capture pre-sale questions.
snippets.notes: Set the address in $wpide_question_email; the visitor's own email app sends the message, so no form data passes through your site.

snippets.title: "Free" Label and Button for Free Downloads
snippets.description: Shows "Free" instead of 0.00 for free downloads and changes their purchase button to "Download for free", so visitors see at a glance they pay nothing.
snippets.notes: Edit the two texts at the top; paid downloads are not affected.

snippets.title: Require the Last Name at EDD Checkout
snippets.description: Makes the last name field required on the Easy Digital Downloads checkout, for invoices and licences that need a full name.
snippets.notes: The field is already on the form; this only makes it mandatory.

snippets.title: Phone Number Field at EDD Checkout
snippets.description: Adds a phone number field to the Easy Digital Downloads checkout, saves it with the order, shows it on the order screen and provides a {checkout_phone} email tag.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_edd_phone_required to false to make the field optional, and use {checkout_phone} in Downloads > Emails templates.

snippets.title: Block Disposable Emails at EDD Checkout
snippets.description: Rejects purchases made with throwaway email addresses on the Easy Digital Downloads checkout, so download links and receipts reach a real inbox.
snippets.notes: Add domains to the list as you spot them; subdomains of listed domains are blocked too.

snippets.title: Minimum Cart Total for EDD Checkout
snippets.description: Requires the Easy Digital Downloads cart to reach a minimum amount before a purchase can be completed, and tells the customer how much more to add.
snippets.notes: The minimum is compared with the subtotal before discounts, and free-only carts are not affected.

snippets.title: Allow Only One Download in the EDD Cart
snippets.description: Empties the Easy Digital Downloads cart before a new item is added, so each purchase contains a single download, which suits licence or membership sales.
snippets.notes: Adding the same download again simply keeps it in the cart.

snippets.title: Money-Back Guarantee Box Below the EDD Checkout Cart
snippets.description: Adds a reassuring money-back guarantee box below the cart on the Easy Digital Downloads checkout, right where buyers decide.
snippets.code:
✓
14-day money-back guarantee
If it is not right for you, email us within 14 days for a full refund. No questions asked.
snippets.notes: Edit the wording and number of days to match your refund policy.

snippets.title: Hide the Discount Code Field at EDD Checkout
snippets.description: Removes the "Have a discount code?" link from the Easy Digital Downloads checkout, so customers without a code do not leave to hunt for one.
snippets.notes: For the shortcode-based checkout; discount links (?discount=CODE) still apply codes automatically.

snippets.title: Apply an EDD Discount Code Automatically
snippets.description: Applies a discount code to every Easy Digital Downloads checkout automatically, ideal for a site-wide sale where buyers should not need to type a code.
snippets.notes: Create the code in Downloads > Discounts first (its dates and limits still apply) and remove the snippet when the sale ends.

snippets.title: Bulk Discount for Several EDD Downloads
snippets.description: Takes a percentage off the Easy Digital Downloads cart when it contains a set number of downloads or more, shown as a discount line at checkout.
snippets.notes: Uses EDD cart fees and recalculates whenever items are added or removed.

snippets.title: Small Order Fee for Low-Value EDD Carts
snippets.description: Adds a small processing fee to Easy Digital Downloads orders below an amount, covering payment costs on very cheap purchases.
snippets.notes: Free carts never get the fee, which shows as its own line at checkout and on the receipt.

snippets.title: Different Success Page per EDD Download
snippets.description: Sends buyers of specific downloads to their own thank-you page after purchase, for example with setup instructions or an onboarding video.
snippets.notes: The first matching download wins; add the [edd_receipt] shortcode to those pages to keep showing the receipt.

snippets.title: Custom Message on the EDD Purchase Receipt Page
snippets.description: Adds your own thank-you text, next steps or support details below the receipt that buyers see after an Easy Digital Downloads purchase.
snippets.notes: Shortcodes and basic HTML are allowed in the message.

snippets.title: Extra Text at the End of EDD Purchase Receipt Emails
snippets.description: Appends a paragraph, such as getting-started tips or a support link, to every Easy Digital Downloads purchase receipt email without editing the template.
snippets.notes: Email tags such as {name} work in the text; edit the receipt itself under Downloads > Emails.

snippets.title: Blind Copy EDD Receipts to the Shop
snippets.description: Sends you a hidden copy of every purchase receipt that Easy Digital Downloads emails to customers, so you can check exactly what they received.
snippets.notes: Use a separate mailbox, as busy stores will receive one copy per sale.

snippets.title: Order Total and Buyer in EDD Sale Notification Subjects
snippets.description: Changes the subject of the "New sale" email you receive to include the amount and the buyer's name, so you can see each sale from your inbox.
snippets.notes: Change the wording in the sprintf line; only the admin sale notification is affected.

snippets.title: Change the EDD Downloads URL Base
snippets.description: Replaces /downloads/ in your product URLs with a word you choose, such as /plugins/ or /templates/, without defining constants in wp-config.php.
snippets.notes: Visit Settings > Permalinks and click Save after activating, and set up redirects from the old URLs if the site is already live.

snippets.title: Turn Off the EDD Downloads Archive Page
snippets.description: Removes the automatic /downloads/ archive page, for stores that list products on a page they designed themselves with the [downloads] shortcode or blocks.
snippets.notes: Save Settings > Permalinks afterwards; single download pages keep working.

snippets.title: Rename "Downloads" to Products, Plugins or Courses
snippets.description: Changes the word "Download" throughout Easy Digital Downloads, in the admin menu, buttons and messages, to a word that fits what you sell.
snippets.notes: Set the singular and plural forms; URLs stay the same unless you also use the URL base snippet.

snippets.title: Keep EDD Downloads Out of Site Search
snippets.description: Removes Easy Digital Downloads products from the normal WordPress search results, for sites where downloads are only sold through dedicated pages.
snippets.notes: Download pages stay public and indexable by search engines.

snippets.title: EDD Purchases and Lifetime Value in the Users List
snippets.description: Adds "Purchases" and "Lifetime value" columns to Users > All Users from Easy Digital Downloads customer records, so you can spot your best buyers.
snippets.notes: Users without an EDD customer record show a dash.

snippets.title: EDD Earnings This Month vs Last Month Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget with this month's Easy Digital Downloads earnings and order count next to last month's totals, using EDD's own stats engine.
snippets.notes: Only users who can view shop reports see it, and the figures are cached for 30 minutes.

snippets.title: Best-Selling Downloads Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Lists your five best-selling Easy Digital Downloads products of all time on the dashboard, with their sales count and a link to edit each one.
snippets.notes: Uses the sales count EDD stores on each download, so the widget is fast even on large stores.

snippets.title: Today's EDD Earnings in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Shows today's Easy Digital Downloads earnings in the admin toolbar, linking to the reports screen, so you can check sales from any page.
snippets.notes: Only users who can view shop reports see it, and the figure is cached for 10 minutes.

snippets.title: "Sold X Times" Note Under EDD Purchase Buttons
snippets.description: Shows how many times a download has been bought under its purchase button, as social proof, once it passes a minimum number of sales.
snippets.notes: Hidden until a download reaches $wpide_edd_min_sales sales, so new products do not show low numbers.

snippets.title: EDD Cart Link With Item Count Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_edd_cart] shortcode that prints a "Cart (2)" link to the Easy Digital Downloads checkout, for headers, menus or widgets.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_edd_cart label="Basket"] to change the text; full-page caches may need to skip pages that show it.

snippets.title: Redirect an Empty EDD Checkout to Your Products
snippets.description: Sends visitors who land on the Easy Digital Downloads checkout with an empty cart to your products page instead of showing "Your cart is empty".
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_edd_shop_url to your products page; receipts and payment confirmation pages are not affected.

snippets.title: "Empty Cart" Button on the EDD Checkout
snippets.description: Adds an "Empty cart" button below the Easy Digital Downloads checkout cart so buyers can start again in one click.
snippets.notes: Asks for confirmation first and uses a security token, so the link cannot be triggered from other sites.

snippets.title: "Continue Shopping" Link on the EDD Checkout
snippets.description: Adds a "Continue shopping" link below the Easy Digital Downloads checkout cart, taking buyers back to your products to add more.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_edd_continue_url to your products page; by default it uses the downloads archive or home page.

snippets.title: Change EDD Checkout Texts Without a Translation Plugin
snippets.description: Replaces Easy Digital Downloads wording such as "Personal Info" or "Purchase" with your own, using a simple list of old and new texts.
snippets.notes: The original text must match exactly, including capitals, and only Easy Digital Downloads texts are affected.

snippets.title: Remove the Automatic EDD Purchase Button From Downloads
snippets.description: Stops Easy Digital Downloads adding a purchase button below every download's content, for pages where you place the button yourself with a block or shortcode.
snippets.notes: Place the button with [purchase_link] or the EDD Buy Button block wherever you want it.

snippets.title: Related Downloads Below Each Download
snippets.description: Lists up to four other downloads from the same category below each download's content, helping buyers discover more of your products.
snippets.notes: Results are cached for 12 hours per download, and downloads without a category show nothing.

snippets.title: "Last Updated" Date and Version on Downloads
snippets.description: Shows when a download was last updated and an optional version number above its content, reassuring buyers that the product is maintained.
snippets.notes: Enter a version in the "Version" box on the download edit screen; the date comes from the last time you saved the download.

snippets.title: Stop Customers Buying the Same Download Twice
snippets.description: Replaces the purchase button with a "You already own this" link for logged-in customers who bought a download before, and blocks repeat purchases at checkout.
snippets.notes: Works for logged-in customers, and downloads with variable prices are checked as a whole.

snippets.title: "Confirm Email" Field at EDD Checkout
snippets.description: Asks guest buyers to type their email address twice on the Easy Digital Downloads checkout, preventing typos that would stop their download links arriving.
snippets.notes: Logged-in customers do not see the extra field.

snippets.title: Promo Code Banner Above EDD Purchase Buttons
snippets.description: Shows a small promotional banner with a discount code above every Easy Digital Downloads purchase button during a sale.
snippets.code: Black Friday: use code BF30 at checkout for 30% off.
snippets.notes: Create the code in Downloads > Discounts and deactivate this snippet when the sale ends.

snippets.title: "Instant Download" Note Under EDD Purchase Buttons
snippets.description: Adds a short reassurance line, such as "Instant download · Secure payment · Lifetime updates", under every Easy Digital Downloads purchase button.
snippets.code: Instant download · Secure payment · Free updates for one year
snippets.notes: Edit the three points to match what you offer.

snippets.title: Help Note Above the EDD Checkout Cart
snippets.description: Shows a friendly "Questions before you buy?" note with your contact details above the cart on the Easy Digital Downloads checkout.
snippets.code: Questions before you buy? Email hello@example.com and we will reply within one business day.
snippets.notes: Replace the email address and response time with your own.

snippets.title: Load EDD Styles Only on Store Pages
snippets.description: Stops the Easy Digital Downloads stylesheet loading on blog posts and other pages without store content, trimming a request from most page views.
snippets.notes: Pages with EDD shortcodes or blocks keep the styles; add page IDs to $wpide_edd_style_pages if a widget needs them elsewhere.

snippets.title: Purchased Downloads Column in the EDD Orders List
snippets.description: Adds a column to Downloads > Orders listing what each order contains, so you can see what was sold without opening every order.
snippets.notes: Shows up to five items per order, then "and N more".

snippets.title: Hide an EDD Payment Method Above an Amount
snippets.description: Removes a payment method, such as a manual or offline gateway, from the Easy Digital Downloads checkout when the cart total is above your limit.
snippets.notes: Use the gateway ID (manual, paypal_commerce, stripe); the method is never removed if it is the only one left.

snippets.title: Notify Extra People of EDD Sales by Category
snippets.description: Adds extra recipients to the Easy Digital Downloads sale notification when an order contains downloads from a category, such as a partner or course author.
snippets.notes: The usual sale notification recipients still get every email.

snippets.title: Add a Custom Currency to Easy Digital Downloads
snippets.description: Adds a currency that Easy Digital Downloads does not list by default, with its own symbol, so you can choose it in Downloads > Settings > General.
snippets.notes: Use the official three-letter ISO code, and check that your payment gateway supports the currency.

snippets.title: Hide ".00" on Whole EDD Prices
snippets.description: Shows whole prices such as 49 instead of 49.00 throughout Easy Digital Downloads, while prices like 49.50 keep their decimals.
snippets.notes: Only the display changes; amounts are stored and charged exactly as before.

snippets.title: Comment Moderator Role
snippets.description: Adds a "Comment Moderator" role that can approve, edit and delete comments without being able to publish or edit other people's posts.
snippets.notes: The role is registered in memory only; users given this role lose it (and fall back to no role) if the snippet is turned off.

snippets.title: Rename Roles Without Changing Them
snippets.description: Changes the names roles show on the Users screen and in role menus, for example "Subscriber" to "Member", without touching capabilities or the database.
snippets.notes: Only the label changes; role IDs such as subscriber stay the same, so plugins keep working.

snippets.title: Hide Unused Roles From Role Menus
snippets.description: Removes roles you never use, such as Author or Contributor, from the role drop-downs when adding or editing users, so nobody picks them by mistake.
snippets.notes: A user who already has a hidden role keeps seeing it on their own edit screen, so saving the profile never changes their role.

snippets.title: Give Users More Than One Role
snippets.description: Adds "Additional roles" checkboxes to the user edit screen so an administrator can give someone a second role, for example Editor plus Shop Manager.
snippets.notes: Only roles the current user may assign are offered, and the Administrator role is never offered as an extra role.

snippets.title: Show a User's Capabilities on Their Profile
snippets.description: Adds a collapsible list of everything a user is allowed to do to the user edit screen, which helps when checking what a role or plugin has granted.
snippets.notes: Visible to administrators only; it is read-only and changes nothing.

snippets.title: Let Editors See the Users List (Read-Only)
snippets.description: Lets editors open the Users screen to look people up, without being able to add, edit, promote or delete anyone.
snippets.notes: Grants only the list_users capability, in memory; turning the snippet off removes it.

snippets.title: Give Extra Capabilities to Specific Users
snippets.description: Grants chosen capabilities to individual user accounts, for example letting one editor manage plugins, without creating a new role.
snippets.notes: Use user IDs, which never change. The capabilities are granted in memory and disappear when the snippet is off.

snippets.title: Search Users by First and Last Name
snippets.description: Makes the search box on the Users screen also find people by their first name, last name or full name, not just username and email.
snippets.notes: Matches up to 200 users by name per search, which is plenty for a search box.

snippets.title: "New Sign-Ups" View on the Users Screen
snippets.description: Adds a "New this week" link next to All / Administrator / Subscriber on the Users screen that lists only people who registered in the last 7 days.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_recent_days to show a different period.

snippets.title: Require a First and Last Name in Profiles
snippets.description: Stops users from saving their profile (or an administrator from saving a user) without a first and last name.
snippets.notes: Applies to the profile screens in wp-admin; existing users are only asked when they next save their profile.

snippets.title: Email the Admin When Users Change Their Profile
snippets.description: Sends the site admin a short email listing what changed when a member updates their own name, email, website or bio.
snippets.notes: Only changes users make to their own account are reported; edits by administrators are ignored.

snippets.title: Suspend User Accounts
snippets.description: Adds a "Suspend this account" checkbox to the user edit screen that logs the person out everywhere and blocks them from logging in until it is unticked.
snippets.notes: Administrators cannot be suspended, and the Users list shows "Suspended" under blocked accounts.

snippets.title: Expiry Dates for User Accounts
snippets.description: Lets administrators set an expiry date on any account; after that date the user is logged out and can no longer log in, which suits trial or temporary access.
snippets.notes: Leave the date empty for accounts that never expire. Dates use the site's time zone.

snippets.title: Let New Users Choose Their Password When Registering
snippets.description: Adds password and confirm-password fields to the WordPress registration form, so new members pick their own password instead of waiting for a "set your password" email.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_reg_auto_login to true to log new members in straight away. Only the wp-login.php registration form is changed.

snippets.title: Require an Invite Code to Register
snippets.description: Adds an "Invite code" field to the registration form and only lets people sign up with one of your codes, each with an optional limit on how many times it can be used.
snippets.notes: Codes are not case-sensitive. Use 0 for unlimited uses; usage counts are kept in the wpide_invite_code_uses option.

snippets.title: Limit Sign-Ups per IP Address
snippets.description: Allows only a few new accounts per IP address per day, which stops bots and people from creating piles of accounts.
snippets.notes: Behind a proxy or CDN make sure REMOTE_ADDR holds the visitor's real IP, or everyone shares one limit.

snippets.title: Let New Users Pick an Account Type
snippets.description: Adds an "I am signing up as" choice to the registration form that gives the new account one of the roles you allow, for example Reader or Writer.
snippets.notes: Roles that can manage options, users, plugins or other people's posts are refused even if you list them, so the form can never hand out admin rights.

snippets.title: "How Did You Hear About Us?" on Registration
snippets.description: Asks new members how they found your site when they register and shows the answer in a column on the Users screen.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_referral_options to change the choices; answers are stored in the wpide_referral user meta.

snippets.title: Assign a Role Based on the Email Domain
snippets.description: Gives people who register with certain email domains a different role automatically, for example staff at your company become Contributors.
snippets.notes: Only applies to self-registration, never to accounts created by an administrator. Avoid roles that can publish or manage other users.

snippets.title: Username Rules for New Registrations
snippets.description: Requires new usernames to be a sensible length, use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores, and not be just a number.
snippets.notes: Existing usernames are not affected. Adjust the length limits at the top.

snippets.title: Verify Email Addresses of New Users
snippets.description: Sends new members a confirmation link and blocks them from logging in until they click it, which keeps fake and mistyped email addresses out.
snippets.notes: Most useful when members choose their own password at sign-up; accounts created by administrators and users who existed before activation are treated as verified.

snippets.title: Front-End Registration Form Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_register] shortcode that shows a sign-up form on any page, styled by your theme, using WordPress's normal registration process and emails.
snippets.notes: "Anyone can register" must be enabled in Settings > General. Other registration snippets (invite codes, account types, verification) also apply because it uses the core registration function.

snippets.title: Friendly Message When Registration Is Closed
snippets.description: Replaces the bare "User registration is currently not allowed" screen with a friendly message and a link back to your site or a waiting-list page.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_waitlist_url to a page where people can leave their email, or leave it empty to link to the homepage.

snippets.title: Front-End Profile Editing Form
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_edit_profile] shortcode where logged-in members can update their name, display name, email, website and bio without visiting wp-admin.
snippets.notes: Saving is protected by a nonce and only ever changes the logged-in user's own account. WordPress emails the old address when the email changes.

snippets.title: Front-End Change Password Form
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_change_password] shortcode where members change their password by entering the current one and the new one twice, and stay logged in afterwards.
snippets.notes: Other devices are logged out when the password changes, which is what WordPress does on the profile screen too.

snippets.title: "Delete My Account" Request Button
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_delete_account] shortcode with a button that files an erasure request in WordPress's privacy tools; the member confirms by email and you process it under Tools > Erase Personal Data.
snippets.notes: Nothing is deleted automatically; it uses the core personal-data erasure workflow so you stay in control.

snippets.title: "Download My Data" Request Button
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_export_data] shortcode with a button that asks WordPress's privacy tools to prepare a copy of the member's personal data, confirmed by email.
snippets.notes: You send the export from Tools > Export Personal Data, or let WordPress email it once you approve the request.

snippets.title: Member Dashboard Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_account] shortcode that greets the logged-in member and shows their avatar, membership details, recent posts and comments, and account links.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_account_links to your own pages (for example a page holding [wpide_edit_profile]); visitors who are not logged in get a login link.

snippets.title: Member Directory Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_members] shortcode that lists members with their avatar and display name in a responsive, paginated grid, shown only to logged-in visitors by default.
snippets.notes: Attributes: role="subscriber" per_page="24" public="yes" (show it to visitors too). Only display names and avatars are shown, never emails.

snippets.title: Member Count Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_member_count] shortcode that shows how many members your site has, optionally for one role, cached so it stays fast on big sites.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_member_count role="subscriber"]. The count refreshes when someone registers or is deleted, and at least twice a day.

snippets.title: "Member Since" Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_member_since] shortcode that shows the date the logged-in member joined, or how long ago, for welcome messages and account pages.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_member_since format="relative"] for "3 months", or any PHP date format such as format="F Y".

snippets.title: Personal Greeting Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_hello] shortcode that greets logged-in members by first name ("Hi, Sam") and visitors with a fallback you choose.
snippets.notes: Example: [wpide_hello greeting="Welcome back" guest="friend"]. Pages with personal greetings should not be served from a full-page cache to logged-in users.

snippets.title: Content for Specific Users Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_for_users] shortcode that shows its content only to the user accounts you list, handy for private notes to one client on a shared page.
snippets.notes: Example: [wpide_for_users ids="12,45"]Your files are ready.[/wpide_for_users]. Administrators always see the content.

snippets.title: Show Menu Items by Login Status or Role
snippets.description: Lets you hide individual menu items from guests, members or certain roles by giving them a CSS class such as wpide-logged-in, wpide-logged-out or wpide-role-editor.
snippets.notes: Turn on "CSS Classes" under Screen Options in Appearance > Menus to add the classes. Child items of a hidden item are hidden too.

snippets.title: "Log Out Other Devices" Button for Members
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_logout_others] shortcode with a button that signs the member out of every other browser and device, keeping the current one logged in.
snippets.notes: Shows how many other sessions are active, so members can spot logins they do not recognise.

snippets.title: Recent Login History on the Profile Screen
snippets.description: Records the last 10 logins for each user (time, IP address and browser) and lists them on their profile screen so they can spot logins they do not recognise.
snippets.notes: Users see their own history; administrators also see it on other users' profiles. IP addresses are personal data, so mention this in your privacy policy.

snippets.title: "Last Seen" Column in the Users List
snippets.description: Records when each user was last active on the site (not just when they last logged in) and shows it in a sortable "Last seen" column on the Users screen.
snippets.notes: Activity is saved at most once every 15 minutes per user, so it adds almost no database writes.

snippets.title: Personal After-Login Page for Each User
snippets.description: Adds an "After login, go to" field to each user's profile so administrators can send specific clients or members to their own page when they log in.
snippets.notes: Only administrators can set the page. Users without one keep the normal login destination.

snippets.title: Personal Message Box for Individual Members
snippets.description: Lets administrators write a private note on any user's profile that only that user sees, through a [wpide_my_message] shortcode and on their own dashboard.
snippets.notes: Useful for client portals ("Your invoice is ready") and member dashboards. Basic formatting and links are allowed.

snippets.title: Let Members Deactivate Their Own Account
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_deactivate_account] shortcode with a button members can use to close their account; they are logged out and blocked, and an administrator can reactivate them later.
snippets.notes: Nothing is deleted. Deactivated users show as "Deactivated" on the Users screen; delete the wpide_deactivated user meta (or use the row link) to reactivate. Administrators cannot deactivate themselves this way.

snippets.title: Pronouns Field for User Profiles
snippets.description: Adds an optional "Pronouns" field to user profiles and a [wpide_pronouns] shortcode that shows them, for example next to an author's name.
snippets.notes: Use [wpide_pronouns user="author"] inside posts to show the post author's pronouns; the default shows the logged-in user's.

snippets.title: New Sign-Ups per Month Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget showing how many people registered in each of the last six months, with simple bars, so you can see if your community is growing.
snippets.notes: Uses one grouped query, cached for 6 hours. Visible to users who can list users.

snippets.title: Show the Newest Users First in the Users List
snippets.description: Sorts the Users screen by registration date with the newest accounts on top by default, so new sign-ups are easy to review.
snippets.notes: Clicking a column header still sorts by that column.

snippets.title: Show Your Role in the Toolbar
snippets.description: Adds the current user's role next to their name in the admin toolbar ("Howdy, Sam (Editor)"), helpful when testing with several accounts.
snippets.notes: Shows all roles when a user has more than one.

snippets.title: Limit How Many Users a Role Can Have
snippets.description: Caps the number of accounts for chosen roles, such as a maximum of 3 Editors, and blocks adding or promoting anyone beyond that limit.
snippets.notes: Applies when users are added or edited in wp-admin. Existing users above the limit are not demoted.

snippets.title: Bulk "Add Role" Action on the Users Screen
snippets.description: Adds "Add role" options to the Bulk actions menu on the Users screen, so you can give a second role to many users at once without replacing their current role.
snippets.notes: Only roles you are allowed to assign are offered, never Administrator, and users you cannot promote are skipped.

snippets.title: Hide Members-Only Pages From Menus for Visitors
snippets.description: Removes menu links to posts and pages marked members-only (by the WPIDE "Members-Only Posts" snippet) or set to private, so visitors never see links they can't open.
snippets.notes: Logged-in users still see every link; restrictions by role are checked by the members-only snippet itself when the page is opened.

snippets.title: Record Where Each User Signed Up
snippets.description: Notes how every new account was created (registration form, admin screen, checkout, REST API or WP-CLI) and shows it in a "Signed up via" column on the Users screen.
snippets.notes: Only accounts created after activation are labelled.

snippets.title: Require Unique Display Names
snippets.description: Stops users from picking a public display name that another member already uses, which prevents impersonation in comments and forums.
snippets.notes: Checked when profiles are saved in wp-admin; existing duplicates are left alone until those users next save their profile.

snippets.title: bbPress: "Topic Starter" Badge on Replies
snippets.description: Adds a small "Topic starter" badge under the author's name on replies written by the person who opened the topic, making long threads easier to follow.
snippets.notes: Style the badge with the .wpide-bbp-starter class.

snippets.title: Comments Column in the Users List
snippets.description: Adds a "Comments" column to the Users screen showing how many approved comments each user has written, linked to their comments.
snippets.notes: Counts for the whole page of users are fetched with one query.

snippets.title: "Join for Free" Bar for Visitors
snippets.description: Shows a slim, dismissible bar at the bottom of the screen inviting visitors who are not logged in to create a free account or log in.
snippets.notes: Dismissing hides it for 30 days. It never shows to logged-in users or on the login page, and only links to registration when sign-ups are open.

snippets.title: Passwordless Login With an Email Link
snippets.description: Adds an "Email me a login link" option to the login screen; members enter their email or username and get a one-time link that logs them in for 15 minutes.
snippets.notes: Links work once and expire after 15 minutes. Roles in $wpide_magic_excluded_roles (administrators by default) must still use their password.

snippets.title: Emailed Login Code for Staff Accounts
snippets.description: Adds a second step for administrators and editors: after the correct password, WordPress emails a 6-digit code that must be entered to finish logging in.
snippets.notes: Make sure staff can receive email from the site before turning this on. Codes expire after 10 minutes and are locked after 5 wrong tries.

snippets.title: Email Users When They Log In From a New Device
snippets.description: Sends members an email when their account is used from a browser and network it has not seen before, so they can react quickly if it was not them.
snippets.notes: The first login after activation is remembered without an email. Only a hash of the browser and network is stored, not the full IP address.

snippets.title: Make New Users Change Their Password on First Login
snippets.description: When an administrator creates an account, the new user is sent to their profile and asked to choose a new password before they can use the rest of the site.
snippets.notes: Applies to accounts created by administrators from now on, not to self-registrations or existing users.

snippets.title: Expire Passwords After 90 Days
snippets.description: Makes users in chosen roles reset their password once it is older than 90 days; at login they are told it has expired and pointed to the password reset form.
snippets.notes: The clock starts for everyone on the day you activate the snippet, so nobody is locked out straight away.

snippets.title: Lost Password Form on Your Own Page
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_lost_password] shortcode with a "reset your password" form and points WordPress's "Lost your password?" links to the page that holds it.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_lost_password_page to the page ID. The reset link in the email still opens the secure WordPress screen to choose the new password.

snippets.title: Block Logins From Accounts Without a Role
snippets.description: Stops accounts that have no role on this site (often left over after a role was removed) from logging in, which closes a common gap on older sites.
snippets.notes: On multisite, network super admins are always allowed through.

snippets.title: Explain Why Visitors Were Sent to the Login Page
snippets.description: Shows "Please log in to view that page" above the login form when a visitor was redirected there from a members-only page, instead of a bare form.
snippets.notes: It shows whenever redirect_to points to a page on your own site rather than wp-admin.

snippets.title: Log Out Back to the Same Page
snippets.description: Makes every "Log out" link on the front of the site return people to the page they were reading instead of the login screen.
snippets.notes: Pages that need a login send people to the homepage instead, so nobody lands on a locked page.

snippets.title: Reject Login Attempts for Common Usernames
snippets.description: Refuses login attempts for usernames bots love to try, such as "admin", "administrator" or "root", before WordPress even checks a password.
snippets.notes: Make sure none of your real accounts use one of the listed usernames before activating.

snippets.title: "Welcome Back" Message After Logging In
snippets.description: Shows a small, dismissible "Welcome back, Sam!" notice on the front of the site right after a member logs in.
snippets.notes: The notice shows once per login and disappears after 6 seconds; it respects reduced-motion settings.

snippets.title: Allow Some Roles to Log In Only During Office Hours
snippets.description: Lets users in chosen roles, such as shop managers or support staff, log in only on working days between set hours in the site's time zone.
snippets.notes: Administrators are never restricted. Staff already logged in are logged out when office hours end.

snippets.title: Log Users Out Everywhere When Their Role Changes
snippets.description: Ends all of a user's active sessions as soon as an administrator changes or removes their role, so a demoted account cannot keep using old access.
snippets.notes: Your own sessions are kept when you change your own role, so you are not logged out mid-edit.

snippets.title: Lock Accounts That Haven't Been Used for Months
snippets.description: Blocks logins from accounts that have been inactive for a long time (180 days by default) until they reset their password, which protects forgotten accounts.
snippets.notes: Activity is tracked from activation, so existing users get a full period before any lock. Administrators are exempt.

snippets.title: Password Reset by Email Address Only
snippets.description: Makes the "Lost your password?" form accept only an email address, not a username, so the form can't be used to probe which usernames exist.
snippets.notes: The field label changes to "Email address" to match.

snippets.title: Members-Only Posts and Pages With Role Choice
snippets.description: Adds a "Members only" box to the post and page editor; restricted content shows a login prompt to visitors and to roles you did not tick, and stays out of search and feeds for them.
snippets.notes: Tick no roles to allow every logged-in user. Titles stay public; only the content and excerpt are hidden. Works in the block and classic editors.

snippets.title: Members-Only Category With a Teaser
snippets.description: Posts in a chosen category show visitors the first few lines followed by a log-in or sign-up box; logged-in members see the full post.
snippets.notes: Set the category slug and teaser length at the top. The teaser is plain text, so images and embeds in the hidden part are never sent to visitors.

snippets.title: Drip Content by Registration Date
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_drip days="7"] shortcode that unlocks the content inside it a set number of days after each member registered, and tells them when it unlocks.
snippets.notes: Example: [wpide_drip days="14"]Week 3 lesson[/wpide_drip]. Administrators and editors always see the content.

snippets.title: Unlock Posts a Number of Days After Joining
snippets.description: Adds an "Unlock after" field to the post editor so a post's content only appears to members a set number of days after they registered, perfect for e-mail-course style sites.
snippets.notes: Leave the field empty for posts everyone can read. Visitors who are not logged in see a login prompt on dripped posts.

snippets.title: Free Article Limit for Visitors (Metered Paywall)
snippets.description: Lets visitors read a few posts each month for free, then asks them to log in or sign up to keep reading; members always read without limits.
snippets.notes: The count is kept in a cookie, so it is a soft wall rather than strict protection. Exclude these posts from full-page caching for visitors, or the limit cannot apply.

snippets.title: Show or Hide Blocks for Members and Guests
snippets.description: Hides any block from visitors or members based on a CSS class you add in the block's Advanced panel: wpide-members-only, wpide-guests-only or wpide-role-{role}.
snippets.notes: Hidden blocks are removed on the server, so their content never reaches the browser. Example class for editors only: wpide-role-editor.

snippets.title: Members-Only Download Links
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_member_download id="123"] shortcode that gives logged-in members a personal download link for a Media Library file and shows visitors a login link instead.
snippets.notes: Links are tied to the member's session, so shared links do not work for others. The file's normal uploads URL is still public unless your server blocks it.

snippets.title: Private Pages for Individual Members
snippets.description: Adds a "Page owner" setting to pages so you can build a private page for one member or client; only that person and editors can open it, and a [wpide_my_pages] shortcode lists a member's pages.
snippets.notes: Visitors are sent to the login screen and other members get a 404, so the page's existence is not revealed.

snippets.title: Fade-Out Effect Above Members-Only Prompts
snippets.description: Styles the members-only and paywall prompts from the WPIDE library with a soft fade over the last lines of the teaser and a clear call-to-action box.
snippets.notes: Targets the .wpide-members-only, .wpide-teaser-box and .wpide-meter-wall boxes; change the colours to match your theme.

snippets.title: Private Full-Content RSS Feed for Members
snippets.description: Gives each member a personal feed URL (shown on their profile) that includes members-only posts in full, so they can read in a feed reader or podcast app.
snippets.notes: The key only unlocks feeds, never the rest of the site. Members can reset their key from their profile if the URL leaks.

snippets.title: Trial Accounts That Downgrade After a Set Number of Days
snippets.description: Gives new sign-ups a "trial" role for a limited time (14 days by default) and then switches them to a basic role automatically the next time they visit.
snippets.notes: Both roles must exist. Accounts made by administrators are not put on trial; [wpide_trial_days_left] shows the days remaining.

snippets.title: Lock Icon on Members-Only Post Titles
snippets.description: Adds a small lock symbol before the titles of members-only posts in lists and archives for visitors, so they know what needs an account before clicking.
snippets.notes: Works with posts marked members-only by the WPIDE "Members-Only Posts" snippet or placed in the members category; edit $wpide_lock_category to match yours.

snippets.title: Members-Only Content After the "More" Tag
snippets.description: Shows visitors everything above the "More" block of a post and keeps the rest for logged-in members, with a login prompt where the content stops.
snippets.notes: Only posts that contain a More block (or <!--more-->) are affected. Limit it to some categories with $wpide_more_categories.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Redirect Students After They Finish a Course
snippets.description: Sends students to a page of your choice (a thank-you page, survey or upsell) the next time they load a page after completing a LearnDash course.
snippets.notes: Map course IDs to pages in $wpide_ld_done_pages; the "default" entry is used for every other course. Leave it empty to only redirect the courses you list.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Course Progress Bar Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_ld_progress] shortcode that shows the logged-in student's progress in a course as an accessible bar with "4 of 10 steps (40%)".
snippets.notes: Inside a course, lesson or topic it uses the current course; elsewhere pass course_id="123".

snippets.title: LearnDash: "My Courses" List With Progress
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_ld_my_courses] shortcode that lists every course the student is enrolled in, with their progress and a Start, Continue or Review link.
snippets.notes: Visitors who are not logged in see a login link. Courses are listed in alphabetical order.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Students Column on the Courses Screen
snippets.description: Adds a "Students" column to the LearnDash Courses list showing how many users are enrolled in each course, cached for speed.
snippets.notes: Counts direct enrollments; students who only get access through a group, or courses set to "Open", are not included. Counts refresh every 6 hours.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Access Mode Column on the Courses Screen
snippets.description: Shows each course's access mode (Open, Free, Buy now, Recurring or Closed) in a column on the Courses list, so you can check pricing at a glance.
snippets.notes: Reads the course's own setting; nothing is stored.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Enroll New Users in Starter Courses
snippets.description: Automatically enrolls every newly registered user in the LearnDash courses you choose, such as a free onboarding course.
snippets.notes: Add your course IDs to $wpide_ld_starter_courses. Existing users are not enrolled.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Enroll Users When They Get a Role
snippets.description: Gives users access to chosen LearnDash courses as soon as they are given a role, for example enrolling every new "Employee" in the compliance training.
snippets.notes: Access is added, never removed, when roles change. Works for role changes from the admin, other plugins and new registrations.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Email the Admin When a Course Is Completed
