snippets.description: Emails you (or a list of addresses) whenever a student completes a LearnDash course, with the student's name and a link to their profile.
snippets.notes: Add more addresses to $wpide_ld_notify_emails, or limit it to some courses with $wpide_ld_notify_courses.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Congratulations Email With Certificate Link
snippets.description: Sends students a friendly congratulations email when they complete a course, including a link to download their certificate when the course has one.
snippets.notes: Edit the subject and message at the top; %1$s is the student's first name and %2$s the course title.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Encouraging Email When a Quiz Is Failed
snippets.description: Emails students who did not pass a LearnDash quiz with their score and a link to try again, so they do not give up.
snippets.notes: Sent at most once a day per quiz and student, so repeated attempts do not flood their inbox.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Send Visitors to Login From Lessons
snippets.description: Redirects logged-out visitors who open a lesson, topic or quiz to the login screen, then brings them back to that page after they log in.
snippets.notes: Course pages stay public so visitors can still see what they would be buying.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Certificate Download Button Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_ld_certificate course_id="123"] shortcode that shows a "Download your certificate" button once the student has completed the course, and nothing before that.
snippets.notes: Inside a course or lesson the course_id can be left out. Change the button text with label="...".

snippets.title: LearnDash: Course Completion Date Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_ld_completed_on] shortcode that shows the date the student completed a course, or a "not completed yet" message.
snippets.notes: Use course_id="123" outside a course, and format="j F Y" for a custom date format.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Show Students When Their Course Access Expires
snippets.description: Shows a notice at the top of course, lesson and topic pages telling enrolled students the date their access ends, for courses that use access expiration.
snippets.notes: Only shows for courses with "Expire access" turned on. The notice turns into a warning in the last 7 days.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Last Learning Activity Column in Users
snippets.description: Records when each student last completed a lesson, topic or quiz and shows it in a sortable "Last learning activity" column on the Users screen.
snippets.notes: Activity is recorded from the moment the snippet is active; earlier activity is not back-filled.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Enrolled Courses Column in Users
snippets.description: Adds a "Courses" column to the Users screen showing how many LearnDash courses each user is enrolled in and how many they have completed.
snippets.notes: Uses LearnDash's own enrollment data, which LearnDash caches per user.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Keep Lessons and Quizzes Out of Site Search
snippets.description: Removes LearnDash lessons, topics, quizzes and certificates from your site's search results so visitors only find courses, not locked lesson pages.
snippets.notes: Courses stay searchable. Add sfwd-courses to the list to hide those too.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Stop Search Engines Indexing Lessons
snippets.description: Tells search engines not to index LearnDash lessons, topics, quizzes and certificates, which are usually locked and only show a login message to crawlers.
snippets.notes: Links on those pages are still followed. Course pages stay indexable.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Brand Colour for Progress Bars and Buttons
snippets.description: Recolours LearnDash's progress bars, "Mark Complete" buttons and completed-step checkmarks to your brand colour with a few lines of CSS.
snippets.notes: Change --wpide-ld-brand to your colour. LearnDash's own colour settings in the Design panel take precedence when set.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Body Classes for Course Status
snippets.description: Adds body classes such as wpide-ld-enrolled and wpide-ld-completed on course, lesson and topic pages, so you can style or hide things with CSS depending on the student's status.
snippets.notes: Classes: wpide-ld-guest, wpide-ld-not-enrolled, wpide-ld-enrolled and wpide-ld-completed.

snippets.title: LearnDash: "Resume Course" Button Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_ld_resume course_id="123"] shortcode that takes students straight to the first lesson or topic they have not finished yet.
snippets.notes: Falls back to the course page when every step is done or the next step cannot be found.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Best Quiz Score Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_ld_best_score quiz_id="123"] shortcode that shows the student's best percentage on a quiz and whether they passed.
snippets.notes: Inside a quiz the quiz_id can be left out. Students who have not taken the quiz see "Not attempted yet".

snippets.title: LearnDash: Give a Role When a Quiz Is Passed
snippets.description: Adds a role to students when they pass a chosen LearnDash quiz, for example a "Certified" role that unlocks a members area.
snippets.notes: The role is added alongside the student's current role. Make sure the role exists (for example with a role editor plugin).

snippets.title: LearnDash: Change Role After Course Completion
snippets.description: Adds a role (or replaces the current one) when a student completes a chosen course, such as promoting trainees to "Instructor".
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_ld_replace_role to true to swap the role instead of adding it. Administrators are never changed.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Turn Off Comments on Lessons and Quizzes
snippets.description: Closes comments on LearnDash lessons, topics and quizzes, and hides existing ones, while leaving comments on courses and blog posts alone.
snippets.notes: Remove a post type from the list to keep its comments open.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Add New Users to a Group
snippets.description: Puts every newly registered user into a LearnDash group automatically, giving them the group's courses and placing them under its group leaders.
snippets.notes: Set the group ID at the top. Users created by an administrator are included too.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Send Unenrolled Students to the Course Page
snippets.description: When a logged-in user opens a lesson or topic of a course they are not enrolled in, they are sent to the course page where they can enroll, instead of seeing a locked page.
snippets.notes: Administrators and group leaders are never redirected.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Ungraded Essays Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget that shows how many essay submissions are waiting to be graded, with a link straight to the list.
snippets.notes: Visible to users who can edit others' posts. The count is cached for 15 minutes.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Recent Course Completions Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Keeps a short log of the latest course completions and shows it in a dashboard widget with student names, courses and how long ago.
snippets.notes: The log starts when the snippet is activated and keeps the 15 most recent completions in one small option.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Email Group Leaders When Their Students Finish a Course
snippets.description: Notifies the leaders of each LearnDash group a student belongs to when that student completes a course, so managers can follow their team's training.
snippets.notes: Leaders get one email per completion, even if they lead several of the student's groups.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Enroll in the Next Course After Completing One
snippets.description: Builds a learning path by enrolling students in the next course automatically as soon as they complete the previous one.
snippets.notes: Map each completed course to the course(s) that should open next. Use LearnDash's prerequisites as well if the next course must stay locked otherwise.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Student Count Shortcode for Course Pages
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_ld_students] shortcode that shows social proof such as "1,240 students enrolled" on a course page, cached so it stays fast.
snippets.notes: Use course_id="123" outside a course and min="50" to hide the count until it is worth showing. Counts direct enrollments and refresh every 12 hours.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Course Status Badge Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_ld_status] shortcode that shows a small "Not started", "In progress" or "Completed" badge for the current student and course.
snippets.notes: Style it with the classes .wpide-ld-status.is-not-started, .is-in-progress and .is-completed.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Custom Page After a Student Completes a Course
snippets.description: Sends students to a page you choose, such as a survey or next-steps page, the next time they load a page after completing a LifterLMS course.
snippets.notes: Map course IDs to URLs; the "default" entry covers every other course. Remove it to only redirect the courses you list.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Enroll New Users in Starter Courses
snippets.description: Enrolls every newly registered user in the LifterLMS courses or memberships you choose, such as a free welcome course.
snippets.notes: Add course or membership IDs to $wpide_llms_starter_products. Existing users are not enrolled.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Course Progress Bar Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_llms_progress] shortcode that shows the logged-in student's progress through a course as an accessible bar with a percentage.
snippets.notes: On a course or lesson page it uses that course; elsewhere add course_id="123".

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Course Completion Alerts for the Site Admin
snippets.description: Emails you whenever a student completes a LifterLMS course, with their name, email and a link to their reporting page.
snippets.notes: Add more recipients to $wpide_llms_notify_emails.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Personal Welcome Email on Enrollment
snippets.description: Sends students a short, personal welcome email when they are enrolled in a LifterLMS course, with a direct link to start learning.
snippets.notes: Limit it to some courses with $wpide_llms_welcome_courses; leave it empty for all courses.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Encouraging Email When a Quiz Is Failed
snippets.description: Emails students who fail a LifterLMS quiz with their grade and a link to review the lesson and try again.
snippets.notes: Sent at most once a day per student and quiz.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Remove Student Dashboard Tabs You Don't Use
snippets.description: Hides tabs such as Redeem a Voucher, Notifications or Achievements from the LifterLMS student dashboard to keep it simple.
snippets.notes: Tab IDs include dashboard, view-courses, view-memberships, view-achievements, view-certificates, notifications, edit-account, redeem-voucher and orders.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Send Students to Their Dashboard After Login
snippets.description: Sends students who log in through wp-login.php to the LifterLMS student dashboard instead of the WordPress admin profile.
snippets.notes: Staff who can edit posts still go to wp-admin, and an explicit redirect_to link is respected.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Courses Column in the Users List
snippets.description: Adds a "Courses" column to the Users screen showing how many LifterLMS courses each user is enrolled in.
snippets.notes: Links to the student's LifterLMS reporting page for details.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Students Column on the Courses Screen
snippets.description: Adds a "Students" column to the LifterLMS Courses list showing how many students are currently enrolled, cached for speed.
snippets.notes: Counts refresh every 6 hours and whenever someone enrolls or is removed.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Stop Search Engines Indexing Lessons and Quizzes
snippets.description: Adds a noindex instruction to LifterLMS lessons, quizzes and certificates, which are usually locked and only show crawlers a restriction message.
snippets.notes: Course and membership pages stay indexable.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Remove Lessons and Quizzes From Search Results
snippets.description: Removes LifterLMS lessons and quizzes from your site's search results so visitors find courses instead of locked lesson pages.
snippets.notes: Courses and memberships stay searchable.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Add a Role While Users Are in a Membership
snippets.description: Gives users an extra role when they join a LifterLMS membership and removes it again when they leave, so other plugins can use roles for access.
snippets.notes: Map membership IDs to roles that already exist. The user's main role is never touched.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Body Classes for Enrollment Status
snippets.description: Adds body classes such as wpide-llms-enrolled or wpide-llms-completed on course and lesson pages so you can tailor the design for each student.
snippets.notes: Classes: wpide-llms-guest, wpide-llms-not-enrolled, wpide-llms-enrolled, wpide-llms-completed.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Send Visitors to Login From Lessons
snippets.description: Redirects logged-out visitors who open a lesson or quiz to the login screen, then back to that lesson once they log in.
snippets.notes: Free lessons marked as "free lesson" in LifterLMS stay open to everyone.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Turn Off Comments on Lessons and Quizzes
snippets.description: Closes and hides comments on LifterLMS lessons and quizzes without affecting comments on your blog posts.
snippets.notes: Remove lesson from the list if you use lesson comments for discussions.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Add a Role After Course Completion
snippets.description: Adds a role to students when they complete a chosen LifterLMS course, for example to unlock a graduates-only area.
snippets.notes: The role is added next to the student's current role and must already exist.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Learning Path With Automatic Next-Course Enrollment
snippets.description: Creates a learning path by enrolling students in the next LifterLMS course automatically when they finish the previous one.
snippets.notes: Map each completed course to the course(s) that should follow.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Content Only for Enrolled Students
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_llms_enrolled id="123"] shortcode that shows its content only to students enrolled in a course or membership, with an optional message for everyone else.
snippets.notes: Example: [wpide_llms_enrolled id="123" message="Enroll to download the workbook."]Download link[/wpide_llms_enrolled].

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Dashboard Widget Listing the Latest Graduates
snippets.description: Keeps a short log of the latest LifterLMS course completions and shows it as a dashboard widget for admins and instructors.
snippets.notes: The log starts when you activate the snippet and holds the last 15 completions.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Last Lesson Completed Column in Users
snippets.description: Records when each student last completed a LifterLMS lesson and shows it in a "Last lesson" column on the Users screen, to spot students who have stalled.
snippets.notes: Activity is tracked from activation onwards.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Redirect Students After They Complete a Course
snippets.description: Sends students to a page you choose, such as a review request or next course, right after they click "Complete Course" in Tutor LMS.
snippets.notes: Map course IDs to URLs; "default" applies to all other courses.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Enroll New Users in Free Courses
snippets.description: Enrolls every newly registered user in the Tutor LMS courses you choose, such as a free getting-started course.
snippets.notes: Use free courses here; paid courses should be enrolled through their checkout.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Course Progress Bar Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_tutor_progress] shortcode that shows the logged-in student's completion percentage for a Tutor LMS course as an accessible progress bar.
snippets.notes: On a course page it uses that course; elsewhere add course_id="123".

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Email the Admin When a Course Is Completed
snippets.description: Emails you whenever a student completes a Tutor LMS course, with the student's name, email and the course.
snippets.notes: Add more addresses to $wpide_tutor_notify_emails; the course instructor can be added with the option below.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Send a Start-Learning Email to New Students
snippets.description: Sends students a friendly welcome email with a direct "start learning" link as soon as they enroll in a Tutor LMS course.
snippets.notes: Limit it to some courses with $wpide_tutor_welcome_courses; leave empty for all.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Remove Student Dashboard Menu Items
snippets.description: Hides student dashboard menu items you don't use, such as Wishlist, Reviews or Q&A, to keep the Tutor LMS dashboard focused.
snippets.notes: Item keys depend on your Tutor version; in Tutor 2 and 3 they include wishlist, reviews, question-answer, my-quiz-attempts and purchase_history.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Enrolled Student Count in the Courses Admin List
snippets.description: Adds a "Students" column to the Tutor LMS courses list in wp-admin showing how many students are enrolled in each course.
snippets.notes: Counts are cached for 6 hours and refreshed when someone enrolls.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Enrolled Courses Column in Users
snippets.description: Adds a "Courses" column to the Users screen showing how many Tutor LMS courses each user is enrolled in.
snippets.notes: Uses Tutor's own enrollment records.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Noindex for Lessons, Quizzes and Assignments
snippets.description: Adds a noindex instruction to Tutor LMS lessons, quizzes and assignments, which are normally locked and only show crawlers a login wall.
snippets.notes: Course pages stay indexable.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Keep Lessons Out of Site Search
snippets.description: Removes Tutor LMS lessons, quizzes and assignments from your site search so visitors land on course pages instead.
snippets.notes: Courses stay searchable.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Grant a Role to Course Graduates
snippets.description: Adds a role to students when they complete a chosen Tutor LMS course, for example to open a graduates-only forum or downloads area.
snippets.notes: The role must already exist and is added next to the student's current role.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Email the Instructor When a Quiz Is Submitted
snippets.description: Emails the course author each time a student finishes a Tutor LMS quiz, with the score, so instructors can follow up or grade open questions quickly.
snippets.notes: The email goes to the author of the course the quiz belongs to.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Enrolled-Students-Only Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_tutor_enrolled course_id="123"] shortcode that shows its content only to students enrolled in that course, with an optional message for others.
snippets.notes: Example: [wpide_tutor_enrolled course_id="123" message="Enroll to get the slides."]Slides link[/wpide_tutor_enrolled].

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: CSS Classes Based on the Student's Course Status
snippets.description: Adds body classes such as wpide-tutor-enrolled or wpide-tutor-completed on Tutor LMS course pages, so you can show or hide elements with CSS.
snippets.notes: Classes: wpide-tutor-guest, wpide-tutor-not-enrolled, wpide-tutor-enrolled, wpide-tutor-completed.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Land on the Tutor Dashboard After Logging In
snippets.description: Sends students who log in through wp-login.php to the Tutor LMS dashboard instead of the WordPress admin profile.
snippets.notes: Staff who can edit posts still go to wp-admin, and explicit redirect_to links are respected.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Email the Admin About New Student Sign-Ups
snippets.description: Emails the site admin when someone registers through the Tutor LMS student registration form.
snippets.notes: Only Tutor's student sign-up form triggers this email, not other registration forms.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Enroll in the Next Course After Completing One
snippets.description: Builds a learning path by enrolling students in the next Tutor LMS course automatically when they complete the previous one.
snippets.notes: Best used with free follow-up courses.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Track Each Student's Most Recent Lesson in Users
snippets.description: Records when each student last completed a Tutor LMS lesson and shows it in a "Last lesson" column on the Users screen.
snippets.notes: Tracking starts when the snippet is activated.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Recent Course Completions Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Keeps a log of the latest Tutor LMS course completions and shows them in a dashboard widget with student names and dates.
snippets.notes: Keeps the 15 most recent completions, starting from activation.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Brand Colour for Progress Bars
snippets.description: Recolours Tutor LMS progress bars and the course completion button to your brand colour.
snippets.notes: Change --wpide-tutor-brand. Tutor's colour settings under Tutor LMS > Settings > Design take precedence when set.

snippets.title: "Mark as Complete" Button for Lesson Posts (No LMS Needed)
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_mark_complete] shortcode that lets logged-in readers tick off a post or page as done, turning a plain blog series into a simple course without an LMS plugin.
snippets.notes: Completed lessons are stored per user in the wpide_completed_lessons user meta. Pair it with the "Series Progress" snippet to show overall progress.

snippets.title: Series Progress for a Category of Lessons (No LMS Needed)
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_series_progress category="course-1"] shortcode that shows how many posts in a category the reader has marked complete, with a progress bar and checklist.
snippets.notes: Works with the "Mark as Complete" button snippet. Posts are listed oldest first; add list="no" to show only the bar.

snippets.title: Previous and Next Lesson Links Within a Category
snippets.description: Adds "Previous lesson" and "Next lesson" links at the end of posts in your course categories, in publishing order, so readers can work through a series.
snippets.notes: List the category slugs that are courses in $wpide_course_categories. Links stay inside the same category.

snippets.title: LearnDash: Email the Admin About New Enrollments
snippets.description: Sends you an email whenever a user is given access to a LearnDash course, whether through purchase, a group or manual enrollment.
snippets.notes: Removals are not reported. Limit it to some courses with $wpide_ld_enroll_courses.

snippets.title: LearnDash: "Edit Course" Link in the Toolbar on Lessons
snippets.description: Adds an "Edit Course" link to the admin toolbar when you view a lesson, topic or quiz, so you can jump straight to the parent course's builder.
snippets.notes: Only shown to users who can edit the course.

snippets.title: LifterLMS: Email the Admin About New Enrollments
snippets.description: Emails you when a student is enrolled in a LifterLMS course, so you can welcome them personally or keep an eye on sales.
snippets.notes: Fires for every enrollment trigger: purchases, memberships, vouchers and manual enrollments.

snippets.title: Tutor LMS: Admin Alert for Every New Course Enrollment
snippets.description: Emails the site admin each time a student enrolls in a Tutor LMS course, with the student's name and the course title.
snippets.notes: Limit it to some courses with $wpide_tutor_enroll_courses.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Hide "Active X Minutes Ago" on Profiles
snippets.description: Removes the "active 5 minutes ago" timestamps from BuddyPress profiles and the members directory, for communities where members value privacy.
snippets.notes: BuddyPress still records activity internally, so "Active" sorting in the directory keeps working.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Send Members From the Levels Page to Their Account
snippets.description: Redirects members who already have a level away from the levels page to their membership account page, unless they came to change their level.
snippets.notes: Add ?change=1 to links where members should be able to pick a new level.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Send Existing Members From Sign-Up Pages to Their Account
snippets.description: Redirects logged-in members who already own a membership away from that membership's sign-up page to their account page, avoiding accidental double purchases.
snippets.notes: Members can still buy other memberships; only the one they already have redirects.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Send Members to Their Profile After Login
snippets.description: Sends members to their own BuddyPress profile (or activity stream) after logging in, instead of the WordPress dashboard.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_bp_login_target to "activity" to land on the site-wide activity stream. Staff who can edit posts still go to wp-admin.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Hide Administrators From the Members Directory
snippets.description: Keeps site administrators (and any other roles you list) out of the BuddyPress members directory and member counts on the directory page.
snippets.notes: Hidden members can still be found by visiting their profile URL directly. The list of IDs is cached for an hour.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Members-Only Community Pages
snippets.description: Sends logged-out visitors who open BuddyPress pages (members, profiles, activity, groups) to the login screen, so the community is visible to members only.
snippets.notes: Registration and account activation pages stay open so new members can still sign up.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Remove Profile Tabs You Don't Need
snippets.description: Removes tabs from BuddyPress member profiles, such as Friends or Groups, while leaving the components switched on elsewhere.
snippets.notes: Use tab slugs such as friends, groups, notifications, messages or settings. To remove a sub-tab add "parent/child", for example "settings/profile".

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Strip Links From New Members' Activity Updates
snippets.description: Turns links into plain text in activity updates posted by members who joined recently, which takes the reward out of spam sign-ups.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_bp_link_days to set how long members count as new. Moderators are never affected.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Mark Activity With Blocked Words as Spam
snippets.description: Automatically marks activity updates and comments that contain words from your blocklist as spam, so they never appear in the stream.
snippets.notes: Words are matched case-insensitively as whole words. Spammed items can be reviewed under Activity in wp-admin.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Hide Noisy Activity Types From the Stream
snippets.description: Removes routine entries such as "became a registered member", "changed their profile picture" and new friendships from the activity streams.
snippets.notes: The entries are hidden, not deleted, so removing a type from the list brings them back.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Show a Profile Field in the Members Directory
snippets.description: Shows a profile field such as Location or Job Title under each member's name in the BuddyPress members directory.
snippets.notes: Use the exact field name from Users > Profile Fields. Field visibility settings are respected.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Profile Field Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_bp_field name="Location"] shortcode that prints a BuddyPress profile field for the logged-in member, or for the profile being viewed.
snippets.notes: Add user="displayed" to show the field of the profile being viewed instead of the logged-in member.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Turn Off @Mentions
snippets.description: Switches off @mention links, notifications and the mention autocomplete in BuddyPress for communities that don't want them.
snippets.notes: Existing mention links in old updates are left as they are.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Don't Load Gravatar for Member Avatars
snippets.description: Stops BuddyPress from requesting Gravatar images for members without an uploaded photo and uses the local mystery-person image instead, for privacy and speed.
snippets.notes: Members who upload their own profile photo are not affected.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Turn Off Cover Images
snippets.description: Disables cover image uploads for member profiles and groups, keeping profiles simple and saving storage.
snippets.notes: Set either variable to false to keep that kind of cover image.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Limit the Length of Activity Updates
snippets.description: Shortens activity updates and comments longer than a set number of characters, which keeps the stream readable and discourages wall-of-text spam.
snippets.notes: Moderators can post longer updates. A maxlength is also added to the update box so members see the limit while typing.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Email the Admin When a Member Activates
snippets.description: Emails the site admin when a new member activates their BuddyPress account, with a link to their profile.
snippets.notes: Fires once the member has clicked their activation link, so unconfirmed spam sign-ups are not reported.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Add New Members to Groups Automatically
snippets.description: Adds every newly activated member to the BuddyPress groups you choose, such as a "Welcome" or "Announcements" group.
snippets.notes: Use group IDs (shown in the Groups admin list). Works with public, private and hidden groups.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Unread Notifications Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_bp_notifications] shortcode that shows a bell link with the member's unread BuddyPress notification count, for headers and menus built with blocks.
snippets.notes: Shows nothing to visitors. Style the badge with .wpide-bp-bell__count.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Members per Page in the Directory
snippets.description: Changes how many members the BuddyPress members directory shows per page, and can switch the default order to alphabetical.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_bp_default_order to "" to keep BuddyPress's own "last active" order.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Add a Custom Tab to Member Profiles
snippets.description: Adds a new tab to every BuddyPress member profile with your own content, for example "Portfolio" showing the member's posts.
snippets.notes: The example lists the member's published posts; replace the content callback with your own output.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Last Active Column on the Users Screen
snippets.description: Adds a "Last active" column to the WordPress Users screen using BuddyPress's activity tracking, so you can see who is actually using the community.
snippets.notes: Shows "Never" for members who have not been active since BuddyPress was installed.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Username Rules on the Sign-Up Form
snippets.description: Requires BuddyPress usernames to be at least a few characters long and not just numbers, giving members a clear error message on the sign-up form.
snippets.notes: BuddyPress already limits usernames to letters and numbers; this adds length and "not only digits" checks.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Only Friends Can Send Private Messages
snippets.description: Limits BuddyPress private messages so members can only message people who have accepted their friend request, which cuts down unwanted messages.
snippets.notes: Moderators can still message anyone. If none of the recipients are friends the message is not sent and BuddyPress shows its error notice.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Let Only Certain Roles Create Groups
snippets.description: Restricts creating BuddyPress groups to the roles you choose, such as editors or paying members, while everyone can still join groups.
snippets.notes: Administrators can always create groups.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Hide Administrators' Activity From the Stream
snippets.description: Keeps activity created by administrators (such as testing posts and profile edits) out of the public activity streams.
snippets.notes: Administrators still see everything on their own profile. The ID list is cached for an hour.

snippets.title: BuddyPress: Remind Members to Complete Their Profile
snippets.description: Shows a friendly notice on BuddyPress pages to members who have not filled in important profile fields or uploaded a profile photo, with a link to edit their profile.
snippets.notes: List the field names to check in $wpide_bp_required_fields. The result is cached per member for an hour.

snippets.title: bbPress: Hold Posts From New Members for Moderation
snippets.description: Puts topics and replies from members who joined recently, or who have few approved posts, into the pending queue until a moderator approves them.
snippets.notes: Members are trusted once they pass either limit. Moderators and keymasters are never held.

snippets.title: bbPress: Block Links in Posts From New Members
snippets.description: Stops members who joined in the last few days from posting links in forum topics and replies, with a clear message explaining why.
snippets.notes: Moderators and keymasters can always post links.

snippets.title: bbPress: Reject Posts With Blocked Words
snippets.description: Refuses forum topics and replies that contain words or phrases from your blocklist, showing the member a polite error instead of publishing them.
snippets.notes: Matching ignores case and checks both the title and the content. Moderators are not checked.

snippets.title: bbPress: Email the Admin About New Topics
snippets.description: Sends the site admin (or a moderator address) an email with the title, author and link whenever a new forum topic is posted.
snippets.notes: Limit it to some forums with $wpide_bbp_notify_forums; leave empty for all forums.

snippets.title: bbPress: Forums for Logged-In Members Only
snippets.description: Sends logged-out visitors who open any forum, topic or forum profile to the login screen, making the whole bbPress forum private.
snippets.notes: Forum content is also kept out of feeds for visitors.

snippets.title: bbPress: Limit Certain Forums to Specific Roles
snippets.description: Lets only chosen roles open particular forums and their topics, for example a "Staff" forum for editors or a "VIP" forum for paying members.
snippets.notes: Other visitors are sent to the login screen (if logged out) or the forum index. Keymasters always have access.

snippets.title: bbPress: Rename Forum Roles
snippets.description: Changes the names of bbPress forum roles shown next to members' posts, for example "Participant" to "Member" and "Keymaster" to "Admin".
snippets.notes: Only the labels change; capabilities stay the same.

snippets.title: bbPress: Topics and Replies per Page
snippets.description: Changes how many topics a forum page lists and how many replies a topic page shows, independent of the bbPress settings screen.
snippets.notes: Large numbers make pages heavier; 20 to 50 is a good range.

snippets.title: bbPress: Hide Breadcrumbs and Forum Info Notices
snippets.description: Removes the bbPress breadcrumb trail and the grey "This forum has X topics" info boxes for a cleaner forum layout.
snippets.notes: Set either option to false to keep that element.

snippets.title: bbPress: Post Count and Join Date Under Forum Authors
snippets.description: Shows how many posts each member has made and when they joined under their name in forum topics and replies.
snippets.notes: Counts come from bbPress's own cached totals, so this adds no heavy queries.

snippets.title: bbPress: Minimum Length for Topics and Replies
snippets.description: Refuses very short forum posts such as "thanks" or "+1" by requiring a minimum number of characters in topics and replies.
snippets.notes: Set separate limits for topics and replies at the top.

snippets.title: bbPress: Change the Maximum Topic Title Length
snippets.description: Raises or lowers the maximum number of characters allowed in bbPress topic titles (80 by default).
snippets.notes: Very long titles can break forum layouts on phones; 100 to 120 is a sensible maximum.

snippets.title: bbPress: Stop Replies to Old, Inactive Topics
snippets.description: Hides the reply form on topics with no activity for a set number of days and shows a note instead, which prevents necro-posting and old-thread spam.
snippets.notes: Topics are not changed in the database; the reply form simply stops showing. Moderators can still reply.

snippets.title: bbPress: Tick "Notify Me of Follow-Up Replies" by Default
snippets.description: Pre-ticks the subscription checkbox on new topics and replies, so members get email notifications about their own discussions unless they opt out.
snippets.notes: Members can still untick the box; existing subscriptions are not changed.

snippets.title: bbPress: Email Moderators About Posts Waiting for Approval
snippets.description: Emails forum moderators and keymasters when a topic or reply lands in the pending queue (for example from Akismet or moderation rules), so nothing waits for days.
snippets.notes: Sends at most one email every 15 minutes to avoid floods during spam waves.

snippets.title: bbPress: Keep Forum Posts Out of Site Search
snippets.description: Removes forums, topics and replies from your main WordPress search results so blog searches stay focused; bbPress's own forum search still works.
snippets.notes: The forum search box (bbPress search) is not affected.

snippets.title: bbPress: Stop Search Engines Indexing Forum Profiles
snippets.description: Adds noindex to bbPress user profile pages, which are thin, duplicate content and a common target for spam sign-ups trying to get links indexed.
snippets.notes: Forums and topics stay indexable.

snippets.title: bbPress: Allow Headings and Code Blocks in Posts
snippets.description: Lets forum members use more formatting in topics and replies, such as headings, preformatted code blocks and tables, which is handy for technical forums.
snippets.notes: Only harmless formatting tags are added; no scripts, styles or attributes that could be abused.

snippets.title: bbPress: "Mark as Solved" for Support Topics
snippets.description: Lets topic authors and moderators mark a topic as solved with one click; solved topics get a "[Solved]" label in their title so others find answers quickly.
snippets.notes: The button appears above the topic for its author and moderators. Clicking again marks the topic as unsolved.

snippets.title: bbPress: Only Staff Can Start Topics in Announcement Forums
snippets.description: Stops regular members from creating new topics in chosen forums, such as Announcements, while still letting them reply.
snippets.notes: Staff means anyone with bbPress moderator rights. Set $wpide_bbp_allow_replies to false to block replies too.

snippets.title: bbPress: Limit New Topics per Member per Day
snippets.description: Caps how many new topics a member can start in 24 hours, which stops spammers and over-eager posters from flooding the forums.
snippets.notes: Replies are not limited. Moderators are exempt.

snippets.title: bbPress: Welcome Notice Above the Forum Index
snippets.description: Shows a short welcome or rules notice above the list of forums, with a link to your community guidelines.
snippets.notes: Edit the text and link at the top; leave the link empty to show the text only.

snippets.title: bbPress: Turn Off Topic Tags
snippets.description: Removes the topic tags field from the new topic form and hides tag clouds and tag lists, for forums that don't use tags.
snippets.notes: Existing tags stay in the database and come back if you remove the snippet.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Different Login Destinations per Membership
snippets.description: Sends members to a different page after logging in depending on the membership they hold, for example Gold members to the Gold dashboard.
snippets.notes: Memberships are checked in the order listed, so put your highest tier first. Works with the MemberPress login form and wp-login.php.

snippets.title: MemberPress: List the Member's Active Memberships
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_mepr_memberships] shortcode that lists the logged-in member's active memberships by name, for welcome boxes and account pages.
snippets.notes: Shows the optional none="..." text when the member has no active membership.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Add a Role While a Membership Is Active
snippets.description: Gives members an extra WordPress role when they buy a membership and removes it when that membership expires, so role-based plugins can follow MemberPress.
snippets.notes: The role must exist. It is only removed when the member no longer has any active transaction for that membership.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Email the Admin When a Membership Expires
snippets.description: Sends you an email when a member's MemberPress transaction expires, so you can reach out personally before they forget about you.
snippets.notes: MemberPress also fires this event for one-off transactions that reach their end date. Members who renewed in time are skipped.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Add a Custom Tab to the Account Page
snippets.description: Adds a new tab, such as "Resources" or "Support", to the MemberPress account page navigation with your own content.
snippets.notes: Put your content in $wpide_mepr_tab_content; shortcodes are allowed.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Only Allow Sign-Ups From Certain Email Domains
snippets.description: Rejects MemberPress registrations unless the email address belongs to one of your allowed domains, ideal for company or school memberships.
snippets.notes: Existing members logging in are not affected. Subdomains count, so "example.edu" also allows "mail.example.edu".

snippets.title: MemberPress: Reassurance Note Above the Sign-Up Button
snippets.description: Shows a short "secure checkout, cancel any time" note with a padlock just above the MemberPress sign-up button to reduce hesitation.
snippets.code: 🔒 Secure checkout. Cancel any time from your account page.
snippets.notes: Edit the wording to match your refund and cancellation policy.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Active Memberships Column in Users
snippets.description: Adds a "Memberships" column to the WordPress Users screen showing each user's active MemberPress memberships at a glance.
snippets.notes: Users without an active membership show a dash.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Email the Admin About New Members
snippets.description: Sends you a short email with the member's name, email and membership as soon as someone completes a MemberPress sign-up.
snippets.notes: Complements MemberPress's own admin emails with a plain summary you can forward or filter.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Show Menu Items Only to Certain Memberships
snippets.description: Hides navigation menu items from people who don't hold a given MemberPress membership, using a CSS class like wpide-mepr-123 on the menu item.
snippets.notes: Enable "CSS Classes" under Screen Options in Appearance > Menus, then add wpide-mepr-{membership ID}. Several classes mean "any of these".

snippets.title: MemberPress: Hide the Coupon Field on Sign-Up Forms
snippets.description: Hides the coupon code field on MemberPress registration forms so visitors without a code don't leave to hunt for one; coupon links keep working.
snippets.notes: Coupons can still be applied with a link that adds ?coupon=CODE to the sign-up page.

snippets.title: MemberPress: Membership Options Under the Access-Denied Message
snippets.description: Lists your memberships with "Join" links right below the MemberPress unauthorized message, so visitors can upgrade without searching for the pricing page.
