snippets.title: MemberPress: Body Classes for Active Memberships
snippets.description: Adds body classes like wpide-mepr-member and wpide-mepr-123 for each active membership, so you can show, hide or restyle parts of your theme with CSS.
snippets.notes: Visitors without a membership get wpide-mepr-non-member. Use CSS for presentation only; protect real content with MemberPress rules.

snippets.title: MemberPress + LearnDash: Enroll Members in Courses
snippets.description: Gives MemberPress members access to the LearnDash courses tied to their membership when they pay, and removes it when the membership expires.
snippets.notes: Map membership IDs to course IDs. Only access granted by this snippet is removed, and only when no other active membership includes the course.

snippets.title: MemberPress + BuddyPress: Add Members to a Group
snippets.description: Adds MemberPress members to a BuddyPress group for their membership when they pay, giving each tier its own private community space.
snippets.notes: Map membership IDs to BuddyPress group IDs. Members are not removed from groups automatically when they leave.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Login Destination per Level
snippets.description: Sends members to a different page after logging in depending on their membership level, for example Premium members to the premium library.
snippets.notes: Levels are checked in the order listed. Members without a listed level keep the normal destination.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Give Each Level Its Own Role
snippets.description: Adds a WordPress role that matches the member's level when they join and removes it when they cancel, expire or change level.
snippets.notes: The roles must exist. The member's main role is kept, and administrators are never changed.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Membership End Date Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [wpide_pmpro_expires] shortcode that shows when the member's current level ends, or "never" for levels without an end date.
snippets.notes: Recurring levels usually have no end date and show the "never" text; change it with never="renews automatically".

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Email the Admin When a Membership Expires
snippets.description: Sends you a short email when Paid Memberships Pro expires a member's level, so you can follow up personally.
snippets.notes: Fires from PMPro's daily expiration check.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Move Expired Members to a Free Level
snippets.description: When a paid membership expires, the member is moved to your free level instead of losing membership entirely, so they keep basic access and stay on your list.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_pmpro_free_level to the ID of a free level that already exists.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Restrict Checkout to Certain Email Domains
snippets.description: Only lets people check out with an email address from your allowed domains, for company, school or association memberships.
snippets.notes: Existing members checking out while logged in are checked against their account email.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Extra Links on the Account Page
snippets.description: Adds your own links, such as "Member resources" or "Book a call", to the Member Links box on the Paid Memberships Pro account page.
snippets.notes: Add a level ID to a link to show it only to that level, or 0 for every member.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Custom Thank-You Page per Level
snippets.description: Sends new members to a different confirmation page for each level after checkout, for example an onboarding page for your premium tier.
snippets.notes: Levels not listed keep PMPro's normal confirmation page.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Membership Level Column in Users
snippets.description: Adds a "Level" column to the WordPress Users screen showing each user's Paid Memberships Pro level and its end date.
snippets.notes: Users with several levels show all of them.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Extra Column on the Members List
snippets.description: Adds a column to Memberships > Members showing a value from the member's profile, such as their company or phone number.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_pmpro_col_meta to the user meta key to show. Uses the members list hooks from PMPro 3.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Body Classes for Membership Levels
snippets.description: Adds body classes like wpide-pmpro-member and wpide-pmpro-level-2 so you can tailor your theme's look for each membership level with CSS.
snippets.notes: Visitors and members without a level get wpide-pmpro-non-member. Use PMPro's own content restriction for anything private.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Show Menu Items Only to Certain Levels
snippets.description: Hides navigation menu items from anyone who doesn't hold a matching membership level, using a CSS class like wpide-level-2 on the item.
snippets.notes: Enable "CSS Classes" under Screen Options in Appearance > Menus. Use wpide-level-any for "any level".

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Add a Note to Level Prices
snippets.description: Appends a short note such as "plus VAT" or "cancel any time" to the price text Paid Memberships Pro shows for each level.
snippets.notes: Leave a level out of $wpide_pmpro_price_notes to keep its text as it is; "default" applies to all other levels.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Company Name Field at Checkout
snippets.description: Adds an optional "Company" field to the Paid Memberships Pro checkout and member profile, saved with the member's account.
snippets.notes: Uses PMPro's user fields API (PMPro 2.9 or newer). Set required to true to make it mandatory; the value is stored in the "company" user meta.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Cap the Number of Members per Level
snippets.description: Closes checkout for a level once it reaches the number of active members you set, perfect for limited founding-member or cohort offers.
snippets.notes: Counts active members of the level, cached for 10 minutes. Existing members can still renew.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Renewal Reminder Banner
snippets.description: Shows a banner across the top of the site to members whose level ends within the next few days, with a link to renew.
snippets.notes: Only levels with an end date trigger the banner; automatically renewing subscriptions don't.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Email the Admin When a Member Cancels
snippets.description: Emails you right away when a member cancels their membership, with the level they left, so you can ask why or offer help.
snippets.notes: Only cancellations are reported (moving to level 0), not upgrades or downgrades between levels.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Members per Level Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget that lists your membership levels with the number of active members in each, cached so the dashboard stays fast.
snippets.notes: Counts refresh every hour and whenever a membership changes.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro: Hide Levels From the Levels Page
snippets.description: Keeps chosen levels (for example a hidden staff or legacy level) off the public levels page while their checkout links keep working.
snippets.notes: People can still join a hidden level if you give them its checkout link.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro + LearnDash: Courses per Membership Level
snippets.description: Enrolls members in the LearnDash courses tied to their Paid Memberships Pro level and removes access when they cancel or their level expires.
snippets.notes: Map level IDs to course IDs. Only access granted by this snippet is removed, so courses bought separately are never taken away.

snippets.title: Paid Memberships Pro + bbPress: Forums for Members Only
snippets.description: Lets only members with an active Paid Memberships Pro level open your bbPress forums, sending everyone else to the levels page.
snippets.notes: List level IDs in $wpide_pmpro_forum_levels to allow only those levels, or leave it empty to allow any level.

snippets.title: Remove the Yoast SEO Comments From the Page Source
snippets.description: Stops Yoast SEO from wrapping its meta tags in "This site is optimized with the Yoast SEO plugin" HTML comments. The tags themselves stay.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wpseo_debug_markers', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Only the comments are removed; titles, meta descriptions and schema are untouched.

snippets.title: Turn Off Yoast Schema on Selected Pages
snippets.description: Removes the Yoast SEO JSON-LD graph from the pages you list, for example landing pages where you print your own structured data.
snippets.notes: List page or post IDs in $wpide_no_schema_ids. Yoast's other meta tags still print.

snippets.title: Remove the Search Action From Yoast's WebSite Schema
snippets.description: Drops the SearchAction (sitelinks search box markup) from the WebSite piece of the Yoast SEO graph, useful when your site search is disabled or poor.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'disable_wpseo_json_ld_search', '__return_true' );

snippets.title: Set About and Contact Page Types in Yoast Schema
snippets.description: Changes the WebPage type in the Yoast SEO graph to AboutPage, ContactPage or another type for the page slugs you choose.
snippets.notes: Map your own page slugs to schema.org WebPage subtypes such as FAQPage, CollectionPage or CheckoutPage.

snippets.title: Mark Posts in a Category as NewsArticle in Yoast
snippets.description: Switches the Yoast SEO Article schema type to NewsArticle for posts in the categories you list, which suits news and press sections.
snippets.notes: Use category slugs. Other posts keep the type set in Yoast's settings.

snippets.title: Add Address and Contact Point to Yoast's Organization Schema
snippets.description: Extends the Organization piece of the Yoast SEO graph with your postal address, phone number, email and a customer service contact point.
snippets.notes: Fill in your details at the top; leave a value empty to skip it.

snippets.title: Add Job Title and Expertise to Yoast's Person Schema
snippets.description: Adds a job title and "knows about" topics from each author's profile to the Person pieces Yoast SEO outputs, which supports E-E-A-T signals.
snippets.notes: Adds two fields to user profiles. Separate topics with commas.

snippets.title: Add "Reviewed By" and Last Reviewed Date to Yoast's WebPage Schema
snippets.description: Lets editors pick a reviewer and a review date for a post, then adds reviewedBy and lastReviewed to the WebPage piece of the Yoast SEO graph.
snippets.notes: Useful for health, finance and legal content. The reviewer must be a user on the site.

snippets.title: Remove Yoast's Breadcrumb Schema From the Homepage
snippets.description: Skips the BreadcrumbList piece of the Yoast SEO graph on the front page, where a one-item trail adds nothing.

snippets.title: Add a LocalBusiness to the Yoast Schema Graph
snippets.description: Adds a LocalBusiness node with address, phone and opening hours to the Yoast SEO graph on the homepage and links it to Yoast's Organization.
snippets.notes: Use a more specific type such as Restaurant or Dentist. Yoast Local SEO users already have this.

snippets.title: Remove the Current Page From Yoast Breadcrumbs
snippets.description: Drops the last item (the page you are on) from the Yoast SEO breadcrumb trail, so the trail only shows the path leading to it.
snippets.notes: The homepage keeps its single crumb.

snippets.title: Add the Blog Page to Yoast Breadcrumbs on Posts
snippets.description: Inserts your blog page (Settings > Reading > Posts page) after "Home" in the Yoast SEO breadcrumbs of single posts and post archives.
snippets.notes: Does nothing when no posts page is set or Yoast already shows it.

snippets.title: Add a Parent Page to Yoast Breadcrumbs for a Post Type
snippets.description: Puts a regular page in front of a custom post type in the Yoast SEO breadcrumbs, for example Home > Services > Web Design when services have no archive.
snippets.notes: Map each post type to the ID of the page that should appear as its parent.

snippets.title: Accessible Markup for Yoast Breadcrumbs
snippets.description: Wraps the Yoast SEO breadcrumbs in a nav landmark with an aria-label and uses a separator that screen readers skip, so the trail is announced cleanly.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_crumb_label or the separator character to suit your site.

snippets.title: Show Yoast Breadcrumbs Above Post Content
snippets.description: Prints the Yoast SEO breadcrumb trail at the top of posts and pages for themes that have no breadcrumb spot of their own.
snippets.notes: Turn on breadcrumbs under Yoast SEO > Settings > Advanced > Breadcrumbs. Skip this snippet if your theme already shows them.

snippets.title: Exclude Specific Posts and Pages From the Yoast Sitemap
snippets.description: Keeps the posts and pages you list out of the Yoast SEO XML sitemaps while leaving them indexable.
snippets.notes: Yoast caches sitemaps; save any post afterwards to refresh them.

snippets.title: Exclude Post Types From the Yoast Sitemap
snippets.description: Removes whole post types, such as landing pages or a plugin's internal post type, from the Yoast SEO sitemap index.
snippets.notes: To also hide them from search, set them to noindex in Yoast's Content types settings.

snippets.title: Exclude Taxonomies From the Yoast Sitemap
snippets.description: Leaves taxonomy sitemaps, such as tags or a plugin's filter attributes, out of the Yoast SEO sitemap index.

snippets.title: Leave Old Posts Out of the Yoast Sitemap
snippets.description: Removes posts that have not been updated for a number of years from the Yoast SEO post sitemap, so crawlers spend time on fresher content.
snippets.notes: The posts stay published and indexable; only the sitemap entry goes.

snippets.title: Change the Number of Links per Yoast Sitemap
snippets.description: Sets how many URLs each Yoast SEO sitemap page holds. Lower it if large sitemaps time out on your server.
snippets.notes: Yoast's default is 1000; Google accepts up to 50,000.

snippets.title: Add Your Own Sitemaps to the Yoast Sitemap Index
snippets.description: Lists extra sitemap files, such as one from a shop, forum or static section, in the Yoast SEO sitemap_index.xml so search engines find them in one place.
snippets.notes: Use full URLs on your own domain; search engines ignore cross-site sitemaps without verification.

snippets.title: Keep Some User Roles Out of Yoast's Author Sitemap
snippets.description: Removes users with the roles you choose, such as shop managers or contributors, from the Yoast SEO author sitemap.
snippets.notes: Only matters when the author sitemap is enabled in Yoast.

snippets.title: Add Gallery Images From a Custom Field to the Yoast Sitemap
snippets.description: Includes images stored in a custom field (a list of attachment IDs, such as a gallery) in the image entries of the Yoast SEO sitemap.
snippets.notes: The field may hold an array of IDs or a comma-separated list, as ACF and most gallery fields do.

snippets.title: Reading Time Variable for Yoast Titles and Descriptions
snippets.description: Adds a %%wpide_reading_time%% variable to Yoast SEO, so meta descriptions or social titles can say "5 min read".
snippets.notes: Type %%wpide_reading_time%% in any Yoast title or description field. Change the words per minute to suit your readers.

snippets.title: Point the Yoast Canonical to an Original Source
snippets.description: Uses a URL saved in a custom field as the canonical link on posts republished from another site, overriding Yoast's default.
snippets.notes: Add a custom field named original_url with the full source URL to a post. Yoast Premium's canonical field also works per post.

snippets.title: Noindex Page 2 and Beyond With Yoast
snippets.description: Tells search engines not to index paginated archive pages (page 2, 3 and so on) while still following their links, using Yoast SEO's robots meta.
snippets.notes: The first page of every archive stays indexable.

snippets.title: Remove Yoast Columns From Admin Lists
snippets.description: Hides the SEO score, readability, title, meta description, keyphrase and link count columns Yoast SEO adds to post and page lists.
snippets.notes: Remove a column name from the list to keep that one.

snippets.title: Move the Yoast Box to the Bottom of the Editor
snippets.description: Lowers the priority of the Yoast SEO meta box so it sits below your other boxes instead of right under the content.

snippets.title: Hide the Yoast Box From Authors and Contributors
snippets.description: Removes the Yoast SEO meta box for users who cannot publish pages, so only editors and administrators manage SEO settings.
snippets.notes: Change publish_pages to another capability to widen or narrow who sees the box. In the block editor Yoast's sidebar icon can remain; this removes the main box.

snippets.title: Hide the Yoast Box on Selected Post Types
snippets.description: Removes the Yoast SEO meta box from post types that never appear in search, such as internal records, while leaving it on everything else.
snippets.notes: To exclude a post type from Yoast entirely, also set it to "noindex" in Yoast's settings.

snippets.title: Remove the Yoast SEO Menu From the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Takes the Yoast SEO item out of the toolbar on the front end and in the admin for everyone.
snippets.notes: Yoast also has a setting for this under Settings > Site features; this snippet keeps it off for every user.

snippets.title: Remove Yoast Dashboard Widgets
snippets.description: Takes the Yoast SEO posts overview and Wincher widgets off the WordPress dashboard.

snippets.title: Default Social Image per Post Type in Yoast
snippets.description: Gives Yoast SEO a fallback Open Graph image for each post type when a post has neither a social image nor a featured image.
snippets.notes: Use images at least 1200 × 630 pixels. Yoast's site-wide default image still applies to other types.

snippets.title: Add Gallery Images as Extra Open Graph Images in Yoast
snippets.description: Adds the images from a gallery custom field as additional og:image tags through Yoast SEO, so social networks can offer a choice of preview.
snippets.notes: The field may hold an array of attachment IDs or a comma-separated list. Most networks use only the first image.

snippets.title: Use the Small Twitter Card in Yoast
snippets.description: Switches the X (Twitter) card Yoast SEO outputs from the large image card to the compact summary card with a square thumbnail.

snippets.title: Remove the Author and Reading Time From Yoast's Slack Previews
snippets.description: Stops Yoast SEO from adding "Written by" and "Est. reading time" labels to link previews in Slack and similar apps.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'wpseo_enhanced_slack_data', '__return_empty_array' );

snippets.title: Use the Excerpt When a Yoast Meta Description Is Empty
snippets.description: Fills an empty Yoast SEO meta description with the post's excerpt (or its opening words), trimmed to a search-friendly length.
snippets.notes: Descriptions set in Yoast, and Yoast's template descriptions, always win.

snippets.title: Primary Category Shortcode for Yoast
snippets.description: Adds a [primary_category] shortcode that shows the post's Yoast SEO primary category as a link, falling back to its first category.
snippets.notes: Use [primary_category link="no"] for plain text or taxonomy="product_cat" for another taxonomy.

snippets.title: Set the Open Graph Type for a Post Type in Yoast
snippets.description: Changes the og:type Yoast SEO outputs for a custom post type, for example "article" for a news or recipe post type that Yoast marks as a website.
snippets.notes: Facebook accepts website, article, profile, book and the video and music types.

snippets.title: Remove the Rank Math Comments From the Page Source
snippets.description: Stops Rank Math from printing its "Search Engine Optimization by Rank Math" HTML comments around the meta tags in your page source.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'rank_math/frontend/remove_credit_notice', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Only the comments go; titles, meta tags and schema are unchanged.

snippets.title: Rank Math Breadcrumbs Without the Current Page
snippets.description: Drops the last item (the page being viewed) from the Rank Math breadcrumb trail, leaving only the links that lead to it.
snippets.notes: Rank Math also has a "Hide Post Title" option for posts; this works on every page type.

snippets.title: Blog Page Crumb in Rank Math Breadcrumbs
snippets.description: Inserts the page set as your posts page after "Home" in Rank Math breadcrumbs on single posts, categories and tags.
snippets.notes: Does nothing when Settings > Reading has no posts page.

snippets.title: Rank Math Breadcrumbs: Parent Page for a Post Type
snippets.description: Shows a regular page before custom post type entries in Rank Math breadcrumbs, such as Home > Our Team > Jane Doe.
snippets.notes: Map each post type to the ID of the page that acts as its parent.

snippets.title: Accessible Wrapper for Rank Math Breadcrumbs
snippets.description: Sets your own aria-label on the Rank Math breadcrumb navigation and wraps the separator so screen readers skip it.
snippets.notes: Rank Math's separator setting still controls the character itself.

snippets.title: Rank Math Breadcrumbs at the Top of Posts and Pages
snippets.description: Prints the Rank Math breadcrumb trail at the top of single posts and pages, for themes with no built-in breadcrumb area.
snippets.notes: Enable breadcrumbs under Rank Math > General Settings > Breadcrumbs first.

snippets.title: Add a LocalBusiness Entity to Rank Math Schema
snippets.description: Adds a LocalBusiness node with your address, phone and hours to Rank Math's JSON-LD on the homepage, linked to the site's organization.
snippets.notes: Rank Math PRO's Local SEO module does this too; use one or the other.

snippets.title: Turn Off Rank Math Schema on Selected Pages
snippets.description: Removes all Rank Math JSON-LD from the posts or pages you list, so you can add hand-written structured data there instead.
snippets.notes: List post or page IDs. Meta tags from Rank Math still print.

snippets.title: Use NewsArticle Schema for a Category in Rank Math
snippets.description: Changes Article and BlogPosting entities in Rank Math's schema to NewsArticle on posts filed under the categories you choose.
snippets.notes: Use category slugs. Other posts keep the type chosen in Rank Math.

snippets.title: Remove Breadcrumb Schema From Rank Math
snippets.description: Stops Rank Math from adding BreadcrumbList structured data, for example when your theme or another plugin already outputs it.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'rank_math/json_ld/breadcrumbs_enabled', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: The visible breadcrumbs are unaffected.

snippets.title: Drop the Sitelinks Search Box From Rank Math Schema
snippets.description: Deletes the SearchAction (sitelinks search box) from the WebSite entity in Rank Math's JSON-LD.

snippets.title: Add a Customer Service Contact to Rank Math's Organization
snippets.description: Adds a ContactPoint with phone, email and languages to the Organization entity Rank Math outputs on your site.
snippets.notes: Only applies when Rank Math describes the site as an organization, not a person.

snippets.title: Exclude Specific Posts From the Rank Math Sitemap
snippets.description: Leaves the posts and pages you list out of Rank Math's XML sitemaps without changing their robots settings.
snippets.notes: Rank Math caches sitemaps; clear the cache or update a post to see the change.

snippets.title: Rank Math Sitemap: Leave Out Whole Post Types
snippets.description: Removes entire post types from the Rank Math sitemap index regardless of the sitemap settings screen.

snippets.title: Rank Math Sitemap: Leave Out Taxonomies
snippets.description: Keeps taxonomy archives such as tags or product attributes out of the Rank Math sitemap index.

snippets.title: List Extra Sitemap Files in Rank Math's Index
snippets.description: Lists extra sitemap files from other parts of your site in Rank Math's sitemap_index.xml.
snippets.notes: Use full URLs on the same domain.

snippets.title: Add Custom Field Images to the Rank Math Sitemap
snippets.description: Adds images from a gallery custom field (attachment IDs) to each post's image entries in the Rank Math sitemap.
snippets.notes: The field may be an array of IDs or a comma-separated list.

snippets.title: Turn Off Rank Math Sitemap Caching on Staging
snippets.description: Disables Rank Math's sitemap cache on local, development and staging sites, so sitemap changes show up immediately while you work.
snippets.notes: Relies on WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE; production sites keep the cache.

snippets.title: Reading Time Variable for Rank Math
snippets.description: Adds a %wpide_reading_time% variable to Rank Math, so titles, descriptions and social text can include an estimated reading time.
snippets.notes: Type %wpide_reading_time% in any Rank Math title or description field.

snippets.title: Noindex Paginated Archives With Rank Math
snippets.description: Sets page 2 and later of archives to noindex, follow through Rank Math's robots meta, keeping the first page indexable.

snippets.title: Rank Math Canonical From an "Original URL" Field
snippets.description: Replaces the canonical URL with one saved in a custom field on posts republished from elsewhere.
snippets.notes: Add a custom field named original_url with the full source URL.

snippets.title: Rank Math Description Fallback From the Excerpt
snippets.description: Fills an empty Rank Math meta description on posts and pages with the excerpt or opening text, trimmed to about 155 characters.
snippets.notes: Descriptions you write in Rank Math always win.

snippets.title: Remove Rank Math Columns From Admin Lists
snippets.description: Hides the SEO details, SEO title and description columns Rank Math adds to post, page and product lists.
snippets.notes: Remove a key from the list to keep that column.

snippets.title: Move the Rank Math Box Below Other Boxes
snippets.description: Lowers the Rank Math meta box priority in the classic editor so it appears after your other meta boxes.

snippets.title: Hide Rank Math on Selected Post Types
snippets.description: Removes the Rank Math meta box and settings from post types that are never shown in search, such as internal records or form entries.
snippets.notes: Use post type names; the type disappears from Rank Math's Titles & Meta settings too.

snippets.title: Rank Math Box for Editors and Administrators Only
snippets.description: Removes the Rank Math meta box for users who cannot publish pages, leaving SEO settings to editors and administrators.
snippets.notes: Rank Math's Role Manager module offers finer control if you enable it.

snippets.title: Remove the Rank Math Menu From the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Removes the Rank Math SEO item from the toolbar on the front end and in the admin.

snippets.title: Rank Math Fallback Open Graph Image by Post Type
snippets.description: Supplies a fallback Open Graph image for chosen post types when Rank Math finds no social or featured image on a post.
snippets.notes: Use images of at least 1200 × 630 pixels.

snippets.title: Output Rank Math Focus Keywords as Meta Keywords
snippets.description: Prints a meta keywords tag built from each post's Rank Math focus keywords, for internal search tools and older engines that still read it.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'rank_math/frontend/show_keywords', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Google ignores meta keywords, and competitors can read them.

snippets.title: Remove rel="next" and rel="prev" Links From Rank Math
snippets.description: Stops Rank Math from adding rel next and prev link tags on paginated archives and multi-page posts.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'rank_math/frontend/disable_adjacent_rel_links', '__return_true' );
snippets.notes: Google no longer uses these links; Bing still reads them.

snippets.title: Primary Category Shortcode for Rank Math
snippets.description: Adds a [rm_primary_category] shortcode that shows the primary category chosen in Rank Math, or the first category when none is set.
snippets.notes: Use link="no" for plain text, or taxonomy="product_cat" for WooCommerce products.

snippets.title: Turn Off All in One SEO Output on Selected Pages
snippets.description: Stops All in One SEO from printing any meta tags or schema on the pages you list, for pages managed by a landing page builder or another tool.
snippets.notes: List post or page IDs. The page title falls back to the theme's default.

snippets.title: Turn Off All in One SEO Schema on Selected Pages
snippets.description: Removes the All in One SEO JSON-LD graph from the pages you list while keeping its titles and meta tags.

snippets.title: Use NewsArticle Schema for a Category in All in One SEO
snippets.description: Changes Article and BlogPosting graphs in All in One SEO's schema to NewsArticle for posts in the categories you choose.
snippets.notes: Use category slugs.

snippets.title: Add Address and Contact Point to All in One SEO's Organization
snippets.description: Extends the Organization graph in All in One SEO's JSON-LD with a postal address and a customer service contact point.
snippets.notes: Fill in your details; empty values are skipped.

snippets.title: Remove the Current Page From All in One SEO Breadcrumbs
snippets.description: Drops the final crumb (the current page) from the All in One SEO breadcrumb trail.
snippets.notes: The homepage keeps its single crumb.

snippets.title: Rename "Home" in All in One SEO Breadcrumbs
snippets.description: Replaces the "Home" label in All in One SEO breadcrumbs with your own wording, such as your brand name.
snippets.notes: Matches the crumb that links to your homepage, whatever its current label.

snippets.title: Exclude Specific Posts From the All in One SEO Sitemap
snippets.description: Keeps the posts and pages you list out of All in One SEO's XML sitemap.
snippets.notes: The posts stay indexable; only the sitemap entry is removed.

snippets.title: Leave Chosen Categories Out of the AIOSEO Sitemap
snippets.description: Removes the category or tag archives you list (by term ID) from All in One SEO's sitemap.
snippets.notes: Find a term's ID in the edit link on Posts > Categories.

snippets.title: Add Custom URLs to the All in One SEO Sitemap
snippets.description: Adds pages that WordPress does not manage, such as static files or app routes, to All in One SEO's sitemap.
snippets.notes: Paths are relative to your homepage. AIOSEO Pro also has an "Additional Pages" setting.

snippets.title: Leave Old Posts Out of the All in One SEO Sitemap
snippets.description: Removes post entries that have not been modified for several years from All in One SEO's post sitemap.
snippets.notes: Only the "post" type is filtered; pages and other types are kept.

snippets.title: Use the Excerpt When an All in One SEO Description Is Empty
snippets.description: Fills an empty All in One SEO meta description on single posts and pages with the excerpt or opening text.
snippets.notes: Descriptions you write in AIOSEO always win.

snippets.title: Noindex Paginated Archives With All in One SEO
snippets.description: Adds noindex to page 2 and later of archives through All in One SEO's robots meta while keeping links followed.

snippets.title: Point the All in One SEO Canonical to an Original Source
snippets.description: Uses a URL stored in a custom field as the canonical link on republished posts instead of All in One SEO's default.
snippets.notes: Add a custom field named original_url with the full source URL.

snippets.title: Default Social Image per Post Type in All in One SEO
snippets.description: Sets a fallback og:image for chosen post types when All in One SEO finds no image for a post.
snippets.notes: Use images of at least 1200 × 630 pixels.

snippets.title: Use the Small Twitter Card in All in One SEO
snippets.description: Switches the X (Twitter) card All in One SEO outputs to the compact summary card with a square thumbnail.

snippets.title: Remove the All in One SEO Menu From the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Hides the AIOSEO item in the toolbar on the front end and in the admin.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'aioseo_show_in_admin_bar', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Hide the All in One SEO Help Flyout
snippets.description: Removes the floating help and upgrade button All in One SEO shows in the corner of its admin screens.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'aioseo_flyout_menu_enable', '__return_false' );

snippets.title: Remove the All in One SEO Column From Admin Lists
snippets.description: Hides the AIOSEO details column (score, title and description) from post, page and custom post type lists.
snippets.notes: You can also hide it per user in Screen Options; this hides it for everyone.

snippets.title: Hide the All in One SEO Box From Authors and Contributors
snippets.description: Removes the AIOSEO settings box from the editor for users who cannot publish pages.
snippets.notes: AIOSEO Pro's Access Control settings offer finer control.

snippets.title: ACF Google Maps API Key From wp-config.php
snippets.description: Gives Advanced Custom Fields' Google Map field your API key from a constant in wp-config.php, so the key never sits in the database or theme files.
snippets.notes: Add define( 'WPIDE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY', 'your-key' ); to wp-config.php and restrict the key to your domain in Google Cloud.

snippets.title: Save ACF Field Groups as JSON Outside the Theme
snippets.description: Stores Advanced Custom Fields field groups, post types and options pages as JSON files in wp-content/acf-json, so they survive theme changes and can go into version control.
snippets.notes: After activating, open each field group and click Update once to write its file. Change $wpide_acf_json_dir to use another folder.

snippets.title: Add an ACF Site Settings Options Page
snippets.description: Registers a "Site Settings" options page with Header and Footer sub-pages in the admin, ready for ACF field groups that hold site-wide values.
snippets.notes: Options pages need ACF PRO. Assign field groups with the rule "Options Page is equal to Site Settings" and read values with get_field( 'name', 'option' ).

snippets.title: Shortcode for ACF Options Page Fields
snippets.description: Adds an [acf_option name="phone"] shortcode that prints a value from an ACF options page anywhere, such as a phone number or address in widgets and footers.
snippets.notes: Text, number, email, URL, select and true/false fields work. Use default="..." for a fallback.

snippets.title: Turn the [acf] Shortcode Back On
snippets.description: Re-enables Advanced Custom Fields' own [acf field="..."] shortcode, which ACF 6.3 switched off by default for security.
snippets.notes: Only turn this on if you trust everyone who can write content, since the shortcode can read any field of any post.

snippets.title: Display Any ACF Field With a Safe Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [field_value name="..."] shortcode that prints an ACF field of the current post and handles images, links, choices, dates and post objects sensibly.
snippets.notes: Only fields of public posts are shown. Use post_id="123" for another post and size="medium" for image fields.

snippets.title: ACF Image Field Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds an [acf_image name="hero" size="large"] shortcode that outputs a responsive image from an ACF image field, whatever return format the field uses.
snippets.notes: The image's alt text comes from the Media Library. Add class="..." for styling.

snippets.title: Show an ACF Repeater as a List
snippets.description: Adds an [acf_list name="features" sub="text"] shortcode that turns a repeater field into a bulleted list, with an optional second sub field shown in bold.
snippets.notes: Example: [acf_list name="specs" label="name" sub="value"]. Repeaters need ACF PRO.

snippets.title: ACF Gallery Field as a Responsive Grid
snippets.description: Adds an [acf_gallery name="gallery"] shortcode that shows an ACF gallery field as a lazy-loaded, responsive image grid linking to the full-size files.
snippets.notes: Gallery fields need ACF PRO. Set columns="4" for a wider grid; on phones it drops to two columns.

snippets.title: ACF Link Field as a Button
snippets.description: Adds an [acf_button name="cta"] shortcode that renders an ACF link field as a theme-styled button, respecting the "open in new tab" choice.
snippets.notes: Uses the block editor's button classes, so it matches your theme's buttons.

snippets.title: Hide the ACF Menu on Production Sites
snippets.description: Removes the Advanced Custom Fields menu on the live site so field groups can only be edited on development or staging, where changes are synced through JSON.
snippets.notes: Set WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE to "staging" or "development" on other copies of the site. Fields keep working on production.

snippets.title: Bring Back the Custom Fields Box With ACF
snippets.description: Shows WordPress's own Custom Fields meta box again, which Advanced Custom Fields hides by default to speed up the editor.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'acf/settings/remove_wp_meta_box', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Turn on "Custom fields" under Preferences > Panels in the block editor too.

snippets.title: Validate Phone Numbers in an ACF Field
snippets.description: Checks a phone number field when a post is saved and shows an error unless it has 7 to 15 digits, optionally with +, spaces, dashes and brackets.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_acf_phone_field to your field's name. Empty values pass unless the field is required.

snippets.title: Make an ACF End Date Come After the Start Date
snippets.description: Blocks saving when an end date field is earlier than its start date field, such as for events, offers or bookings.
snippets.notes: Set the field names and the start field's key (shown under each field when "Field Keys" is ticked in Screen Options).

snippets.title: Require a Unique Value in an ACF Field
snippets.description: Prevents two posts from sharing the same value in a field, such as a product code, membership number or reference ID.
snippets.notes: Set the field name and post type. The check ignores trashed posts and the post being edited.

snippets.title: Word Limit for an ACF Text Area
snippets.description: Shows an error when a text area or WYSIWYG field goes over a set number of words, which keeps summaries and teasers short.
snippets.notes: Set the field name and limit. ACF's own character limit counts characters, not words.

snippets.title: Minimum Image Size for an ACF Image Field
snippets.description: Rejects uploads to a chosen ACF image field when the picture is smaller than the width and height you need, such as for hero banners.
snippets.notes: Applies to new uploads through the field. ACF also has min width and height settings for images picked from the library.

snippets.title: Sortable Admin Column From an ACF Field
snippets.description: Adds a column showing an ACF field to a post type's admin list and lets you sort the list by it, for values like price, date or priority.
snippets.notes: Set the post type, field name and column label. Use 'meta_value_num' for numbers and Ymd dates, 'meta_value' for text. Posts without a value are listed last.

snippets.title: Thumbnail Column From an ACF Image Field
snippets.description: Shows a small preview of an ACF image field in a post type's admin list, handy for logos, headshots or product photos that are not the featured image.
snippets.notes: Set the post type and the image field name.

snippets.title: Filter an Admin List by an ACF Select Field
snippets.description: Adds a dropdown above a post type's admin list to show only posts with a chosen value of an ACF select, radio or button group field.
snippets.notes: Set the post type and field name. The choices come from the field's own settings.

snippets.title: Expose Chosen ACF Fields in the REST API
snippets.description: Adds an "acf_fields" property with the ACF fields you list to the REST API responses of chosen post types, for headless front ends and apps.
snippets.notes: Only the listed fields are shared, and only for posts the visitor may read. ACF's own "Show in REST API" option exposes whole field groups instead.

snippets.title: Read-Only REST Endpoint for ACF Options
snippets.description: Publishes selected fields from your ACF options pages at /wp-json/wpide/v1/site-options, so a headless front end or app can load site-wide settings.
snippets.notes: Only list fields that are safe to make public. The response is cached by browsers for five minutes.

snippets.title: Two-Way ACF Relationship Field
snippets.description: Keeps a relationship field in sync on both sides, so linking post A to post B also links B back to A, and removing the link removes it from both.
snippets.notes: Use the same relationship field on both post types (for example related_items). Existing links are updated the next time each post is saved.

snippets.title: Only Published Posts in ACF Relationship Fields
snippets.description: Limits the choices in ACF relationship and post object fields to published content, newest first, so editors cannot link to drafts.
snippets.notes: Applies to every relationship and post object field; add /name=your_field to the hook names to target one.

snippets.title: Stop ACF Fields Linking a Post to Itself
snippets.description: Removes the post being edited from the choices of ACF relationship and post object fields.

snippets.title: Fill an ACF Select Field With Posts of a Type
snippets.description: Loads the choices of an ACF select field from the titles of a post type, such as locations or team members, and refreshes them when those posts change.
snippets.notes: Set the field name and the source post type. The list is cached until a post of that type is saved or deleted.

snippets.title: Manage ACF Select Choices From an Options Page
snippets.description: Lets editors maintain the choices of an ACF select field in a repeater on an options page instead of editing the field group.
snippets.notes: Create an options repeater (default name: color_choices) with "value" and "label" sub fields. Needs ACF PRO.

snippets.title: Make an ACF Field Read-Only
snippets.description: Shows an ACF field's value in the editor but stops editors changing it, useful for IDs or values filled by an import or integration.
snippets.notes: Works for text, number, email and URL fields. Code can still update the value.

snippets.title: Hide ACF Fields From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Hides the ACF fields you choose in the editor for everyone except administrators, such as internal notes or technical settings.
snippets.notes: Hidden fields keep their saved values. Change manage_options to target another role.

snippets.title: List Posts by an ACF Field Value
snippets.description: Adds an [acf_posts field="featured" value="1"] shortcode that lists posts whose ACF field matches a value, such as featured items or posts for a region.
snippets.notes: Add post_type="..." and limit="..." as needed. Results are cached and refresh automatically when content changes.

snippets.title: Register ACF Fields in Code
snippets.description: A ready-to-edit example that registers an ACF field group (subtitle, summary and call-to-action link) for posts in PHP, so the fields are version-controlled and cannot be changed in the admin.
snippets.notes: Keep every key unique and never change a key after content has been saved. Edit the location rule to target other post types.

snippets.title: Minimal Toolbar Option for ACF WYSIWYG Fields
snippets.description: Adds a "Minimal" toolbar choice to ACF WYSIWYG fields with only bold, italic, link and lists, for short formatted text where full editing is too much.
snippets.notes: Pick "Minimal" in the field's Toolbar setting after activating.

snippets.title: Descriptive ACF Flexible Content Layout Titles
snippets.description: Shows each flexible content row's heading next to its layout name in the editor, so long pages built from sections are easy to scan.
snippets.notes: Set the flexible content field name and the sub field holding each section's heading. Needs ACF PRO.

snippets.title: Build the Post Title From ACF Fields
snippets.description: Sets a post's title and slug from ACF fields when it is saved, for example a team member's first and last name, so editors never type it twice.
snippets.notes: Set the post type and the fields joined into the title. Runs after ACF saves its values.

snippets.title: Front-End Submission Form With ACF
snippets.description: Adds an [acf_submit_form] shortcode that lets logged-in users submit a new post (saved as pending review) using your ACF field groups.
snippets.notes: Set the field group key(s) and post type. Submissions wait for review; guests see a login link.

snippets.title: Turn Off ACF's Post Types and Taxonomies Screens
snippets.description: Hides the post type and taxonomy builder added in ACF 6.1, for sites that register content types in code or with another tool.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'acf/settings/enable_post_types', '__return_false' );
snippets.notes: Post types already created there stop being registered, so move them to code first.

snippets.title: Shortcode for ACF Fields on Categories and Terms
snippets.description: Adds a [term_field name="..."] shortcode that prints an ACF field of the current category, tag or custom term on archive pages, or of a term you specify.
snippets.notes: On singular pages pass term="12" with the term ID.

snippets.title: Shortcode for ACF Fields on the Post Author
snippets.description: Adds an [author_field name="job_title"] shortcode that shows an ACF user field of the current post's author, for author boxes and bylines.
snippets.notes: Only list fields that are safe to make public.

snippets.title: Embed a Map From an ACF Google Map Field
snippets.description: Adds an [acf_map name="location"] shortcode that shows a lazy-loaded embedded map and a directions link for the place saved in an ACF Google Map field.
snippets.notes: The embed needs no API key. Change height="..." to resize; the map always fits the screen width.

snippets.title: Use ACF Fields in Core Blocks With Block Bindings
snippets.description: Registers an "ACF field" block bindings source, so paragraph, heading, button and image blocks can show ACF values without a custom block (WordPress 6.5+).
snippets.notes: Bind in the Code editor, e.g. "metadata":{"bindings":{"content":{"source":"wpide/acf","args":{"key":"subtitle"}}}}. Fields starting with an underscore are never exposed.

snippets.title: Fall Back to an ACF Options Value When a Field Is Empty
snippets.description: Uses a site-wide default from your ACF options page whenever a post's own field is empty, such as a standard call-to-action text or banner.
snippets.notes: Set the post field and the options field that holds the default.

snippets.title: Body Classes From ACF True/False Fields
snippets.description: Adds a body class such as "acf-hide-title" when a true/false field is switched on for the current page, so you can change the layout with CSS alone.
snippets.notes: List your true/false field names. The class is "acf-" plus the field name with dashes.

snippets.title: Page Accent Color From an ACF Color Picker
snippets.description: Turns an ACF color picker on posts and pages into a --page-accent CSS variable, so each page can have its own highlight color.
snippets.notes: Use var(--page-accent) in your CSS, e.g. a { color: var(--page-accent, inherit); }.

snippets.title: Show Post Type and Date in ACF Relationship Results
snippets.description: Adds the post type and publish date after each title in ACF relationship and post object fields, so similar titles are easy to tell apart.

snippets.title: Default an ACF Date Field to Today
snippets.description: Pre-fills an empty ACF date picker with today's date on new posts, saving a click for fields like "published on" or "received".
snippets.notes: Uses the site's timezone. Saved dates are never changed.

snippets.title: FAQ Section With Schema From an ACF Repeater
snippets.description: Adds an [acf_faq] shortcode that shows a question-and-answer repeater as accessible collapsible items and outputs matching FAQPage structured data.
snippets.notes: Create a repeater named faqs with question and answer sub fields (or change the names). Needs ACF PRO.

snippets.title: Use an ACF Image When There Is No Featured Image
snippets.description: Makes WordPress treat an ACF image field as the featured image for posts that have none, so archives, related posts and social previews still get a picture.
snippets.notes: Set the image field name. A real featured image always wins.

snippets.title: Fill the Excerpt From an ACF Summary Field
snippets.description: Copies an ACF summary field into the post excerpt on save when the excerpt is empty, so themes, feeds and search results show your summary.
snippets.notes: Set the field name and post types. Excerpts you write by hand are kept.

snippets.title: Responsive Video Embeds From ACF oEmbed Fields
snippets.description: Wraps the output of ACF oEmbed fields in a 16:9 container and adds lazy loading, so embedded videos scale to the screen instead of overflowing on phones.
snippets.notes: Change the aspect ratio for vertical or square videos.

snippets.title: Run Shortcodes Inside ACF Text Fields
snippets.description: Lets editors use shortcodes in ACF text and text area fields, which ACF otherwise prints as plain text.
snippets.notes: WYSIWYG fields already run shortcodes. Only use this if you trust everyone who can edit fields.

snippets.notes: Made for the Books post type snippet.

snippets.title: Property Details Meta Box
snippets.description: Adds price, bedrooms, bathrooms, floor area and address fields to property listings and a [property_details] shortcode that shows them as a fact list.
snippets.notes: Made for the Real Estate Properties post type snippet. Set the currency symbol at the top.

snippets.title: Testimonials Grid Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [testimonials] shortcode that shows testimonials as a responsive grid of quotes with the customer's name, role and star rating.
snippets.notes: Works with the Testimonials post type and details meta box snippets. Use limit, columns and orderby="date|menu_order|rand".

snippets.title: Team Members Grid Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [team] shortcode that shows team members with photo, name and job title in a responsive grid, optionally filtered by department.
snippets.notes: Works with the Team post type and Team details snippets. Example: [team department="sales" columns="4"].

snippets.title: FAQ Accordion Shortcode With Schema
snippets.description: Adds a [faq_list] shortcode that shows FAQ posts as accessible collapsible questions and adds FAQPage structured data for them.
snippets.notes: Works with the FAQ post type snippet. Filter by group with group="billing", or turn the schema off with schema="no".

snippets.title: Upcoming Events Shortcode for an Events Post Type
snippets.description: Adds an [upcoming_events] shortcode that lists the next events by start date, skipping events that have already begun.
snippets.notes: Reads the start date saved by the Event Details meta box snippet (_event_start). Use limit="10" to show more.

snippets.title: Sortable Event Date Column for Events
snippets.description: Adds "Starts" and "Venue" columns to the Events admin list, sorts the list by start date by default and lets you click to reverse it.
snippets.notes: Reads the fields saved by the Event Details meta box snippet.

snippets.title: "Add to Calendar" Download for Events
snippets.description: Adds an "Add to calendar" link to single events that downloads an .ics file for Apple Calendar, Outlook and Google Calendar.
snippets.notes: Reads the start, end, venue and address saved by the Event Details meta box snippet. Events without an end time last one hour.

snippets.title: Automatically Expire Listings After Their Closing Date
snippets.description: Adds an "Expired" status and an hourly check that moves job listings (or any post type) out of public view once their closing date has passed.
snippets.notes: Defaults to jobs and the _job_valid_through date from the Job Details snippet; change the post type and meta key for events, offers or adverts. Expired items stay in the admin under "Expired".

snippets.title: Show Featured Items First on Post Type Archives
snippets.description: Adds a "Featured" checkbox to chosen post types and lists featured items at the top of their archives, newest first after that.
snippets.notes: Change the post types in $wpide_featured_types. Sticky posts already do this for the blog.

snippets.title: Post Type Grid Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [post_grid type="..."] shortcode that shows any post type as a responsive grid of cards with image, title and excerpt, so a regular page can act as its archive.
snippets.notes: Options: type, limit, columns, taxonomy and term (slug), orderby="date|title|menu_order". Results are cached and refresh when that post type changes.

snippets.title: Related Items From the Same Category for Any Post Type
snippets.description: Shows up to three other items that share a category or tag below single custom post type entries, such as related recipes, services or case studies.
snippets.notes: Set the post types and heading. Each list is cached for a day and refreshed when content of that type changes.

snippets.title: Published Item Count Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [post_count type="job"] shortcode that prints how many published items a post type has, for lines like "We have 12 open positions".
snippets.notes: Uses WordPress's cached counts, so it adds no extra queries on most pages.

snippets.title: A–Z Index Shortcode for Glossaries and Directories
snippets.description: Adds an [az_index type="glossary_term"] shortcode that lists every item of a post type grouped by first letter, with a jump-to-letter bar.
snippets.notes: Works with any public post type, up to 1,000 items. The list is cached and refreshed when that post type changes.

snippets.title: List Child Items of a Hierarchical Post Type
snippets.description: Adds a [child_items] shortcode that lists the children of the current page or hierarchical item, such as sub-services under a service.
snippets.notes: Ordered by the Order field, then title. Add excerpt="yes" to include short descriptions.

snippets.title: Admin Column for a Taxonomy Added by a Plugin or Theme
snippets.description: Shows a column for any taxonomy in its post type's admin list, even when the plugin or theme that registered it left the column out.
snippets.notes: List taxonomy names (shown in the URL when you edit its terms, e.g. taxonomy=portfolio_category).

snippets.title: Manual Ordering for Custom Post Types
snippets.description: Adds the Order field to chosen post types and sorts them by it on the front end and in the admin, so you can control the order of team members, services or FAQs.
snippets.notes: Set the order under Page Attributes (or "Order" in the block editor's sidebar). Items with the same number sort by title.

snippets.title: Filter an Admin List by a Custom Field
snippets.description: Adds a dropdown above a post type's admin list with every value used in a custom field (such as city or brand), so you can show only matching items.
snippets.notes: Set the post type, meta key and label. The list of values is cached for an hour and refreshed when an item is saved.

snippets.title: Filter Admin Lists by Author
snippets.description: Adds an author dropdown above the admin lists of posts and chosen post types, so editors can see everything one person wrote.
snippets.notes: Only users who can write posts appear. WordPress handles the filtering itself through the author parameter.

snippets.title: Enable the Block Editor and REST API for a Plugin's Post Type
snippets.description: Turns on REST API support for post types registered without it, which also switches them to the block editor and makes them available to apps and headless sites.
snippets.notes: The post type also needs editor support for the block editor to appear. Test the plugin's own meta boxes, which may not all work in the block editor.

snippets.title: Change the URL Slug of Any Post Type
snippets.description: Changes the URL base of a post type registered by a theme or plugin, for example from /portfolio/ to /work/, including its archive.
snippets.notes: Visit Settings > Permalinks once afterwards, and redirect the old URLs if the site is already indexed.

snippets.title: Change the URL Slug of Any Taxonomy
snippets.description: Changes the URL base of a category-style taxonomy registered by a theme or plugin, for example from /portfolio-category/ to /work-type/.
snippets.notes: Visit Settings > Permalinks once afterwards. For the built-in category and tag bases, use Settings > Permalinks instead.

snippets.title: Put the Category in Custom Post Type URLs
snippets.description: Builds custom post type URLs with a taxonomy term, such as /books/fantasy/the-hobbit/, which reads better and groups content by section.
snippets.notes: Every item needs a term; items without one use $wpide_term_url['fallback'], so create a term with that slug. Visit Settings > Permalinks once after activating.

snippets.title: Remove the Post Type Slug From URLs
snippets.description: Gives a custom post type short URLs like example.com/web-design/ instead of example.com/services/web-design/, as pages have.
snippets.notes: Needs the "Post name" permalink setting and a non-hierarchical post type. Avoid items with the same slug as a page or post.

snippets.title: One Template for All Custom Post Types
snippets.description: Lets every custom post type use a shared archive-custom and single-custom template before falling back to the general ones, so you design CPT pages once.
snippets.notes: Create archive-custom.php and single-custom.php in a classic theme, or templates named archive-custom and single-custom in a block theme. Post-type-specific templates still win.

snippets.title: Use the Page Template for a Custom Post Type
snippets.description: Displays single entries of chosen post types with your theme's page template instead of the blog post template, so they have no dates, authors or post navigation.
snippets.notes: Works with classic (page.php) and block themes (the "Pages" template). A single-{post_type} template still takes priority.

snippets.title: Make a Plugin's Post Type Admin-Only
snippets.description: Removes the public pages, archive and search presence of a post type registered by a plugin or theme while keeping it editable in the admin.
snippets.notes: Use for internal records that should never be public, then visit Settings > Permalinks once.

snippets.title: Add Excerpts, Revisions and More to Any Post Type
snippets.description: Switches on editor features such as excerpts, revisions, page attributes or custom fields for post types that were registered without them.
snippets.notes: Feature names: title, editor, author, thumbnail, excerpt, comments, revisions, page-attributes, custom-fields.

snippets.title: Categories and Tags for Pages
snippets.description: Lets you assign categories and tags to pages, and includes those pages on the matching category and tag archives.

snippets.title: Default Term for a Custom Taxonomy
snippets.description: Gives a custom taxonomy a default term, like "Uncategorized" for categories, so items saved without a term still get one.
snippets.notes: WordPress creates the term on the next page load if it does not exist. Works for taxonomies registered on init by any plugin or theme.

snippets.title: Color Field for Categories and Terms
snippets.description: Adds a color picker to categories (or any taxonomy) with a swatch column in the term list, and a helper to use each term's color in your theme.
snippets.notes: Use wpide_term_color( $term_id ) in templates, or the body class "term-color-set" with the --term-color variable on term archives.

snippets.title: Members-Only Post Type
snippets.description: Sends logged-out visitors to the login page when they open entries or the archive of a chosen post type, and hides those entries from them in the REST API.
snippets.notes: After logging in, visitors return to the page they wanted. Combine with noindex if the content was public before.

snippets.title: Give a Role Full Control of One Post Type Only
snippets.description: Gives a custom post type its own permissions and lets a chosen role (for example Author) manage it fully, including others' items, without extra rights elsewhere.
snippets.notes: Administrators keep full access. The permissions are granted while the snippet runs, so nothing is written to the database.

snippets.title: Change the Menu Icon and Position of Any Post Type
snippets.description: Gives a post type registered by a plugin or theme a different Dashicon and moves it up or down the admin menu.
snippets.notes: Pick icons at developer.wordpress.org/resource/dashicons. Positions: 5 below Posts, 20 below Pages, 60 below Appearance.

snippets.title: Rename a Plugin's Post Type
snippets.description: Changes the name a theme or plugin gave its post type everywhere in the admin, for example "Projects" to "Case Studies", without touching URLs or content.
snippets.notes: Only the labels change; use the slug snippet to change URLs as well.

snippets.title: Turn Off the Archive Page of a Post Type
snippets.description: Removes the automatic archive page of a post type, for example when you build the listing yourself on a regular page with the same URL.
snippets.notes: Visit Settings > Permalinks once afterwards so a page with that slug can take over the URL.

snippets.title: Remove a Post Type or Taxonomy Added by a Theme or Plugin
snippets.description: Unregisters post types or taxonomies you never use, such as a theme's "Portfolio" or "Projects", to tidy the admin menu and URLs.
snippets.notes: Existing items stay in the database and come back if you deactivate this snippet. Built-in types cannot be removed.

snippets.title: Sort a Post Type Archive A to Z
snippets.description: Lists the items of chosen post type archives in alphabetical order by title instead of newest first, for directories, glossaries and catalogs.
snippets.notes: Their taxonomy archives keep the default order.

snippets.title: Category and Term Names in REST API Responses
snippets.description: Adds a "term_names" field to REST API responses for posts and custom post types, so apps get category and tag names without extra requests.
snippets.notes: Only taxonomies shown in REST are included.

snippets.title: Stop Non-Administrators Deleting Items of a Post Type
snippets.description: Lets editors and authors edit entries of chosen post types but only administrators can trash or delete them, protecting records like locations or products.
snippets.notes: Change manage_options to another capability to allow more users.

snippets.title: Hide Items in a Term From a Post Type Archive
snippets.description: Keeps items filed under certain terms (such as "Archived" or "Internal") off a post type's main archive, while their own term archive still lists them.
snippets.notes: Set the post type, taxonomy and term slugs.

snippets.title: Product Structured Data Without WooCommerce
snippets.description: Outputs Product JSON-LD with price, currency, SKU, brand and availability for a catalog post type, so products shown without a shop can still get rich results.
snippets.notes: Set the post type and the custom field names that hold each value. Skip it on WooCommerce products, which have their own schema.

snippets.title: Event Structured Data for an Events Post Type
snippets.description: Adds Event JSON-LD (dates, venue or online location, price and organizer) to single events, so they can appear in Google's event listings.
snippets.notes: Reads the fields saved by the Event Details meta box snippet. Set your currency at the top.

snippets.title: Recipe Structured Data for a Recipes Post Type
snippets.description: Adds Recipe JSON-LD with times, servings, calories, ingredients, steps, cuisine and course to single recipes, for recipe rich results.
snippets.notes: Reads the Recipe Details meta box fields and the Cuisine and Course taxonomies. Google requires a featured image.

snippets.title: JobPosting Structured Data for Job Listings
snippets.description: Adds JobPosting JSON-LD (salary, employment type, location or remote, closing date and employer) to single job listings, so they can appear in Google for Jobs.
snippets.notes: Reads the Job Details meta box fields. Remove or expire listings once filled; Google penalises stale job markup.

snippets.title: How-To Steps Shortcode With HowTo Schema
snippets.description: Adds a [howto] shortcode that wraps a numbered list of steps, keeps it on the page as normal content and outputs matching HowTo structured data.
snippets.notes: Wrap a numbered list in [howto name="How to repot a plant" time="20"] ... [/howto]; Google no longer shows HowTo rich results, but other search and AI tools read the markup.

snippets.title: Person Structured Data for a Personal Brand
snippets.description: Adds Person JSON-LD describing you (name, job title, photo, employer and social profiles) to your About page and homepage, for personal sites and portfolios.
snippets.notes: Fill in your details and the slug of your About page. Use Organization schema instead if the site represents a company.

snippets.title: VideoObject Structured Data for YouTube Embeds
snippets.description: Finds YouTube videos embedded in a post and adds VideoObject JSON-LD for each, with thumbnail and embed URL, so the page can show video results in search.
snippets.notes: Uses the post title, excerpt and publish date for every video (up to three per page); no requests are sent to YouTube.

snippets.title: SoftwareApplication Structured Data for an App Page
snippets.description: Adds SoftwareApplication JSON-LD (operating system, category, price and optional rating) to the page that presents your app, plugin or SaaS product.
snippets.notes: Only add a rating when it comes from real, visible reviews; leave rating_value empty otherwise.

snippets.title: Service Structured Data for a Services Post Type
snippets.description: Adds Service JSON-LD (name, description, provider and area served) to single service pages, describing what your business offers.
snippets.notes: Made for the Services post type snippet. Set the areas you serve.

snippets.title: ItemList Structured Data on Archive Pages
snippets.description: Adds ItemList JSON-LD listing the posts shown on category, tag, post type and blog archive pages, using the posts already loaded so it adds no queries.
snippets.notes: Google uses ItemList for carousels of some content types, such as recipes and courses.

snippets.title: LocalBusiness Structured Data for Each Location Page
snippets.description: Adds LocalBusiness JSON-LD (address, phone, opening hours and map coordinates) to every branch or store page of a Locations post type.
snippets.notes: Reads the Location Details meta box fields. Change the type to Restaurant, Store or another LocalBusiness subtype.

snippets.title: Book Structured Data for a Books Post Type
snippets.description: Adds Book JSON-LD with author, ISBN, publisher, page count and publication date to single book pages.
snippets.notes: Reads the Book Details meta box fields.

snippets.title: FAQ Structured Data From Details Blocks
snippets.description: Turns every Details block (summary and hidden text) in a post or page into a question and answer in FAQPage JSON-LD, with nothing extra to fill in.
snippets.notes: Google now shows FAQ rich results mainly for authoritative health and government sites, but other search and AI tools still read the markup.

snippets.title: Paywalled Content Structured Data
snippets.description: Marks members-only posts as not free with isAccessibleForFree and the CSS class of the gated section, so Google does not treat the hidden part as cloaking.
snippets.notes: Wrap the members-only part of the content in an element with the paywall class. If your SEO plugin already outputs Article schema, this adds a second, compatible Article node.

snippets.title: ProfilePage Structured Data for Team Members
snippets.description: Adds ProfilePage JSON-LD with a Person (name, job title, photo and LinkedIn) to each team member page, linking staff to your organization.
snippets.notes: Reads the Team Member Details meta box fields. Email and phone are left out on purpose.

snippets.title: Image License Structured Data for Featured Images
snippets.description: Adds ImageObject JSON-LD with license, credit and copyright details for each post's featured image, which can earn the "Licensable" badge in Google Images.
snippets.notes: Point the license and acquire-license URLs at real pages on your site that explain your image terms.

snippets.title: hreflang Tags for Regional Versions of Your Site
snippets.description: Links matching pages across your country sites (such as example.com, example.co.uk and example.com.au) with hreflang tags, assuming each page uses the same path on every domain.
snippets.notes: Add this to every regional site with the same map. Pages whose path differs between sites need a multilingual plugin instead.

snippets.title: Noindex Author Archives
snippets.description: Keeps author archive pages out of search results while their links are still followed, which suits single-author blogs where they duplicate the main blog.
snippets.notes: To remove author pages entirely, use a redirect instead.

snippets.title: Noindex Password-Protected Posts and Pages
snippets.description: Adds noindex to posts and pages that need a password, so search engines do not list pages whose content they cannot see.

snippets.title: Noindex an Entire Post Type
snippets.description: Keeps every entry and the archive of chosen post types out of search results and removes them from the built-in XML sitemap, while visitors can still open them.
snippets.notes: Useful for thank-you pages, internal resources or thin listings. SEO plugins have their own per-type setting.

snippets.title: Noindex Posts Below a Word Count
snippets.description: Adds noindex to blog posts with fewer words than a minimum, such as quick updates or link posts, so thin pages do not drag down how search engines see your site.
snippets.notes: Change the post types and minimum. The count ignores HTML and shortcodes.

snippets.title: Noindex URLs With Sorting and Filter Parameters
snippets.description: Adds noindex to pages opened with sorting or filter parameters (such as ?orderby= or ?filter_color=), so crawlers do not index endless variations of the same list.
snippets.notes: Names ending in an underscore match as prefixes. Tracking parameters like utm_source are left alone, since the canonical tag handles them.

snippets.title: rel="prev" and rel="next" Links on Paginated Archives
snippets.description: Adds rel prev and next link tags to paginated blog, category and archive pages, which Bing and other crawlers use to understand page series.
snippets.notes: Skip this if your SEO plugin already prints these links.

snippets.title: Remove ?replytocom From Comment Reply Links
snippets.description: Stops comment reply links from creating ?replytocom= URLs that crawlers treat as duplicate pages, and redirects any such URL to the clean post address.
snippets.notes: Replying still works through WordPress's comment-reply script, which every modern theme loads.

snippets.title: Canonical Link to the Original Source for Republished Posts
snippets.description: Points the canonical tag of a post to the URL in its "original_url" custom field, for articles first published elsewhere, so the original keeps the search credit.
snippets.notes: Works with WordPress's own canonical tag. SEO plugins replace it, so use their canonical setting instead when one is active.

snippets.title: Remove /category/ From Category URLs
snippets.description: Shortens category links from example.com/category/news/ to example.com/news/ and redirects the old addresses there permanently.
snippets.notes: Needs pretty permalinks; visit Settings > Permalinks once after activating and avoid categories with the same slug as a page, since the category wins.

snippets.title: Automatic Internal Links for Key Phrases
snippets.description: Links the first mention of phrases you choose to the matching pages in your posts, building internal links without editing old content.
snippets.notes: Matching ignores case and never links inside headings, existing links, code or buttons. Each phrase is linked once per post, and a page never links to itself.

snippets.title: Orphaned Content Report
snippets.description: Adds Tools > Orphaned Content, listing published posts and pages that no other post or page links to, so you can add internal links where they are missing.
snippets.notes: Scans up to 3,000 published items and caches the result for 12 hours; use the Refresh button after adding links. Menus and widgets are not counted as links.

snippets.title: Warn About H1 Headings in the Block Editor
snippets.description: Shows a warning in the block editor when a post contains an H1 heading block, since the post title is already the page's H1 and a second one muddles the outline.
snippets.notes: The warning disappears as soon as the heading is changed to H2 or removed.

snippets.title: Geo Meta Tags for Local Businesses
snippets.description: Adds geo.region, geo.placename, geo.position and ICBM meta tags with your business location to every page, a small extra local signal for some search engines and directories.
snippets.notes: Region uses the ISO 3166-2 code (country-state), e.g. US-IL or GB-LND. Find coordinates by right-clicking the spot in Google Maps.

snippets.title: Last-Modified Header and 304 Responses for Posts
snippets.description: Sends a Last-Modified header with each post's update time and answers repeat visits from crawlers and browsers with "304 Not Modified", saving bandwidth and crawl budget.
snippets.notes: Only for logged-out visitors on single posts and pages. Sidebar or menu changes do not update the date, so leave this off if those change often.

snippets.title: Shorter Post Slugs Without Stop Words
snippets.description: Removes filler words such as "the", "and" or "how" from automatically created post slugs and caps their length, giving shorter, cleaner URLs.
snippets.notes: Only slugs WordPress creates from the title on first publish are changed; slugs you edit by hand are kept. Edit the word list for other languages.

snippets.title: Test Structured Data From the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a toolbar menu for editors on the front end that opens the current page in Google's Rich Results Test or the Schema.org validator.
snippets.notes: The page must be publicly reachable for the testing tools to fetch it.

snippets.title: Related Post Link in the Middle of Articles
snippets.description: Places a "Related" link to another post from the same category halfway through each blog post, a well-placed internal link that keeps readers on the site.
snippets.notes: Inserted at the middle of the content by the snippet location. The related post is chosen once per post and cached for a week.

snippets.title: Filter REST API Results by Allowed Custom Fields
snippets.description: Lets REST API requests filter posts by custom fields you allow, e.g. /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?meta_key=location&meta_value=paris, for apps and headless front ends.
snippets.notes: Only the listed keys can be used, so private fields stay unqueryable. The parameters also appear in the endpoint's schema.

snippets.title: Refresh Permalinks Automatically When Post Types Change
snippets.description: Rebuilds the rewrite rules once whenever a post type or taxonomy is added, removed or gets a new slug, so new URLs work without visiting Settings > Permalinks.
snippets.notes: Compares a short fingerprint on each request, which costs almost nothing; the actual rebuild only happens after a change.

snippets.title: Rewrite Rules Viewer and URL Tester
snippets.description: Adds Tools > Rewrite Rules, listing every rewrite rule and showing which rule and query a URL path you enter would match, for debugging 404s and custom permalinks.
snippets.notes: Read-only: it never changes rules. Enter a path such as /events/summer-fair/.

snippets.title: Content Types Overview Screen
snippets.description: Adds Tools > Content Types, a table of every registered post type and taxonomy with its labels, visibility, archive, REST base, URL slug and item count.
snippets.notes: Handy for finding the internal names other snippets ask for.

snippets.title: Testimonial Card Styles (SCSS)
snippets.description: Styles the [testimonials] grid as soft cards with a large quote mark, gold stars and a clear attribution line that adapt to light and dark themes.
snippets.notes: Change $accent and $radius at the top. Pairs with the Testimonials Grid Shortcode snippet.

snippets.title: Team Grid Card Styles (SCSS)
snippets.description: Gives the [team] grid rounded photos, a gentle hover lift and tidy name and job title typography, with motion turned off for visitors who prefer less.
snippets.notes: Set $photo-radius to 50% for circular photos.

snippets.title: FAQ Accordion Styles (SCSS)
snippets.description: Styles collapsible FAQ items (from the FAQ list and ACF FAQ shortcodes, or any Details block) with dividers, a plus/minus marker and a visible keyboard focus ring.
snippets.notes: Targets .faq-item, .acf-faq-item and the Details block.

snippets.title: Event Details and Upcoming Events Styles (SCSS)
snippets.description: Lays out the [event_details] facts as a neat two-column list and the [upcoming_events] list with bold dates, collapsing to one column on phones.
snippets.notes: Pairs with the Event Details meta box and Upcoming Events shortcode snippets.

snippets.title: Recipe Card Styles (SCSS)
snippets.description: Turns the [recipe_card] output into a printable card with a fact strip for times and servings, a two-column ingredient list on wide screens and numbered steps.
snippets.notes: Pairs with the Recipe Details meta box snippet; when printed, the card drops its background to save ink.

snippets.title: A–Z Index Styles (SCSS)
snippets.description: Styles the [az_index] letter bar as a row of buttons that stays visible while scrolling, and lays out each letter's entries in columns.
snippets.notes: Set $sticky-top to the height of a fixed header if your theme has one.

snippets.title: Card Layout for the Post Grid Shortcode (SCSS)
snippets.description: Styles the [post_grid] shortcode output as clean cards with rounded images, a subtle shadow on hover and clamped excerpts, respecting reduced-motion settings.
snippets.notes: Change $radius and $excerpt-lines to taste.

snippets.title: Honeypot Trap for Contact Form 7
snippets.description: Adds a hidden field to every Contact Form 7 form that people never see but spam bots fill in. Submissions with the field filled are marked as spam and never emailed.
snippets.notes: Change the field name if a bot learns it; keep it something a bot would want to fill, such as a website or company field.

snippets.title: Reject Contact Form 7 Submissions Sent Too Fast
