snippets.description: Deletes the custom user fields you list when you run a personal data erasure request under Tools > Erase Personal Data, so they are not left behind.
snippets.notes: Only the listed keys are removed; the account itself is not deleted.

snippets.title: Include Custom Comment Fields in Privacy Exports and Erasures
snippets.description: Adds extra comment fields stored as comment meta (such as a phone number or rating) to personal data exports, and removes them during erasure requests.
snippets.notes: List the comment meta keys your comment form or plugins store; each request handles up to 100 comments per page.

snippets.title: Add Custom Order Fields to WooCommerce Privacy Exports
snippets.description: Includes extra checkout fields you store on orders (such as a VAT number or delivery notes) in the order section of personal data exports.
snippets.notes: Use the order meta keys your checkout field plugin saves; keys starting with an underscore are fine.

snippets.title: Add Your Own Section to the Privacy Policy Guide
snippets.description: Adds a suggested paragraph about your custom code (such as analytics, embeds or contact forms) to the Privacy Policy Guide under Settings > Privacy, ready to copy into your policy.
snippets.notes: Edit the text to describe what your site really collects; the guide only suggests content and does not change your policy page.

snippets.title: Privacy Policy Link in the Site Footer
snippets.description: Adds a link to the privacy policy page you set under Settings > Privacy at the bottom of every page, for themes that do not show it.
snippets.notes: Nothing is printed until a published privacy policy page is selected in Settings > Privacy.

snippets.title: "Privacy Policy Last Updated" Date Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [privacy_policy_updated] shortcode that prints the date your privacy policy page was last changed, so the date on the page is always correct.
snippets.notes: Use [privacy_policy_updated format="F j, Y"] to choose a date format; it defaults to your site's date format.

snippets.title: Self-Host Google Fonts Used by Your Theme and Plugins
snippets.description: Detects Google Fonts stylesheets loaded on your site, lets you download them to your own server from Tools > Local Google Fonts, and then serves the local copies so visitors' browsers never contact Google.
snippets.notes: Visit a few front-end pages first so the fonts are detected; fonts loaded with @import inside a theme stylesheet are not detected.

snippets.title: Don't Send Referrer Information to Other Sites
snippets.description: Adds rel="noreferrer" to links in your content that point to other websites, so the sites you link to do not learn which page the visitor came from.
snippets.notes: Affiliate programs that rely on the referrer to credit you may stop working; add their domains to $wpide_referrer_allowed.

snippets.title: Cookie List Table Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [cookie_list] shortcode that prints a clear table of the cookies your site uses, with provider, purpose and duration, for your cookie or privacy policy page.
snippets.notes: Keep the list in the snippet up to date whenever you add or remove a tool that sets cookies.

snippets.title: Consent Record Log With Shortened IP Addresses
snippets.description: Records each cookie consent choice (accepted or rejected, categories, date and privacy policy version) in its own database table, with only a shortened IP address, and lists the latest records under Tools > Consent Log.
snippets.notes: Picks up choices from the WP Consent API and from the wpide:consent event of the consent banner snippet; records older than $wpide_consent_keep_days are removed daily.

snippets.title: Vimeo Embeds With "Do Not Track"
snippets.description: Adds Vimeo's dnt=1 setting to every embedded Vimeo video, which stops Vimeo from setting tracking cookies or collecting session data for your visitors.
snippets.notes: Vimeo still sees the visitor's IP address when the player loads; combine with a click-to-load snippet if you need to avoid that too.

snippets.title: Load Vimeo Videos Only After a Click
snippets.description: Replaces embedded Vimeo players with a lightweight placeholder showing the video title, so nothing is loaded from Vimeo until the visitor clicks to play.
snippets.notes: The placeholder uses no image from Vimeo on purpose, so no request reaches Vimeo before the click.

snippets.title: Two-Click Loading for Spotify, SoundCloud and Other Embeds
snippets.description: Replaces iframes from third-party services in your posts with a notice and a "Load" button, with an option to always allow that service on the visitor's device.
snippets.notes: YouTube, Vimeo and Google Maps have their own click-to-load snippets; add other services to $wpide_two_click_hosts.

snippets.title: Load Social Media Post Embeds Only on Click
snippets.description: Holds back embedded posts from X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and Threads behind a short notice, so their scripts and trackers only load when the visitor asks for them.
snippets.notes: The text of the post is still shown inside the notice when the provider includes it in the embed code.

snippets.title: Store Shortened IP Addresses and No Browser Details on Orders
snippets.description: Shortens the customer IP address saved with each new WooCommerce order and removes the stored browser user agent, keeping order records leaner on personal data.
snippets.notes: Fraud prevention and payment plugins may read the full IP during checkout before it is saved; check your fraud tools still work.

snippets.title: Store Shortened IP Addresses for Easy Digital Downloads Orders
snippets.description: Shortens the customer IP address that Easy Digital Downloads records with orders and customer logs, so a full address is never stored.
snippets.notes: EDD's fraud and file download limits that rely on IP addresses then work per network instead of per device.

snippets.title: Personal Data Request Form Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [privacy_request_form] shortcode where visitors can ask for a copy of their personal data or for its deletion. Requests go into WordPress's own privacy tools and the visitor confirms by email.
snippets.notes: Handle the confirmed requests under Tools > Export Personal Data and Tools > Erase Personal Data; submissions are limited to 3 per hour per visitor.

snippets.title: Expire Personal Data Export Downloads After 24 Hours
snippets.description: Shortens how long the download link and ZIP file of a personal data export stay available, from WordPress's default of three days to one day.
snippets.notes: Change the value in hours to fit how quickly people usually download their exports.

snippets.title: Pending Privacy Requests Badge in the Admin Menu
snippets.description: Shows a count bubble next to Tools and the Export and Erase Personal Data menu items when confirmed privacy requests are waiting for you to process them.
snippets.notes: Only confirmed requests are counted, since those are the ones that need action from you.

snippets.title: Warn About Privacy Requests Close to the 30-Day Deadline
snippets.description: Shows a dashboard notice to administrators when a personal data request has been waiting for more than 25 days, since GDPR expects an answer within one month.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_request_warn_days to warn earlier; the check is cached for an hour.

snippets.title: Hide Commenter IP Addresses From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Hides commenters' IP addresses in the Comments screens for editors, moderators and authors, so only administrators can see this personal data.
snippets.notes: Administrators (users who can manage options) still see the full IP address.

snippets.title: Third-Party Requests Inspector in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds an admin bar item on the front of the site that counts the external domains the current page loads files from, and lists them on click, to help you keep your cookie notice and privacy policy accurate.
snippets.notes: Uses the browser's resource timing list, so requests made after the click are not counted until you click again.

snippets.title: Remove Location and Camera Data From Uploaded Photos
snippets.description: Strips EXIF metadata such as GPS location, camera serial number and date from JPEG and WebP images when they are uploaded, while keeping them correctly rotated.
snippets.notes: Uses Imagick when available and falls back to re-saving with GD (which also removes color profiles); photographers who want to keep metadata should not use this.

snippets.title: Delete Old Contact Form 7 Messages Stored in Flamingo
snippets.description: Permanently deletes contact form messages saved by the Flamingo add-on once they are older than 180 days, so old enquiries and their personal data are not kept forever.
snippets.notes: Requires the Flamingo plugin alongside Contact Form 7; nothing happens if Flamingo is not active.

snippets.title: "Cookie Settings" Link That Reopens the Consent Banner
snippets.description: Adds a [cookie_settings_link] shortcode that lets visitors change their cookie choice at any time: it clears the stored choice and reloads the page so the consent banner shows again.
snippets.notes: Made for the simple wpide_consent cookie banner; consent plugins usually provide their own settings link.

snippets.title: Tell Visitors When the Privacy Policy Changes
snippets.description: Shows a small dismissible notice linking to your privacy policy whenever the policy page has been updated since the visitor last dismissed it. Logged-in users' choice is saved to their profile.
snippets.notes: Only shown once a privacy policy page is set in Settings > Privacy; it reappears each time you update that page.

snippets.title: Turn Off WooCommerce Customer Geolocation
snippets.description: Stops WooCommerce from looking up each visitor's location from their IP address and uses your store's base country as the default customer location instead.
snippets.notes: Tax and shipping estimates then start from your store's address until the customer enters their own.

snippets.title: Keep WooCommerce Usage Tracking Switched Off
snippets.description: Forces WooCommerce's optional usage tracking off, so no store data is sent to WooCommerce even if someone accepts the prompt by mistake.
snippets.notes: This does not affect WooCommerce.com connections such as extension updates.

snippets.title: Stop Dashboard Browser and PHP Version Lookups
snippets.description: Prevents the dashboard from sending your browser's user agent and your server's PHP version to WordPress.org to decide whether to show upgrade warnings.
snippets.notes: You will no longer see "Your browser is out of date" or "PHP update required" boxes; keep an eye on Site Health instead.

snippets.title: Store Shortened IP Addresses for Contact Form 7 Submissions
snippets.description: Shortens the visitor IP address that Contact Form 7 records with each submission (used in mail tags and by Flamingo and spam filters), so a full address is never kept.
snippets.notes: Return an empty string instead to drop the IP address entirely; spam protection that relies on it may become less accurate.

snippets.title: Hide Commenter Email Addresses From Authors and Contributors
snippets.description: Hides commenters' email addresses in the comment lists of the dashboard for users who are not moderators, so authors can reply to comments without seeing readers' personal email addresses.
snippets.notes: Editors and administrators (users who can moderate comments) still see email addresses.

snippets.title: Shorter WooCommerce Guest Sessions
snippets.description: Makes WooCommerce forget guest shopping sessions (cart contents and entered details) after 24 hours instead of two days, so less customer data sits in the sessions table.
snippets.notes: Carts of guests who come back after more than a day will be empty.

snippets.title: Don't Send Guest Commenters' Emails to Gravatar
snippets.description: Shows a built-in placeholder avatar for comments from visitors without an account, so their hashed email address is never sent to Gravatar, while registered users keep their Gravatar picture.
snippets.notes: Change the color in the SVG to match your design; registered users can still be shown with their Gravatar.

snippets.title: Remind Administrators to Publish a Privacy Policy
snippets.description: Shows a notice on the dashboard while no published privacy policy page is selected in Settings > Privacy, with a link to set one up.
snippets.notes: The notice disappears as soon as a published page is selected.

snippets.title: Require Age Confirmation When Registering
snippets.description: Adds a required "I am at least 16 years old" checkbox to the WordPress and WooCommerce registration forms, since many privacy laws do not allow children to consent on their own.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_min_age to the age required in your country (13 to 16 under GDPR, 13 under COPPA).

snippets.title: Stop Browsers Prefetching DNS for Links on Your Pages
snippets.description: Sends the X-DNS-Prefetch-Control header to tell browsers not to look up the domains of every link on your pages in advance, so visitors' DNS providers do not learn which sites you link to before they click.
snippets.notes: Explicit dns-prefetch and preconnect hints in your pages still work.

snippets.title: Remove Ad Click IDs From Links in Your Content
snippets.description: Strips tracking parameters such as fbclid, gclid, msclkid and Mailchimp or HubSpot IDs from links in your posts (often pasted in by accident), so you do not pass your visitors' ad tracking along to other sites.
snippets.notes: UTM campaign tags are kept on purpose; add utm_source and friends to the list if you want those removed too.

snippets.title: Delete Comments Left Unmoderated for 90 Days
snippets.description: Once a day, permanently deletes comments that have been waiting in the moderation queue for more than 90 days, along with the names, emails and IP addresses they contain.
snippets.notes: Approve or reply to comments you want to keep before they reach the age limit.

snippets.title: Anonymize the Comments of Deleted Users
snippets.description: When a user account is deleted, keeps their comments but replaces the name with "Former member" and removes the email address, website and IP address stored with them.
snippets.notes: WordPress normally keeps the commenter details of deleted accounts; change $wpide_former_name to your wording.

snippets.title: Site Health Checks for Privacy Settings
snippets.description: Adds Site Health tests that check whether a privacy policy page is published, whether full commenter IP addresses are being stored, and whether the comment cookie consent checkbox is turned on.
snippets.notes: Each result explains how to fix the setting; pair it with the IP shortening and consent snippets.

snippets.title: Never Send the Referrer From Checkout and Account Pages
snippets.description: Sends a strict no-referrer policy on the WooCommerce checkout, order received and account pages, so order keys and other private URL details are never passed to third-party scripts or sites linked from there.
snippets.notes: Payment gateways that redirect off-site are not affected; they do not rely on the referrer.

snippets.title: Content Security Policy Builder With Violation Reports
snippets.description: Sends a report-only Content Security Policy and collects the browser's violation reports, then lists every blocked source per directive under Tools > CSP Reports with a suggested policy you can enforce later.
snippets.notes: Let it run for a few days while you browse the whole site, then copy the suggested policy into your security headers; reports are stored in one capped option.

snippets.title: Nonce-Based Content Security Policy for Scripts
snippets.description: Adds a fresh random nonce to every script WordPress prints and sends a strict, nonce-based script policy (report-only by default), the modern way to block injected scripts.
snippets.notes: Scripts hard-coded into theme templates do not get the nonce and full-page caches reuse it, so check the console with your cache active before setting $wpide_nonce_enforce to true.

snippets.title: Security Headers for wp-admin and the Login Page
snippets.description: Sends nosniff, a strict referrer policy, a restrictive permissions policy and a cross-origin opener policy on dashboard and login pages, which front-end header snippets do not cover.
snippets.notes: WordPress already sends X-Frame-Options on these screens; this adds the remaining common headers.

snippets.title: Cross-Origin Opener Policy and Related Isolation Headers
snippets.description: Sends Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, Origin-Agent-Cluster and X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies headers on public pages, which stop other sites you link to or that open yours from reaching into your pages.
snippets.notes: same-origin-allow-popups keeps payment and social login popups working; switch to same-origin only if you use none.

snippets.title: Site Health Check for Security Headers
snippets.description: Adds a Site Health test that loads your homepage and reports which common security headers (HSTS, CSP, nosniff, framing, referrer and permissions policies) are missing.
snippets.notes: The result is cached for 12 hours; headers added by your server or CDN are detected too.

snippets.title: Site Health Check for Publicly Exposed Sensitive Files
snippets.description: Adds a Site Health test that checks whether files such as .env, debug.log, .git/HEAD and wp-config.php backups can be downloaded from your site by anyone, and flags them as critical.
snippets.notes: Fix problems by deleting the files or blocking them in your server configuration; results are cached for 12 hours.

snippets.title: Site Health Checks for Weak Security Settings
snippets.description: Adds Site Health tests for common weak spots: default or reused security keys, an account named "admin", the file editor left enabled, and a world-readable wp-config.php file.
snippets.notes: Each problem appears as its own recommendation with a short explanation of how to fix it.

snippets.title: Ask for the Password Again Before Sensitive Admin Screens
snippets.description: Requires administrators to log in again before opening plugin, theme, user and update screens when their login is older than 30 minutes, so a hijacked session cannot quietly install code or add users.
snippets.notes: Adjust $wpide_reauth_minutes and the list of screens; after logging in again the user lands back on the screen they asked for.

snippets.title: "Log Out Everyone" Button for Emergencies
snippets.description: Adds a button under Tools > Log Out Everyone that ends every login session on the site except your own, useful after a suspected break-in or a staff change.
snippets.notes: Users only need to log in again, so also change passwords if you suspect they were stolen.

snippets.title: Active Login Sessions Overview
snippets.description: Adds Users > Active Sessions, listing everyone who is currently logged in with their login time, IP address and browser, and lets you end a user's sessions with one click.
snippets.notes: Shows up to 200 users with active sessions, most recent logins first.

snippets.title: Stop Author URLs From Revealing Login Names
snippets.description: Gives new users an author URL slug based on their user ID instead of their login name, and adds a one-click fix under Users for existing accounts whose author URL shows their username.
snippets.notes: Changing a slug changes that author's archive URL, so old author links will no longer work.

snippets.title: Reject Uploads That Contain PHP Code
snippets.description: Scans every uploaded file that is not a PHP file for hidden PHP code (such as an image with a PHP payload) and refuses the upload if any is found.
snippets.notes: Only the first 2 MB of each file is scanned to keep uploads fast.

snippets.title: Block PHP Execution in the Uploads Folder (Apache)
snippets.description: Adds Tools > Uploads Protection with a button that writes .htaccess rules to your uploads folder so PHP files there can never be run, even if one slips through an upload.
snippets.notes: Works on Apache and LiteSpeed; on Nginx add a location rule for /wp-content/uploads/ that denies .php files instead.

snippets.title: Add a Random Suffix to Uploaded File Names
snippets.description: Appends a short random string to the name of every uploaded file (for example report-k3f9q2.pdf), so private documents cannot be found by guessing their URL.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_random_types to limit it to documents if you want image file names to stay clean for SEO.

snippets.title: Activity Log in Its Own Database Table
snippets.description: Records logins, failed logins, content changes, plugin, theme and user changes and edits to key settings in a dedicated database table, with a searchable, paginated log under Tools > Activity Log and automatic cleanup.
snippets.notes: Records are kept for $wpide_log_days days; the table is created the first time an administrator opens the dashboard.

snippets.title: Prevent Reusing Any of the Last 5 Passwords
snippets.description: Remembers the last five password hashes of each user and refuses a new password that matches one of them, on the profile screen and on password reset.
snippets.notes: Only hashes are stored, never the passwords themselves; history starts building from the next password change.

snippets.title: Block Passwords Found in Known Data Breaches
snippets.description: Checks new passwords against the Have I Been Pwned database of breached passwords when users change or reset them, and asks for a different one if it appears there.
snippets.notes: Only the first 5 characters of the password's SHA-1 hash are sent (k-anonymity), never the password; if the service cannot be reached, the password is allowed.

snippets.title: Daily Plugin and Theme File Change Monitor
snippets.description: Fingerprints every PHP file in your plugins and themes once a day and emails the administrator a list of files that were added, changed or removed outside of normal updates.
snippets.notes: The baseline is refreshed automatically after updates done from the dashboard; changes made over FTP or by malware are reported.

snippets.title: Alert When PHP Files Appear in the Uploads Folder
snippets.description: Scans the uploads folder once a day for PHP files, which never belong there and usually mean a backdoor, and emails the administrator and shows a dashboard warning when new ones show up.
snippets.notes: Small "silence is golden" index.php files that some plugins add are ignored.

snippets.title: Only Named Administrators Can Manage Plugins, Themes and Users
snippets.description: Limits installing, activating, editing and deleting plugins and themes, updating WordPress and managing users to the administrator accounts you list by user ID, even if other accounts have the administrator role.
snippets.notes: Put your own user ID in the list first (find it in the address bar when editing your profile); if none of the listed IDs is an administrator, the snippet does nothing so you cannot lock yourself out.

snippets.title: Allow Only Chosen REST API Namespaces for Visitors
snippets.description: Blocks REST API routes for logged-out visitors except the namespaces you list (for example oEmbed, contact forms and the WooCommerce Store API), shrinking the public attack surface without breaking front-end features.
snippets.notes: Add the namespace of any plugin feature that stops working for visitors; the namespace is the first one or two parts of the route, such as contact-form-7/v1.

snippets.title: Detect Administrator Accounts Added Behind Your Back
snippets.description: Keeps a list of approved administrator accounts and checks it daily and on every dashboard visit; administrators that appear any other way (for example inserted directly into the database by malware) trigger an email and a warning with an approve button.
snippets.notes: Administrators that exist when you activate the snippet are approved automatically, as are those created or promoted from the Users screen by an approved administrator.

snippets.title: Block TRACE, TRACK and Other Unusual HTTP Methods
snippets.description: Answers requests that use HTTP methods WordPress never needs (such as TRACE, TRACK, CONNECT or DEBUG) with a 405 error before any page is built.
snippets.notes: GET, POST, HEAD, OPTIONS, PUT, PATCH and DELETE stay allowed because the REST API uses them.

snippets.title: Reject Requests for Unknown Host Names
snippets.description: Returns an error for requests whose Host header is not your site's domain, which blocks host header injection tricks (such as poisoned password reset links) and junk traffic aimed at your server's IP.
snippets.notes: Add every domain and subdomain that legitimately points at this site (staging, www, mapped domains) to $wpide_allowed_hosts.

snippets.title: Reject Login Attempts That Don't Come From Your Login Form
snippets.description: Refuses login form submissions that are not sent from a page on your own site, which stops many brute-force bots that post straight to wp-login.php.
snippets.notes: Browsers send the needed Origin or Referer header automatically; disable the snippet if a mobile app or external form logs users in through wp-login.php.

snippets.title: Bot Trap Link That Blocks Misbehaving Crawlers
snippets.description: Adds an invisible link that real visitors never see and well-behaved search engines are told to skip; any client that requests it anyway is blocked from the site for 24 hours.
snippets.notes: The trap URL is disallowed in robots.txt, so Google and Bing will not fall into it; logged-in users are never blocked.

snippets.title: Block IP Addresses That Trigger Many 404 Errors
snippets.description: Temporarily blocks visitors who hit more than 20 missing pages within a minute, a typical sign of vulnerability scanners probing for old plugins and backup files.
snippets.notes: Logged-in users are never blocked; raise $wpide_404_limit if you recently changed many URLs and expect lots of broken links.

snippets.title: Alert the Site Owner When an Administrator's Email or Password Changes
snippets.description: Emails the site's admin address whenever any administrator account changes its email address or password, a key warning sign of an account takeover.
snippets.notes: WordPress already notifies the affected user; this adds a second notice to the site owner.

snippets.title: Allow the Administrator Role Only for Company Email Addresses
snippets.description: Refuses to give the administrator role to accounts whose email address is not on one of your approved domains, whether set from the profile screen, the Add User screen or a bulk role change.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_admin_domains to your own domains before activating; existing administrators are not changed.

snippets.title: Allow Your Site to Be Embedded Only on Partner Domains
snippets.description: Replaces the usual same-site framing rule with a Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors list, so your pages can be shown in iframes on the partner sites you name and nowhere else.
snippets.notes: This removes any X-Frame-Options header sent by WordPress or other snippets, since that header cannot list several sites.

snippets.title: Subresource Integrity for Scripts and Styles From CDNs
snippets.description: Adds integrity and crossorigin attributes to the CDN-hosted scripts and stylesheets you list, so browsers refuse to run them if the CDN copy is ever tampered with.
snippets.notes: Get the hash for each exact file version from the CDN (for example the "Copy SRI" button on cdnjs) and update it whenever you change the version.

snippets.title: Emergency Lockdown Switch
snippets.description: Adds a "Lockdown" toggle to the admin bar for administrators. While it is on, only administrators can log in, everyone else is logged out, registration and comments are closed and XML-RPC is off.
snippets.notes: Use it while you investigate a problem; switch it off again from the same admin bar item.

snippets.title: Capability Audit for Risky Permissions
snippets.description: Adds Users > Capability Audit, listing every role other than Administrator and every user outside the administrator role that holds powerful permissions such as unfiltered HTML, plugin installation or user management.
snippets.notes: Plugins sometimes grant extra capabilities to editors or shop managers; review anything you did not set up yourself.

snippets.title: Limit Guesses on Password-Protected Posts
snippets.description: Allows each visitor at most 10 password attempts on password-protected posts and pages every 15 minutes, which stops bots from brute-forcing the post password.
snippets.notes: Every submission counts, including correct ones; the limit is per IP address.

snippets.title: Forget Post Passwords When the Browser Closes
snippets.description: Makes the cookie that remembers a protected post's password last only until the browser is closed, instead of the default 10 days, which matters on shared and public computers.
snippets.code: add_filter( 'post_password_expires', '__return_zero' );
snippets.notes: Visitors need to enter the password again in each new browser session.

snippets.title: Email Alerts When Application Passwords Are Created
snippets.description: Emails the user and the site administrator whenever a new application password is created for an account, since these passwords give API access that bypasses the normal login.
snippets.notes: Application passwords created by the user themselves also trigger the email, which doubles as a receipt.

snippets.title: Accept Application Passwords Only From Trusted IP Addresses
snippets.description: Rejects REST API and XML-RPC logins made with application passwords unless they come from the IP addresses or networks you list, such as your office, CI server or integration partner.
snippets.notes: Use single addresses or CIDR ranges like 198.51.100.0/24; leave the list empty to allow every address.

snippets.title: Protect wp-cron.php From Outside Requests
snippets.description: Requires a secret key for requests to wp-cron.php and adds that key automatically to WordPress's own cron calls, so outsiders cannot hammer the endpoint to slow your site down.
snippets.notes: If a server cron job calls wp-cron.php, add ?wpide_cron_key=YOUR_KEY to its URL; the key is shown under Tools > Site Health > Info > WPIDE cron key.

snippets.title: Daily Email Summary of Failed Logins
snippets.description: Counts failed login attempts during the day (per username and IP address) and emails the administrator a short summary each morning, so you notice brute-force attacks without a flood of alerts.
snippets.notes: No email is sent on days with fewer failed attempts than $wpide_digest_minimum.

snippets.title: Never Show Login Names as Public Display Names
snippets.description: When a user's public display name is the same as their login name (the WordPress default), switches it to their first and last name, or to a neutral name, so author bylines and comments do not reveal usernames.
snippets.notes: Applies when accounts are created or updated; existing accounts change the next time they are saved.

snippets.title: Hide the REST Users Endpoint From Subscribers and Customers
snippets.description: Blocks the REST API users endpoint for logged-in users who cannot edit posts, such as subscribers and shop customers, so a low-level account cannot list your authors and their usernames.
snippets.notes: Authors, editors and administrators keep access because the block editor needs it; their own /users/me request keeps working for everyone.

snippets.title: Alert When wp-config.php, .htaccess or Root Files Change
snippets.description: Checks your site's root folder once a day and emails the administrator when wp-config.php, .htaccess, .user.ini or php.ini change, or when new PHP files appear next to WordPress's own files.
snippets.notes: Core files are covered by WordPress checksums; this watches the configuration files and unexpected additions that those checks miss.

snippets.title: Weekly Security Summary Email
snippets.description: Emails the administrator a short security summary every week: pending WordPress, plugin and theme updates, administrator accounts, new users of the week, inactive plugins and whether debug mode is on.
snippets.notes: Update counts come from WordPress's own update checks, so no extra requests are made.

snippets.title: Automatic Updates for the Plugins You Trust Most
snippets.description: Turns on automatic background updates for the plugins you list (for example your security and backup plugins), so security fixes for them are installed within hours without waiting for you.
snippets.notes: Use plugin folder names as they appear in wp-content/plugins; all other plugins keep the setting chosen on the Plugins screen.

snippets.title: Reject Registrations From Email Domains That Cannot Receive Mail
snippets.description: Checks that the email domain of every new registration has mail (MX) records, and refuses sign-ups from made-up or mistyped domains that bots and spammers often use.
snippets.notes: Results are cached per domain for a day; if your server cannot do DNS lookups the check lets registrations through.

snippets.title: Allow XML-RPC Only From Trusted IP Addresses
snippets.description: Keeps XML-RPC available for the services you list (such as Jetpack or a publishing app on your office network) while answering every other XML-RPC request with a 403 error.
snippets.notes: Replace the example addresses with your own; Jetpack publishes its current IP ranges in its documentation.

snippets.title: Find Posts Using a Shortcode (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp find-shortcode" command that lists every post, page or custom post that contains a given shortcode, with its status and edit link. Handy before removing a plugin.
snippets.notes: Run it as "wp find-shortcode gallery --post_type=post,page --format=csv"; drafts and private posts are included.

snippets.title: Find Posts Using a Block (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp find-block" command that lists the content using a given block, such as core/table or a plugin's block, with how many times it appears in each post.
snippets.notes: Pass the full block name, for example "wp find-block core/image" or "wp find-block acme/slider --format=csv".

snippets.title: Search Text Across All Content (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp search-content" command that finds an exact word or phrase in titles, content and excerpts of every post type, so you can locate old links, prices or names quickly.
snippets.notes: Matching is case-insensitive and literal; add --in=title to search titles only.

snippets.title: Trim Old Revisions, Keeping the Latest (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp trim-revisions" command that deletes old revisions but keeps the newest few for every post. It only reports what it would delete until you add --yes.
snippets.notes: Example "wp trim-revisions --keep=3 --yes"; take a database backup first, deleted revisions cannot be restored.

snippets.title: Find and Remove Orphaned Post Meta (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp orphaned-meta" command that counts custom field rows left behind by deleted posts, grouped by meta key, and removes them in small batches when you add --delete.
snippets.notes: Back up the database before running with --delete.

snippets.title: Report Images Missing Alt Text (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp missing-alt" command that lists every image in the Media Library without alt text, with the post it is attached to, so you can fix accessibility gaps in order of importance.
snippets.notes: Use --format=csv > missing-alt.csv to hand the list to an editor.

snippets.title: Move All Posts From One Author to Another (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp reassign-posts" command that hands every post of one user to another user, for example when a writer leaves, without deleting the old account.
snippets.notes: Users can be given by ID, login or email; add --post_type=page to limit it and --dry-run to preview.

snippets.title: Find Broken Internal Links (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp check-internal-links" command that scans published content for links to your own site that no longer point to a post, page or file, and lists them with the post they appear in.
snippets.notes: It checks links without making HTTP requests, so archive, search and plugin-made URLs may show up; review the list before editing.

snippets.title: List Custom Field Keys With Counts (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp meta-keys" command that lists every custom field key used by a post type and how many posts use it, which helps when cleaning up after old plugins or planning a migration.
snippets.notes: Add --hidden to include keys that start with an underscore.

snippets.title: Content Audit Summary (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp content-audit" command that shows, per post type, how many items are published, drafts, missing a featured image, missing an excerpt and not updated for two years.
snippets.notes: Change the stale threshold with --stale-days=365.

snippets.title: Change the Status of Many Posts at Once (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp change-status" command that moves posts from one status to another, for example every draft older than a date back to pending, with a preview count before anything changes.
snippets.notes: Example "wp change-status --from=draft --to=pending --before=2024-01-01 --yes"; without --yes it only counts.

snippets.title: Export Every Public URL (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp list-urls" command that prints the address of every published post, page, custom post and term archive, ready to build a redirect map before a migration or redesign.
snippets.notes: Save the list with "wp list-urls --format=csv > urls.csv"; add --no-terms to skip category and tag archives.

snippets.title: Find and Delete Unused Tags and Categories (WP-CLI)
snippets.description: Adds a "wp empty-terms" command that lists the terms of a taxonomy that no post uses, and deletes them when you add --delete. The default category is always kept.
snippets.notes: Example "wp empty-terms --taxonomy=post_tag --delete".

snippets.title: Word Count and Reading Time in the REST API
snippets.description: Adds word_count and reading_time fields to posts in the REST API, so headless front ends and apps can show "5 min read" without counting words themselves.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_words_per_minute to match your audience; add more post types to $wpide_reading_post_types.

snippets.title: Author Name and Avatar in REST API Posts
snippets.description: Adds an author_details field with the author's display name, profile link and avatar URL to every post in the REST API, saving apps a second request or a heavy _embed call.
snippets.notes: Only public profile data is exposed; the author's email and login are never included.

snippets.title: Navigation Menus as a REST API Endpoint
snippets.description: Adds a public /wp-json/site/v1/menu/{location} endpoint that returns the menu assigned to a theme location as a nested list, ready for a headless or app front end.
snippets.notes: Works with classic menu locations (Appearance > Menus); block themes that only use the Navigation block have no locations to return.

snippets.title: Private Site Statistics REST Endpoint
snippets.description: Adds a /wp-json/site/v1/stats endpoint that returns post, page, comment and user counts to logged-in editors or application-password clients, for reporting tools and status boards.
snippets.notes: Access needs the edit_others_posts capability; use an application password to call it from another server.

snippets.title: Random Post REST Endpoint
snippets.description: Adds a public /wp-json/site/v1/random endpoint that returns one random published post with its title, link and excerpt, for "surprise me" buttons or widgets.
snippets.notes: The list of candidate IDs is cached for an hour and refreshed when you publish or update a post.

snippets.title: Uptime Check Endpoint That Tests the Database
snippets.description: Adds a lightweight /wp-json/site/v1/ping endpoint for uptime monitors. It answers 200 only when WordPress can reach the database, and 503 otherwise, without exposing any versions.
snippets.notes: Point your monitor at https://example.com/wp-json/site/v1/ping and alert on any status other than 200.

snippets.title: Allow Random Order in REST API Post Lists
snippets.description: Lets REST API clients request posts with orderby=rand, for example to show a few random articles in an app, which WordPress does not allow by default.
snippets.notes: Random ordering cannot be cached well by CDNs; keep per_page small.

snippets.title: Keep REST API Responses Out of Search Results
snippets.description: Sends an X-Robots-Tag: noindex header with every REST API response so search engines do not index raw JSON from /wp-json/ next to your real pages.
snippets.notes: This does not block access to the API; it only asks search engines not to index the responses.

snippets.title: REST API Error Log Under Tools
snippets.description: Records REST API requests that fail with a 4xx or 5xx status, with the route, method, user and error code, and lists the latest 100 under Tools > REST Errors for debugging integrations.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_rest_log_404 to false to skip "not found" errors from bots; the log is stored in one non-autoloaded option.

snippets.title: Previous and Next Post Links in the REST API
snippets.description: Adds a navigation field to single posts in the REST API with the ID, title and link of the previous and next posts, so apps can build "read next" buttons.
snippets.notes: The field is only computed for single-post requests, so post lists stay fast.

snippets.title: Send a Webhook When a Post Is Published
snippets.description: Posts a small JSON payload (ID, title, link, author and date) to a URL of your choice whenever a post goes live, to trigger a static site build, a Zapier flow or a chat notification.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_webhook_url; the request is non-blocking with a short timeout so publishing never waits for the receiving service.

snippets.title: Weekly and Monthly WP-Cron Schedules
snippets.description: Adds "Once Weekly" and "Once Monthly" recurrences to WP-Cron so your own scheduled tasks, or plugins that offer a schedule picker, can run less often than daily.
snippets.notes: Use the keys "wpide_weekly" and "wpide_monthly" with wp_schedule_event(); WordPress 5.4+ already has "weekly", which this keeps untouched.

snippets.title: Run a Task Later Helper Function
snippets.description: Adds a wpide_run_later() helper that schedules any hook to run once after a delay, without creating duplicates, so slow work like sending a report or calling an API can leave the page request.
snippets.notes: Example wpide_run_later( 'my_send_report', 5 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS, array( $order_id ) ), then add_action( 'my_send_report', ... ) to do the work.

snippets.title: Pause WP-Cron Outside Production
snippets.description: Stops scheduled tasks from running on local, development and staging copies of the site, so a cloned database does not send newsletters, sync orders or run backups twice.
snippets.notes: It relies on WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE in wp-config.php; tasks still run if you trigger them manually with WP-CLI.

snippets.title: Show Which Conditional Tags Are True in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a "Conditionals" menu to the front-end admin bar for administrators listing which template conditions are true on the current page, such as is_singular(), is_archive() or is_front_page().
snippets.notes: Add your own checks, such as is_woocommerce, to $wpide_conditionals; functions that do not exist are skipped.

snippets.title: List Every Hook Fired on a Page
snippets.description: Lets administrators add ?wpide_hooks=1 to any front-end URL to see, at the bottom of the page, every action and filter that ran and how many times, in firing order.
snippets.notes: Tracking only starts when the parameter is present, so normal page loads are not slowed down.

snippets.title: Show the Template Parts Used on a Page
snippets.description: Adds a "Template parts" menu to the front-end admin bar for administrators listing every template part loaded on the page, for both classic themes (get_template_part) and block themes.
snippets.notes: Pair it with a template viewer to see the full picture of which files build a page.

snippets.title: Inspect the Main Query and Its SQL
snippets.description: Lets administrators add ?wpide_query=1 to a front-end URL to print the main query's variables, the SQL it ran and the number of posts found at the bottom of the page.
snippets.notes: Useful when a pre_get_posts change does not behave as expected.

snippets.title: Log Deprecated and "Doing It Wrong" Notices With Their Source
snippets.description: Writes every deprecated function, argument, hook or "doing it wrong" notice to the PHP error log with the plugin or theme file that caused it, even when WP_DEBUG is off.
snippets.notes: Turn it on before upgrading WordPress or PHP, then check the error log; each distinct message is logged once per request.

snippets.title: Send PHP Values to the Browser Console
snippets.description: Adds a wpide_console() helper that prints any PHP variable to the browser's developer console for administrators, so you can inspect data without breaking the page layout.
snippets.notes: Example wpide_console( $post, 'Current post' ); values are queued and printed in the footer of front-end and admin pages.

snippets.title: Private Log File Helper Function
snippets.description: Adds a wpide_log() helper that writes timestamped messages and data to a daily log file in a protected folder inside uploads, so custom code can leave a trail without touching debug.log.
snippets.notes: Example wpide_log( 'Order synced', array( 'id' => $order_id ), 'info' ); the folder name contains a random suffix and blocks direct web access on Apache.

snippets.title: Readable Variable Dump for Administrators
snippets.description: Adds a wpide_dump() helper that shows any variable in a readable, collapsible box only to administrators, so debug output never reaches visitors even if you forget to remove it.
snippets.notes: Example wpide_dump( get_queried_object() ); pass true as the second argument to stop the page after the dump.

snippets.title: Show Outgoing HTTP Requests in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Counts the external HTTP requests WordPress, plugins and themes make while building a page, and lists each URL, status and time in an admin bar menu for administrators.
snippets.notes: Slow pages often come from plugins calling remote APIs on every load; this shows them at a glance.

snippets.title: Show the Admin Screen ID in the Footer
snippets.description: Displays the current screen ID, base, post type and hook suffix in the admin footer for administrators, which is exactly what you need when targeting a screen in your own code.
snippets.notes: Use the values with get_current_screen() checks or the admin_enqueue_scripts hook suffix.

snippets.title: List All Registered Shortcodes Under Tools
snippets.description: Adds a Tools > Shortcodes screen listing every shortcode available on the site and the plugin, theme or function that provides it, so you know what can be used in content.
snippets.notes: Shortcodes registered only on the front end will not appear here.

snippets.title: Registered Image Sizes Under Tools
snippets.description: Adds a Tools > Image Sizes screen listing every image size WordPress creates on upload, with its width, height and crop mode, so you can see what themes and plugins have added.
snippets.notes: Each listed size is generated for every uploaded image; remove the ones you do not use to save disk space.

snippets.title: Flush Permalinks From the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a "Flush permalinks" link to the admin bar for administrators that rebuilds the rewrite rules in one click, handy after registering post types or custom rewrite rules.
snippets.notes: Same effect as saving Settings > Permalinks; the link is protected with a nonce.

snippets.title: Site Health Check for Must-Have Plugins
snippets.description: Adds a test to Tools > Site Health that turns critical when any plugin you list as essential, such as your backup, security or SEO plugin, is deactivated or missing.
snippets.notes: List plugin paths as folder/main-file.php in $wpide_required_plugins.

snippets.title: Maintainer Details in Site Health Info
snippets.description: Adds a "Site maintainer" section to Tools > Site Health > Info with your agency's contact details, support plan and notes, so they travel with every copied debug report.
snippets.notes: Edit the $wpide_maintainer values; nothing is shown on the front end.

snippets.title: Different Admin Color Scheme per Environment
snippets.description: Switches the admin color scheme automatically on local, development and staging sites, so nobody mistakes a test copy for the live site while editing.
snippets.notes: Production keeps each user's own choice; change the schemes in $wpide_env_colors (fresh, light, modern, blue, coffee, ectoplasm, midnight, ocean, sunrise).

snippets.title: Environment Name in the Browser Tab Title
snippets.description: Prefixes browser tab titles with [LOCAL], [DEV] or [STAGING] for logged-in users on non-production sites, in the admin and on the front end, so open tabs are easy to tell apart.
snippets.notes: Visitors and the production site see normal titles.

snippets.title: Object Cache Hit Rate in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Shows administrators the object cache hit rate, hits and misses for the current page in the admin bar, to check whether Redis or Memcached is actually helping.
snippets.notes: Without a persistent object cache the numbers only cover the current request.

snippets.title: User Meta Inspector on Profile Screens
snippets.description: Shows administrators a read-only table of every stored user meta value at the bottom of user profile screens, with session tokens and other secrets masked.
snippets.notes: Add other sensitive keys to $wpide_masked_meta to keep them hidden.

snippets.title: REST API Link for the Current Item in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a "REST" link to the front-end admin bar for administrators that opens the JSON for the post, page, term or author being viewed, which speeds up headless and integration work.
snippets.notes: Only items exposed in the REST API get a link.

snippets.title: Measure How Long Code Takes
snippets.description: Adds wpide_timer_start() and wpide_timer_stop() helpers that measure the time and memory a piece of code uses and write the result to the PHP error log, to find slow functions.
snippets.notes: Example wpide_timer_start( 'menu' ); ... wpide_timer_stop( 'menu' ); the stop call also returns the milliseconds.

snippets.title: Admin Notice Helper That Survives Redirects
snippets.description: Adds a wpide_flash_notice() helper that queues a success, warning or error message for the current user and shows it on the next admin screen, even after a redirect.
snippets.notes: Example wpide_flash_notice( 'Import finished.', 'success' ); before wp_safe_redirect(); messages are stored per user for five minutes.

snippets.title: Change the Author URL Base From /author/ to /team/
snippets.description: Changes author archive addresses from /author/name/ to a word of your choice, such as /team/name/ or /writers/name/, to match how your site talks about its people.
snippets.notes: Visit Settings > Permalinks and click Save once after activating or changing $wpide_author_base, so the new rules are built.

snippets.title: Serve a humans.txt File
snippets.description: Answers /humans.txt with a plain-text file crediting the people and tools behind the site, generated by WordPress so you do not need to upload anything to the server.
snippets.notes: Edit $wpide_humans_txt; save Settings > Permalinks once so WordPress learns the new address. A real humans.txt file on the server takes priority.

snippets.title: Different Single Post Template per Category
snippets.description: Lets a classic theme use single-cat-{slug}.php for posts in a given category, for example a recipe layout for posts filed under Recipes, falling back to the normal template.
snippets.notes: Create the file in your child theme, such as single-cat-recipes.php; block themes can use the template picker in the editor instead.

snippets.title: Register Page Templates From a Folder Outside the Theme
snippets.description: Adds every PHP file in wp-content/page-templates/ to the page Template menu of classic themes, so custom layouts survive theme switches and updates.
snippets.notes: Each file needs a "Template Name: ..." header comment like a theme template; block themes use the Site Editor for templates instead.

snippets.title: wp-config.php Settings Overview Under Tools
snippets.description: Adds a Tools > Config Constants screen that shows the value of important wp-config.php settings, such as debug mode, memory limits, cron, caching and file editing, without opening the file.
snippets.notes: Secret keys, salts and database passwords are never shown; add more names to $wpide_config_constants.

snippets.title: Transients Viewer Under Tools
snippets.description: Adds a Tools > Transients screen listing the cached transients stored in the database with their size and expiry time, and lets administrators delete a single one to force a refresh.
snippets.notes: Sites with Redis or Memcached keep transients in the object cache, so the list will be short or empty there.

snippets.title: Excerpt Column in the Posts List
snippets.description: Adds an Excerpt column to the Posts screen showing the start of each manual excerpt, and a clear "missing" label where none was written, so editors can fill the gaps.
snippets.notes: Add more post types to $wpide_excerpt_column_types if they support excerpts.

snippets.title: Sortable Custom Field Column in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Adds a column showing the value of a custom field, such as a price, event date or SKU, to an admin list and lets you sort the list by it.
snippets.notes: Set the key, label, post type and whether values are numbers; sorting a large list by a meta value is slower than by date.

snippets.title: Attached Media Count Column
snippets.description: Adds a Media column to the Posts and Pages lists with the number of files uploaded to each item, linking to them in the Media Library, to spot heavy or image-less content.
snippets.notes: Counts files attached through "Uploaded to"; images picked from the library after upload are not attached.

snippets.title: Parent Page Column for Pages
snippets.description: Adds a Parent column to the Pages list with a link to each page's parent, so the structure of a large site is clear even when the list is sorted or searched.
snippets.notes: Top-level pages show a dash.

snippets.title: Countdown for Scheduled Posts in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Shows how long until each scheduled post goes live, such as "in 3 hours", next to the date in admin lists, so the publishing queue is easy to read.
snippets.notes: Posts whose scheduled time has already passed get a red "missed schedule" label.

snippets.title: Revisions Count Column
snippets.description: Adds a Revisions column to the Posts and Pages lists showing how many saved revisions each item has, linking to the revision browser, to find heavily edited content.
snippets.notes: Counts come from one grouped query per screen.

snippets.title: Filter Pages by Template
snippets.description: Adds a template dropdown above the Pages list so you can show only the pages that use a given page template, such as every landing page or full-width page.
snippets.notes: "Default template" shows pages that do not use a custom template.

snippets.title: Filter Posts With or Without a Featured Image
snippets.description: Adds a "Featured image" dropdown above admin post lists to show only posts that have one or only those that are missing one, which makes fixing gaps quick.
snippets.notes: Works on every post type that supports featured images.

snippets.title: PDF, Document and Spreadsheet Filters in the Media Library
snippets.description: Adds PDFs, Documents, Spreadsheets and Archives to the Media Library type filter next to Images and Video, so non-image files are easy to find.
snippets.notes: Each filter only appears once at least one file of that type has been uploaded.

snippets.title: Bulk Make Posts Sticky or Not Sticky
snippets.description: Adds "Make sticky" and "Remove sticky" to the bulk actions on the Posts screen, so you can pin or unpin many posts at once instead of editing each one.
snippets.notes: Sticky posts show first on the blog page in most themes.

snippets.title: Bulk Duplicate Posts and Pages as Drafts
snippets.description: Adds a "Duplicate as draft" bulk action to post and page lists that copies the selected items with their content, categories, tags and custom fields into new drafts.
snippets.notes: Copies are owned by you and titled "(Copy)"; comments and revisions are not copied.

snippets.title: Export Selected Posts to CSV
snippets.description: Adds an "Export to CSV" bulk action to the Posts and Pages screens that downloads the selected items with ID, title, status, author, dates, categories, link and word count.
snippets.notes: Opens directly in Excel or Google Sheets; add columns in the $row array.

snippets.title: Bulk Rebuild Slugs From Titles
snippets.description: Adds a "Rebuild slug from title" bulk action that regenerates the URL slug of the selected drafts or posts from their current titles, handy after importing content with messy slugs.
snippets.notes: Changing the slug of a published post changes its URL; WordPress remembers the old slug and redirects it, but update internal links too.

snippets.title: Quick Edit and Bulk Edit for a Custom Field
snippets.description: Adds a custom field, such as a subtitle or price, to the Quick Edit and Bulk Edit panels of the Posts screen, with a matching column, so values can be changed without opening each post.
snippets.notes: Change the key and label; in Bulk Edit an empty box leaves each post's value unchanged.

snippets.title: One-Click "Featured" Star in the Posts List
snippets.description: Adds a star column to the Posts screen that marks or unmarks a post as featured with one click, saving a "featured" custom field your theme or queries can use.
snippets.notes: Query featured posts with 'meta_key' => '_wpide_featured', 'meta_value' => '1'; change $wpide_featured_key to reuse an existing field.

snippets.title: Warning Banner When Editing Key Pages
snippets.description: Shows a prominent warning at the top of the editor when someone opens an important page, such as the homepage, checkout or a landing page, reminding them to be careful.
snippets.notes: The homepage and privacy page are included automatically; add more page IDs and messages to $wpide_key_pages.

snippets.title: Notice When Editing Someone Else's Post
snippets.description: Reminds editors with a notice in the block editor when the post they opened was written by another author, to avoid unintended changes to a colleague's work.
snippets.notes: Shows the original author's name; it does not lock the post.

snippets.title: Tuck Admin Notices Into a Collapsible Panel
snippets.description: Gathers the banners plugins print at the top of admin screens into one "Notices" panel that stays closed until you open it, while errors and your own save messages stay visible.
snippets.notes: Success messages after saving and notices marked as errors are never hidden.

snippets.title: Your Site Icon in Place of the WordPress Logo in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Replaces the WordPress logo menu in the admin bar with your Site Icon linking to the dashboard, a simple branding touch for client sites.
snippets.notes: Set a Site Icon under Settings > General first; without one the site name's first letter is shown.

snippets.title: "Get Help" Menu in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a "Help" menu to the admin bar with links to your support desk, guides and contact details, so clients always know where to turn when something is unclear.
snippets.notes: Edit the links in $wpide_help_links; they open in a new tab.

snippets.title: Rename Any Admin Menu Item
snippets.description: Renames admin menu entries to words your team understands, such as "Appearance" to "Design" or a plugin's menu to "Bookings", without touching the plugin.
snippets.notes: Use the exact current label as the key; submenu items are renamed too. Screen titles inside plugins keep their own wording.

snippets.title: Dark Mode for wp-admin (Per User)
snippets.description: Adds a "Dark mode" checkbox to each user's profile that switches the whole admin area to a dark look, with images and videos kept in their real colors.
snippets.notes: The theme uses a CSS filter, so a few plugin screens may look slightly off; the block editor canvas keeps your theme's real colors.

snippets.title: Private Notes on the Plugins Screen
snippets.description: Adds a "Note" link under each plugin on the Plugins screen where administrators can record why it is installed, who requested it or what to check after updates.
snippets.notes: Notes are saved in one option and only visible to users who can manage plugins.

snippets.title: Look Up Posts by URL Slug From Admin Lists
snippets.description: Lets you type slug:my-post-name into the search box of any admin post list to find the item with that URL slug, which is handy when you only have a link.
snippets.notes: You can also paste a full URL after "slug:"; only the last part of the path is used.

snippets.title: Quick Find Box in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a small search box to the admin bar on every admin screen that searches posts, pages or users, and jumps straight to the editor when you type a post ID.
snippets.notes: Type a number to open that post or page for editing; anything else searches the chosen list.

snippets.title: Label Special Pages in the Pages List
snippets.description: Adds labels such as "Contact form" or "Landing page" next to chosen pages in the Pages list, the same way WordPress marks the front page, so editors know which pages matter.
snippets.notes: Map page IDs to labels in $wpide_page_labels; find an ID by hovering the page's Edit link.

snippets.title: Prevent Deleting Categories That Still Have Posts
snippets.description: Stops anyone from deleting a category or tag while posts still use it, which avoids accidentally emptying sections of the site or breaking menus and links.
snippets.notes: Move or remove the posts first, then the term can be deleted; the default category is already protected by WordPress.

snippets.title: Limit Posts to a Single Category
snippets.description: Keeps every post in exactly one category: when several are ticked, only the most specific one is kept on save, which keeps URLs, breadcrumbs and archives tidy.
snippets.notes: The deepest child category wins; between categories at the same level the one with the lowest ID is kept.

snippets.title: Lock the URL Slug of Published Posts
snippets.description: Prevents authors and editors from changing the slug of a post or page once it is published, so shared links and search rankings do not break. Administrators can still change it.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_slug_unlock_cap to choose who may still edit slugs.

snippets.title: Change a Post's Type From the Editor
snippets.description: Adds a "Post type" box to the editor sidebar for administrators that converts an item into another post type, such as turning a post into a page, keeping its content and URL slug.
snippets.notes: Categories and tags that the new type does not support stay in the database but are hidden; check the URL afterwards.

snippets.title: Hide the Custom Fields Box From Non-Administrators
snippets.description: Removes the raw "Custom Fields" box from the editor for everyone except administrators, so editors cannot accidentally change values that plugins and the theme depend on.
snippets.notes: Fields shown in proper boxes by plugins such as ACF are not affected.

snippets.title: Highlight Your Own Posts in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Gives rows you authored a subtle colored edge in admin post lists, so on busy multi-author sites you can spot your own work at a glance.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_my_rows_color to match your admin color scheme.

snippets.title: "Copy Link" Action in Admin Lists
snippets.description: Adds a "Copy link" action under each published post and page in admin lists that copies its public URL to the clipboard in one click, for sharing in chats and emails.
snippets.notes: Uses the browser clipboard; very old browsers fall back to a prompt with the URL selected.

snippets.title: Your Own Help Tab on Editing Screens
snippets.description: Adds a "Site guide" tab to the Help panel of the post and page editing screens with your own instructions, such as image sizes, tone of voice or who to contact.
snippets.notes: The tab content accepts basic HTML; open it with the Help button at the top right of classic admin screens.

snippets.title: "Recently Edited" Menu in the Admin Bar
snippets.description: Adds a menu to the admin bar listing the last eight posts and pages you edited, with their status, so you can jump back into your work from anywhere on the site.
snippets.notes: Based on WordPress's own "last edited by" record; change $wpide_recent_count for a longer list.

snippets.title: Duplicate a Navigation Menu
snippets.description: Adds a "Duplicate this menu" button to Appearance > Menus that copies the selected classic menu with all its items and nesting, handy for trying a new structure safely.
snippets.notes: The copy is not assigned to any theme location until you choose one.

snippets.title: "Needs Review" View for Outdated Posts
snippets.description: Adds a "Needs review" link above the Posts list that shows published posts not updated for a year or more, so editors can keep old content accurate.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_review_months; the count in the link is cached for an hour.

snippets.title: "My Notes" Personal Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Adds a "My notes" widget to the dashboard where each user keeps their own private notes and reminders, saved instantly and invisible to everyone else.
snippets.notes: Notes are stored per user, up to 5,000 characters, and saved when you click away from the box.

snippets.title: Site Activity Timeline Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget with one timeline of the latest published posts, approved comments and new user sign-ups, newest first, so you see what happened on the site at a glance.
snippets.notes: Shows the last 12 events; change $wpide_timeline_count. New users only appear for people who can list users.

snippets.title: Pending Updates Summary Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget showing how many WordPress, plugin, theme and translation updates are waiting, with the names of the plugins and a link to install them.
snippets.notes: Uses the update data WordPress already checks twice a day, so it adds no remote requests.

snippets.title: Media Library Overview Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget breaking the Media Library down into images, videos, audio and documents, with uploads this month and the number of files not attached to any content.
snippets.notes: Counts are cached for an hour; the "unattached" link opens the matching Media Library view.

snippets.title: Posts per Month Chart Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget with a simple bar chart of how many posts were published in each of the last 12 months, to keep an eye on your publishing rhythm.
snippets.notes: Pure HTML and CSS, no chart library; counts are cached for six hours and refreshed when a post is published.

snippets.title: Author Leaderboard Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget ranking authors by the number of posts they published this month, with last month's figure for comparison, to celebrate your most active writers.
snippets.notes: Counts published posts only and are cached for an hour.

snippets.title: Quick Draft for Pages and Custom Post Types
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget like Quick Draft that lets you start a draft of any post type, such as a page, product or event, with a title and a few notes.
snippets.notes: After saving you get a link to continue editing the new draft.

snippets.title: Last 7 Days Compared Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget comparing new posts, comments and user registrations from the last seven days with the seven days before, with up and down arrows.
snippets.notes: Figures are cached for an hour.

snippets.title: Shared To-Do List Widget
snippets.description: Adds a team to-do list to the dashboard where editors can add tasks, tick them off and clear finished ones, shared by everyone who can edit content.
snippets.notes: Tasks are stored in one option; finished tasks stay listed until someone clicks "Clear done".

snippets.title: Default Dashboard Layout for New Users
snippets.description: Gives every user who has never arranged their dashboard the same widget order and columns you choose, so clients see the most useful widgets first.
snippets.notes: List widget IDs per column; users who later drag widgets around keep their own layout.

snippets.title: Recent Uploads Dashboard Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget with thumbnails of the 12 most recently uploaded images and files, each linking to its edit screen, so you can review new media quickly.
snippets.notes: Non-image files show their file type icon.

snippets.title: Posts Missing a Featured Image Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget listing the latest published posts that have no featured image, with edit links, so social shares and archive pages never show blank spaces.
snippets.notes: Shows up to ten posts; change the post type in $wpide_thumb_check_type.

snippets.title: Forgotten Drafts Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget listing drafts nobody has touched for over 30 days, oldest first, with their author, so half-finished ideas get finished or cleaned up.
snippets.notes: Editors see everyone's drafts; authors only see their own.

snippets.title: Unanswered Comments Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget listing recent approved comments from readers that nobody on your team has replied to yet, so questions do not go unanswered.
snippets.notes: A reply from any user who can edit posts counts as answered; looks at the last 60 days.

snippets.title: Team Time Zones Widget
snippets.description: Adds a dashboard widget showing the current local time for each office or teammate you list, next to the site's own time, so scheduling across time zones is easier.
snippets.notes: Use PHP time zone names such as Europe/London or America/New_York in $wpide_team_zones.

snippets.title: Pre-Publish Checklist in the Block Editor
snippets.description: Adds a checklist to the block editor's publish panel, such as "Spell-checked" or "Links tested", and keeps the Publish button locked until every item is ticked.
snippets.notes: Edit the items in $wpide_checklist_items; ticks are not saved, so the list resets each time the post is published.

snippets.title: Require a Real Category Before Publishing
snippets.description: Stops posts from being published while they are only in "Uncategorized" or have no category, and shows the writer a clear message in the block or classic editor.
snippets.notes: Drafts can still be saved; only publishing and scheduling are blocked.

snippets.title: Require an Excerpt Before Publishing
snippets.description: Blocks publishing posts that have no hand-written excerpt, so archive pages, search results and social shares always have a proper summary.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_excerpt_min_chars to require a minimum length; drafts can still be saved.

snippets.title: Block Publishing Posts That Contain Placeholder Text
snippets.description: Refuses to publish content that still contains placeholder words such as "Lorem ipsum", "TODO", "TK" or "[insert", so unfinished drafts never go live by accident.
snippets.notes: Add or remove phrases in $wpide_placeholder_phrases; matching ignores letter case.

snippets.title: Title Length Meter in the Block Editor
snippets.description: Shows a live character count for the post title in the editor sidebar, turning amber and red as it passes the length search engines usually display, to help write tidy titles.
snippets.notes: Adjust $wpide_title_ideal and $wpide_title_max; the meter never blocks saving.

snippets.title: Word Count Goal in the Block Editor
snippets.description: Lets writers set a target word count for each post in the editor sidebar and shows a progress bar that fills as they write, handy for briefs and freelance work.
snippets.notes: The goal is stored in the _wpide_word_goal custom field; set $wpide_default_word_goal for new posts.

snippets.title: Private Editorial Notes in the Block Editor
snippets.description: Adds an "Editorial notes" panel to the editor sidebar where writers and editors leave internal notes about a post, such as sources or open questions, that never appear on the site.
snippets.notes: Notes are stored in the protected _wpide_editorial_notes field and shown as an icon in the Posts list.

snippets.title: "Add to Queue" Scheduling for Drafts
snippets.description: Adds an "Add to queue" link under drafts in the Posts list that schedules the post into the next free publishing slot, such as weekdays at 9:00, without picking dates by hand.
snippets.notes: Define your slots in $wpide_queue_days and $wpide_queue_times (site time zone); only one post is scheduled per slot.

snippets.title: Editorial Calendar Screen
snippets.description: Adds a Posts > Calendar screen showing a month grid of published, scheduled and draft posts on their dates, with links to edit each one and arrows to move between months.
snippets.notes: Drafts appear on their last modified date in grey; scheduled posts in blue.

snippets.title: Move Posts in a Category Back to Draft After a Number of Days
snippets.description: Automatically unpublishes posts in a chosen category, such as Jobs, Offers or Events, once they are older than a set number of days, so stale listings disappear on their own.
snippets.notes: Runs twice a day in batches of 50; posts are set to draft, not deleted, so nothing is lost.

snippets.title: Unstick Sticky Posts Automatically After a Few Days
snippets.description: Removes the sticky flag from posts a set number of days after they were made sticky, so featured announcements do not stay pinned to the top of the blog forever.
snippets.notes: The countdown starts when the post is made sticky (or when this snippet first sees it); change $wpide_sticky_days.

snippets.title: Keep Custom Field Changes in Revisions
snippets.description: Saves chosen custom fields, such as a subtitle, price or event date, with every revision so restoring an older version brings those values back too.
snippets.notes: Needs WordPress 6.4 or newer; list the field keys in $wpide_revision_meta_keys.

snippets.title: Rewrite and Republish Published Posts Safely
snippets.description: Adds a "Rewrite & republish" link to published posts that creates a private working copy; when the copy is published, its content replaces the original at the same URL and the copy is removed.
snippets.notes: The original stays live and unchanged until you publish the copy; comments, URL and publish date of the original are kept.

snippets.title: Minimum Size for Featured Images
snippets.description: Stops posts from being published with a featured image smaller than the size you set, such as 1200 by 630 pixels, so social previews and hero images never look blurry.
snippets.notes: Posts without a featured image are not affected; pair it with a "require featured image" rule if you need both.

snippets.title: Fact-Check Reminder When Editing Old Posts
snippets.description: Shows a notice in the block editor when someone opens a post published more than two years ago, reminding them to check facts, links and screenshots while they are there.
snippets.notes: Change $wpide_old_post_years; the notice can be dismissed for the session.

snippets.title: Save an Excerpt Automatically When One Is Missing
snippets.description: Fills in the excerpt field from the first sentences of the post when it is saved without one, so feeds, plugins and APIs that read the stored excerpt always get a summary.
snippets.notes: Writers can still type their own excerpt, which is never overwritten; change $wpide_auto_excerpt_words for a longer summary.

snippets.title: Responsive Columns Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds [layout_columns] and [layout_col] shortcodes that place content side by side in two, three or four columns and stack them on phones, for classic editor content and page builders without a columns tool.
snippets.notes: Example [layout_columns gap="2rem"][layout_col]Left[/layout_col][layout_col]Right[/layout_col][/layout_columns]; columns share the width equally unless you add width="30%".

snippets.title: Inline SVG Icon Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds an [svg_icon] shortcode with a small built-in set of clean SVG icons, such as check, cross, star, arrow, info, warning, phone and mail, sized to match the surrounding text.
snippets.notes: Example [svg_icon name="check" color="green" label="Included"]; without a label the icon is hidden from screen readers as decoration.

snippets.title: Table From Comma-Separated Text Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [data_table] shortcode that turns comma-separated lines typed between the tags into a clean, accessible HTML table with a header row, which is much quicker than building tables by hand.
snippets.notes:
Example [data_table caption="Opening hours"]Day, Hours
Monday, 9-17[/data_table]; use delimiter=";" for semicolons and header="no" to skip the header row.

snippets.title: Pull Quote Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [pull_quote] shortcode that sets a short quotation in large type, floated to the side on wide screens and full width on phones, to break up long articles.
snippets.notes: Example [pull_quote align="right" cite="Jane Doe"]Great design is invisible.[/pull_quote]; align can be left, right or center.

snippets.title: Star Rating Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [star_rating] shortcode that shows a rating such as 4.5 out of 5 as stars, with half stars and a text label for screen readers, for reviews and comparison posts.
snippets.notes: Example [star_rating rating="4.5" max="5" color="#f5a623"]; values are clamped between 0 and max.

snippets.title: Click-to-Call Phone Number Shortcode
snippets.description: Adds a [phone_link] shortcode that prints your phone number as a tap-to-call link, formatted for reading but dialled correctly in international format, so it only needs to be changed in one place.
snippets.notes: Set $wpide_phone_number once, then use [phone_link] anywhere; [phone_link number="+44 20 7946 0000" text="Call London"] overrides it.

snippets.title: Formatted Date Shortcode With Offsets
